To address this issue, Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP)-based methods align 3D embeddings with pretrained image and text representations, giving rise to 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) that support zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, and open-vocabulary recognition of 3D shapes. This tutorial provides an overview of 3D VLMs, ranging from basic definitions of 3D representations and their encoding into embeddings to cross-modal contrastive alignment, modern multimodal frameworks, and 3D Vision-Large Language Models (3D VLLMs). We present the main definitions of contrastive learning for multimodal embedding alignment and highlight recent advances in language-guided 3D Gaussian splatting, 3D shape generation, and embodied AI for robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于3D视觉-语言模型（3D VLMs）的教程性综述，涵盖了从3D表示定义、嵌入编码到跨模态对比对齐、多模态框架以及3D视觉-大语言模型（3D VLLMs）的核心概念，并介绍了语言引导的3D高斯泼溅、3D形状生成和具身AI等领域的最新进展。
AI.motivation: 传统的3D深度学习模型通常针对特定任务（如分类、分割、检测）训练，无法自然地利用文本或图像作为查询进行跨模态检索。为解决此问题，需要将CLIP范式扩展到3D领域，构建支持零样本分类、跨模态检索和开放词汇识别的3D VLMs。
AI.method: 本文采用教程式的综述方法，系统性地介绍了3D VLMs的关键技术，包括3D表示的编码、基于CLIP对比学习的跨模态嵌入对齐、多模态框架设计以及3D VLLMs的构建，同时梳理了3D高斯泼溅、3D形状生成和具身AI等前沿方向的进展。
AI.result: 本文系统梳理了3D VLMs从基础到前沿的完整技术体系，展示了基于CLIP对齐方法的3D embedding如何与预训练的图像和文本表示对齐，从而实现zero-shot分类、跨模态检索和开放词汇的3D形状识别。
AI.conclusion: 3D VLMs通过将CLIP对齐范式引入3D领域，有效解决了传统3D模型缺少跨模态能力的问题，并在3D视觉-大语言模型、语言引导的3D生成和具身AI等方面展现出广阔的应用前景。

title: From Narrative to Auditable Forecasts: A Structured Scaffold for Agentic Forecasting
summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for live forecasting, where they retrieve up-to-date information and produce estimates for unresolved future events. However, current agentic forecasting often relies on implicit narrative aggregation: agents collect evidence, discuss it in prose, and often assign a probability without an explicit update path from evidence to forecast. This limits both forecasting accuracy and auditability. We propose AuditForecast, an agentic scaffold for structured probabilistic forecasting. AuditForecast first anchors the forecast with a suitable quantitative baseline model, uses model-guided data retrieval to derive a base probability, and then applies situational factor updates outside the model's scope through mechanical aggregation in odds space. This turns forecasting from a prose-based judgment into a structured process with explicit intermediate objects. Across multiple live forecasting benchmarks, AuditForecast improves forecasting accuracy and calibration relative to strong agentic baselines, surpasses market-implied references in several settings, and outperforms substantially more expensive deep-research agents while remaining Pareto-dominant in the cost--accuracy tradeoff. Beyond performance gains, AuditForecast produces an auditable forecasting report that makes forecast construction explicit and supports systematic post hoc analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了AuditForecast框架，通过结构化概率预测方法（先锚定量化基线模型、用模型引导检索导出基础概率、再在赔率空间进行情境因子更新）替代隐式叙述聚合，在多个实时预测基准上提升了准确性和校准度，同时生成可审计的预测报告。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体预测依赖隐式叙述聚合，证据收集后往往直接给出概率，缺乏从证据到预测的显式更新路径，这既限制了预测准确性，也限制了可审计性。
AI.method: AuditForecast采用三步结构化流程：首先用合适的量化基线模型锚定预测，其次通过模型引导的数据检索导出基础概率，最后在赔率空间中通过机械化聚合应用模型范围之外的情境因素更新。
AI.result: 在多个实时预测基准上，AuditForecast相比强智能体基线提升了准确性和校准度，在多个场景超过市场隐含参考，并优于成本高得多的深度研究智能体，在成本-准确率权衡上保持帕累托优势。
AI.conclusion: AuditForecast将预测从基于散文的判断转变为具有显式中间对象的可结构化过程，不仅提升性能，还生成可审计的预测报告，使预测构建透明化并支持系统的后验分析。

title: SceneMosaic: Efficient and Diverse Simulation-Ready Scene Generation via Hybrid Agentic Layout Evolution
summary: Diverse and simulation-ready indoor scenes are essential for interactive entertainment and embodied AI, yet their scalable generation remains challenging. Recent agentic text-to-3D scene pipelines that rely on vision-language models (VLMs) can generate scenes of high fidelity but require costly iterative object placement and refinement. Another mainstream paradigm, parametric image-to-3D scene models, produces scenes efficiently from strong priors learned from 2D images but often leads to imprecise and physically invalid scenes. More importantly, both paradigms struggle to output diverse scenes for a single input, making it hard for them to reflect the dynamically changing nature of real scenes. In this paper we propose \textbf{SceneMosaic}, a framework that combines the merits of both paradigms. It obtains the initial candidate from the learned image-based prior, and subsequently evolves the result through VLM agents, ensuring both efficiency and physical validity. Within the evolution process, SceneMosaic exploits the locality of natural scenes and decomposes a scene into independent local units, allowing separate evolution within each unit before composing the global scene via Cartesian product. On SceneEval-100, SceneMosaic matches the strongest agentic baseline in semantic layout quality with a 24x speedup, substantially reduces physical violations, and receives the highest human ratings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rxjfighting/SceneMosaic.

AI.tldr: SceneMosaic是一个结合图像先验和VLM智能体的室内3D场景生成框架，通过将场景分解为局部单元独立演化再组合，实现了高效、物理有效且多样化的场景生成，在SceneEval-100上达到与最强agentic基线相当的质量且提速24倍。
AI.motivation: 现有室内3D场景生成方法存在两难：基于VLM的agentic管线生成保真度高但迭代成本昂贵；基于图像的参数化模型虽高效但结果不精确且物理无效。且两类方法都难以对单一输入产生多样化场景，无法反映真实场景的动态变化特性。
AI.method: SceneMosaic融合两种范式的优势：首先从图像先验获取初始候选场景，然后通过VLM智能体进行演化优化以保证效率和物理有效性。演化过程利用自然场景的局部性将场景分解为独立的局部单元，各单元分别演化，最后通过笛卡尔积组合为全局场景以实现多样性。
AI.result: 在SceneEval-100基准上，SceneMosaic在语义布局质量上与最强agentic基线相当，提速24倍，大幅减少物理违规，并获得最高的人类评分。
AI.conclusion: SceneMosaic成功证明了两类场景生成范式的互补融合是可行的，能够在保证质量和物理合理性的同时显著提升效率和场景多样性。

title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{MixReward}, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose \textbf{UniRRM}, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MixReward大规模多语言数据集（覆盖6个领域、103种语言，含成对和列表数据）及UniRRM统一推理奖励模型，支持多语言和多样评估范式。UniRRM通过分段推理链动态生成任务通用与指令特定标准，实现细粒度自适应判断。实验表明UniRRM-8B和UniRRM-14B在多个基准上达到同规模SOTA水平，且在未见评估范式上依然有效。
AI.motivation: 开放域任务中奖励模型的可靠性是关键挑战。现有方案要么依赖昂贵的专有LLM-as-a-Judge系统，要么使用缺乏可解释性的不透明标量奖励模型；生成式奖励模型虽有前景，但受限于静态评估标准、碎片化评估范式和有限的多语言支持。
AI.method: 提出MixReward大规模多语言数据集（6领域、103语言、包含pairwise和listwise数据），并在此基础上提出UniRRM统一推理奖励模型。UniRRM采用分段推理链（staged reasoning chain），动态生成任务通用与指令特定评估标准，支持多种语言与评估范式，实现细粒度且输入自适应的判断。
AI.result: UniRRM-8B和UniRRM-14B在多个基准上达到与同规模模型相媲美的性能（接近最优），并能有效处理未见过的评估范式；消融实验验证了模型的可靠性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: UniRRM通过动态生成评估标准并统一多语言、多范式评估，解决了现有奖励模型在可靠性、可解释性和泛化性方面的不足，为开放域RL场景中的奖励建模提供了新的可行方案。

title: Time-Aware Assistive Navigation
summary: Can interactive vision-and-language agents learn not just what to say but also \textbf{\textit{when}} to say it? Current language models rarely plan over whether and when to realize a real-time response to a user. However, providing accurate and timely support for human decision-making, such as when guiding visually impaired individuals through urban environments, requires careful real-time responsiveness--poorly timed responses can distract users or add unnecessary cognitive load. As a machine intelligence challenge for Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based agents, we introduce a large-scale multimodal benchmark for an egocentric, assistive navigation task in complex outdoor environments. Using this benchmark, we uncover a fundamental limitation of off-the-shelf MLLMs in delivering safe and time-sensitive navigation instructions, even with model fine-tuning on substantial amounts of data. We then demonstrate that a simple yet effective modification of the model, including direct supervision to predict the underlying reason for each instruction, yields significant performance gains across open-loop, closed-loop, and sim-to-real generalization settings. However, our analysis highlights persistent challenges in temporal reasoning, safety-critical object awareness, and relational and distance understanding. To advance the development of scalable assistive agents, we will release our simulation, benchmark, and code (available at the project website: https://timeli-icra.github.io/).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个大规模多模态基准，用于评估基于MLLM的智能体在执行以自我为中心的无障碍导航任务时，是否能在正确的时间提供正确的导航指令。研究发现现成的MLLM即使经过大量微调，仍难以提供安全且时间敏感的导航反馈；通过在模型中添加直接监督以预测每条指令背后的原因，可以在开环、闭环及仿真到现实泛化等设置中取得显著的性能提升，但时间推理、安全隐患物体感知以及距离和关系理解仍是挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型很少规划是否以及何时向用户提供实时响应，但在引导视障人群穿越城市环境等辅助场景中，糟糕的响应时机可能分散用户注意力或增加认知负担，因此亟需研究MLLM在时间敏感的实时辅助导航中的能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个面向复杂户外环境的大规模基于自我中心视角的无障碍导航多模态基准，并提出了一个简单有效的模型改进方法：在训练中直接监督模型预测每条导航指令背后的原因，以增强模型的时序决策能力。
AI.result: 公开可用的MLLM在提供安全且时间敏感的导航指令方面存在根本性缺陷，即使经过大量数据微调也是如此。添加原因预测的直接监督显著提升了模型在开环、闭环和仿真到真实泛化设置中的性能。
AI.conclusion: 尽管方法有效，但时间推理、安全隐患相关的物体识别、关系与距离理解方面仍然存在持续挑战，作者将开放仿真环境、基准和代码以推动可扩展辅助智能体的发展。

title: Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models
comment: EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: https://github.com/NLP2CT/NGFT
summary: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting, which current methods typically address in isolation and lack a unified optimization signal to bridge data selection, parameter updates, and knowledge preservation. To address this, we propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, which identifies essential neurons in a single forward pass to concentrate updates and reduce redundancy; (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states, deepening representation learning and preserving general knowledge. Experimental results across three models across both domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that NGFT significantly outperforms existing mainstream fine-tuning methods in both efficiency and performance, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NGFT框架，利用神经元激活模式作为统一代理，通过任务特定神经元选择、基于激活的数据选择和激活对齐损失三个协同机制，同时解决全参数微调中的参数冗余、数据质量不一致和灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有全参数微调存在参数冗余、数据质量不均和灾难性遗忘三大问题，且当前方法通常是孤立地处理这些问题，缺乏一个统一的优化信号来桥接数据选择、参数更新和知识保留。
AI.method: NGFT框架包含三个协同机制：(1)自适应任务特定神经元选择——通过单次前向传播识别关键神经元以集中更新；(2)基于激活的数据选择——优先选择对关键神经元贡献最大的信息密集样本；(3)神经元激活对齐——一种新损失函数，将激活锚定到预训练状态，深化表征学习并保留通用知识。
AI.result: 在三个模型上的领域特定和通用基准测试中，NGFT在效率和性能上均显著优于现有主流微调方法，同时有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: NGFT通过神经元激活模式这一统一代理成功整合了数据选择、参数更新和知识保留三个微调环节，为监督微调提供了一个更高效、更稳健的整体框架。

title: Unsupervised Transfer Clustering for Mitigating Cold Start in Active Prompt Learning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are able to achieve impressive zero-shot classification performance by aligning visual and textual representations, but each new task still demands handcrafted prompts. Active Prompt Learning (APL) combines Active Learning (AL) and Prompt Learning (PL) into a single framework, allowing for the usage of the VLM prior knowledge for iteratively querying the most informative images to be labeled. However, the cold-start problem is still relevant for APL methods, where the performance of the initial query can be worse than random sampling. While recent state-of-the-art APL methods mitigate with balanced sampling and multimodal features, they rely on rigid, distance-based clustering to group these features. This simplistic approach can struggle to capture the complex, high-dimensional semantic distributions inherent to VLMs, leading to suboptimal query representativeness. Unsupervised transfer can be applied to these features as a possible alternative, since it is capable of inferring the underlying human labeling of a task without any form of supervision. This way, samples can be grouped in semantically coherent clusters. This paper proposes Unsupervised Transfer Clustering with Selective Querying (UTC+SQ), a framework that enhances a recent APL approach by leveraging state-of-the-art unsupervised transfer model. These models generate high-fidelity pseudo-labels that establish semantically meaningful clusters, allowing for the selection of more relevant samples. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that shifting from distance-based to projection-based clustering improves the representativeness of the queried subset, achieving accuracy gains in 6 of the 8 datasets tested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UTC+SQ框架，利用无监督迁移聚类替代传统距离聚类，来改进主动提示学习（APL）中的冷启动问题，在8个数据集中有6个取得了精度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的APL方法虽然通过平衡采样和多模态特征缓解了冷启动问题，但其依赖的距离聚类方法难以捕捉VLM中高维语义分布，导致查询子集的代表性不足。
AI.method: 提出UTC+SQ框架，将无监督迁移模型应用于APL流程，生成高保真伪标签以建立语义连贯的簇，从而选择更具代表性的样本进行标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，从距离聚类转向投影聚类能提升查询子集的代表性，在8个测试数据集中有6个取得了精度增益。
AI.conclusion: 无监督迁移聚类是优于距离聚类的一种特征分组方式，能有效提升APL方法的查询质量和下游分类性能。

title: Solving versus Verifying: Catching Contradictions in Tax Reasoning Systems
comment: Accepted for the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: Large language models now compute correct tax liabilities on over 90% of well-formed cases in statutory benchmarks, which makes them candidates for the tax-advisory and compliance systems that consume such an answer directly. Real legal inputs, however, are frequently defective: required facts are missing, or stated facts contradict one another. Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong. This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input? We study six recent models on SARA-derived tax cases under missing-fact and contradictory-fact perturbations. The strongest models abstain when a fact is missing but compute through injected contradictions, returning the clean-input answer 63-76% of the time with no signal of the conflict; asked instead to verify the same input, they flag most of those contradictions. We wire that verification call into a simple contradiction gate: one extra call that abstains when the model reports a conflict. Across all six models it recovers most of the missed contradiction abstention at a clean-accuracy cost of at most about 5 percentage points, with no training and no external tooling. High accuracy on well-formed inputs is therefore an incomplete measure of reliability, and the detection the solver misses is cheaply recoverable with a single self-check.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型在税务合规场景中对有缺陷输入（缺失事实/矛盾事实）的行为表现。发现最强模型在事实缺失时会弃权，但面对矛盾输入仍会给出答案（63-76%无冲突信号）。通过增加一次验证调用构成"矛盾门控"，可在无需训练和外部工具的情况下恢复大部分遗漏的矛盾弃权，且干净准确率损失不超过约5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在干净法规模数据上计算税务负债准确率超过90%，使其成为税务咨询与合规系统的候选方案。然而真实法律输入常存在缺失或矛盾的事实缺陷，模型在干净基准上的高准确率无法反映其在缺陷输入下的行为。若系统直接对有缺陷的输入计算结果，会返回一个充满自信的数字却不给出任何异常提示，这构成严重风险。
AI.method: 在SARA衍生的税务案例上，通过两种扰动（缺失事实与矛盾事实）测试六个最新模型的行为。首先检验模型在缺陷输入下是否弃权；其次检验模型在单独收到验证任务时能否发现缺陷。最后将验证调用整合为简单的"矛盾门控"机制：当模型报告冲突时即弃权，额外增加一次自我检查调用。
AI.result: 最强模型在事实缺失时会弃权，但对注入的矛盾会继续计算，63-76%的情况下返回干净输入的答案且无冲突信号。当被要求验证同一输入时，模型能标记出大部分矛盾。将验证调用接入矛盾门控后，六种模型均恢复了大部分遗漏的矛盾弃权，干净准确率代价最多约5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 高准确率在干净合法输入上是对可靠性不完整的衡量。求解器遗漏的矛盾检测可以通过一次自检廉价恢复，无需训练或外部工具。这揭示了对缺陷输入的稳健性应成为评估LLM在专业领域（如税务法律）部署时的重要维度。

title: Facial Age Estimation for Age Fraud Detection in National ID Systems
summary: Identity fraud during biometric enrollment and updates remains a major challenge for large-scale national identity systems. A common fraud vector is misrepresenting one's age to access age-restricted services or welfare schemes. In this work, we present SwinAge, a facial age estimation system designed for use within the Aadhaar biometric enrollment pipeline, to assist quality-check (QC) operators to flag potential age-related fraud. This is critical for a system like Aadhaar (the world's largest national identity programme), that holds about 1.5 billion unique identities, with 22.4 million new enrollments and 283 million updates in the last year. Building upon the SwinFace architecture with landmark-based similarity (warp affine) alignment, we train on a large in-house dataset of 1.45 million face images and evaluate on an independent, age-stratified test set of 283K images, both drawn from an ethnically diverse population of 716K unique subjects. We investigate three Aadhaar-specific operational thresholds (5, 18, and 60 years) and propose a deployment triage framework that flags suspected cases for manual review. Following NIST FATE, we report false acceptance/rejection rates (FAR/FRR) at each threshold rather than aggregate accuracy: at 1% FAR the model achieves an FRR of 3% (<5yrs), 0.4% (>18yrs) and 11.0% (>60yrs). SwinAge achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.94 years on the same test set, outperforming three zero-shot vision language models on all benchmarks, and improving the state-of-the-art on 5 out of 7 public benchmark datasets. We further report per-gender errors and distill lessons for national identity programs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SwinAge，一个用于Aadhaar生物识别登记流程中辅助质检人员识别年龄欺诈的面部年龄估计系统。该系统基于SwinFace架构，在包含716K独特受试者、145万张面部图像的数据集上训练，并在283K图像上评估。针对5岁、18岁和60岁三个操作阈值提出部署分流框架，在1%假接受率下分别实现3%、0.4%和11.0%的假拒绝率，MAE达2.94年，在5/7个公开基准数据集上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模国家身份系统中的年龄欺诈（如虚报年龄以获取年龄限制服务或福利）是一个重大挑战。Aadhaar作为全球最大的国家身份计划，持有约15亿唯一身份信息，每年有大量新登记和更新，亟需高效准确的年龄验证工具来辅助质检人员识别潜在欺诈。
AI.method: 基于SwinFace架构并采用基于地标的相似性（warp affine）对齐，在145万张面部图像的内部数据集上训练模型。针对Aadhaar特定的5岁、18岁、60岁三个操作阈值，提出一个部署分流框架，将疑似年龄欺诈案例标记供人工复核。遵循NIST FATE标准，采用每个阈值下的假接受率/假拒绝率（FAR/FRR）而非聚合精度进行评估。
AI.result: 在1%假接受率下，模型的假拒绝率分别为：<5岁为3%，>18岁为0.4%，>60岁为11.0%。同一测试集上的平均绝对误差（MAE）为2.94年，在7个公开基准数据集的5个上超越现有最优方法，并在所有基准上优于三个零样本视觉语言模型。研究还报告了按性别划分的误差。
AI.conclusion: SwinAge展示了在大规模国家身份系统中用于年龄欺诈检测的可行性和有效性，为Aadhaar等国家级身份项目提供了实用的年龄估算工具，并总结了面向国家身份项目部署的经验教训。

title: SurveyAgent-HKA: A multi-agent framework for scientific survey generation with LLMs and human knowledge augmentation
summary: Automatic scientific survey generation has become an important task in scientific document processing. The common approach of retrieving literature from a single source (e.g., arXiv) and generating surveys through a one-pass large language model (LLM) call often leads to limited reference coverage and, more importantly, fails to replicate the expert-driven revision process that is crucial for writing high-quality surveys. In this paper, we introduce SurveyAgent-HKA, a multi-agent framework that improves end-to-end scientific survey generation by incorporating knowledge derived from published surveys and peer-review comments. The framework decomposes survey generation into well-defined sub-tasks handled by LLM-powered agent. It first retrieves relevant papers from multiple sources and identifies key topics through clustering to construct an initial outline, which is then refined using outlines from related human-written surveys. Based on the refined outline, topic-focused papers are retrieved and re-ranked to select for drafting a well-grounded survey. Then, we identify common issues raised by experts in peer-review comments from published surveys to guide the revisions and finalize the survey. Experiments on two domains show that our approach outperforms mainstream baselines in citation quality, structural consistency, and content quality. Furthermore, our framework is efficient in both time and cost, making it a practical solution for broader AI-assisted scientific writing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurveyAgent-HKA，一个多智能体框架，通过融合已发表综述的知识和同行评审意见来改进端到端科学综述生成。该框架将综述生成分解为多个子任务，包括多源文献检索、聚类主题发现、基于人类综述大纲的精细化、主题聚焦的论文重排序，以及利用同行评审反馈指导修订。在两个领域上的实验表明，该方法在引用质量、结构一致性和内容质量方面优于主流基线，且时间和成本高效。
AI.motivation: 现有自动科学综述生成方法通常从单一来源（如arXiv）检索文献并使用单次大语言模型调用生成综述，导致参考文献覆盖范围有限，更重要的是无法复现专家驱动的修订过程，而这一过程对撰写高质量综述至关重要。
AI.method: 提出SurveyAgent-HKA多智能体框架，具体包括：1) 从多个来源检索相关论文并通过聚类识别关键主题以构建初始大纲；2) 利用相关人类撰写的综述大纲对初始大纲进行细化；3) 基于细化后的大纲检索主题聚焦的论文并进行重排序，以选取用于起草的论文；4) 从已发表综述的同行评审评论中提取专家提出的常见问题，用于指导综述的修订和最终定稿。整个过程由多个LLM驱动的智能体协作完成。
AI.result: 在两个领域的实验中，该方法在引用质量、结构一致性和内容质量方面优于主流基线模型。此外，该框架在时间和成本方面也具有高效性，适合更广泛的AI辅助科学写作应用。
AI.conclusion: SurveyAgent-HKA通过引入源自人类综述和同行评审的外部知识，有效解决了现有单源、单次LLM生成方法的局限，证明了多智能体框架和专家反馈机制在科学综述生成中的有效性，为大规模AI辅助学术写作提供了实用方案。

title: Srijika: OpenType-Layout-Reusing Font Restyling for Nine Indic Scripts
summary:
We present Srijika, a system for producing installable OpenType fonts for nine Brahmic scripts: Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, and Odia. Rather than generating fonts from scratch, Srijika restyles glyph outlines from shaping-complete template fonts. It preserves the template's cmap and GSUB closure and its GPOS data under a documented metric policy, making every output a complete font by construction. This addresses a central challenge of Indic font generation: hundreds to thousands of conjuncts, half forms, and matra variants must remain mutually consistent under OpenType shaping.
  Srijika produces 66 TTFs: 57 curated presets and nine open-vocabulary showcase fonts. All pass the OpenType Sanitizer, while HarfBuzz and CoreText reproduce the template glyph-ID sequences on conjunct-heavy probes. A full-closure audit covering 80,915 glyphs and 54,812 anchors quantifies metric changes. Natural-language style selection uses Lipika, a retrieval index over approximately 650 open-license font families. A reference-conditioned latent diffusion model redraws template glyphs in the selected style, followed by content gating, harmonization, and shaped-cluster verification with fallback to template outlines.
  We evaluate against no-learning baselines. On diffusion-training-family-held-out SSIM gates, template copying outperforms generation on 50 of 56 faces. Style movement is measurable only with an internal same-model embedding whose training corpus includes the held-out families, so these results require caution. A learned baseline, independent style metric, and human study are outside this report's scope. Our contributions are the layout-reusing formulation and pipeline, its nine-script audit and benchmark, and a negative-results catalogue covering failed conditioning, objective choices, and data-hull limits of reference-guided restyling.

AI.tldr: Srijika是一个为九种天城文系文字（如梵文、泰米尔文、孟加拉文等）生产可安装OpenType字体的系统。它不从头生成字体，而是基于shaping完整的模板字体重新造型字形轮廓，保留模板的cmap和GSUB闭包及GPOS数据，从而确保输出字体在OpenType shaping下结构完整。系统共生成66个TTF文件，并通过多种验证手段（OpenType Sanitizer、HarfBuzz、CoreText等）确保质量。评估结果显示，在基准测试中模板复制在某些指标上优于生成方法，作者将其定位为布局复用方案并公开了负结果目录。
AI.motivation: Indic字体生成的核心挑战在于：数以百计乃至千计的连字（conjuncts）、半形（half forms）和元音变体（matra variants）必须在OpenType shaping下保持相互一致。从头生成字体很难保证这种一致性，现有方法缺乏可行方案。
AI.method: 采用模板复用策略：从shaping完整的模板字体出发，仅重新造型字形轮廓，保留模板的cmap和GSUB闭包及GPOS数据（在文档化的度量策略下）。风格选择使用Lipika检索索引（覆盖约650个开源字体族），通过参考条件的潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion model）将模板字形重绘为目标风格，随后进行内容门控、协调化以及shaped-cluster验证，失败时回退至模板轮廓。
AI.result: 生成66个TTF（57个精选预设和9个开放词汇展示字体），全部通过OpenType Sanitizer，HarfBuzz和CoreText能复现模板的glyph-ID序列。全闭包审计覆盖80,915个字形和54,812个锚点。在SSIM门控评估中，模板复制在56个字体面中的50个上优于生成方法。风格移动仅在内部同模型嵌入中可测量，结果需谨慎对待。
AI.conclusion: 作者的贡献包括：布局复用（layout-reusing）的字体生成公式和流水线、九个脚本的审计与基准测试，以及一份记录失败的负结果目录（涵盖条件失败、目标选择和数据hull限制）。同时承认学习型基线、独立风格度量和人类研究不在本报告范围内，表明该领域仍有待探索的空间。

title: The Blindness of Document-Level Translation Evaluation
summary: Document-level machine translation (MT) evaluation extends segment-level protocols by presenting full documents to annotators, on the assumption that such presentation elicits document-level judgments. We test this assumption with a counterfactual condition (MIX) in which each document combines segments drawn from different systems, preserving document-level presentation while breaking cross-segment consistency. Across 18,420 expert Englis-to-Korean annotations and 14 automatic metrics, scores, system rankings, and error annotations are statistically equivalent between coherent and incoherent documents. Perception does not explain this: shown matched passages, raters identify the coherent one as the work of a single translator in 87.3% of trials. Document presentation does change how annotators work, but that change does not reach the recorded output. What is blind is the protocol, not the annotator. The concern is not that scores fall short, but that the resources invested in document-level systems, metrics, and annotation may not be measuring what they are intended to measure.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了文档级机器翻译评估的一个核心假设：向标注者展示完整文档是否能引发文档级判断。通过反事实实验（MIX条件）破坏文档内部一致性，发现18,420条专家标注和14个自动指标的结果在连贯与不连贯文档间统计等价，表明评估协议本身是"盲"的，而非标注者感知迟钝。
AI.motivation: 文档级MT评估假设"展示完整文档"能让标注者做出文档级判断，但这一假设从未被严格检验。研究者担心资源投入可能未测量到应有目标，因此设计实验验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 采用反事实条件（MIX）设计：将不同系统的片段拼合成"伪文档"，保留文档级展示形式但破坏跨片段一致性。对比连贯与不连贯文档下的评分、系统排名和错误标注，涉及18,420条英译韩专家标注及14个自动指标，并辅以感知测试。
AI.result: 连贯与不连贯文档在评分、系统排名和错误标注上统计等价；感知测试显示标注者能在87.3%的情况下识别连贯文档出自单一译者，说明感知能力正常，但该能力未记录到最终输出中。
AI.conclusion: 文档级MT评估协议本身是"盲"的——展示格式虽然改变了标注者的工作方式，但未影响最终记录输出。这意味着投入在文档级系统、指标和标注上的资源可能未测量其预期目标。

title: Full-Page Optical Music Recognition of Handwritten Monophonic Scores
summary: Full-page end-to-end Optical Music Recognition seeks to transcribe entire music pages directly into symbolic notation, avoiding the limitations of traditional pipelines that rely on accurate staff segmentation. Recent Transformer-based architectures have achieved strong performance on typeset scores, relying on large-scale synthetic data for pretraining. However, their applicability to handwritten music remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study full-page transcription on handwritten monophonic collections and analyze the impact of synthetic pretraining in this setting. To investigate which factors are most relevant during pretraining, we introduce a generator capable of producing visually coherent full-page scores in both typeset and handwritten styles. Experiments on three real handwritten datasets provide a comparative evaluation of several full-page pipelines and different synthetic pretraining strategies. The results suggest that the benefits of synthetic pretraining are primarily associated with learning structural layout conventions rather than with visual similarity to the target handwriting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全页面端到端光学音乐识别（OMR）在手写单声部乐谱上的应用，并分析了合成预训练在此场景中的作用。作者引入了一个能生成排版和手写风格全页乐谱的生成器，通过三个真实手写数据集的实验发现，合成预训练的收益主要来源于学习结构布局惯例，而非与目标手写风格的视觉相似性。
AI.motivation: 现有全页面端到端OMR方法在排版乐谱上表现优异，但对手写乐谱的适用性尚未被充分探索。传统管线依赖精确的乐谱分割，基于Transformer的架构依赖大规模合成数据预训练，这些方法在手写场景下的有效性需要验证。
AI.method: 提出了一个能够生成视觉连贯的排版风格和手写风格全页乐谱的生成器，用于合成预训练。通过在三个真实手写数据集上，对多个全页面OMR管线及不同合成预训练策略进行系统比较实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，合成预训练在全页面手写乐谱识别中的收益主要与学习结构性版面布局惯例相关，而非与目标手写样本的视觉相似性直接相关。这为合成预训练的设计策略提供了新的见解。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议在合成预训练中应更关注版面结构的学习而非视觉风格的逼真度，这有助于提升模型在真实手写乐谱上的端到端转录性能。研究填补了全页面OMR在手写乐谱领域的研究空白。

title: Beyond Cross-Lingual Transfer: Benchmarking Propagation Boundaries in Multilingual LLM Unlearning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning aims to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities. In multilingual settings, unlearning must additionally propagate within its intended linguistic scope. However, existing evaluations mainly measure cross-lingual transfer and cannot distinguish insufficient from excessive propagation. We introduce CLLPU (Cross-Lingual and Language-Bound Protocol for LLM Unlearning), a multilingual benchmark that formulates this problem through two settings: common-goal forgetting, where target knowledge should be suppressed across all languages, and language-conditioned forgetting, where suppression should remain confined to a designated language. CLLPU combines goal-guided topic pairing, schema-aware relation matching, and dual-anchor multilingual translation to construct 800 matched knowledge-unit pairs and 72,000 QA instances across ten languages. Experiments with six representative methods on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reveal opposite failure modes: forgetting remains incomplete when universal suppression is required, yet spreads beyond the intended boundary when language-conditioned confinement is required. We further find that general multilingual utility can conceal damage to neighbor knowledge. These findings establish propagation control as a central challenge for multilingual LLM unlearning. We publicly release CLLPU together with its construction pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLLPU，一个面向多语言LLM遗忘的多语言基准测试框架，通过"共同目标遗忘"和"语言条件遗忘"两种设定来评估遗忘的传播控制能力，发现通用遗忘不彻底、语言限定遗忘过度扩散两种相反失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘评估主要衡量跨语言迁移能力，无法区分遗忘传播不足与传播过度的问题，缺乏精确的多语言遗忘基准。
AI.method: 构建CLLPU基准，包含两种遗忘设定（共同目标遗忘与语言条件遗忘），通过目标引导的主题配对、模式感知的关系匹配和双锚多语言翻译方法，构建800对匹配知识单元和72,000个QA实例，覆盖十种语言，并在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上测试六种代表性遗忘方法。
AI.result: 实验发现截然相反的失效模式：通用遗忘场景下遗忘不彻底，而语言限制遗忘场景下遗忘过度扩散；同时发现多语言通用效用可能掩盖对相邻知识的损害。
AI.conclusion: 传播控制是多语言LLM遗忘的核心挑战，CLLPU及其构建流程已公开，为后续研究提供基准支持。

title: Bigger Text Encoders Can Hurt CLIP Zero-Shot Performance
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) is a building block of many machine learning applications. Scaling laws have guided resource allocation for large-scale training, yet prior work treats total CLIP model size as a single variable, without exploring how the capacity split between encoders impacts downstream performance. Here, we train multiple CLIP models with different vision and text encoder sizes, revealing that for most vision encoders, there is an optimal text encoder size beyond which zero-shot performance degrades---even as total parameter count increases. Exploiting this behavior yields efficient configurations that match the zero-shot performance of the standard ViT-B/16 architecture with up to 55% fewer parameters. We further show that this degradation stems from overfitting induced by the oversized text encoder, and that using modality-specific weight decay coefficients not only recovers but improves performance across all degraded configurations. A geometric analysis reveals a trade-off in which scaling the text encoder improves embedding uniformity but worsens cross-modal alignment; we further show that these metrics are predictive of zero-shot performance. We hope these findings motivate CLIP architectures and training methods that counteract this degradation, a prerequisite for scaling CLIP reliably and efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CLIP模型中视觉与文本编码器容量分配对下游性能的影响，发现对于大多数视觉编码器存在一个最优文本编码器大小，超过后即使总参数量增加性能反而下降。通过利用这一行为，可以匹配标准ViT-B/16架构的zero-shot性能但节省高达55%的参数。
AI.motivation: CLIP作为许多机器学习应用的基础组件，其扩展定律指导了大规模训练的资源配置，但以往研究将CLIP总模型大小视为单一变量，未探索编码器之间的容量分配如何影响下游性能。
AI.method: 训练多组不同视觉与文本编码器大小的CLIP模型，系统分析容量分配的影响；通过模态特定的权重衰减系数来缓解过拟合；并通过几何分析（嵌入均匀性与跨模态对齐）解释性能退化的内在机制。
AI.result: 发现过大的文本编码器会导致过拟合从而使zero-shot性能退化；利用最优容量分配可匹配ViT-B/16性能但节省55%参数；模态特定权重衰减不仅能恢复还能提升退化配置的性能；几何分析表明缩放文本编码器改善嵌入均匀性但损害跨模态对齐，且这些指标可预测zero-shot性能。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为设计CLIP架构和训练方法提供了指导，有助于抵消容量分配不当导致的性能退化，这是可靠且高效扩展CLIP的前提条件。

title: Alignment by Stereotyping: How LLMs Sacrifice Individual Distinctiveness for Cultural Adaptation
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed for personalized interaction, and demographic conditioning via user profiles is a widely adopted strategy for cultural adaptation. We ask whether this approach genuinely serves individual users or achieves accuracy by erasing individual distinctiveness. Studying seven models including frontier GPT-5.1 on the World Values Survey, we find that demographic profiles improve value alignment accuracy for most models, but at a systematic cost to individuality. That is, models pull responses toward demographic group centroids rather than preserving individual differences, a behavioral pattern we term alignment by stereotyping. Permutation tests (10,000 permutations, six demographic attributes, seven models) certify that top-performing models compress individuals far above the human baseline; within-family scaling amplifies this tradeoff while degrading intrinsic cultural understanding. Using a synthetic dialogue dataset validated on real human-chatbot conversations from PRISM (Kirk et al., 2024), we further show that distributing demographic signals across conversational turns partially suppresses prototype retrieval compared to compact demographic labels, a finding validated on real conversations via PRISM but requiring replication at larger scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了7个大语言模型（包括GPT-5.1）在个性化和文化适应中的人口统计学条件化策略，发现该方法虽能提升价值对齐准确性，但会以牺牲个体独特性为代价，使模型输出趋向人口统计群体的中心值，作者将其称为"通过刻板印象对齐"。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于个性化交互，人口统计学条件化（通过用户画像）被广泛应用以实现文化适应。作者质疑这种方法是否真正服务于个体用户，还是通过抹除个体独特性来获得准确性。
AI.method: 在World Values Survey数据集上测试7个模型（包括前沿的GPT-5.1）；采用10,000次置换检验，涵盖6个人口统计属性和7个模型；使用PRISM数据集中真实人-聊天机器人对话验证的合成对话数据集进行实验。
AI.result: 大多数模型通过人口统计画像提升了价值对齐准确性，但系统性牺牲了个体独特性——模型将响应拉向人口统计群体质心而非保留个体差异（"通过刻板印象对齐"）。置换检验证明顶级模型对个体的压缩远高于人类基线；家族内扩展放大了这种权衡并降低内在文化理解。将人口统计信号分散到对话轮次中可部分抑制原型检索（相比紧凑的人口统计标签），该发现在PRISM真实对话中验证但需更大规模复制。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计学条件化在提升价值对齐精度的同时系统性牺牲了个体独特性，存在"对齐即刻板印象化"的固有权衡；需要重新审视个性化策略中人口统计画像的使用方式。

title: RenderFormer-V2: Neural Rendering with Heterogeneous Scene Primitives
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://renderformer.github.io/v2/
summary: We present 'RenderFormer-V2', a unified learned transformer-based neural rendering model, complementary to modern physics-based rendering systems, that can handle diverse light-transport effects such as caustics, volumetric scattering, environment lighting, textured and displaced surfaces and out-of-distribution materials without per-scene training or specialized code. RenderFormer-V2 models global light transport as a sequence-to-sequence transformation. Following its predecessor, RenderFormer-V2 also employs a two stage process: a view-independent stage that resolves intra-scene primitive to primitive transport, and a view-dependent stage that transforms the internal neural scene representation into image pixels. Different from RenderFormer, our model employs a novel combined windowed-attention and rendering-informed attention sink in the view-independent stage to improve scalability while maintaining render accuracy. To further improve versatility, RenderFormerV2 supports heterogeneous scene primitives, including environment maps and participating media, and it employs a material encoding independent of the underlying surface reflectance model that encodes material appearance via a novel neural embedding. We demonstrate the versatility of RenderFormer-V2 on a variety of scenes and perform an extensive ablation of the improved attention mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RenderFormer-V2，一种基于Transformer的统一神经渲染模型，无需逐场景训练或专用代码即可处理焦散、体积散射、环境光照、纹理/置换表面及分布外材质等多种光传输效应。模型采用两阶段流程（视图无关的场景内图元间传输 + 视图相关的图像像素生成），通过改进的窗口注意力与渲染感知注意力汇机制提升可扩展性和渲染精度，并支持异构场景图元及新颖的材质神经嵌入。
AI.motivation: 现代基于物理的渲染系统在多样光传输效应下仍具挑战性，而现有神经渲染方法往往需要逐场景训练或专用代码，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。作者旨在构建一个统一的、无需特殊处理的神经渲染模型，能够处理多样化场景和材料。
AI.method: 采用两阶段Transformer架构：视图无关阶段解决场景内图元间光传输（使用新颖的组合窗口注意力与渲染感知注意力汇以提升可扩展性和精度），视图相关阶段将内部神经场景表示转换为图像像素。模型支持异构场景图元（包括环境贴图和参与介质），并通过与底层表面反射模型无关的神经嵌入编码材质外观。
AI.result: 在多种场景上验证了RenderFormer-V2的通用性和有效性，并对改进的注意力机制进行了广泛的消融实验。
AI.conclusion: RenderFormer-V2作为一种互补于物理渲染系统的统一学习框架，在保持渲染精度的同时显著提升了对复杂光照效果和异构场景元素的适应能力，为通用神经渲染提供了可行方案。

title: ModularPhaseNet: Finite-Cyclic Phase Geometry for Computable Semantic Hierarchy, Direction, and Context Consistency in Standard Transformers
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet) and arXiv:2608.15820 (QuantumPhaseNet). Theory and a pre-registered evaluation plan; no experimental results are reported
summary: We propose ModularPhaseNet, a classical and integer-computable discretization of the continuous complex phase geometry introduced in QuantumPhaseNet. The real-valued hidden states of a standard Transformer are retained, while only an auxiliary phase channel is quantized into a cyclic subgroup G = <g> of order q | (p-1) in the multiplicative group of F_p. A continuous phase e^{i phi} is represented by z = g^a mod p; phase composition becomes group multiplication, relative phase becomes group division, conceptual hierarchy is induced by a filtration of cyclic quotients, semantic direction is represented by oriented relative group elements, and contextual consistency is measured by gauge-invariant cycle holonomy. The method introduces three components into an otherwise standard Transformer: a finite-phase encoder, a quotient-filtration hierarchy module, and a group-valued connection module. Their outputs enter self-attention as real-valued bias terms. Training uses distributions in the real group algebra or straight-through Gumbel-Softmax, whereas inference uses exact modular exponentiation and precomputed tables. No quantum hardware, complex-valued matrix multiplication, or discrete-logarithm computation is required. We prove quantization-distortion bounds, nesting of quotient-induced partitions, gauge invariance, a discrete integrability result for flat connections, and boundedness of the resulting attention output. The central empirical hypothesis is that these exact discrete invariants improve hierarchy recovery, discourse alignment, contradiction detection, and calibrated hallucination-risk prediction under a controlled compute budget. This paper reports the theory together with a pre-registered evaluation plan; the experiments described in Section 14 have not yet been carried out, and no empirical result is claimed here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ModularPhaseNet，一种将连续复相位几何离散化为经典整数算术的方法，在标准Transformer中引入有限相位编码器、商滤过层级模块和群值连接模块，通过有限循环群G（阶q整除p-1）表示相位，支持精确整数推理，无需量子硬件或复值矩阵运算。论文给出理论证明和预注册实验方案，但尚未开展实证评估。
AI.motivation: 量子相位网络框架在理论上具有精确离散语义的好处，但依赖连续复值计算甚至量子硬件。作者希望通过经典整数算术离散化该框架，在标准Transformer架构中保留可计算性，同时获得离散几何不变量带来的语义优势（如层级恢复、话语对齐、矛盾检测和幻觉风险校准）。
AI.method: 在标准Transformer基础上引入三个模块：(1) 有限相位编码器，将连续相位e^{iφ}映射为模素数p的循环群元素z=g^a mod p；(2) 商滤过层级模块，利用循环群的滤过商结构诱导概念层级；(3) 群值连接模块，用规范不变的环和乐度量上下文一致性。各模块输出以实值偏置项注入自注意力。训练用实群代数分布或直通Gumbel-Softmax，推理用精确模幂和预计算表。文中还证明了量化失真界、商分区的嵌套性、规范不变性、平坦连接的离散可积性以及注意力输出的有界性。
AI.result: 本文报告的是理论结果与预注册评估计划，实验（第14节）尚未执行，未宣称任何实证结果。理论贡献包括：量化失真界、商诱导划分的嵌套性质、规范不变性、平坦连接离散可积性以及注意力输出的有界性证明。
AI.conclusion: ModularPhaseNet实现了连续复相位几何的经典整数可计算离散化，无需量子硬件、复值矩阵乘法或离散对数运算。其核心经验假设是精确离散不变量能在受控计算预算下改善层级恢复、话语对齐、矛盾检测和校准幻觉风险预测；实证验证留待后续工作。

title: SeRV: Semantic-Aligned Residual Vector Quantization for American Sign Language Generation
summary: American Sign Language (ASL) generation remains challenging due to limited paired text-ASL motion data and the difficulty of learning motion representations both precise for reconstruction and predictable from linguistic input. Existing methods rely on motion tokenizers optimized for reconstruction, without explicit semantic supervision from paired text. As a result, the learned tokens remain limited in supporting semantically consistent and fine-grained ASL motion generation. To address this limitation, we propose SeRV (Semantic-Aligned Residual Vector Quantization), a semantic-aligned RVQ tokenizer for ASL generation. SeRV learns a semantically structured residual token space by combining sentence-level motion-text alignment with token-level text-conditioned supervision. Building on this tokenizer, a Hierarchical GPT predicts residual motion tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, generating structurally coherent and semantically aligned 3D ASL motion. We further construct a large-scale reconstructed 3D ASL motion-text benchmark by recovering paired 3D motion from YouTube-ASL videos. Experiments across 375 hours of ASL video show that SeRV achieves state-of-the-art pose accuracy on both How2Sign and YouTube-ASL datasets, while producing semantically consistent 3D ASL motion directly from text.

AI.tldr: SeRV提出了一种语义对齐的残差向量量化（RVQ）分词器，用于美式手语（ASL）3D动作生成。通过将句子级运动-文本对齐与token级文本条件监督结合，学习语义结构化的残差token空间，并配合层级GPT实现从粗到细的运动生成。此外构建了大规模重建3D ASL运动-文本基准，在How2Sign和YouTube-ASL数据集上取得了最优姿态精度。
AI.motivation: 现有ASL生成方法面临两大挑战：配对的文本-ASL运动数据稀缺；以及学习既能精确重建又能从语言输入预测的运动表征困难。现有运动tokenizer仅针对重建优化，缺乏来自配对文本的显式语义监督，导致token无法支持语义一致和细粒度的ASL运动生成。
AI.method: SeRV包含三个核心组件：(1) 语义对齐的RVQ分词器，结合句子级运动-文本对齐和token级文本条件监督；(2) 层级GPT，以从粗到细的方式预测残差运动token；(3) 从YouTube-ASL视频重建配对3D运动，构建大规模3D ASL运动-文本基准。
AI.result: 在375小时的ASL视频实验中，SeRV在How2Sign和YouTube-ASL数据集上均达到最先进的姿态精度，并能从文本直接生成语义一致的3D ASL运动。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐的token空间设计能有效弥补重建与语言学预测之间的鸿沟，为手语生成提供了更精准且语义一致的运动表征方案，同时大规模重建基准进一步推动了ASL生成研究的进展。

title: Tri-PvP: Exposing Modality Bias in Omni-Modal Large Language Models through Perceptual-Propositional Evidence Conflicts
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) jointly process vision, audio, and text, yet their modality bias under cross-modal conflict remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks conflate two distinct forms of evidence within a single modality: perceptual signals (e.g., a photograph or recording of a dog) and propositional signals (e.g., the declarative claim "this is a dog"), such that any measured modality bias is inherently confounded with evidence-form bias, precluding clean attribution to either source. To address this, we introduce Tri-PvP, an 8,000-sample tri-modal conflict benchmark crossing vision, audio, and text, where vision and audio each take perceptual or propositional form. Evaluating five OLLMs, we find robust visual bias across most models and evidence-type conditions. Crucially, we reveal a systematic asymmetry in evidence-form bias: models exhibit a stronger bias toward perceptual signal in vision but propositional in audio. Further analyses via layer-wise linear probing and contrastive decoding reveal that modality bias is already linearly decodable from early representation layers and can only be partially mitigated, calling for mitigation strategies beyond surface-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tri-PvP基准（含8000个跨模态冲突样本），用于解耦OLLMs中的模态偏差与证据形式偏差，发现模型普遍存在视觉偏差，且视觉偏向感知信号而音频偏向命题信号，该偏差在早期表征层即可线性解码且难以完全缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态冲突基准将同一模态内的感知信号与命题信号混为一谈，导致测得的模态偏差与证据形式偏差相互混淆，无法干净地归因于单一来源，亟需一个能解耦这两种偏差的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建Tri-PvP基准，包含8000个跨视觉、音频和文本的三模态冲突样本，其中视觉和音频均以感知形式（如照片/录音）或命题形式（如陈述句）呈现；在五个OLLMs上评估，并辅以逐层线性探针和对比解码分析偏差的来源与可缓解性。
AI.result: 大多数模型表现出鲁棒的视觉偏差；揭示了系统性的证据形式偏差不对称性：视觉模态更偏向感知信号，而音频模态更偏向命题信号；模态偏差可从早期表征层线性解码，且仅能被部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 当前OLLMs的模态偏差根植于深层表征且难以通过表层干预消除，需要设计超越浅层干预的缓解策略，同时研究应关注跨模态冲突中的证据形式因素。

title: Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold Method for Massive Point Cloud Data
summary: Reconstructing continuous terrain manifolds from massive, unstructured airborne LiDAR point clouds remains challenging in complex Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) environments, where deep neural networks require costly point-wise annotations and nonparametric surface reconstruction methods often lack structural interpretability. This paper introduces the Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold (GLFM), a physics-informed statistical framework that represents continuous surface topography using deterministic linear functional bases while modeling microscale diffuse laser backscatter as an isotropic Gaussian process. To avoid the quadratic computational cost of exact constrained maximum likelihood estimation, we develop an algebraic singular value decomposition (SVD) rank-reduction algorithm that enables linear-time parameter estimation and closed-form quadric classification. Evaluated on 35.2 km^2 of real-world aerial LiDAR data, GLFM automatically filters ground points and extracts morphological features, achieving an adjusted Rand index (ARI) of 0.9933 against field-verified ground truth and outperforming four leading baselines while maintaining an out-of-core memory footprint. The framework provides a rigorous, interpretable, and scalable foundation for large-scale point cloud analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高斯线性函数流形（GLFM）框架，用于从未结构化机载LiDAR点云中重建连续地形表面，在复杂的野地-城市交界（WUI）环境中实现了高精度、可解释的地面滤波和形态特征提取。
AI.motivation: 大规模非结构化机载LiDAR点云在复杂环境中重建连续地形仍然具有挑战性：深度神经网络需要昂贵的逐点标注，非参数表面重建方法缺乏结构可解释性，且精确约束最大似然估计存在二次计算成本问题。
AI.method: 提出GLFM框架，用确定性线性函数基表示连续表面地形，用各向同性高斯过程建模微观尺度漫反射激光后向散射；开发基于代数奇异值分解（SVD）的秩约简算法，实现线性时间参数估计和闭式二次曲面分类。
AI.result: 在35.2平方公里真实航空LiDAR数据上，GLFM自动滤波地面点并提取形态特征，调整兰德指数（ARI）达0.9933，超越四种主流基线方法，同时保持外部内存占用。
AI.conclusion: GLFM为大规模点云分析提供了严谨、可解释且可扩展的物理信息统计框架。

title: Factors Influencing the Emergence of Dependency Length Minimization in Neural Agent Simulations
comment: This is a preprint version of the manuscript currently under review at Cognitive Science
summary: Given various grammatical options, language users prefer the word order choice that reduces the overall length of syntactic dependencies, a principle known as dependency length minimization (DLM). The origins of this preference remain an open question, particularly whether it originates from constraints on efficient information processing. Computational simulations provide a powerful approach to identifying the factors influencing the emergence of linguistic phenomena. However, previous simulations of DLM have not examined realistic interaction contexts and have produced mixed results. The present study investigates the emergence of DLM in artificial languages using a recently proposed language learning and communication framework based on recurrent neural networks (RNNs). In this framework, agents are trained to speak and interpret artificial languages and then use these languages to communicate. Using this framework, we study the impact of several factors related to processing limitations in a communicative setting, such as noise during listening, limited speaker capacity, and incremental sentence processing. Our results reveal a complex interplay among these factors in shaping word order preferences in neural agents. Specifically, in the full meaning space, agents regularize toward a single dominant word order, while in the half meaning space they show a short-before-long preference that only aligns with DLM in verb-initial languages. A consistent DLM preference emerges only when agents are subject to incremental processing pressure. These findings suggest that limitations in human cognitive processing may indeed play a role in shaping DLM. Our findings provide insights into the conditions under which neural models replicate human-like preferences and highlight the challenges of designing emergent communication models that capture human cognitive biases in language processing.

AI.tldr: 本文使用基于循环神经网络（RNN）的语言学习与交流框架，模拟了人工语言中依赖长度最小化（DLM）偏好的涌现过程。研究发现，仅在智能体面临增量式句子处理压力时，才会出现一致的DLM偏好，表明人类认知处理限制可能在塑造DLM中发挥作用。
AI.motivation: 语言使用者倾向于选择能减少句法依赖总长度的词序（依赖长度最小化，DLM），但其起源尚不清楚，尤其是是否源于高效信息处理约束。以往对DLM的计算模拟未考察现实交互情境且结果不一致，因此需要更真实的模拟框架来探究其涌现机制。
AI.method: 采用基于循环神经网络（RNNs）的语言学习与交流框架：智能体先被训练来产生和理解人工语言，随后用这些语言进行交流。研究考察了多个与处理限制相关的因素，包括听力噪声、说话者容量限制以及增量式句子处理。
AI.result: 研究发现这些因素之间存在复杂交互：在完整意义空间中，智能体趋向于单一主导词序；在半意义空间中则表现出短词在前的偏好，该偏好仅在动词居首语言中与DLM一致。只有施加增量式处理压力时，才涌现出与DLM一致的一致性偏好。
AI.conclusion: 人类认知处理的限制确实可能在塑造DLM中发挥关键作用。该研究揭示了神经模型复现人类类似偏好的条件，并指出了设计能捕捉人类认知偏好的涌现通信模型所面临的挑战。

title: GeoContext: One Context Ladder, Two Failure Modes in Vision-Language Geolocation: Flat Reliance on User-Provided Location Context and False Confirmation of Location Claims
summary:
Visual geolocation benchmarks typically ask a model where an image was captured without accounting for the location context that users often provide. We introduce GeoContext, a resource supporting two complementary tasks: GeoHint, open-ended localization given a true but coarse location hint, and GeoVerify, binary verification of whether an image was taken within 150 m of a claimed place. GeoContext constructs a context ladder by stratifying nearby reference points according to distance and referenceability, allowing the image to remain fixed while the supplied context varies. The benchmark covers 109 sites in 30 cities and evaluates five vision-language models using 21,933 GeoHint responses and 6,270 GeoVerify responses.
  Our evaluation reveals three main patterns. First, hint repetition varies by only 1.5 percentage points across referenceability tiers and by less than 3 points across distance bands, while the resulting localization error increases steadily with hint distance. Second, behavior depends strongly on no-context performance: at sites with low no-context accuracy, the median ratio between localization error and hint distance is approximately 1.00, whereas at higher-accuracy sites it ranges from 0.24 to 0.69. After correcting for bias introduced by the site grouping procedure, only one of the five models retains a negative accuracy estimate when given a nearby hint. Third, in GeoVerify, no model reaches d' = 1 for decoys immediately beyond the 150 m tolerance. Model rankings also change when sensitivity is separated from response bias, and 83.8% of false acceptances are reported with confidence of at least 0.8. We release the benchmark, construction pipeline, audit decisions, and scoring code.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍GeoContext基准，包含两个任务：GeoHint（给定粗糙地点提示进行开放域定位）和GeoVerify（验证图像是否在声称地点150米内拍摄）。基准覆盖30个城市109个地点，评估了5个视觉语言模型，发现提示距离与定位误差正相关，且模型对附近提示几乎无正面增益。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉地理定位基准未考虑用户常提供的粗粒度位置上下文，忽视了真实场景中定位任务通常伴随地点提示这一事实，缺乏对带提示定位能力的系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建GeoContext基准，通过距离和可参考性分层附近参考点形成上下文阶梯，保持图像不变而改变所给上下文。包含GeoHint（开放域定位）和GeoVerify（二元验证）两个任务，覆盖30个城市109个地点，评测5个视觉语言模型，共收集21,933条GeoHint响应和6,270条GeoVerify响应。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：（1）提示重复率在不同参考性层仅差1.5个百分点、不同距离带差不到3个百分点，但定位误差随提示距离稳定增加；（2）模型行为强烈依赖无上下文表现，校正站点分组偏差后仅一个模型在近处提示下保持负准确率估计；（3）GeoVerify任务中无模型在刚过150米容差的诱饵上达到d'=1的判别力，83.8%的错误接受置信度≥0.8。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉语言模型在利用粗粒度位置提示进行地理定位方面表现不佳，尤其在验证任务中判别敏感性不足且过于自信，提示信息对定位精度的增益有限。作者公开了基准、构建流程、审计决策和评分代码以供后续研究。

title: Generating Adversarial Texts for Machine Translation via GRPO
summary: As machine translation (MT) systems continue to improve, standard benchmarks become less informative for exposing remaining weaknesses. Traditional methods for creating challenging test sets rely on expensive manual creation or curation, while automated approaches struggle to produce sets with the necessary translation difficulty and linguistic diversity. We propose a scalable reinforcement-learning-based approach for rewriting existing source texts into instances that are more difficult to translate for MT systems. We fine-tune a large language model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using reward signals based on translation difficulty together with constraints for semantic similarity, grammaticality, and approximate length preservation. On WMT25, our approach substantially reduces average COMET translation quality from 0.63 to 0.48, while preserving grammaticality and readability, whereas the base model remains at 0.64. Evaluations on the unseen WMT19-WMT24 benchmarks confirm that this behavior generalizes beyond the training data, and human evaluation further shows that the rewrites substantially lower translation quality while incurring a moderate drop in naturalness and only a small change in grammaticality. We release our code to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（GRPO）的可扩展方法，通过微调大语言模型来重写源文本，使其对机器翻译系统更具挑战性，从而生成更具区分度的测试集。该方法在WMT25上将翻译质量从0.63降至0.48，并能在未见过的基准上泛化。
AI.motivation: 随着机器翻译系统性能不断提升，标准基准在暴露系统弱点方面变得越来越不具区分度。现有的挑战性测试集构建方法中，人工方法成本高且耗时，自动方法则难以同时保证翻译难度和语言多样性。因此需要一种可扩展且有效的方法来生成具有挑战性的测试实例。
AI.method: 采用基于强化学习的方法重写已有源文本。使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）微调大语言模型，奖励信号基于翻译难度，同时施加语义相似性、语法正确性和近似长度保持的约束。
AI.result: 在WMT25上，COMET翻译质量从0.63显著降至0.48（基线模型保持在0.64），同时保持语法性和可读性。在未见过的WMT19-WMT24基准上验证了泛化能力。人工评估确认重写后的文本显著降低翻译质量，自然度仅适度下降，语法性变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 提出的强化学习方法能够可扩展地生成高难度、高质量的挑战性MT测试集，克服了人工成本高和自动方法质量不足的问题，并已开源以支持可复现性。

title: AAMBERS-UAV: Acquisition-Aware Multimodal Backbone Evaluation and Ranking for UAV Weedy Rice Segmentation
summary: UAV image collections contain spatially and temporally related frames, yet semantic-segmentation benchmarks commonly split them at image level. Such splitting can place samples from one acquisition in both model development and testing, obscuring transfer to a genuinely new survey. Using the 734-sample WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB, we fix a 124-image target-acquisition test set and compare two protocols with identical train, validation, and test counts: target-held-out, which excludes the target acquisition from development, and target-exposed, which admits its remaining images. SegFormer-B0 is evaluated with RGB, four-band multispectral (MS), and seven-channel RGB+MS input over two fixed-split seeds. RGB is strongest under complete acquisition holdout ($0.7317\pm0.0201$ IoU), whereas RGB+MS becomes strongest after target exposure ($0.7822\pm0.0269$). A fixed-split U-Net/ResNet18 replication confirms positive exposure gains for all three inputs, but retains RGB as the best modality under both protocols. Acquisition exposure therefore increases measured performance across both evaluated backbones, while its effect on modality ranking is architecture-dependent. A supplied-split audit reveals strong near-sequential dependence, and corruption tests show that early fusion is substantially more sensitive to RGB--MS displacement than to moderate radiometric scaling. These results support acquisition-aware same-test evaluation as a necessary complement to ordinary image-level splitting in multimodal UAV benchmarks. The code and supporting the findings of this study will be publicly released upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无人机图像语义分割基准中图像级划分导致的目标采集泄漏问题，利用WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB数据集设计目标采集保留与目标采集暴露两种协议对比评估，发现SegFormer-B0在完全保留时RGB最优，暴露后RGB+MS最优，而U-Net/ResNet18在两种协议下RGB均为最佳，表明采集暴露提升性能但模态排序依赖骨干架构，主张采用采集感知的同测试集评估作为图像级划分的补充。
AI.motivation: 无人机图像语义分割基准通常按图像级随机划分数据，这会使同一航次采集的样本同时出现在训练和测试集中，从而虚增模型性能并掩盖模型对全新调查场景的真实泛化能力。
AI.method: 在734样本的WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB数据集上固定124张目标采集测试集，设计两种协议（目标保持不留式与目标暴露式），采用相同训练/验证/测试数量，使用SegFormer-B0评估RGB、四波段多光谱及RGB+MS七通道输入，并以固定划分的U-Net/ResNet18进行复现验证，同时进行数据依赖审计和损坏测试。
AI.result: 完全采集保留下RGB最强（IoU 0.7317±0.0201），暴露后RGB+MS最强（0.7822±0.0269）；U-Net/ResNet18复现确认暴露对三种输入均有正增益，但RGB在两种协议下均为最佳模态；数据依赖审计显示强近序依赖性，损坏测试表明早期融合对RGB-MS错位比对中等辐射缩放更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 采集暴露显著提升测量性能但影响模态排序的程度依赖骨干架构；采集感知的同测试集评估应作为多模态无人机基准中普通图像级划分的必要补充。

title: Don't Lose Entities from Retrieval to Generation: Dual Entity Recovery RAG for multi-hop QA
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented multi-hop question answering (QA) decomposes a query into sub-questions and decomposes the corpus into smaller retrieval units such as sentences. Both forms of decomposition improve the pipeline, but we show that both share the same vulnerability, the loss of entity information, and that this loss breaks the pipeline at two separate points. The first point is retrieval, where a sub-question loses the entity resolved at the previous hop, leaving the retriever with nothing to match against. The second point is harder to see, because retrieval still appears to succeed. Once a passage is split into sentences, an isolated sentence loses the context that grounds its pronouns, so even with the correct sentence in hand the LLM cannot tell which entity the sentence is about. We isolate this second point as a distinct failure mode that we call lost-in-generation, and a retrieval-controlled experiment shows that it degrades answers even when the gold evidence is fixed in the context. We then propose Dual Entity Recovery RAG (DER-RAG), which keeps the grounding entity explicit from retrieval through to generation with two lightweight components, a two-way query decomposition that carries the resolved entity across sub-questions and a subject entity prefix attached to each sentence at generation time. DER-RAG needs no graph construction, no corpus modification, and no fine-tuning, yet on three multi-hop QA benchmarks it matches or exceeds strong baselines, including graph-based methods that depend on costly offline structures.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有多跳问答中查询分解和语料分解（句子级）共享同一脆弱性——实体信息丢失，分别在检索和生成两个环节破坏流水线。后者被命名为"lost-in-generation"（生成中丢失），即使正确的gold证据在上下文中也会导致回答质量下降。作者提出DER-RAG方法，通过双向查询分解携带已解析实体、生成时附加主语实体前缀，无需图构建、语料修改或微调，在三个多跳QA基准上达到或超越强基线（包括依赖昂贵离线结构的图方法）。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的多跳问答通过子问题分解和句子级检索单元分解来提升性能，但作者发现这两种分解共享同一漏洞——实体信息丢失，且该丢失在检索和生成两个独立环节破坏流水线。先前工作忽视了生成环节中的这一隐藏失败模式。
AI.method: 提出DER-RAG（Dual Entity Recovery RAG），包含两个轻量组件：(1) 双向查询分解，跨子问题携带已解析的实体；(2) 主语实体前缀，在生成时附加到每个句子以保持实体指称清晰。无需图构建、语料修改或微调。
AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上，DER-RAG匹配或超越了强基线，包括依赖昂贵离线结构的基于图的方法。此外，通过检索受控实验证实"lost-in-generation"失败模式确实会降低即使gold证据在上下文中的回答质量。
AI.conclusion: 实体信息的显式保持从检索到生成全流程是解决多跳QA中分解导致的信息丢失问题的关键，且可以通过轻量级方法实现，无需依赖昂贵的离线结构。

title: MolParser-Mobile: Ultrafast OCSR System for Large-Scale Chemical Literature Mining
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) is a fundamental component of chemical literature mining, enabling molecular database construction, reaction extraction, and AI-driven scientific discovery. Despite substantial progress in recognition accuracy with recent deep learning-based methods, inference throughput remains a critical bottleneck that limits web-scale deployment. To address this challenge, we propose MolParser-Mobile, an AutoML-optimized lightweight end-to-end OCSR framework. MolParser-Mobile contains only 9.98M parameters, while reaching a throughput of 1,520 molecules per second on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090D GPU. Despite its compact design, it maintains competitive and, on several benchmarks, superior recognition accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MolParser-Mobile，一个基于AutoML优化的轻量级端到端光学化学结构识别（OCSR）框架，仅含9.98M参数，在单张NVIDIA RTX 4090D GPU上达到每秒1520个分子的吞吐量，同时保持有竞争力的识别精度。
AI.motivation: OCSR是化学文献挖掘的基础组件，尽管深度学习方法的识别精度已取得显著进展，但推理吞吐量仍是大规模网络部署的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用AutoML技术优化的轻量级端到端OCSR框架MolParser-Mobile，通过自动化的模型搜索与压缩策略在保持精度的同时大幅降低参数量和计算开销。
AI.result: 模型仅含9.98M参数，在单张NVIDIA RTX 4090D GPU上实现每秒1520个分子的推理吞吐量，同时在多个基准上保持竞争性甚至更优的识别精度。
AI.conclusion: MolParser-Mobile证明了在OCSR任务中可以通过轻量化设计兼顾高吞吐量与高精度，适用于web级大规模部署场景。

title: DPH Parser: A Bottom-Up Grammar-Driven Parser for Joint Constituency and Dependency Analysis
summary:
This paper presents Dependency-Phrase Hierarchy Parser (DPH Parser), a grammar-driven bottom-up unsupervized parsing framework inspired by Generalized Phrase Structure Grammar (GPSG) and Head-driven Phrase Structure Grammar (HPSG). The parser incrementally constructs constituency structures using a compact inventory of feature-based syntactic rules while deriving dependency relations through explicit head annotations. The system combines probabilistic POS tagging, recursive phrase projection, and weighted parse hypotheses to process realistic and partially noisy text input. Unlike purely neural and data-driven parsers, the resulting syntactic derivations remain explicitly interpretable.
  We evaluated parser performance on English corpora from the Universal Dependencies (UD) project using Unlabeled Attachment Score (UAS) as the main parsing metric, comparing the outcomes against Stanza and spaCy parsers. For a small inventory of syntactic rules, DPH parser achieved UAS values of 53.32% & 52.58% (UD Devset/Testset respectively). For the same data, Stanza achieved 89.12% & 88.67% while spaCy achieved 56.91% and 58.59%. Although the current system does not yet approach the accuracy of modern neural parsers, the results demonstrate the feasibility of applying transparent rule-based bottom-up parsing to realistic treebank data while jointly producing constituency and dependency structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DPH Parser，一个受GPSG和HPSG启发的基于语法的自底向上无监督解析框架，能够增量构建短语结构并同时推导依存关系。该解析器在UD英文语料上的UAS为53%，远低于Stanza（89%）和spaCy（57%），但证明了透明规则驱动解析方法的可行性。
AI.motivation: 纯神经和数据驱动的解析器虽然准确率高，但其句法推导过程缺乏可解释性。作者旨在探索一种规则驱动的解析框架，能够在处理真实且含噪文本的同时保持句法推导的显式可解释性，并同时产出短语结构和依存结构。
AI.method: DPH Parser采用自底向上的语法驱动解析方式，结合了(G)PSG和HPSG的思想，利用紧凑的特征化句法规则清单增量构建成分结构，通过显式的中心词标注推导依存关系。系统整合了概率POS标注、递归短语投射和加权解析假设来处理真实含噪文本。
AI.result: 在UD英语语料上，DPH Parser的UAS为53.32%（开发集）和52.58%（测试集），对比Stanza的89.12%/88.67%和spaCy的56.91%/58.59%。当前系统的准确率尚未接近现代神经解析器水平。
AI.conclusion: 尽管DPH Parser在准确率上不及神经解析器，但结果验证了透明规则驱动的自底向上解析方法应用于真实树库数据的可行性，并证明其能够联合产出成分结构和依存结构。

title: CoRe-SAM3: Conditional Semantic--Visual Reconciliation for SAM3 Crack Segmentation
summary: Crack segmentation requires a model to recognize target semantics while accurately recovering thin, low-contrast, and topologically continuous local structures. Although SAM3 provides strong open-concept segmentation, its direct application to the crack domain still misses weak cracks, activates crack-like background regions, and produces local boundary errors. We first diagnose the functional differences between the internal prompt-conditioned semantic representation and native visual representation of SAM3 on five crack datasets. The results show that the semantic representation already carries most task information for crack prediction, whereas the utility of the visual representation depends on the current semantic state. Directly combining the two representations does not yield consistent gains. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic--Visual Reconciliation, termed CoRe. CoRe retains semantic prediction as the primary decision path, applies lightweight semantic calibration to adjust the target-domain decision mapping, and uses spatially aligned native visual evidence to generate a zero-initialized, bounded, and regularized conditional residual that selectively corrects existing predictions. Across five domains, CoRe-SAM3 improves the average Crack IoU from 62.34% to 70.47% and clDice from 81.98% to 89.24%, while introducing only 18.914 K trainable parameters. Prediction-transition analysis further shows that CoRe corrects an average of 34.38% of native errors, with a damage rate of only 0.23% on pixels correctly classified by native SAM3. These results demonstrate that constrained prediction correction based on the functional differences between internal representations provides an effective and parameter-efficient target-domain adaptation strategy for vision foundation models with strong task-specific semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRe（条件语义-视觉调和）方法，用于改进SAM3基础模型在裂缝分割任务中的表现。通过诊断SAM3内部语义表征与视觉表征的功能差异，保留语义预测为主决策路径，并使用对齐的视觉证据生成有界、零初始化的条件残差来有选择地修正预测。在五个裂缝数据集上，裂纹IoU从62.34%提升至70.47%，clDice从81.98%提升至89.24%，仅引入18.914K可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 直接应用SAM3到裂缝领域存在明显缺陷：漏检弱裂纹、激活裂纹样背景区域、产生局部边界误差。作者希望通过诊断SAM3内部提示条件化语义表征与原生视觉表征的功能差异，寻找一种基于表征功能差异的、参数高效的领域适配策略。
AI.method: 首先在五个裂缝数据集上诊断SAM3内部提示条件化语义表征与原生视觉表征的功能差异；基于发现（语义表征已携带大部分任务信息，视觉表征效用依赖于当前语义状态，直接组合无一致增益），提出CoRe：保留语义预测作为主决策路径，应用轻量语义校准调整目标域决策映射，并使用空间对齐的原生视觉证据生成零初始化、有界且正则化的条件残差，选择性地修正既有预测。
AI.result: 在五个裂缝数据集上，CoRe-SAM3将平均裂纹IoU从62.34%提升至70.47%，clDice从81.98%提升至89.24%，仅引入18.914K可训练参数。预测转换分析显示，CoRe平均纠正了34.38%的原生误差，且仅对SAM3正确分类像素造成0.23%的损害率。
AI.conclusion: 基于内部表征功能差异的有约束预测修正，为具有强任务特定语义先验的视觉基础模型提供了一种有效且参数高效的领域适配策略。该方法验证了"内部表征功能差异引导的约束修正"这一范式的有效性。

title: From Two Passes to One: Compact and Efficient Target-Stance Extraction
summary: Target-Stance Extraction (TSE) is the task of predicting both the target (or topic) of an author's writing and the author's stance toward it. Existing approaches to TSE use a sequential pipeline of two separate neural models: one to identify the target and another to determine the stance. We present a one-pass, joint architecture that predicts both in a single forward pass, reducing trainable parameters by nearly 50% with only a 4-7 F1 point tradeoff in performance. We further demonstrate that standard target-scrubbing practices artificially suppress target prediction accuracy. Retaining explicit target mentions, as in real-world deployments, improves F1 by at least 6 points across both target classification and target generation settings. These improvements allow for significantly easier integration of TSE in downstream applications such as public opinion tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单遍联合架构用于目标-立场抽取（TSE），同时预测写作目标和作者立场，相比传统顺序流水线方法减少近50%的可训练参数，仅付出4-7个F1点的性能代价；同时指出标准的目标擦除（target-scrubbing）实践会人为降低目标预测精度，保留显式目标提及可将F1提升至少6个点。
AI.motivation: 现有TSE方法采用两个独立神经模型的顺序流水线来分别完成目标识别和立场判定，缺乏联合建模的效率与优势；此外，标准的目标擦除预处理方式不反映真实部署场景，人为压低了目标预测的准确性。
AI.method: 提出一种单次前向传播即可同时预测目标和立场的联合架构，代替原有两阶段顺序流水线；同时对比目标擦除与保留显式目标提及两种设置下的性能，分别在目标分类和目标生成两种场景下进行验证。
AI.result: 联合架构将可训练参数减少近50%，性能仅损失4-7个F1点；在保留目标提及的情况下，目标分类和生成场景的F1均提升至少6个点。
AI.conclusion: 联合单遍架构在显著降低参数量的同时保持可接受的性能水平，且保留显式目标提及更贴近真实部署场景并能大幅提升目标预测精度，从而使TSE更容易集成到舆论追踪等下游应用中。

title: Map the Possibilities: Spatial Belief Fields for Language-Goal Aerial Navigation
summary: Language-goal aerial navigation requires an agent to local- ize a potentially unobserved target from relational instruc- tions and partial observations, and translate this inference into metric actions in large-scale continuous environments. Existing methods often reduce language grounding to one single waypoint or action, prematurely collapsing the spatial uncertainty inherent in incomplete evidence and ambiguous relations. To address this limitation, we introduce SBFNav, a closed-loop navigation framework centered on a language- conditioned Spatial Belief Field (SBF). Unlike ego-centric maps that primarily record what has been observed, SBF rep- resents a task-conditioned distribution over plausible target locations, preserving multiple spatial hypotheses under par- tial evidence. At each step, this distribution is updated from accumulated observations as new evidence becomes avail- able. Built on this representation, SBFNav selects the goal that best aligns with the instruction and observations as a met- ric waypoint for control. Experiments on both the original and revised CityNav benchmarks achieve the best reported overall performance. On the Test Unseen split, our method improves SR from 25.91% to 32.29% and SPL from 19.63% to 30.43%. Ablation studies further confirm the advantages of spatial-belief modeling over single-point prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBFNav，一种基于语言条件空间信念场的闭环导航框架，通过维护目标位置的概率分布而非单点预测，在CityNav基准上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在语言导航中过早地将语言接地（language grounding）压缩为单一航点或动作，未能充分处理部分观测和模糊关系带来的空间不确定性，导致导航决策不佳。
AI.method: 提出语言条件空间信念场（Spatial Belief Field），在每一步根据累积观测更新关于目标可能位置的分布，保留多个空间假设，然后选择与指令和观测最一致的度量航点进行控制。采用闭环导航框架，在大型连续环境中逐步推断和行动。
AI.result: 在CityNav原始和修订基准上均取得最佳综合性能。在Test Unseen划分中，SR从25.91%提升到32.29%，SPL从19.63%提升到30.43%。消融实验证实了空间信念建模优于单点预测。
AI.conclusion: 空间信念建模相比单点预测能更有效地处理导航中的空间不确定性，为语言目标导航提供了新的表示和决策范式。

title: STQA: A Benchmark for Stock-Focused Tabular Question Answering over Historical and Forecasted Data
comment: 9 pages of main text, 15 pages of appendices, 19 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Stock market analysis inherently requires composite reasoning over historical records and future projections, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across isolated tasks. We introduce STQA (Stock-focused Tabular Question Answering), an end-to-end benchmark designed to systematically evaluate natural-language question answering over historical data, numerical forecasts, and forecast-based reasoning. Built on a large-scale financial dataset, STQA covers 4,417 stocks and contains 31,400 question-answer pairs derived from expert-crafted templates, accompanied by fine-grained intent and slot annotations. To operationalize this benchmark, we present SQFRS (Stock Query-Forecast-Reasoning System), an agent-based unified framework that orchestrates SQL retrieval and time-series forecasting tools. Experiments demonstrate that while current large language models perform well on historical queries, forecast-based reasoning poses a substantial challenge, revealing critical bottlenecks in tool coordination and reasoning under uncertainty. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/xuxubaobaoan/STQA_Project. STQA thus serves as a rigorous testbed for future research on trustworthy, tool-augmented financial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了STQA（股票表格问答）基准测试，用于系统性评估大语言模型在历史数据查询、数值预测及基于预测的推理任务上的表现，并配套提出了SQFRS（股票查询-预测-推理系统）作为统一的智能体框架。实验表明现有大模型在历史查询上表现良好，但在预测推理上存在显著瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 股票市场分析本质上需要对历史记录和未来预测进行复合推理，但现有基准测试分散在孤立的单一任务上，缺乏一个端到端、系统化评估模型综合能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建了STQA基准测试（涵盖4,417只股票和31,400个问答对，基于专家设计的模板生成并附带细粒度的意图与槽位标注），并提出了SQFRS，一个基于智能体的统一框架，通过编排SQL检索和时间序列预测工具来完成问答任务。
AI.result: 实验发现当前大语言模型在历史查询任务上表现良好，但在基于预测的推理任务上存在显著挑战，揭示了工具协同和不确定性条件下的推理是当前模型的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: STQA可作为可信任、工具增强型金融智能体未来研究的重要测试平台，数据与代码已开源。

title: Hierarchical Prompt Injector for Domain Generalization Segmentation
summary: Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation (DGSS) is a challenging task, as vision models often rely on low-level appearance cues that change across domains. In contrast, structural attributes exhibit cross-domain stability, motivating the use of structural priors for DGSS. Existing methods use prompt learning to transfer such priors into DGSS models, but typically encode each class as a single holistic prompt. Moreover, these methods apply prompts uniformly to all pixels, offering no mechanism to adapt when only a subset of object regions is visible due to viewpoint changes, occlusion, and environmental variation. We address this with \textbf{Spatial Hierarchical Prompts (SHP)} that enrich each class with region-level geometric anchors capturing structural appearance from distinct viewing angles, ensuring complementary coverage under arbitrary viewpoints. Additionally, we propose the \textbf{Hierarchical Prompt Injector (HPI)}, which enables spatially adaptive prompt injection in foundation models. HPI spatially grounds prompts by modeling their semantic relevance and spatial influence with visual features. Considering the difficulty of learning spatially and semantically aware prompt injection, we further introduce auxiliary supervision to align hierarchical prompts with their corresponding object regions. We achieve 70.62\% and 72.74\% mIoU on synthetic-to-real and real-to-real benchmarks, respectively. Code and checkpoints are released at https://github.com/MosukFate/HPI

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间层级提示（SHP）和层级提示注入器（HPI）用于域泛化语义分割，通过区域级几何锚点丰富每个类别，并实现空间自适应的提示注入，在合成到真实和真实到真实基准上分别达到70.62%和72.74% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 域泛化语义分割中，视觉模型常依赖跨域变化的低级外观线索，而结构属性具有跨域稳定性。现有基于提示学习的方法将每个类别编码为单一整体提示，且对所有像素统一应用提示，无法适应因视角变化、遮挡和环境差异导致的物体局部可见情况。
AI.method: 提出空间层级提示（SHP），为每个类别添加区域级几何锚点，捕捉不同视角下的结构外观，确保任意视角下的互补覆盖；同时提出层级提示注入器（HPI），通过建模提示与视觉特征的语义相关性和空间影响来实现空间自适应的提示注入，并引入辅助监督以对齐层级提示与对应物体区域。
AI.result: 在合成到真实和真实到真实基准上分别达到70.62%和72.74% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 通过空间层级提示和自适应注入机制，有效解决了现有DGSS方法中单一整体提示和统一注入的局限，提升了跨域语义分割性能。

title: Protocol Compression Changes Which Party Pays: Bilateral Cost in Cross-Organization LLM Agent Communication
summary: Agents that talk across organizations exchange long messages billed by the token. A shorter notation therefore looks like a saving that costs nothing but an agreement to use it. Recent work reports the saving is conditional. Compressed notation can instead raise total tokens by 8% to 11% over a JSON baseline, when parsing failures force extra model calls. That is measured for one payer. Between two organizations neither side can install a decoder at the other end, and each pays under its own tokenizer, price, and cache state. We measure both sides. A preregistered token-level study covered 198 content-matched item pairs across six vendors, for 2,376 native-usage cells. We then overlay an English baseline, runtime schema negotiation followed by compression, and injected-schema compression on a two-party procurement bargain with an exactly enumerated feasible set. The overlay covers 1,053 completed dialogues of a 1,215-cell grid across 3 model pairs, plus a 405-dialogue rerun of the negotiated condition. Compression amplifies cross-vendor cost dispersion by a factor of 1.078, with a 95% CI of [1.066, 1.091], and two vendor pairs reverse which endpoint is cheaper. Runtime negotiation succeeds as a protocol and fails as a bargain. The parties agree a schema in 121 of 135 headline dialogues, none of them the schema we would have supplied. They settle the task in only 9 of those dialogues, and they reach impasse in 106 of them. The negotiated sessions average 10.8 turns against 17.6, and cost 52% of the English total because sessions end sooner, not because the handshake is repaid. Break-even horizons run from 20 to 70 turns, the low end only under the conditional accounting, and all of them lie above every observed English session. On one cross-vendor pair both parties keep about half their cost. On the other the receiving party pays more at a high cache-hit rate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了组织间智能体（Agent）使用压缩符号进行通信的成本效益。通过双组织、双付费方的实验发现：压缩并非总是省钱——解析失败可能使总token数比JSON基线高出8%-11%；跨供应商成本离散度被放大1.078倍；运行时schema协商在协议层面可行但在谈判层面失败（仅9/121次完成任务，106次陷入僵局）；所有盈亏平衡水平（20-70轮）都高于任何实际英文会话长度，压缩在双边场景下总体不划算。
AI.motivation: 跨组织智能体交换的长消息按token计费，压缩符号看似零成本节省。但先前研究在单一付费方条件下发现压缩可能反而增加token。实际跨组织场景中双方各有tokenizer、价格和缓存状态且无法在对方端安装解码器，需要双边度量的精确研究。
AI.method: 预注册token级研究覆盖198个内容匹配条目对、6个供应商、2376个原生使用单元；叠加基于英文的基线、运行时schema协商加压缩、注入式schema压缩三种条件，在双边采购谈判场景（精确枚举可行集）上运行1053个完成的对话（1215格网格、3个模型对），并对协商条件额外进行405个对话的复跑。
AI.result: 压缩将跨供应商成本离散度放大1.078倍（95%CI [1.066,1.091]），两对供应商的成本更低方发生反转；运行时协商在135个主要对话中有121个达成schema共识（无一是指定schema），但只有9个完成任务，106个陷入僵局。协商会话平均10.8轮对17.6轮，成本为英文基线的52%（因提前结束而非握手收益）；盈亏平衡为20-70轮，均超过所有观察到的英文会话长度。一对跨供应商双方各节省约一半，另一对在高缓存命中率下接收方反而支付更多。
AI.conclusion: 压缩通信在单一系统内或许有利，但在跨组织双边场景中：要么因协商失败导致任务无法完成，要么因会话过短使压缩投资无法回本。运行时schema协商作为协议可行但作为谈判机制失败，压缩放大供应商间成本差异且可能反转成本排序，不能简单视为零成本优化。

title: FACT: A Forensic Agent with Compiled Tool-Use Trajectories for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detection is increasingly open-world: new image generators produce highly realistic images that make visual artifacts harder to identify. Existing detectors usually rely on a fixed set of forensic cues, so a detector that works well for one generator family may fail on another. We introduce FACT (Forensic Agent with Compiled Tool-use Trajectories), which learns an image-conditioned tool-use policy for forensic analysis. Instead of applying a fixed detector, FACT decides which forensic tools to call, interprets the returned evidence, and stops when sufficient evidence has been collected. FACT follows an Evolve--Distill--Refine pipeline: it evolves an execution-verified forensic skill, compiles the skill into action--observation tool-use trajectories, distills them into a compact agent, and refines the policy with cost-aware GRPO. Across two internal and four public benchmarks, FACT achieves the best performance among all compared methods, including on recent unseen generators, deepfakes, and manipulated images.

AI.tldr: FACT是一个面向开放世界AI生成图像检测的取证智能体框架，通过学习图像条件下的工具调用策略，自适应地选择取证工具、解释证据并在达到足够证据时停止，在多个基准上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统AI生成图像检测器依赖固定的取证线索集，对特定生成器族有效但对其他生成器失效。随着新图像生成器不断涌现，需要能自适应不同生成器类型、具备开放世界泛化能力的检测方法。
AI.method: FACT采用Evolve-Distill-Refine流水线：(1)演化执行验证的取证技能，(2)将技能编译为动作-观察工具调用轨迹，(3)蒸馏为紧凑智能体，(4)使用成本感知的GRPO（组相对策略优化）细化策略。智能体学习图像条件下的工具使用策略，自主决策调用哪些取证工具并收集证据直到充分。
AI.result: 在两个内部基准和四个公开基准上，FACT在所有对比方法中取得最佳性能，包括在未见过的生成器、深度伪造和篡改图像上的表现。
AI.conclusion: FACT证明了基于工具调用的取证智能体范式能够有效应对开放世界AI生成图像检测，通过动态工具选择和证据收集代替固定检测器，实现更强的跨生成器泛化能力。

title: What the Window Does Not Contain: Auditing Provenance in a Document-Grounded Instability Benchmark
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 11th Workshop on Financial Technology and NLP (FinNLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/eikiyo/FoFinNLP
summary: Ask a language model the same question about the same document twenty times, and it sometimes returns two different answers. We built Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings, to measure how often this happens. Then we audited our own corpus and found a defect any excerpt-built benchmark can carry: items whose evidence is missing from the window of text the model is shown. The audit flags 36 items and separates two failures a single flag would conflate: evidence genuinely absent from the window and answers that must be computed from numbers the window does supply. Flagged items change their answers far more often, wobbling at 0.255 against 0.087 on the 427 clean items, and excluding them cuts apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth. Before testing whether the missing evidence explains the instability, we registered a prediction: re-cut each window to hold its evidence, and instability should fall below a set threshold. It failed: the repair moved wobble by 0.058, with an interval containing zero. We report the association as correlational. Almost all measurements sit where instability cannot show, which bounds what a corpus built for accuracy can say about stability. We release the corpus, all 112,800 raw responses, and the audit as a runnable check for any document benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了Probity基准（60个任务、470个项目，来自真实风险投资文件），用于测量语言模型对同一问题多次回答的不稳定性。审计发现36个项目存在证据缺失问题，并将"窗口内证据确实缺失"与"需从窗口内数字计算答案"两种失败区分开。被标记项目的不稳定率（0.255）远高于干净项目（0.087），排除它们会使跨模型一致性降低约五分之一。预注册的"重切窗口修复"预测失败（效应量0.058，置信区间含零），因此将该关联报告为相关性而非因果性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对于同一问题-文档对会给出不同答案（不稳定性），但现有的文档基准大多针对准确性构建，缺乏对答案稳定性的系统测量。此外，基于摘录构建的基准可能隐含"证据缺失窗口"的缺陷，该缺陷会与需要数值计算的情况混淆，导致测量偏差和误导性的跨模型一致性估计。
AI.method: 构建Probity基准（含60个任务、470个项目，来自真实风险融资文件），多次询问语言模型同一问题以量化不稳定性（wobble）。对语料进行审计，设计标记程序区分两类失败：证据确实不在窗口内 vs. 答案需从窗口内数字计算。预注册预测：重新裁剪窗口以包含证据后，不稳定性应降至设定阈值以下，并通过实验验证。
AI.result: 审计标记了36个项目（约7.7%），被标记项目的不稳定率为0.255，远高于427个干净项目的0.087；排除被标记项目后，跨模型一致性估计降低约20%。预注册的窗口修复实验失败：修复仅使wobble变化了0.058，置信区间包含零，未能达到设定阈值。绝大多数测量位于不稳定性无法显现的位置，限制了语料对稳定性的推断能力。
AI.conclusion: 证据缺失与不稳定性之间存在相关性（非因果性），因为窗口修复实验未能证明因果关系。该研究揭示了基于准确度构建的语料在测量稳定性方面的根本局限——当测量几乎都落在不稳定性无法显现的范围内时，语料无法有效推断模型的稳定性。作者发布了完整语料、112,800条原始响应及可运行审计检查，供其他文档基准使用。

title: UniFusion: Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction via Unified Spatio-temporal Depth Alignment
summary: In this paper, we address the challenging problem of 4D reconstruction from sparse-view videos. This setup usually relies on monocular depth estimation to provide priors for the reconstruction model. A key challenge arises from limited cross-view overlap and temporal variation, making monocular depth predictions inconsistent across views and time. Existing methods align spatial and temporal dimensions in separate stages, requiring foreground segmentation masks while failing to leverage temporal cues for cross-view alignment. Contrary to these methods, we propose a unified spatial-temporal depth alignment framework that jointly resolves cross-view and cross-time inconsistencies without distinguishing foreground/background. Our method represents depth maps across views and time as a set of spatio-temporal neural fields. This representation not only yields fast convergence, but also captures spatio-temporal correlation among depth maps implicitly, without dependence on external segmentation/tracking models. We also propose a multi-view depth-order loss while leveraging the classic scale-and-shift-invariant loss to further improve the final depth quality. The aligned depths initialize and supervise Gaussian splatting models for 4D reconstruction. Experiments on Ego-Exo4D and EgoHuman demonstrate that our improved depth alignment substantially benefits dynamic Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction methods for novel-time/view synthesis and geometry accuracy/consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的时空深度对齐框架，用于解决稀疏视角视频中的4D重建问题。该方法将跨视角和跨时间的深度图表示为时空神经场，联合解决深度不一致性问题，无需前景/背景分割，对齐后的深度图用于初始化和监督动态高斯溅射模型，在Ego-Exo4D和EgoHuman数据集上显著提升了4D重建质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角视频的4D重建通常依赖单目深度估计提供先验，但有限的跨视角重叠和时间变化导致深度预测在视角间和时间上不一致。现有方法分阶段对齐空间和时间维度，需要前景分割掩码且未利用时间线索进行跨视角对齐，缺乏统一的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出统一的时空深度对齐框架：(1) 将跨视角和时间的深度图表示为时空神经场，隐式捕获时空相关性，无需外部分割/跟踪模型且收敛快速；(2) 提出多视角深度顺序损失，结合尺度和平移不变损失提高深度质量；(3) 将对齐后的深度用于初始化和监督动态高斯溅射模型进行4D重建。
AI.result: 在Ego-Exo4D和EgoHuman数据集上的实验表明，改进的深度对齐方法显著提升了基于动态高斯溅射的重建方法在新视角/新时间合成以及几何精度和一致性方面的表现。
