MobileNetV2 achieved the highest reported accuracy of 88% with balanced class-wise performance. The custom CNN achieved pneumonia recall of 92.67% and precision of 79.43%, highlighting a precision-recall trade-off. Accuracy, F1-score, precision, recall, confusion matrices, and training curves were used to assess performance.
  Synthetic pneumonia images were combined with real images to investigate whether augmentation could improve classification performance. In the reported VGG19 comparison, augmented-data training accuracy reached approximately 100%, while validation accuracy remained near 50%, below the real-data validation accuracy. This experiment therefore did not demonstrate a validation-performance benefit from GAN augmentation. The classifier comparison highlights differences in accuracy and pneumonia recall, while the augmentation experiment indicates the need for further evaluation of synthetic-image quality and training settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用VGG19、MobileNetV2、ResNet50和自定义CNN对胸部X光片进行肺炎分类，其中MobileNetV2达到最高准确率88%。研究还探索了GAN合成数据增强，但实验结果显示增强后的验证准确率（约50%）低于真实数据，未能证明GAN增强对验证性能有改进。
AI.motivation: 评估多种CNN架构在胸部X光肺炎分类中的表现，并探究GAN合成数据增强是否能够提升分类性能。
AI.method: 对比四种深度学习模型（VGG19、MobileNetV2、ResNet50、自定义CNN）在胸部X光肺炎分类中的性能，并使用GAN生成合成肺炎图像与真实图像结合进行数据增强实验。评估指标包括准确率、F1分数、精确率、召回率、混淆矩阵和训练曲线。
AI.result: MobileNetV2取得最高准确率88%，类别性能均衡；自定义CNN的肺炎召回率达92.67%，精确率79.43%，呈现出精确率-召回率权衡。GAN增强实验中训练准确率接近100%但验证准确率仅约50%，低于真实数据验证准确率，未显示验证性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 不同CNN架构在肺炎分类中存在准确率和召回率的差异；GAN增强实验未展示验证性能优势，需进一步评估合成图像质量和训练设置。

title: PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables
summary: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PTCG框架，结合思维树风格的分步生成与剪枝以及说话人角色选择，用于生成多样且具有说服力的反驳论点，实验表明其在多样性和说服力上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有反驳论点生成方法通常只产生单一结果，无法捕捉真实辩论所需的多样性和说服力，限制了批判性思维和平衡对话的实现。
AI.method: 提出Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG)框架，结合Tree-of-Thoughts启发的逐步生成与剪枝策略，并通过估计原文作者的persona及引入代表不同视角的说话人persona来实现观点采择，从而生成多样化的反驳论点。
AI.result: 通过LLM-as-a-Judge、基于分类器的评估以及人工评估，PTCG在反驳论点的多样性和说服力方面均比基线方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: PTCG通过persona引导的树状生成框架有效提升了反驳论点生成的多样性和说服力，为批判性思维中的论点生成任务提供了新的解决方案。

title: Object-Aware Background-Controlled Editing via Weighted Velocity Guidance
summary: Training-free image editing steers diffusion or flow-matching generative models at inference time by modifying prompt-conditioned denoising velocities. Existing velocity-based editors often apply prompt-induced residuals globally over the latent space and rely on the model to localize semantic changes implicitly. For object-centric edits, these residuals are rarely zero outside the target object, so small non-target components can accumulate during multi-step integration, causing background drift and unstable object boundaries. We propose Object-Aware Velocity Control (OAVC), a training-free framework that introduces object-level control into the velocity-integration process. OAVC decouples where semantic residuals are allowed to act from how they are injected into the dynamics. It constructs a background-anchored reference interface under the source prompt and then performs object-localized safe semantic injection under the target prompt. A constrained injection operator suppresses drift-inducing velocity components, while time-adaptive spatial weighting stabilizes the transition near object boundaries. OAVC requires no training or modification of pretrained model parameters. Experiments on object-centric image and video benchmarks with image and video rectified-flow backbones show improved background preservation, structural fidelity, boundary stability, and temporal consistency while retaining effective localized editability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OAVC（Object-Aware Velocity Control），一个无需训练的框架，通过在速度积分过程中引入对象级别的控制，解耦语义残差的作用位置与注入方式，解决基于速度编辑器中非目标区域残差累积导致的背景漂移和边界不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于速度的图像编辑方法在潜空间中全局应用提示残差，依赖模型隐式定位语义变化。对以物体为中心的编辑而言，目标物体外的残差并非严格为零，在多步积分过程中较小非目标分量会累积，导致背景漂移和物体边界不稳定。
AI.method: OAVC解耦语义残差"在哪里生效"与"如何注入动力学"两个问题：在源提示下构建背景锚定的参考界面，然后在目标提示下执行对象局部化的安全语义注入。通过约束性注入算子抑制引起漂移的速度分量，并使用时间自适应空间权重稳定物体边界附近的过渡。该方法无需训练或修改预训练模型参数。
AI.result: 在图像和视频的对象中心基准测试中，使用图像和视频rectified-flow骨干网络的实验表明，OAVC在保留背景、结构保真度、边界稳定性和时间一致性方面均有提升，同时保持有效的局部可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: OAVC通过对象级速度控制有效解决了训练自由图像编辑中背景漂移和边界不稳定的问题，在图像和视频编辑任务中实现了更稳定且有效的局部编辑。

title: Line-Coupled Language Model
summary: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

AI.tldr: 本文提出行耦合语言模型（LCLM），一种自回归模型，可同时推进多行文本生成，每行预测下一个token，通过共享因果上下文耦合各行，在保持标准next-token目标和因果注意力的同时实现并行生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型每步只生成一个token，限制了每次前向传播的有效输出量。虽然扩散模型、插入式解码和多token预测支持并行生成，但要么增加训练时的token流量，要么难以预测强依赖的未来token。
AI.method: LCLM将多行文本的token交错排列到单一因果序列中，并为每一行独立预测下一个token，同时使用行错开的旋转位置编码（line-staggered rotary positions）来共享因果上下文。模型保留标准next-token目标和因果注意力机制。
AI.result: 控制实验表明跨行目标比连续同行目标的依赖程度显著更低。在881M参数下，LCLM平均每次前向传播生成2.94个内容token，验证交叉熵损失为2.44；而基线自回归模型每次前向传播仅生成1.00个token，损失为2.39。即使LCLM每次前向传播生成16个token，其损失仅比基线高0.09（2.34 vs 2.25）。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了行可作为并行生成单元的有效性，LCLM在不训练额外token流量、保持标准训练目标的前提下，能以少量损失成本换取显著的并行生成吞吐提升。

title: SignDino: Self-Supervised Sign Language Representation Learning via Temporal-Axis Self-Distillation
summary: Self-supervised sign language representation learning must model two properties not central to natural-image SSL: signs are produced by a small set of anatomically distinct articulators, and their meaning depends on the temporal organisation of those articulators. We introduce SignDino, a self-supervised sign-video encoder that moves the DINOv3 student--teacher recipe from the spatial domain of image crops to the temporal domain of tracked sign streams. Each video is decomposed into left-hand, right-hand, and face streams by a detector-first YOLOv8n+ByteTrack pipeline. A frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 embeds each per-frame anatomical crop, while lightweight temporal Transformers, not the image backbone, form the student and EMA teacher. They are trained by temporal DINO self-distillation, frame-level masked-token prediction in the style of iBOT, KoLeo feature spreading, and Gram anchoring of the frame-to-frame similarity structure. This design keeps strong image-level visual primitives fixed and learns only how articulator states evolve across time. We evaluate on sign-to-English translation, isolated sign recognition, and fingerspelling detection benchmarks. Across these tasks, SignDino provides a strong public self-supervised representation and shows competitive or state-of-the-art performance under matched downstream evaluation.

AI.tldr: SignDino是一种手语视频自监督学习编码器，通过将DINOv3的师生蒸馏范式从图像空间扩展到跟踪的手语关节运动流时间域，仅轻量时间Transformer学习手、脸等发音器官状态的时序演变，在多项手语任务上达到竞争性或最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督手语表示学习需要建模两个自然图像SSL不具备的特性：手语由少量解剖学上不同的发音器官产生，且其含义依赖于这些器官的时间组织方式。现有基于图像的自监督方法无法有效捕获这些时序与多关节特性。
AI.method: 每段视频通过YOLOv8n+ByteTrack检测器分解为左手、右手和脸部三个运动流。使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B/16编码每个帧级的解剖学裁剪块，轻量时间Transformer作为学生和EMA教师模型。训练目标包括时间域DINO自蒸馏、iBOT风格帧级掩码token预测、KoLeo特征扩展和Gram锚定帧间相似度结构。保留强的图像级视觉基元不变，仅学习发音器官状态如何随时间演变。
AI.result: 在手语翻译、孤立手语识别和手指拼写检测等多个基准测试上，SignDino提供了强大的公开自监督表示，在匹配的下游评估协议下达到竞争性或最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将自监督学习从空间域转向跟踪手语运动流的时间域，SignDino证明了时间Transformer在不解冻图像骨干的情况下能有效学习手语中多发音器官的时序组织，为手语自监督表示学习提供了强公开基线。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction
comment: Accepted at CCL 2026 (China National Conference on Computational Linguistics)
summary: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAME（检索增强多提示集成）框架，用于CCL2026-Eval任务5小杂粮育种信息抽取。该训练-free框架结合混合检索式少样本选择、三提示集成（严格/宽松/平衡）和大规模重复采样多数投票，在不训练的情况下提升LLM联合抽取12种实体和6种关系的性能，最终以0.499总分排名第一，超越GPT-5.5驱动的官方基线11.4%。
AI.motivation: 小杂粮育种文献中的信息抽取任务（MGBIE）需要同时抽取12种实体和6种关系，具有较高挑战性。现有监督方法需要标注数据且泛化受限，而直接使用LLM进行抽取存在提示敏感、噪声多、准确率不稳定等问题，因此需要探索一种无需微调训练即可提升抽取效果的方法。
AI.method: RAME框架包含三大组件：(i)通过混合BM25与嵌入模型的检索器实现检索增强的少样本示例选择；(ii)设计三个覆盖精度到召回谱系的提示模板（Strict、Relaxed、Balanced）进行多提示集成；(iii)在受控多样性下大规模重复采样，并通过多数投票聚合多个LLM输出，过滤噪声预测以获得高置信度结果。系统基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash构建。
AI.result: 在leaderboard上RAME取得Total Score 0.499（NER 0.730，RE 0.346），排名第一，相比官方基于GPT-5.5的Track-A基线（0.448）实现11.4%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: RAME验证了在无需训练的前提下，通过检索增强示例选择与多提示多样化的多数投票机制，能够有效提升LLM在专业领域信息抽取（特别是关系抽取）任务上的性能，为低资源专业文献抽取提供了可行思路。

title: CST-WM: A Causally Structured World Model for Embodied Visual Tracking
summary: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot not only to react to the current view, but to choose actions that preserve or recover future evidence of a moving target under ego-motion, occlusion, and distractors. It is therefore a predictive decision problem over future target observability and apparent scale. A central difficulty is a task-specific form of causal hallucination: in action-conditioned prediction, a model can exploit the strong correlation between robot control and target-related observations by hallucinating a direct causal effect from the current action to target evidence, rather than letting action influence that evidence only through robot motion and the resulting observation change. The shortcut yields plausible futures with the wrong semantics for tracking-oriented planning and re-acquisition. We propose CST-WM, a causally structured world model that decomposes the latent state into target-evidence, robot, and observation branches and factorizes the transition so that direct action injection into the target-evidence branch is blocked, while action remains available to robot motion and observation updates. Combined with rollout-based model-predictive control, CST-WM supports both stable following and temporary target re-acquisition in one planning framework. On EVT-Bench and Habitat 3.0, covering standard tracking, target-loss recovery, and cross-dataset transfer, it improves following quality, distance-range control, safety, and re-acquisition over reactive and world-model baselines; offline diagnostics show better multi-step rollout fidelity, stronger planning-value consistency, and substantially reduced direct action leakage. For embodied visual tracking, future prediction alone is not enough: the predictive structure itself must align with how target evidence enters planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CST-WM，一种因果结构的世界模型，用于具身视觉跟踪问题。该模型将潜在状态分解为目标证据、机器人和观测三个分支，阻断从动作到目标证据分支的直接因果路径，使动作只能通过机器人运动和观测变化间接影响目标证据，从而避免因果幻觉。结合基于展开的模型预测控制，该方法在一个规划框架中同时支持稳定跟随与目标重新获取，在EVT-Bench和Habitat 3.0上优于反应式和世界模型基线。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉跟踪本质上是一个关于未来目标可观测性和表观尺度的预测性决策问题。现有模型存在一种任务特定的因果幻觉：在动作条件预测中，模型利用机器人控制与目标观测之间的强相关性，幻觉出从当前动作到目标证据的直接因果效应，而非让动作仅通过机器人运动间接影响目标证据。这种捷径产生语义错误的未来预测，难以用于跟踪规划和重新获取。
AI.method: 提出CST-WM（因果结构世界模型）：将潜在状态分解为目标证据、机器人和观测三个分支，并因式化状态转移，阻断动作向目标证据分支的直接注入，同时保留动作对机器人运动和观测更新的影响。结合基于rollout的模型预测控制，形成统一的规划框架。
AI.result: 在EVT-Bench和Habitat 3.0上（覆盖标准跟踪、目标丢失恢复和跨数据集迁移），该方法在跟随质量、距离范围控制、安全性和重新获取方面优于反应式和世界模型基线。离线诊断显示更好的多步展开保真度、更强的规划价值一致性和显著减少的直接动作泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 对于具身视觉跟踪，仅进行未来预测是不够的，预测结构本身必须与目标证据进入规划的因果路径对齐。CST-WM通过因果结构化的世界模型设计证明了这一点。

title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vishing-Tactics-Bench基准，将语音钓鱼（vishing）检测从事后分类转为实时危害预测，通过在每轮对话中预测通话将走向信息收集还是财务利用两种终端危害，利用基于Endsley态势感知框架和MITRE ATT&CK改编的战术分类体系（Vishing-Tactics），在5,645通中文合成电话的35,340条诈骗者话语上进行标注与验证。
AI.motivation: 语音钓鱼是实时发生的，通话结束后再进行事后分类已无法阻止危害发生。更关键的问题是在通话进行中预测其正朝着哪种具体危害（信息收集或财务利用）发展，以便及时干预。
AI.method: 基于Endsley态势感知框架构建基准，将MITRE ATT&CK改编为6战术分类（Vishing-Tactics）；提出Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting协议，采用生存分析风格建模两种终端危害；使用AP@k、C-index和发散误差三种指标评估从马尔可夫启发式到微调LLM的多种基线模型。
AI.result: 实验表明战术轨迹可作为可解释的通话战术状态表征，支持危害特定的预测；分层提前时间分析在严格误报预算下识别出轨迹信号在通话中的哪个时点能够产生早期预警。
AI.conclusion: 战术轨迹为实时语音钓鱼防御提供了可解释的中间表征，可实现危害预测和干预选择，比传统的事后欺诈分类更具实践价值。

title: One Shared LoRA Weight for MRI Reconstruction across Acceleration Factors
summary: Accelerated MRI reconstruction recovers images from undersampled k-space. However, different acceleration factors produce distinct artifact patterns. Existing methods often train separate models for each factor, leading to poor cross-factor generalization and high training and storage costs. We propose Shared LoRA, a parameter-efficient framework that freezes the pretrained SHFormer backbone and trains a single shared set of LoRA adapters together with a lightweight gating network. During training, undersampled inputs are generated by randomly sampling acceleration factors and their corresponding sampling masks, enabling the shared adapters to learn reconstruction knowledge across factors. Given the acceleration factor, GateNet generates layer-wise coefficients to dynamically modulate the residual strength of each adapter. Experiments show that Shared LoRA achieves the best or competitive PSNR and SSIM across acceleration factors, while its trainable parameters account for only about 5.3% of the total model parameters. Its performance at lower acceleration factors remains largely unaffected as the jointly trained factor set expands, and it generalizes stably to unseen neighboring factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Shared LoRA框架，冻结预训练的SHFormer骨干网络，仅训练一组共享LoRA适配器和轻量门控网络，实现跨不同加速因子的MRI重建，训练参数仅占总参数的5.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有MRI加速重建方法针对不同加速因子需分别训练独立模型，导致跨因子泛化能力差，且训练和存储成本高昂。
AI.method: 冻结预训练的SHFormer骨干，训练一组共享LoRA适配器及轻量门控网络GateNet；训练时通过随机采样加速因子和对应采样掩码生成欠采样输入，使共享适配器学习跨因子重建知识；推理时GateNet根据给定加速因子生成逐层系数，动态调制每个适配器的残差强度。
AI.result: 实验表明Shared LoRA在各加速因子上取得最优或具竞争力的PSNR和SSIM指标，可训练参数仅占总模型参数的约5.3%；在扩展联合训练的因子集时，低加速因子性能几乎不受影响，且能稳定泛化到未见过的邻近因子。
AI.conclusion: Shared LoRA通过参数高效的共享适配器设计，实现了跨加速因子MR重建的高效建模，兼顾了重建性能、参数效率与跨因子泛化能力。

title: FreqBLiMP: Frequency-Controlled Minimal Pairs Reveal Robustness and Fragility of LLMs Under Lexical Rarity
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Repo link: https://github.com/TimeTravelerTy/freqblimp-generation
summary: Minimal-pair benchmarks such as BLiMP evaluate linguistic knowledge by testing whether language models (LMs) prefer acceptable sentences over minimally different unacceptable ones. However, these benchmarks largely ignore lexical frequency variation, despite lexical frequency being a pervasive and highly skewed property of natural language use. Consequently, existing evaluations do not test whether grammatical preferences remain stable when contrasts involve rare lexical items. We introduce FreqBLiMP, a frequency-controlled extension of BLiMP that regenerates all 67 paradigms under explicit Zipf-frequency regimes while preserving each minimal-pair's grammatical contrast. Evaluating multiple open-weight LLM families across scales, we find that decreasing lexical frequency produces a consistent, monotonic decrease in sentence likelihood, but only a modest reduction in overall contrastive acceptability accuracy. However, this aggregate stability masks substantial variation across linguistic phenomena, with LLMs remaining robust on overt morphosyntactic generalization while degrading on phenomena that require lemma-specific information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FreqBLiMP，一个频率受控的BLiMP扩展基准，用于测试语言模型在稀有词汇条件下的语法偏好稳定性。研究发现词频降低会导致句子似然度持续下降，但对整体可接受性准确率影响较小，不过不同语言现象的稳健性存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有最小对比对基准（如BLiMP）忽略了词汇频率变化对语法判断的影响，而词汇频率是自然语言使用中高度偏斜分布的基本属性。因此需要系统性检验语言模型的语法偏好是否在稀有词汇条件下仍然稳定。
AI.method: 构建FreqBLiMP，在显式齐普夫频率体制下重新生成BLiMP所有67个范式，保持每个最小对比对的语法对立，并在多个开源大语言模型家族及不同规模上进行评估。
AI.result: 词汇频率降低导致句子似然度呈单调下降，但对比性可接受性准确率仅适度降低。然而聚合层面的稳定性掩盖了各语言现象间的显著差异：模型在显性形态句法泛化上保持稳健，但在依赖词元特定信息的现象上表现退化。
AI.conclusion: 频率可能是模型语法稳健性的隐藏调节因素，现有基准可能高估了模型对低频词汇条件下某些语法现象的判断能力，需根据现象类型区分对待模型语法能力的评估。

title: Radiation, Rotation and Scale Invariant Feature Descriptor for Multimodal Image Matching
summary: Multimodal image matching is a fundamental task for multi-source information fusion. However, geometric distortions and nonlinear radiometric differences (NRD) severely limit performance, especially under radiometric, rotation, and scale variations. To address this issue, we propose a radiation, rotation, and scale invariant (RRSI) feature descriptor. First, a dual-head regional sampling (DHRS) module simultaneously performs Cartesian and Log-Polar sampling on keypoint neighborhoods, retaining spatial structural properties while enhancing robustness to rotation and scale variations. We then jointly encode geometric and radiometric relations between multimodal images in a unified deep feature space, enabling feature encoding, interaction, and fusion across intra-modal, dual-head sampled, and inter-modal regions. Furthermore, we introduce a bidirectional cross-modal generative reconstruction constraint during training. By decoding implicit features into structural patches of the counterpart modality, this mechanism anchors modality-invariant geometric topologies without additional inference overhead. Experiments on optical-infrared and optical-SAR datasets demonstrate highly competitive matching performance and strong robustness to rotation and scale variations. RRSI supports the full rotation range from 0 to 360 degrees and scale factors up to four. Its generalization ability is further validated on multimodal images from computer vision, remote sensing, and medical imaging. The implementation will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yeyuanxin110/RRSI .

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种辐射、旋转和尺度不变（RRSI）的多模态图像特征描述子，通过双头区域采样模块联合编码几何与辐射关系，并引入双向跨模态生成重建约束，在光学红外、光学SAR等数据集上取得竞争优势匹配性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像匹配中，几何畸变和非线性辐射差异（NRD）严重限制性能，尤其在辐射、旋转和尺度变化条件下，现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出RRSI特征描述子：1）DHRS模块同时进行笛卡尔和Log-Polar采样，保持空间结构同时增强旋转和尺度鲁棒性；2）在统一深度特征空间中联合编码多模态图像的几何与辐射关系，实现模态内、双头采样和模态间区域的编码、交互与融合；3）引入双向跨模态生成重建约束，解码隐特征为目标模态结构块，锚定模态不变几何拓扑且无额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在光学红外和光学SAR数据集上取得高度竞争的匹配性能，对旋转和尺度变化具有强鲁棒性。支持0-360度全范围旋转及最高4倍尺度因子，泛化能力在计算机视觉、遥感、医学影像等多模态图像上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: RRSI通过联合几何-辐射编码与双向跨模态重建约束，有效解决了多模态图像匹配中的辐射、旋转和尺度不变性问题，具备良好的泛化能力。

title: In-Place Instruction Following in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) generate text via bidirectional iterative denoising, naturally supporting user-specified constraints anchored at arbitrary output positions, a paradigm known as In-place Prompting (IPP). We formalize this as the In-place Instruction Following (IIF) task and construct IIF-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark spanning literal, style, and discourse-function constraints, paired with a rubric-based local-global evaluation protocol. An inference-time attention-bias probe suggests that vanilla dLLMs often under-prioritize constraint spans during denoising. We then propose GRAFT, an IPP-oriented post-training framework combining constraint-aware SFT and preference optimization. On four representative dLLMs, GRAFT raises the average IIF score from 57.75 to 73.10 (+15.35 points), with absolute gains of 15.91 and 15.57 points on literal and discourse-function constraints, while preserving general generation ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的就地指令跟随（IIF）任务及IIF-Bench基准，并设计GRAFT后训练框架，在四个代表性dLLMs上将平均IIF分数从57.75提升至73.10（+15.35分），同时保持通用生成能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型天然支持任意位置约束的就地提示（IPP），但相关任务尚未被系统形式化和评估，且现有模型在去噪过程中对约束片段的关注优先级不足。
AI.method: 形式化IIF任务并构建IIF-Bench分层基准（涵盖字面、风格、语篇功能三类约束），设计基于规则的自上而下评估协议；通过推理期注意力偏置探针诊断问题，提出GRAFT框架，结合约束感知的监督微调（SFT）与偏好优化。
AI.result: 在四个代表性dLLMs上，GRAFT将平均IIF分数从57.75提升至73.10（+15.35分），字面约束和语篇功能约束的绝对增益分别为15.91和15.57分，且不损害通用生成能力。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT作为面向IPP的后训练框架，能有效增强dLLMs遵循任意位置约束的能力，验证了约束感知训练与偏好优化结合的有效性。

title: ChildGaze: A Benchmark Dataset for Collaborative Behavior Understanding in Children
summary: Understanding collaborative behavior in children is important for analyzing social participation, peer interaction, shared attention, and engagement during play and learning activities. Reliable recognition of these cues can support research in child development, educational analysis, and human-centered computer vision. However, estimating where a child is looking does not necessarily reveal whether the child is actively participating in a shared activity. To support this higher-level analysis, we introduce ChildGaze, a child-centered behavioral annotation dataset built on the ChildPlay video collection [1]. ChildGaze introduces two behavioral labels, collaborative and non-collaborative, assigned independently to each child within a frame. The dataset provides face, left-hand, and right-hand bounding boxes for children and adults and organizes the annotations at the row, person, and frame levels. The current release contains 27 annotated video files, 10,641 frames, and 73,268 body-part annotation rows. Annotation reliability was evaluated on 1,187 frames using independent annotations from two annotators. The collaboration labels achieved 93.16% raw agreement and a Cohen's kappa of 0.8631, while bounding-box annotations achieved an overall mean IoU of 0.808. Baseline experiments with pretrained ViT and Swin Transformer models achieved up to 97.44% child-person-level accuracy and 96.80% frame-level accuracy, respectively. These results show that ChildGaze provides a reliable benchmark for studying collaborative behavior in naturalistic child-adult and peer interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ChildGaze，一个基于ChildPlay视频集构建的儿童行为标注数据集，用于识别儿童的协作与非协作行为。数据集包含27个视频、10,641帧和73,268个身体部位标注行，标注者间一致性高（Cohen's kappa=0.8631），基线实验中ViT和Swin Transformer分别达到97.44%的个体级和96.80%的帧级准确率。
AI.motivation: 理解儿童的协作行为对分析社交参与、同伴互动、共享注意力及游戏学习活动中的参与度十分重要。作者指出仅仅估计儿童注视方向并不能揭示其是否真正参与共享活动，因此需要更高层次的行为标注数据集来支持儿童发展、教育分析和人本计算机视觉研究。
AI.method: 基于ChildPlay视频集构建数据集，为每帧中每个儿童独立分配"协作"和"非协作"二元行为标签，提供儿童和成人的脸部、左右手边界框标注，并在行、人和帧三个层面组织注释。使用两名注释员的独立标注评估可靠性，并采用预训练的ViT和Swin Transformer模型进行基线实验。
AI.result: 协作标签的原始一致性达93.16%，Cohen's kappa为0.8631；边界框标注的总体平均IoU为0.808。基线实验中，预训练ViT和Swin Transformer在儿童个体层面达到最高97.44%的准确率，帧层面达到96.80%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: ChildGaze为在自然情境下的儿童-成人及同伴互动中研究协作行为提供了可靠的基准数据集，实验结果表明其标注质量和模型性能均能有效支持该方向的研究。

title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. Long paper. 9 pages + references + appendix
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出电路推理得分（CRS），通过对比消融识别46个推理敏感注意力头，在冻结基座模型上单次前向传播即可计算数据选择信号。反直觉地发现，在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上最低电路参与度十分位数据反而优于随机选择，表明RLVR数据选择具有机制依赖性而非可简化为静态问题质量排序。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR数据选择标准（难度过滤、人工筛选、奖励轨迹评分）将数据价值视为独立于学习模型的内在属性，忽略了数据与特定模型交互的机制效应，需要一种考虑模型内部推理电路参与度的选择信号。
AI.method: 通过对比消融实验识别出46个对推理敏感的注意力头，基于这些头部在冻结基座模型上的激活计算CRS得分，无需奖励标签或推演（rollouts），仅需单次前向传播即可完成数据筛选。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，最低CRS参与度十分位数据在GSM8K（+2.0pp）、OlympiadBench（+1.6pp）和Minerva（+2.9pp）上优于随机选择，而最高参与度十分位提升较少且与中间十分位无显著差异。但该优势存在边界条件：领域精选数据池中无选择方法分离；1.5B规模下有效方向反转；最低奖励训练条件产生最强泛化。
AI.conclusion: RLVR数据选择是机制依赖的（regime-dependent），在Qwen2.5-Math设置下不能还原为静态的问题质量排名，需要针对具体模型规模和训练条件动态调整选择策略。

title: MSCA-UNet: Multi-Scale Context and Attention U-Net for Image Segmentation
summary: U-Net remains a practical baseline for image segmentation because of its simple encoder-decoder structure and skip connections. However, the bottleneck representation is still dominated by a limited set of receptive fields, while decoder features are propagated without explicitly emphasizing the most informative channels and spatial locations. This paper presents MSCA-UNet, a U-Net-based segmentation architecture that combines multi-scale contextual aggregation at the bottleneck with channel-spatial attention refinement in the decoder. The multi-scale module uses parallel atrous convolutions to capture contextual features at different receptive fields, while Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAMs) progressively recalibrate decoder features. Under identical experimental settings, the baseline U-Net achieves 96.9% mIoU on a held-out test set. Adding multi-scale context improves mIoU to 97.5%, while attention alone reaches 98.4%. Combining both mechanisms yields 99.1% mIoU, a 2.2 percentage-point improvement over the baseline. Parameter analysis further shows that the attention-only variant adds approximately 0.044M parameters, whereas the multi-scale module contributes most of the additional model capacity. The results support the view that multi-scale context enrichment and attention-based feature refinement provide complementary benefits within a U-Net framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSCA-UNet，一种基于U-Net的分割架构，在瓶颈处结合多尺度上下文聚合（并行空洞卷积），并在解码器中加入CBAM通道-空间注意力细化模块。实验表明，基线U-Net在测试集上达到96.9% mIoU，多尺度模块将其提升至97.5%，注意力模块达到98.4%，两者结合达到99.1% mIoU，较基线提升2.2个百分点。参数分析显示注意力变体仅增加约0.044M参数，而多尺度模块贡献了大部分额外模型容量。
AI.motivation: U-Net虽因其简洁的编码器-解码器结构和跳跃连接而成为实用的图像分割基线，但其瓶颈表示仍受限于有限的感受野集合，且解码器特征在传播过程中未显式强调最具信息量的通道和空间位置，存在性能提升空间。
AI.method: 提出MSCA-UNet架构：1）在瓶颈处使用多尺度模块，通过并行空洞卷积在不同感受野下捕获上下文特征；2）在解码器中引入CBAM模块，逐步对解码器特征进行通道-空间注意力重校准。
AI.result: 在相同实验设置下，基线U-Net达到96.9% mIoU；加入多尺度上下文后提升至97.5%；仅使用注意力模块达到98.4%；两者结合达到99.1% mIoU，较基线提升2.2个百分点。参数分析显示注意力变体仅增加约0.044M参数，多尺度模块贡献了大部分额外模型容量。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持多尺度上下文增强和基于注意力的特征细化在U-Net框架内具有互补优势，两者结合能带来显著的性能提升。

title: SIFTING: A Novel LLM-Based Framework for Structured and Transparent Information Extraction from Clinical Free-Text Reports, with Application to Tumor Staging in Lung Cancer
summary:
Background: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for extracting information from clinical free-text documents, but their outputs are often unstructured and lack traceability, complicating validation and adoption in clinical workflows. In this work we introduce SIFTING, an LLM-based framework designed to address these shortcomings.
  Methods: SIFTING combines the language comprehension capabilities of LLMs with segment-level processing and structured prompts with strict output control, linking findings to the source text to enable both accurate and transparent information extraction. To demonstrate its capabilities, we applied the framework to the task of extracting tumor T-stage information from 130 lung cancer radiology reports (SIFTING-T-stage). A compact 4-bit quantized version of the open-source LLM Llama-3.3-70B (35 GB) was used in a fully self-hosted setup, providing full control over data and model. Performance was evaluated against a reference standard created by four clinical experts and compared with a range of LLMs as used in a conventional single-prompt approach, using bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals.
  Results: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard. We found its performance to be comparable to even the largest state-of-the-art LLMs with reasoning capabilities and to be interchangeable with clinical experts (p < 0.001), while at the same time offering full traceability through source text references.
  Conclusion: SIFTING enables accurate, structured, and traceable information extraction from clinical free-text documents. It ensures data control, reproducibility, and verifiable outputs that can support clinical validation and workflow integration.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SIFTING，一个基于大语言模型的临床自由文本信息提取框架，通过分段处理和结构化工序结合源码引用，在130份肺癌影像报告中提取肿瘤T分期信息，达到90%的准确率并与临床专家表现相当，同时提供完全可追踪性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在临床自由文本信息提取方面具有潜力，但其输出往往缺乏结构和可追踪性，给临床工作流程中的验证和应用带来困难。
AI.method: SIFTING框架结合了LLM的语言理解能力、分段级处理和具有严格输出控制的结构化提示，将发现结果与源文本关联。作者使用Llama-3.3-70B的4-bit量化版本（35GB）进行完全自主托管的部署，在130份肺癌影像报告中提取T分期，并与四位临床专家构建的参考标准进行比较。
AI.result: SIFTING-T-stage在参考标准上达到90%的准确率（95% CI: 84-95），性能与最大规模的最先进LLM（包括具有推理能力的模型）相当，且与临床专家可互换（p < 0.001），同时通过源文本引用提供了完全的可追踪性。
AI.conclusion: SIFTING实现了从临床自由文本中准确、结构化和可追踪的信息提取，确保了数据控制、可重复性和可验证的输出，能够支持临床验证和工作流集成。

title: AGSA-Net: Abundance-Guided Self-Attention Network for Spectral Unmixing-Aware Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Classification
comment: This paper has been accepted at IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS)
summary: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification plays a vital role in remote sensing applications, including agriculture, environmental monitoring, and urban analysis. However, its performance remains challenged by high spectral redundancy, noise sensitivity, and the difficulty of jointly modeling local material composition and long-range spectral dependencies. To address this, we propose AGSA-Net, an abundance-guided self-attention network that explicitly integrates spectral unmixing priors into the classification process. AGSA Net first estimates physically meaningful subpixel abundance maps subject to non-negativity and sum-to-one constraints, regularized by hybrid linear-nonlinear reconstruction decoder. The learned abundances are then used to construct an abundance affinity prior that guides a spectral transformer to emphasize class-discriminative interactions, and the resulting transformer features are fused with compact abundance descriptors for final prediction; in contrast to existing approaches that use abundance as auxiliary or concatenated features. Experiments on Indian Pines, Augsburg, and Berlin demonstrate the benefit of incorporating abundance- guided contextual modeling, particularly in heterogeneous urban scenes. The source code and trained models are available at: https://github.com/nnuvi/AGSA-Net

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGSA-Net，一种丰度引导的自注意力网络，将光谱解混先验（丰度图）显式集成到高光谱图像分类中，通过丰度亲和先验引导频谱Transformer建模区分性交互，并在Indian Pines、Augsburg和Berlin数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像分类面临高光谱冗余、噪声敏感性以及难以联合建模局部材料组成与长程光谱依赖等挑战，现有方法仅将丰度用作辅助或拼接特征，未充分利用其物理语义先验。
AI.method: AGSA-Net首先估计满足非负性和和为1约束的子像素丰度图，并通过混合线性-非线性重建解码器进行正则化；学习到的丰度用于构建丰度亲和先验，引导频谱Transformer强调类别区分性交互；最终将Transformer特征与紧凑丰度描述符融合进行分类。
AI.result: 在Indian Pines、Augsburg和Berlin三个数据集上的实验表明，丰度引导的上下文建模尤其在异质城市场景中带来了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将光谱解混先验（丰度）显式融入Transformer引导机制可有效提升高光谱图像分类性能，特别是在复杂异质场景下优势明显；代码和模型已开源。

title: CEDAR: Error-Bounded Residual Routing for Efficient Long-Context Attention
summary: Post-hoc sparse attention accelerates long-context prefill by routing each query to a small set of token-level interactions. Hard selection, however, assigns zero probability to every omitted chunk: a routing miss cannot be recovered, and a fixed expansion budget spends the same work on easy and ambiguous queries. We introduce Coarse-to-fine Error-aware Dynamic Attention Routing (CEDAR), a coarse-to-fine method that keeps the language model frozen while preserving global coverage. Each semantic chunk contributes a cheap key--value summary to a residual attention path; chunks with high estimated approximation error are then expanded to exact token attention. Exact and summarized contributions are combined in a single softmax normalization, so refinement replaces, rather than duplicates, coarse evidence. We derive an output-error bound governed by within-chunk key/value dispersion and use it to allocate a variable refinement budget. A controlled clustered-attention study shows that residual summaries reduce reconstruction error by more than 98% relative to hard dropping at equal exact-chunk budgets. Experiments on long-context benchmarks demonstrate that CEDAR recovers most of the quality lost by hard sparse routing while maintaining approximately $3\times$ kernel speedup at 128K context.

AI.tldr: CEDAR是一种用于长上下文预填充的粗到细动态注意力路由方法，通过残差路径保留全局覆盖，仅对高误差分块展开精确注意力，在保持约3倍速度提升的同时恢复大部分硬稀疏路由损失的质量。
AI.motivation: 硬剪枝注意力路由存在两个关键缺陷：一是遗漏的块被分配零概率且无法恢复（路由失误不可补救）；二是固定的扩展预算对简单和模糊的查询花费相同的工作量，缺乏自适应能力。需要一种既能保持全局覆盖又能动态分配预算的稀疏注意力方法。
AI.method: CEDAR采用粗到细的两级策略：首先让每个语义分块通过廉价的键值摘要贡献到残差注意力路径，从而保持全局覆盖；然后估计各分块的近似误差，仅对高误差分块展开为精确的token级注意力。精确与摘要贡献在单个softmax归一化中组合，确保细化替换而非重复粗证据。方法推导了由块内键值离散度控制的输出误差界，并据此分配可变的细化预算。
AI.result: 在受控聚类注意力研究中，残差摘要相比硬丢弃在相同精确块预算下降低了超过98%的重建误差。在长上下文基准上，CEDAR恢复了硬稀疏路由丢失的大部分质量，同时在128K上下文下保持约3倍的kernel加速。
AI.conclusion: CEDAR证明了通过粗到细的残差注意力路径可以在不微调语言模型的情况下实现高质量自适应的稀疏注意力，有效平衡了计算效率与路由可靠性，是硬剪枝注意力的一种可行替代方案。

title: NOVA: Normal-Side Modeling for Training-Free Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Training-free zero-shot video anomaly detection (ZS-VAD) leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to localize anomaly instances from a predefined anomaly vocabulary, without providing any video. Existing CLIP-based methods often emphasize anomaly-side semantics, while the competing normality side remains less carefully formulated. We identify two key limitations in existing solutions: (i) blurred decision boundary: normal prompts may contain ambiguous verbs, such as running, that are semantically close to anomalies, reducing normal and abnormal separation in the VLM embedding space; and (ii) modality gap: poor alignment between features of textual normal anchors and visual frames. We propose NOVA, a training-free ZS-VAD framework that strengthens the normal side at both linguistic and visual levels. NOVA introduces Normality-Aware Prompt Construction (NA), which excludes anomaly-adjacent verbs and biases normal descriptions toward static, low-motion scenes. To overcome the text-vision modality gap, NOVA constructs a Visual Normality Anchor (VNA), which creates a weighted visual normal anchor from the initial frames of each test video, providing a video-specific normal reference without task-specific training or annotations. NOVA achieves 89.86 percent AUC on UCF-Crime and 95.07 percent AUC and 84.82 percent AP on XD-Violence, reaching state-of-the-art performance among comparable training-free zero-shot methods.

AI.tldr: NOVA是一种无需训练的零样本视频异常检测框架，通过在语言和视觉两个层面强化"正常"侧语义来解决现有CLIP方法的决策边界模糊和模态差距问题，在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上达到领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的零样本视频异常检测方法往往侧重于异常语义建模，而忽略了正常侧语义的精细设计，导致正常提示中的模糊动词（如running）与异常语义接近，降低了正常与异常在嵌入空间中的区分度；同时文本正常锚点与视觉帧之间存在模态差距问题。
AI.method: 提出NOVA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Normality-Aware Prompt Construction (NA)，在语言层面排除与异常邻近的动词，使正常描述偏向静态、低运动场景；(2) Visual Normality Anchor (VNA)，在视觉层面利用每个测试视频的初始帧构建加权视觉正常锚点，提供视频特定的正常参考，无需任何训练或标注。
AI.result: 在UCF-Crime上达到89.86% AUC，在XD-Violence上达到95.07% AUC和84.82% AP，在同类无训练零样本方法中达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时强化正常侧的语言描述和视觉锚点，可以有效克服传统CLIP方法在零样本视频异常检测中的决策边界模糊和模态差距问题，验证了"正常侧建模"对异常检测的重要性。

title: Separating Stream Stability from Long-Term Recall in Language Models
summary: Methods for streaming language models are often discussed alongside long-context and memory systems, although they solve different problems. An attention sink can stabilize autoregressive generation over an indefinitely long stream while the model remains unable to use content that has left its recent-token cache. We argue that this distinction should be explicit in system claims and evaluation. We introduce three horizons: the stability horizon, over which predictive behavior remains well behaved; the access horizon, over which past content can still causally affect the output; and the utility horizon, over which a task retains acceptable performance. We show constructively that the stability horizon can be infinite while the access and utility horizons are finite. We then propose ThreeH, an evaluation contract that measures all three horizons under a common state and compute budget. Applying the framework to attention-sink streaming clarifies its strength, constant-memory, stable generation, without treating anchor tokens as semantic memory. The framework exposes roles for cache policies, recurrent state, retrieval, and external memory. Experiments on 128K-token streams, delayed binding recall, and delayed decisions show that attention sinks preserve local modeling but not content beyond the active cache; recurrent and retrieval state extend the semantic horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将流式语言模型中的"稳定性"与"长上下文/记忆"能力明确区分，引入三个视野（稳定性、可访问性、实用性）来系统地评估流式模型，并提出了ThreeH评估框架，通过实验证明注意力汇聚（attention sink）只能保证无限稳定生成，但无法保留超出活动缓存的内容，而循环状态和检索机制可以扩展语义视野。
AI.motivation: 流式语言模型方法常与长上下文和记忆系统混为一谈，但实际上它们解决的是不同的问题。现有的讨论和评估没有明确区分"稳定生成"与"实际访问历史内容"的能力，导致方法评价存在混淆，需要建立区分性的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出三个视野维度：稳定性视野（预测行为保持良好）、可访问视野（历史内容可因果影响输出）、实用性视野（任务保持可接受性能）。在此基础上提出ThreeH评估契约，在统一的状态和计算预算下同时测量三个视野。实验使用128K token流、延迟绑定回忆和延迟决策等任务进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明注意力汇聚可以实现无限稳定性视野，但可访问视野和实用性视野是有限的；注意力汇聚仅保持局部建模能力，不能保留超出活动缓存的内容；循环状态和检索状态可以扩展语义视野。
AI.conclusion: 应明确区分流式模型的稳定性承诺和长上下文/记忆承诺。注意力汇聚的价值在于恒定内存下的稳定流式生成，但不应将其视为语义记忆机制；ThreeH框架为缓存策略、循环状态、检索和外部记忆等方法提供了清晰的角色定位与评估标准。

title: DualPathOcc: Dual-Resolution BEV Encoder for 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Predicting 3D occupancy from multi-view images requires preserving geometric detail during 2D-to-3D lifting while reasoning over sparse, volumetric scene representations. We present DualPathOcc, a camera-based framework that combines a Spatial Enhancer for high-resolution feature aggregation before BEV compression, a SENet-augmented dual-path BEV encoder for local-global context modeling, and height-aware weighted cross-entropy for near-ground occupancy. The final model is optimized with occupancy supervision and no explicit depth loss. On single-frame Occ3D-nuScenes, DualPathOcc achieves 37.37 mIoU. We further analyze how surface-centered depth targets interact with volumetric occupancy learning.

AI.tldr: DualPathOcc是一种基于相机的3D占用预测框架，通过空间增强器、SENet双路径BEV编码器和高度加权交叉熵损失，在单帧Occ3D-nuScenes上达到37.37 mIoU，无需显式深度损失。
AI.motivation: 多视图图像的3D占用预测需要在2D到3D提升过程中保留几何细节，同时需要在稀疏的体积场景表示上进行推理。
AI.method: 提出三个关键组件：1) 空间增强器（Spatial Enhancer）用于在BEV压缩前进行高分辨率特征聚合；2) SENet增强的双路径BEV编码器用于局部-全局上下文建模；3) 高度感知加权交叉熵损失用于近地面占用优化。模型仅使用占用监督，不依赖显式深度损失。
AI.result: 在单帧Occ3D-nuScenes基准上达到37.37 mIoU。此外还分析了以表面为中心的深度目标与体积占用学习之间的交互关系。
AI.conclusion: DualPathOcc通过双路径设计和高度感知损失有效提升了3D占用预测精度，并揭示了深度目标与占用学习之间的关联。

title: Probing the Structure and Dynamics of LLM Value Expression through Value Conflicts
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe
summary: Ethical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) often characterizes model values as static and monolithic. In contrast, we argue that LLM value expression is better understood as a structured yet dynamic phenomenon. To investigate this, we introduce Conflict-driven Value Probing, a controlled framework that places LLMs in value conflicts and implements four types of interventions that perturb these conflicts to probe LLM value expression. Applying this framework to ten LLMs, we identify three recurring patterns. (1) Expression duality: models shift from broad idealistic orientations in abstract assessment toward more pragmatic priorities in concrete conflicts. (2) Functional steerability: models readily reconfigure their expressed value profiles toward task-defined value objectives. (3) Bounded plasticity: such reconfiguration is not without constraints, i.e. pressure induces a security- and goal-oriented priority shift while negative framing distinguishes protected values from those more amenable to redirection. Together, these findings characterize both the structure and dynamics of LLM value expression: context flexibly reconfigures expressed priorities, yet within behavioral boundaries. This behavioral account provides a foundation for understanding controllability, alignment, and safety in LLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出冲突驱动价值探测（Conflict-driven Value Probing）框架，通过在价值冲突情境中对十个LLM施加四种干预来研究其价值表达的动态特性，发现价值表达具有表达二元性、功能可操纵性和有界可塑性三个模式，表明LLM价值表达是结构化的动态现象而非静态单一特征。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM伦理评估往往将模型价值视为静态和单一的，忽略了价值表达的情境依赖性和动态特征，需要更精细的行为框架来理解LLM价值的可控性、对齐与安全性。
AI.method: 提出Conflict-driven Value Probing框架，将LLM置于价值冲突情境中，实施四类干预（扰动冲突），对十个LLM进行系统性探测，分析其在抽象评估和具体冲突情境下的价值表达变化。
AI.result: 识别出三个重复模式：(1)表达二元性——模型从抽象评估中的广泛理想主义转向具体冲突中的务实优先；(2)功能可操纵性——模型能按任务定义的价值目标重新配置价值表达；(3)有界可塑性——再配置受约束限制，压力会引发安全和目标导向的优先级转移，负面框架能区分受保护价值与可重定向价值。
AI.conclusion: LLM价值表达具有结构化的动态特性：情境可灵活重构表达的优先级，但存在行为边界。这一行为学解释为理解LLM的可控性、对齐与安全性提供了基础。

title: Multi-Grid Post-Training for Long-Form Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Generating long-form multi-shot videos requires coherent within-shot motion and visually consistent narratives across shots. Existing video generators favor continuous motion and struggle to present complete shot sets when an entire narrative is packed along one temporal axis. We propose MovieGrid, a Multi-Grid Post-Training paradigm that decomposes a long video into shorter, temporally ordered chunks and arranges them on a spatial grid for joint modeling. This design reduces the number of shots handled by each temporal axis while enabling global information exchange across chunks. We construct the Multi-Grid Long Video (MGLV) dataset from 1,000 long-form videos using source video collection, hierarchical segmentation, grid video construction, and character-aware story annotation, producing 54K grid videos paired with story prompts. Our Noise-Free Random-Grid Training retains a random subset of chunks as clean visual context for denoising the remaining chunks. Grid Embedding encodes grid structure, character-aware Story Prompts link recurring entities, and Grid Boundary Loss stabilizes layouts. Under the same token budget, MovieGrid generates 6.05 times more shots than Temporal Packing in a 1,616-frame video. On a benchmark spanning five real-world categories, it achieves state-of-the-art intra-shot consistency (0.9131 versus 0.8086 for HoloCine) and inter-shot consistency (0.5914 versus 0.5384 for StoryMem). MovieGrid can further scale video length with minimal compromise through single or multiple generations.

AI.tldr: MovieGrid是一种多网格后训练范式，将长视频分解为按时间排序的短片段并排列在空间网格上进行联合建模，以减少每个时间轴处理的镜头数量，同时实现跨片段的全局信息交换。在相同token预算下可生成比Temporal Packing多6.05倍的镜头，并实现最先进的镜头内外一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成器在生成长篇多镜头视频时面临挑战：它们倾向于连续运动，当整个叙事被压缩在单一时间轴上时难以呈现完整的镜头集合。长视频生成需要在镜头内保持连贯运动，同时确保跨镜头的视觉叙事一致性，这两者存在固有矛盾。
AI.method: MovieGrid包含三个核心组件：1) Multi-Grid Post-Training范式，将长视频分解为短时间排序片段并排列在空间网格上联合建模；2) Noise-Free Random-Grid Training，保留随机片段的子集作为清洁视觉上下文以去噪其余片段；3) 辅助模块包括Grid Embedding编码网格结构、角色感知的Story Prompts连接重复实体、Grid Boundary Loss稳定布局。同时构建了包含54K网格视频的MGLV数据集。
AI.result: 在相同token预算下，MovieGrid在1,616帧视频中生成比Temporal Packing多6.05倍的镜头。在覆盖五个真实世界类别的基准测试中，实现镜头内一致性0.9131（对比HoloCine的0.8086）和镜头间一致性0.5914（对比StoryMem的0.5384），均达到最先进水平。此外支持通过单次或多次生成进一步扩展视频长度。
AI.conclusion: 将多个时间轴上的镜头分散到空间维度进行联合建模的网格策略，有效解决了长视频生成中连续性和多镜头叙事的矛盾，为可扩展的长视频生成提供了新范式。

title: Marginal Fidelity Does Not Establish User Simulation in Demographic Synthetic Survey Panels: Response Contracts, Support Collapse and Conditioning Failure
summary:
Demographic synthetic survey panels are often validated by matching aggregate answers to published surveys. We test what that certificate establishes across six multiselect batteries from four survey organisations in three countries. The headline analysis is restricted to three instruments whose synthetic cohort and human target share the stated population frame; three other batteries remain sensitivity analyses.
  The response contract dominates measured fidelity. In the aligned instruments, committed sets leave 66 of 128 model-battery option slots empty in panels of up to 500 respondents, versus 0 of 128 under per-option probability elicitation. Across eight uncapped model-instrument comparisons, probabilities reduce option-marginal MAE by 4.53 to 7.30 points. The capped instrument reverses on two models until the vectors are projected onto its stated maximum. These are measurement effects: human targets are realised check-all responses, whereas the vectors are latent inclusion propensities.
  Published marginal agreement also fails to discriminate respondent simulation from direct population estimation. On nine aligned model-battery pairs, a no-persona population-prevalence query averages 6.27 MAE versus 12.39 for committed panels and wins all nine comparisons. Constraint-aware probability vectors average 5.34 and beat the query on four of nine, so the baseline challenges the validation criterion rather than proving direct estimation uniformly best. On three unpublished demographic cells, neither approach beats reciting the national distribution. Population-marginal agreement is therefore evidence about an elicitation contract and an estimand obtainable without simulated respondents, not evidence of individual simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了"合成面板与公开调查边际匹配"作为验证标准的有效性，发现其衡量的主要是响应合同（elicitation contract）而非个体模拟质量。在三种对齐工具中，承诺集（committed sets）在128个模型-电池选项中留下66个空槽，而逐选项概率估计则无空槽；概率法将边际MAE降低4.53至7.30点。更重要的是，无人格（no-persona）的人口患病率查询在9组对齐比较中以6.27 MAE胜过承诺面板（12.39），表明人口边际一致性无法证明个体级模拟的有效性，只能证明估计量本身可达到。
AI.motivation: 人口统计综合调查面板通常通过与公开调查的聚合答案匹配来验证，但该验证所建立的证书（certificate）究竟证明了什么尚不清楚。作者旨在测试这种验证标准在不同调查组织、国家和多选题电池中的可信度，质疑边际一致性是否真能证明个体级模拟的质量。
AI.method: 跨四个调查组织、三个国家、六个多选电池进行测试，其中三种工具的合成队列与人类目标共享声明的人口框架（对齐工具），另外三种作为敏感性分析。比较两种响应合同：承诺集（committed sets）与逐选项概率估计（per-option probability elicitation），并将模拟面板与无人格的人口患病率查询（直接人口估计）进行对比。
AI.result: 在128个模型-电池选项中，承诺集留下66个空槽（对齐工具中），概率法为零。概率法在八个无上限模型-仪器比较中将选项边际MAE降低4.53至7.30点。无人格人口患病率查询平均MAE为6.27，优于承诺面板的12.39并赢得全部9组比较；约束感知概率向量平均5.34，在9组中赢4组。在三个未发表人口学单元上，两种方法均未胜过直接引用国家分布。
AI.conclusion: 人口边际一致性是响应合同和可估计量（无需模拟个体即可获得）的证据，而非个体模拟质量的证据。发布边际一致性无法区分"模拟个体"与"直接人口估计"两种方法，因此不应被用作个体级综合面板有效性的验证标准。

title: An Integrated Video-AI Platform for Action-Level Microanastomosis Training and Performance Feedback
summary: Developing microanastomosis skill requires repeated practice with timely, action-specific feedback, yet expert review of lengthy microscope videos does not scale to frequent or distributed training. We present an integrated video-AI platform that turns a complete simulated procedure into inspectable, interactive feedback through three connected modules. First, a proposed transformer segments the video into six surgical actions. Second, object detection and tracking localize instrument tips within each action; the resulting kinematic features and action statistics drive supervised classification of five NOMAT-aligned performance dimensions. Third, a grounded large language model (LLM) uses these structured outputs to answer user questions about the current scene, actions, motion, and predicted performance through a unified interface. In a two-site study, 17 participants completed 72 procedures comprising 576 suture placements. The action-segmentation module achieved 87.66\% accuracy and 82.86\% F1, increasing to 93.62\% and 88.32\% after workflow-aware refinement. The five performance classifiers achieved 76.0\% mean accuracy, with Cohen's $κ$ from 0.63 to 0.93. Although the language interface and educational benefit require prospective evaluation, these results establish the technical basis for an expert-supervised platform that can shorten review, expose the evidence behind performance estimates, and support scalable formative microsurgical training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成的视频-人工智能平台，通过三个模块（动作分割、器械检测与跟踪、大语言模型问答）将模拟显微血管吻合手术视频转化为可检查、可交互的反馈，实现了87.66%动作分割精度和76.0%性能分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 显微血管吻合技能的培养需要重复训练和及时、针对性的反馈，但专家审阅大量显微镜视频无法扩展到频繁或分布式训练场景。
AI.method: 该平台包含三个模块：(1) 基于Transformer的动作分割模型将视频分为六种手术动作；(2) 目标检测与跟踪定位器械尖端，提取运动学特征并驱动五种NOMAT对齐性能维度的监督分类；(3) 基于检索增强的大语言模型利用结构化输出统一回答用户问题。
AI.result: 在两机构研究中，17名参与者完成72次手术共576针缝合。动作分割精度87.66%、F1为82.86%，经工作流感知优化后分别提升至93.62%和88.32%。五个性能分类器平均准确率76.0%，Cohen's κ介于0.63至0.93。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为专家监督下的可扩展形成性显微外科训练奠定了技术基础，可缩短审阅时间、揭示性能评估证据，但语言交互界面和教育效益仍需前瞻性评估验证。

title: RouteRelay: Event-Triggered Cross-Layer Route Reuse for Efficient Dynamic Sparse Attention
summary: Dynamic sparse attention reduces long-context prefill cost by routing each query chunk to a small set of key chunks at every Transformer layer. The sparse attention kernel avoids most token interactions, but the router still rebuilds a chunk--chunk score matrix layer after layer, even when the selected routes change little. We introduce RouteRelay, a router-agnostic method that reuses only route metadata across depth while continuing to compute attention with the current layer's queries, keys, and values. Anchor layers perform full routing. Intermediate layers rescore the previous top-$k$ route and a compact sentinel set of near-miss and randomly probed chunks. A query row is rerouted only when a sentinel challenges its weakest selected chunk. We give a top-$k$ stability condition, a probabilistic bound on missed challengers, and a row-selective GPU execution design. In a reproducible empirical evaluation, RouteRelay retains at least 99.99% route recall while rerouting 25.0%, 55.4%, and 78.2% of rows under low, moderate, and high cross-layer drift, respectively. Across routing scales, RouteRelay retains 100.0% recall while evaluating 38.4--51.6% of full-routing score pairs as the key-chunk count grows from 128 to 1024. Its unfused CPU execution remains slower than dense matrix multiplication, exposing row compaction and ledger updates as the main kernel-engineering targets.

AI.tldr: 提出RouteRelay，一种路由器无关的方法，通过跨层复用路由元数据来减少动态稀疏注意力中逐层重建chunk-chunk得分矩阵的预填充开销。锚定层执行完整路由，中间层仅重新评分此前top-k路由及紧凑哨兵集，仅在哨兵挑战成功时才重新路由查询行。
AI.motivation: 动态稀疏注意力虽然减少了长上下文预填充中大部分token交互的成本，但路由器仍需逐层重建chunk-chunk得分矩阵，即便选中的路由在相邻层间变化很小，造成了不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: RouteRelay的核心思想是锚定层做完整路由，中间层仅对上一层的top-k路由和一个紧凑哨兵集（包括近miss和随机探测chunk）重新评分，仅当哨兵挑战当前最弱选中chunk成功时才对该查询行重新路由。提供了top-k稳定性条件、对漏检挑战者的概率上界，以及行选择性GPU执行设计。
AI.result: 在低、中、高跨层漂移下分别仅重新路由25.0%、55.4%和78.2%的行即可保持至少99.99%的路由召回率；在不同路由规模下（key chunk数从128增至1024），仅评估完整路由得分对的38.4%-51.6%即可保持100.0%召回率。
AI.conclusion: RouteRelay能大幅减少跨层路由评估的计算开销，但在unfused CPU执行下仍慢于稠密矩阵乘法，行压缩与ledger更新是后续内核工程优化的主要方向。

title: Scaling 3D Generative Priors to Large-Scale Scene Meshes from Multi-View Images
summary:
Pretrained 3D generative models produce detailed geometry and appearance but are primarily designed for object-centric generation within a limited spatial extent. Recent approaches address this limitation by partitioning large scenes into smaller spatial regions and applying pretrained 3D generative priors to each region. However, scaling tiled generation to large multi-view scenes makes it challenging to maintain local geometric continuity and global appearance consistency.
  We present a training-free framework for large-scale textured mesh generation from multi-view images. Our key idea is to scale tiled generation to large scenes with increased spatial detail while coordinating generation both locally and globally. We introduce local context tiled generation to improve geometric continuity between neighboring regions and global appearance alignment to reduce appearance discrepancies across distant regions. An adaptive scene decomposition further determines the number of tiles according to the input scene geometry. Experiments demonstrate improved geometric and appearance fidelity over existing approaches while enabling fine-grained generation of large-scale scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练的大规模纹理网格生成框架，通过局部上下文分块生成和全局外观对齐来解决多视图大场景生成中的几何连续性与外观一致性问题，并采用自适应场景分解来根据输入几何确定分块数量。
AI.motivation: 预训练的3D生成模型专注于物体级生成且空间范围有限，现有方法通过分区生成大场景，但难以在大型多视图场景中同时保持局部几何连续性和全局外观一致性。
AI.method: 提出训练无关框架，包含三个关键组件：局部上下文分块生成以改善相邻区域的几何连续性、全局外观对齐以减少远距离区域间的外观差异、自适应场景分解根据输入场景几何确定分块数量。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在几何和外观保真度上优于现有方法，同时能够实现大规模场景的细粒度生成。
AI.conclusion: 该训练无关方法有效将预训练3D生成先验扩展到大规模场景，通过兼顾局部连续性与全局一致性实现了更高质量的大场景生成。

title: SPARROW: Scalable Taxonomy Induction via Structure-Preserving Partitioning and Constraint-Guided Merging
summary: Taxonomy induction aims to organize concept sets into coherent hierarchical structures. Recent LLM-based methods can induce taxonomies directly from flat term lists, avoiding the need for corpora, but degrade sharply as concept sets scale up. We argue that this degradation stems not only from context length limitations, but also from structural failures in hierarchical reasoning. To address this, we adopt a divide-and-merge paradigm that partitions concepts into smaller subsets, induces local taxonomies, and merges them into a global hierarchy. However, we identify two structural failure modes inherent to this paradigm: Structural Fragmentation, where partitioning weakens local hierarchical signals, and Parent Displacement, where locally plausible relations are misplaced in the global hierarchy. To address both, we propose SPARROW, a scalable taxonomy induction framework that combines structure-preserving spectral partitioning to retain hierarchical connectivity within each block, and constraint-guided incremental fusion that treats block-level relations as structural constraints rather than ground truth for global placement. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks show that SPARROW consistently achieves the strongest global structural quality across backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/rebeccazyr/SPARROW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARROW框架，通过结构保留谱划分和约束引导的增量融合来解决大规模分类体系归纳中分而治之范式存在的结构碎片化和父节点错位两大问题，在大型基准测试上取得了最优的全局结构质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的分类体系归纳方法处理大规模概念集时性能急剧下降，作者认为这不仅源于上下文长度限制，还源于层级推理中的结构性失败。分而治之范式虽然缓解了规模问题，但引入了结构碎片化和父节点错位两个结构性缺陷，需要针对性解决。
AI.method: 提出SPARROW框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)结构保留谱划分，通过谱聚类保留块内的层级连通性；(2)约束引导的增量融合，将块级关系视为结构性约束而非全局放置的"真实标签"，逐步合并局部分类体系为全局层级。
AI.result: 在大规模基准测试上的实验表明，SPARROW在多个骨干网络上始终取得最强的全局结构质量，验证了其方法的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过识别并解决分而治之范式中的两个结构性失败模式，证明分类体系归纳的性能下降不仅是规模问题，更源于结构性推理缺陷，SPARROW为此提供了有效的可扩展解决方案。

title: Separating Capability from Confidence: Grounded Dual-State Calibration for GRPO-Trained Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) require confidence that reflects both answer correctness and patient-specific visual evidence. Recent GRPO-based methods optimize verbalized confidence together with answer generation. However, this joint optimization may interfere with answer learning and drive confidence toward near-binary values. Verbalized confidence also provides no explicit assessment of visual support. We therefore separate capability learning from confidence estimation and propose \textbf{DualRead}. DualRead builds on the insight that reliability can be read from the actor's internal states at critical moments in the answering process. It freezes the GRPO-trained actor and combines pre-answer solvability with a post-answer assessment of the generated answer and its visual support. To further assess whether confidence reflects visual grounding, we introduce \textbf{Counterfactual Confidence Grounding AUC} (CCG-AUC). It measures whether confidence decreases when real-image substitution changes the actor from correct to incorrect. Across two VLM backbones and both in- and out-of-distribution medical VQA benchmarks, DualRead improves correctness discrimination and calibration over verbalized confidence while preserving answer accuracy. CCG-AUC reveals whether confidence responds to answer-relevant visual evidence rather than primarily to non-visual cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualRead框架，将医学视觉语言模型的能力学习与置信度估计分离，通过冻结GRPO训练的模型，结合回答前可解性评估与回答后视觉支持评估来生成置信度，并引入CCG-AUC指标衡量置信度是否反映视觉依据。
AI.motivation: 现有的GRPO方法将口头置信度与答案生成联合优化，可能导致两者相互干扰，且置信度趋向二值化，无法显式评估视觉证据的支持程度。
AI.method: DualRead冻结GRPO训练好的actor模型，将回答前的可解性判断与回答后对生成答案及其视觉支持的评估相结合来估计置信度。同时提出CCG-AUC指标，通过真实图像替换使模型从正确变为错误时检验置信度是否相应下降，从而衡量置信度对视觉依据的敏感性。
AI.result: 在两种VLM骨干网络上，以及分布内和分布外的医学VQA基准上，DualRead相比口头置信度在正确性判别和校准方面均有所提升，同时保持答案准确率不变。
AI.conclusion: 将能力学习与置信度估计分离可以有效提升医学VLM的置信度质量，CCG-AUC能够揭示置信度是否真正回应了答案相关的视觉证据而非主要依赖非视觉线索。

title: LANTERN: Language Model Assessment on Noisy and Transformed Tasks for Understanding Error and Robustness Nuances
summary: Robustness evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge, particularly in assessing their sensitivity to perturbations in input data. In this work, we systematically evaluate LLM robustness across multiple dimensions, including word error rate, character repetition and duplication, modifications in choices, and variability in instruction following. To facilitate this evaluation, we construct a synthetic and augmented dataset encompassing a diverse set of LLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets and instruction-following tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on LLMs of varying scales-small, medium, and large-as well as across base and instruction-tuned variants. Our analysis quantifies the variability in model responses under perturbed conditions and highlights discrepancies relative to baseline models. The findings provide insights into the stability of LLMs across different evaluation scenarios contributing to the development of more robust and reliable language models as well as robust evaluation methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）在多种扰动条件下的鲁棒性，包括词错误率、字符重复与冗余、选项修改和指令遵循变异性等维度。作者构建了合成和增强数据集，覆盖多项选择题（MCQ）和指令遵循任务，并在不同规模（小、中、大）及基础版与指令微调版模型上进行了广泛实验，量化模型在扰动条件下的响应变异性。
AI.motivation: LLM鲁棒性评估仍是关键挑战，尤其是在评估模型对输入数据扰动的敏感性方面，缺乏系统性的多维度评估方法。
AI.method: 构建合成与增强数据集，涵盖MCQ和指令遵循任务；在多个维度（词错误率、字符重复与重复、选项变更、指令遵循变异性）上系统评估不同规模（小/中/大）及基础/指令微调版本的LLM。
AI.result: 量化了LLM在扰动条件下的响应变异性，揭示了与基线模型相比的差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为理解LLM在不同评估场景下的稳定性提供了洞见，有助于开发更稳健可靠的语言模型及更健壮的评估方法。

title: PLSR: Progressive and Localized Super-Resolution of 3D Objects via Localized Latent Voxel Diffusion
summary: High-resolution 3D asset generation is vital in various 3D applications. Existing state-of-the-art diffusion-based models remain constrained by fixed resolutions, limiting their ability to produce details. In this paper, we tackle the challenge of generating more detailed, higher-resolution 3D objects by introducing a 3D super-resolution (SR) framework built on existing 3D generative foundation models. To this end, we design PLSR, a progressive and localized super-resolution solution to achieve this goal effectively and memory efficiently. Technically, given a coarse geometry from a pretrained 3D generator, we decompose the global SR task into localized sub-tasks via an associative input decomposition scheme, adapt a flow-based 3D generator into a localized super-resolution model through low-cost finetuning, and unify them in an iterative patch-wise denoising pipeline for seamless high-resolution output. Experiments on challenging objects show that our approach is able to generate 3D details with new strong fine-detail fidelity while significantly reducing the computational cost, offering a new and practical solution for high-resolution 3D asset generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLSR，一个渐进式局部化的3D超分辨率框架，基于现有3D生成基础模型，通过将全局超分任务分解为局部子任务，并以迭代的逐块去噪管线实现高分辨率3D资产生成，在显著降低计算成本的同时提升细粒度细节保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的3D生成方法受限于固定分辨率，难以生成更精细、更高分辨率的3D物体细节。
AI.method: PLSR方法包含三个关键技术：1) 通过关联输入分解方案将全局超分任务分解为局部子任务；2) 通过低成本微调将基于流的3D生成器适配为局部超分辨率模型；3) 将上述模块统一到迭代的逐块去噪管线中，实现无缝的高分辨率输出。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的物体数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够生成具有新强细粒度保真度的3D细节，同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: PLSR为高分辨率3D资产生成提供了一种新颖且实用的解决方案，在保持高效性的同时实现卓越的细节生成能力。

title: Content-Based Addressing for Long Context
summary: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) uses each token's integer position to determine the rotation applied inside attention. This works well for local token order, but increasing context length creates a positional train-test mismatch: RoPE produces relative rotations at offsets not seen during training. Methods that rescale, interpolate, randomize, or bias positions specify how attention handles those offsets, but still derive positional information from a growing token counter. We instead divide a token stream into units, retain ordinary RoPE positions within each unit, and assign every completed unit an address computed from its content. Adding units then applies the same learned map to new content rather than extending a positional range or an identifier table. We prove that this construction preserves local RoPE exactly, leaves the attention comparison between two fixed tokens unchanged when other units are inserted or reordered, and does not create new relative rotations merely because more units are added. In a character-level Tiny Shakespeare diagnostic, a model trained on 256-character contexts has validation perplexity 4.04 at 256 characters and 3.82 at 4096, while continuous RoPE changes from 4.71 to 12.09. A second diagnostic shows that content-based addressing can retrieve and use information from multiple serialized facts. These are controlled shallow experiments, not scale benchmarks, but they support a direct prescription: use position to address locally and content to address across units.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将位置编码与内容寻址相结合的方法：在局部单元内保留标准RoPE，而将已完成单元的内容计算出的地址用于跨单元寻址，从而解决RoPE在长上下文中的位置训练-测试不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: RoPE依赖整数位置旋转，当上下文长度增加时会产生训练时未见的相对旋转偏移，导致位置性的训练与测试不匹配。尽管已有多种方法（缩放、插值、随机化、偏置）试图应对这些偏移，但它们仍依赖于不断增长的token计数器来获取位置信息。
AI.method: 将token流划分为单元，每个单元内保持普通RoPE位置；每个已完成的单元被赋予一个由其内容计算出的地址。当添加新单元时，相同的学习映射被应用于新内容，而非扩展位置范围或标识符表。
AI.result: 在字符级Tiny Shakespeare诊断中，以256字符上下文训练的模型在256字符时验证困惑度为4.04，在4096字符时为3.82；而连续RoPE从4.71恶化到12.09。第二个诊断表明基于内容的寻址可以从多个序列化事实中检索和使用信息。
AI.conclusion: 这是一项受控的浅层实验而非规模基准测试，但支持直接的建议：在局部使用位置寻址，在单元之间使用内容寻址。

title: Large-Scale Pretraining for Improving Deep Learning-Based Geometric Distortion Correction of Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
summary: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is widely used in clinical settings but remains vulnerable to geometric distortion. Conventional correction methods often require additional acquisitions or vendor-specific solutions, limiting their feasibility in high-throughput, resource-constrained settings. This study investigates whether large-scale pretraining strategies can improve deep learning-based distortion correction for single-phase-encoding DWI. We formulate the task as image reconstruction, and compare a non-pretrained baseline against a self-supervised and a generative pretrained model, evaluated using both quantitative image-similarity metrics and qualitative expert assessment. The best-performing model was further tested for transferability on data collected in an LMIC setting with acquisition shift. Pretrained models outperformed the non-pretrained baseline, with cWDM achieving the strongest results across both quantitative and qualitative evaluation. However, application to LMIC data revealed transferability challenges, including contrast alteration and over-reliance on T1-weighted anatomical structure. Registering images to a common standard space improved predictions, suggesting that harmonized preprocessing may enhance cross-domain deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大规模预训练策略能否改善基于深度学习的单相位编码DWI几何畸变校正。实验比较了无预训练基线、自监督预训练和生成式预训练模型，发现预训练模型（尤其是cWDM）表现最佳，但在LMIC低资源场景数据的迁移中面临对比度改变和对T1解剖结构过度依赖等挑战，通过图像配准到标准空间可提升跨域预测性能。
AI.motivation: DWI在临床中广泛应用但易受几何畸变影响，传统校正方法需要额外采集或依赖厂商特定解决方案，在高效、资源受限的环境中可行性有限。研究旨在探索大规模预训练策略能否提升基于深度学习的畸变校正效果，特别是在单相位编码设置下。
AI.method: 将DWI畸变校正建模为图像重建任务，比较三种模型：无预训练基线、自监督预训练模型和生成式预训练模型(cWDM)。评估采用定量图像相似性指标与定性专家评估相结合的方式，最佳模型进一步在LMIC（中低收入国家）数据上进行跨域迁移测试，并探索将图像配准到通用标准空间对迁移效果的影响。
AI.result: 预训练模型均优于无预训练基线，其中cWDM在定量和定性评估中均取得最佳效果。但在LMIC数据的迁移测试中发现了挑战，包括对比度改变和对T1加权解剖结构的过度依赖；将图像配准到通用标准空间后预测效果有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 大规模预训练（特别是生成式预训练）能有效提升DWI畸变校正性能，但跨域部署仍面临挑战；标准化的预处理（如配准到公共空间）有助于增强模型的跨域泛化能力。

title: BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures
summary: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fixed pipelines and free-form self-reflection. We evaluate BPA on 300 real scanned blueprint sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects, against five baselines and six ablations. BPA reaches a macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, against 0.301 for single-MLLM zero-shot and 0.820 for a fixed pipeline; removing MLLM-led axis adjudication collapses Beam and Column F1 on complex multi-sheet projects. For dense technical drawings, engineering constraints are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlueprintAgent (BPA)，一个约束触发的多模态智能体，用于从扫描的钢筋混凝土建筑蓝图中自动提取可用于仿真分析的框架结构表示。BPA将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为主要阅读器和决策者，通过将工程约束实现为可调用的验证器，在推理阶段触发MLLM对局部区域进行针对性重访，从而显著优于一次性提示和固定流水线方法。
AI.motivation: 将既有钢筋混凝土建筑蓝图转换为可直接用于有限元分析和工程师审查的仿真模型，是建筑安全评估和抗震加固的重要基础，但该过程目前完全依赖人工。直接让多模态大语言模型处理扫描蓝图不可靠，输出常违反梁-柱支承关系、跨数或三维连续性等工程约束，亟需更可控的自动化方法。
AI.method: BPA将MLLM作为主阅读器和决策者，OCR和计算机视觉仅提供局部证据支持；核心机制是将工程约束实现为可调用的验证器，验证器输出的实体级冲突报告触发MLLM对局部区域进行定向重访，这是一种推理时的控制机制，区别于固定流水线和自由形式的自我反思。
AI.result: 在来自20个匿名RC框架项目的300张真实扫描蓝图上的评估中，BPA的宏平均Beam F1达到0.994，远优于单一MLLM零样本的0.301和固定流水线的0.820。消融实验显示，移除MLLM主导的轴线裁决会导致复杂多张图项目中Beam和Column F1显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 对于密集技术图纸，工程约束最有效的部署方式不是作为事后输出过滤器，而是作为触发实体级定向重访的信号。BPA验证了基于约束触发的多模态智能体范式在建筑物图纸自动化理解领域中的有效性。

title: Thinking with Cameras: Active Visual Reasoning via Dynamic Viewpoint Control for Surveillance Video Understanding
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in general-purpose video understanding. However, their application to surveillance videos remains challenging due to the lack of large-scale domain-specific datasets and the limitation of passive observation from fixed viewpoints. In surveillance scenarios, critical visual evidence can be easily missed when targets are distant, small, occluded, or move beyond the current camera view. In this work, we introduce CamVLM, a new framework for Thinking with Cameras, which enables LVLMs to actively acquire visual evidence through dynamic viewpoint control rather than passively analyzing fixed video streams. We first construct CCTV-Anomaly, a large-scale surveillance video understanding dataset containing 14,459 videos across 10 anomaly categories, with detailed captions and event annotations. We further formulate viewpoint control as an active visual perception problem and build CamTrack-53K, an object-centric viewpoint trajectory dataset for learning camera actions. Moreover, we propose a reinforcement learning based viewpoint policy optimization framework, which models camera control as a sequential decision-making process and learns long-horizon observation strategies beyond supervised trajectory imitation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamVLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under both passive observation and dynamic viewpoint settings, validating the effectiveness of active camera-based reasoning for surveillance video understanding. Our datasets, model, and code will be available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/CamVLM .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CamVLM框架，通过动态视角控制使大型视觉语言模型(LVLM)能够主动获取监控视频中的视觉证据，而非被动分析固定视频流。作者构建了两个大规模数据集（CCTV-Anomaly用于监控异常理解，CamTrack-53K用于视角轨迹学习），并提出基于强化学习(RL)的视角策略优化方法，将相机控制建模为序列决策过程。实验表明CamVLM在被动观察和动态视角两种设置下均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在通用视频理解上取得了显著进展，但应用于监控视频仍面临两大挑战：(1)缺乏大规模领域特定数据集；(2)固定视角的被动观察存在局限性。在监控场景中，当目标距离远、尺寸小、被遮挡或移出视野时，关键视觉证据容易被遗漏，需要模型具备主动获取视觉证据的能力。
AI.method: (1)构建CCTV-Anomaly数据集：包含14,459个视频、10类异常类别，带有详细描述和事件标注；(2)构建CamTrack-53K数据集：将视角控制形式化为主动视觉感知问题，用于学习以目标为中心的相机动作；(3)提出基于强化学习的视角策略优化框架：将相机控制建模为序列决策过程，学习长时序观测策略，超越有监督的轨迹模仿学习。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CamVLM在被动观察和动态视角两种设置下均达到最先进的性能，验证了主动基于相机的推理对监控视频理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CamVLM证明让视觉语言模型主动控制视角（"Thinking with Cameras"）能有效解决监控视频中小目标、遮挡和视野外移动等关键证据遗漏问题，为监控场景的视频理解提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Fluent Generation: A CPU Reliability Benchmark for MCP-Style Tool Calling in Sub-2B Small Language Models for Edge Deployment
summary: Resource constrained single-board computers including Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, Arduino UNO Q, Orange Pi, and LattePanda motivate on-device small language model (SLM) agents that reduce cloud dependence, improve data locality, and tolerate intermittent connectivity. Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool invocation demands more than fluent generation: an agent must emit machine-readable JSON, select the correct tool, supply all required arguments, and avoid unintended actions. We establish a platform-agnostic CPU baseline by evaluating five open-weight models below two billion parameters Phi-1.5, Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat, Qwen2.5-0.5B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 100 prompts spanning weather retrieval, web search, calculation, email composition, and task creation, under greedy decoding and nucleus sampling. A recovery parser strips Markdown fences, extracts brace-delimited substrings, and scores parseability, tool-name correctness, argument completeness, and value agreement. Under this criterion, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 75% (greedy) and 79% (sampling); Qwen2.5-0.5B achieves 72% (greedy) but drops to 32% under sampling. Phi-1.5 scores 0%; Pythia and TinyLlama reach at most 7%. A strict post-hoc audit finds only 5 of 1,000 raw responses directly parseable as JSON, exposing near-total dependence on output recovery. A CPU resource probe shows Qwen2.5-1.5B requires 7,960 MiB and 30.782 s mean latency; Qwen2.5-0.5B uses 3,637 MiB and 10.627 s, revealing a reliability-resource trade-off for edge deployment. These results do not cover the named boards directly or a full MCP implementation. Safe deployment requires schema validation, constrained generation, least-privilege execution, and human escalation for consequential actions.

AI.tldr: 本文在无GPU的CPU环境下评估了五种低于20亿参数的开源小语言模型（SLM）在MCP风格工具调用任务上的可靠性，发现Qwen2.5-1.5B表现最佳（75-79%），但仅有0.5%的原始响应可直接解析为JSON，几乎完全依赖恢复解析器；同时揭示了边缘部署中可靠性与资源消耗之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 资源受限的单板计算机（如树莓派、Jetson Nano等）需要部署端侧SLM代理以减少云端依赖、改善数据局部性并容忍网络不稳定。然而MCP风格的工具调用不仅要求流畅生成，还要求模型能输出机器可读的JSON、选择正确的工具、提供全部必要参数并避免意外操作，这对小模型提出了超越文本生成的可靠性挑战。
AI.method: 在CPU平台上对五个开源模型（Phi-1.5、Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat、Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B）进行了评估，使用100个覆盖天气检索、网络搜索、计算、邮件撰写和任务创建等场景的提示词，在贪心解码和核采样两种方式下测试。采用恢复解析器去除Markdown格式标记、提取花括号分隔的子串，并从可解析性、工具名正确性、参数完整性和数值一致性四方面评分。此外还进行了严格的原始响应审计和CPU资源消耗探测。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B在贪心解码下达到75%、采样下达79%；Qwen2.5-0.5B在贪心下为72%但采样下骤降至32%；Phi-1.5得分为0%，Pythia和TinyLlama最高仅7%。严格审计发现1000条原始响应中仅5条可直接解析为JSON，暴露了对输出恢复的近乎完全依赖。CPU资源探测显示Qwen2.5-1.5B需7,960 MiB内存和30.782秒平均延迟，Qwen2.5-0.5B需3,637 MiB和10.627秒，揭示了边缘部署中的可靠性-资源权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明当前小模型在未辅助的条件下难以可靠执行工具调用任务，安全部署必须结合模式验证、约束生成、最小权限执行以及针对重要操作的人工升级机制。同时指出该研究未直接覆盖所列单板计算机或完整的MCP实现，存在局限性。

title: One MLLM, One Call: Efficient Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation via Spatial-Aware Waypoints
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to navigate unseen environments by following natural language instructions. Current zero-shot VLN-CE methods either rely on pre-trained waypoint predictors or require multiple queries to large models per step. To address prohibitive inference latency and computational overhead, we propose O2C-Nav, an efficient zero-shot navigation framework that calls only a single large model once per decision step. Our approach introduces a training-free structured waypoint generator and a novel abstract representation that projects sparse, history-aware candidate waypoints directly onto RGB images as visual markers. The MLLM selects a waypoint or generates a fallback target bounding box at each step, while a low-level Fast Marching Method (FMM) planner converts the selected target into an executable collision-free path. This paradigm provides the model with concrete spatial perception and explicit memory while significantly reducing the visual processing load. Extensive evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks demonstrate that O2C-Nav outperforms current state-of-the-art zero-shot methods, highlighting its great potential for real-time robotic deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/kkpsq/O2C-Nav-Code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出O2C-Nav，一种高效的零样本VLN-CE导航框架，每步仅需调用一次大型模型。通过训练无关的结构化航点生成器和将稀疏候选航点投影到RGB图像上的抽象视觉标记表示，配合FMM低层规划器，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上超越了现有最先进的零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本VLN-CE方法要么依赖预训练的航点预测器，要么每步需要向大型模型发起多次查询，导致推理延迟和计算开销过大，难以满足实际部署需求。
AI.method: 提出O2C-Nav框架：(1)引入训练无关的结构化航点生成器；(2)设计新颖的抽象表示，将稀疏且具有历史感知的候选航点作为视觉标记直接投影到RGB图像上；(3)MLLM每步选择航点或生成回退目标边界框；(4)底层使用快速行进法(FMM)规划器将所选目标转换为可执行的碰撞规避路径。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上的大量实验表明，O2C-Nav优于当前最先进的零样本方法，展现出在实时机器人部署中的巨大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该范式为模型提供了具体的空间感知和显式记忆，同时显著降低了视觉处理负担，证明了单次大模型调用即可实现高效零样本VLN-CE导航的可行性。

title: Beyond Single-Negative Preference: Multi-Negative DPO for LLM-Centric Historical Entity Linking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise for historical entity linking, but preference optimization for this task is often formulated with only one negative candidate per training instance. This discards information from the remaining candidates retrieved for the same mention. We introduce multi-negative direct preference optimisation (MDPO), a reference-based pairwise objective that compares the correct entity with all valid rejected candidates associated with each mention. MDPO preserves the Bradley-Terry formulation of DPO while exploiting the complete candidate set through masked, length-normalised sequence scores. We evaluate MDPO on hipe-2020 and newseye, covering French, German, English, Swedish, and Finnish historical newspaper text. Experiments show that MDPO improves over supervised fine-tuning and single-negative DPO, with particularly strong gains for NIL mentions, semantic ambiguity, OCR noise, and historically difficult names. Further analyses disentangle candidate-generation and selection errors, showing that candidate retrieval remains a key bottleneck for end-to-end entity linking. These results demonstrate that incorporating all within-instance negative candidates is a simple and effective improvement for LLM-based historical entity linking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多负样本直接偏好优化（MDPO），通过利用每个提及对应的所有有效负候选样本（而非仅单个负样本）来改进基于大语言模型的历史实体链接任务。在五个欧洲语言的历史报纸语料上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型用于历史实体链接时，偏好优化通常每个训练实例只使用一个负候选样本，丢弃了同一提及下其余检索到的候选信息，造成信息浪费，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出MDPO方法，一种基于参考（reference-based）的成对目标函数，将正确实体与所有有效拒绝候选进行比较。该方法保留DPO的Bradley-Terry公式，同时通过掩码（masked）和长度归一化的序列分数充分利用完整候选集。
AI.result: 在hipe-2020和newseye数据集上（涵盖法语、德语、英语、瑞典语和芬兰语的历史报纸文本），MDPO优于监督微调和单负样本DPO，在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声和历史疑难名称等场景下提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 在训练实例内纳入所有负候选样本是提升基于LLM的历史实体链接的简单有效改进。此外，分析表明候选检索仍是端到端实体链接的关键瓶颈，应为后续优化重点。

title: OracleZoom: On-Policy Self-Distillation Inspired Reference-Constrained Recursive Image Super Resolution
summary: Recursive Super-Resolution (SR) extends fixed-scale SR to extreme magnification by repeatedly feeding predictions back into the same model, analogous to zooming an image repeatedly. However, ground truth availability at every scale, especially at depth, remains challenging as the required source resolution grows geometrically, leaving deeper predictions unsupervised. We present OracleZoom, an on-policy distillation-inspired, reference-constrained framework that trains on its trajectory while carrying the last ground-truth evidence beyond the supervision boundary. Direct and cross-scale supervision constrain verifiable content, while a no-reference quality objective guides unresolved fine-scale detail. A KL-constrained pretrained latent prior limits quality-driven drift, while EMA consistency stabilizes the supervision boundary.
