Across seven datasets, OracleZoom achieves the state-of-the-art SR quality across zooming scales, averaging 0.713 CLIPIQA, with larger gains on deeper scales, while significantly reducing hallucinations. Code, data, and models are available at https://dipta007.github.io/OracleZoom/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出OracleZoom，一种基于on-policy蒸馏的参考约束递归超分辨率框架，通过轨迹自训练解决深层重采样中真值缺失问题，在七个数据集上实现SOTA效果并显著减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 递归超分辨率将固定倍率SR扩展到极端放大，但深层放大时所需源分辨率呈几何增长导致真值难以获取，深层预测缺乏监督，影响超分辨率质量和可靠性。
AI.method: 提出OracleZoom框架：采用on-policy蒸馏式训练策略，沿模型自身轨迹训练并将最后真值证据传递到监督边界之外；通过直接监督和跨尺度监督约束可验证内容，使用无参考质量目标引导未解决细节；用KL约束的预训练潜在先验限制质量驱动漂移，EMA一致性稳定监督边界。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上达到SOTA超分辨率质量，平均CLIPIQA达0.713，在更深尺度性能增益更大，同时显著减少幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: OracleZoom有效解决了递归SR中深层真值缺失问题，通过自我蒸馏和多重约束实现了更高质量且更少幻觉的超分辨率效果。

title: An LLM-Associated Register Shift in Korean Journal Abstracts: A Morphology-Aware Excess-Vocabulary Study, 2018-2026
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 31 tables. Working paper. Data, code and this version are deposited at Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22303588
summary: Excess vocabulary, a word's frequency above its pre-2023 trend, is how the change in scholarly English after 2022 has been measured. We adapt it to Korean with morphological units on 398,296 KCI abstracts (2018-August 2026), with 47,165 Vietnamese abstracts for comparison. Placebo floors are 0.1-2.2 points for the single-word statistic and at most 2.9 for the re-selected split-half set statistic. Korean abstracts show nothing in 2023, onset in late 2024, a rise through 2025 flattening in mid-2026: sisahada "suggest" appears in 21.4% of 2026 abstracts against 5.3% expected; plain verbs like araboda "look into" fall to a quarter of trend. Under stated assumptions the single-word conditional lower bound on LLM-processed abstracts is 3.5%, 10.5% and 16.1% for 2024-2026 and a split-half set bound 7.8%, 20.6% and 33.0%. Holzwarth et al.'s estimator under the same discipline gives 41.9% and 72.1% for 2025-2026. Subject-matter controls reduce but do not remove it: restricting the set to lemmas three language-model annotators all call style leaves 14.7 of the 33.0 points, and pairing each 2026 abstract with its journal's closest base-period abstract leaves 34.1. Tested translation routes do not explain it: the surface marks of translated Korean fall as the markers rise. In the same articles' English abstracts the excess appears a year earlier; where the English side carries none, the Korean shift persists at 30 to 66% of the rate where it does. Control abstracts from three providers reproduce the rising words, with marker turnover consistent with model generations; implied prevalences are scenario-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了"超额词汇"概念在韩语学术英文摘要中的应用。通过对398,296篇KCI韩语摘要（2018-2026年8月）及47,165篇越南语对照摘要的分析，发现韩语摘要中2023年未出现异常，但2024年底开始上升并在2025-2026年持续增长，表现为"建议"（sisahada）等词汇使用激增，简单动词使用骤降。估计2024-2026年被LLM处理的摘要比例下限为3.5%、10.5%和16.1%，且排除了翻译路线等替代解释。
AI.motivation: ChatGPT于2022年底发布后，学者们开发了"超额词汇"方法来量化学术英文的变化。本研究旨在将该方法适应韩语，鉴定2022年后韩语学术摘要是否以及多大程度上受到LLM影响，并通过越南语对照、多语种比较等方式强化证据。
AI.method: 将超额词汇统计方法适配于韩语的形态学单位，利用398,296篇KCI韩语摘要（2018年-2026年8月）检测词频偏离2023年前趋势的程度。采用单词统计与重选分裂半数统计两种方法，设置安慰剂下限；设计多种稳健性检验：学科控制、基期配对、翻译路线测试、三种LLM注释者的风格词汇限制等，并与越南语对照比较。
AI.result: 韩语摘要2023年无异常，2024年底出现，2025年上升并在2026年中期趋于平台期。关键词"sisahada（建议）"在2026年21.4%的摘要中出现（预期5.3%）。LLM处理摘要的单词条件下限估计为2024-2026年分别3.5%、10.5%、16.1%，分裂半数设置给出7.8%、20.6%、33.0%。控制变量与替代性解释（如翻译路线）均未能完全消解效应。英文摘要中的超额现象比韩语提前一年出现。
AI.conclusion: 韩语学术摘要自2024年底起显著受到LLM影响，且影响持续到2026年，排除了翻译等替代解释后证据依然稳健。中英文超额词汇的出现时间差以及韩英文同步发表的对照结果，共同支持LLM在学术写作中的应用正在快速扩散的判断。

title: Diffuse2Seg: Diffusion Models Can Segment Anything Without Supervision
summary: Open-world entity segmentation aims to predict masks for arbitrary objects across domains and at multiple granularities, from parts to whole objects. In this setting, SAM sets a strong standard: trained on SA-1B, comprising 11M images and over 1B carefully annotated masks, it achieves remarkable zero-shot performance. Collecting such labels is expensive and time-consuming, however, which limits how far this recipe can scale. Text-to-image diffusion models offer a way around this. Their intermediate features transfer well across perception tasks, and since object structure emerges as the model denoises a noise sample into an image conditioned on a text prompt, that structure is already encoded in these representations. They can therefore be exploited for open-world entity segmentation without retraining or supervision. Building on this observation, we introduce Diffuse2Seg, which repurposes generative diffusion models for automatic mask generation by propagating a grid of point prompts through their self-attention representations in an edge-preserving manner. Diffuse2Seg produces multi-granular instance masks and outperforms prior state-of-the-art label generators by 4.3-7.1 p.p. in AR_1000 across five domains. Training an instance segmentation model on these generated masks advances detector-free open-world segmentation by 7.4 and 7.7 p.p. on "things" and "stuff+things" datasets and surpasses the detector-based UnSAM on "stuff+things" by 2.1 p.p. in AR_1000. Finally, we show that a model trained on Diffuse2Seg labels provides a strong initialization for semi-supervised learning, outperforming its fully supervised counterpart with already 5k labeled images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diffuse2Seg，利用文本到图像扩散模型的自注意力表示来自动生成开放世界实体分割的掩码标签，无需重新训练或人工监督，在多个数据集上显著优于现有标签生成方法，并提升了开放世界分割的性能。
AI.motivation: SAM等现有开放世界实体分割模型依赖大量人工标注（如SA-1B包含1100万图像和超10亿掩码），数据收集成本高昂且耗时，限制了模型的扩展能力。作者希望利用扩散模型的中间特征来绕过昂贵的标注过程。
AI.method: Diffuse2Seg复用生成式扩散模型的去噪过程，通过向自注意力表示传播网格点提示词来生成掩码，采用边缘保持的方式实现多粒度实例分割，无需重新训练或人工监督。将生成的掩码用于训练实例分割模型，并用于半监督学习的初始化。
AI.result: 在五个域上比现有最优标签生成器提升4.3-7.1个百分点（AR_1000）；训练的实例分割模型在"things"和"stuff+things"数据集上分别提升7.4和7.7个百分点，超越检测器基础的UnSAM在"stuff+things"上2.1个百分点；半监督学习下仅用5k标注图像即超过全监督版本。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的特征表示可有效用于自动生成高质量分割标签，为开放世界分割提供了一条低成本、可扩展的路径，同时证明了该标签可用于训练强模型并在半监督学习中有效。

title: FramingQA: Does the Question Shape the Answer? Measuring the Compositional Framing Effect
summary: We introduce FramingQA, a benchmark that measures the model sensitivity to question framing across law, medicine, finance, and robotic simulations. Large language models (LLMs) often change their responses to subtle rephrasings that align with an implied stance by users. This can leave users with advice tainted by how they happened to phrase a question rather than by the underlying facts, and the consequences are highly costly in high-stakes domains. Because in the realistic scenarios, both expert practitioners and non-expert users frequently ask LLMs questions containing incomplete or misleading assumptions, models are highly susceptible to those framings. To test this, we inject the framing bias across three nested levels: a framing-biased question phrasing (root), an injected framing-biased premise prepended to a neutral question (propositional), and a premise paired with a framing-biased question (global). Evaluating nine open models (3.8B-70B) across four families, we find that strong per-variant accuracy does not guarantee the robustness across differently phrased questions under the fixed factual information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FramingQA基准，用于衡量大语言模型对问题框架（framing）敏感度的评估，覆盖法律、医学、金融和机器人仿真领域。测试发现，模型在面对带有隐含立场或误导性假设的措辞时，容易改变回答，导致事实信息不变但答案随提问方式漂移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常因用户提问的细微措辞变化（隐含立场或误导性假设）而改变回答，这在法律、医学、金融等高风险领域可能导致严重后果。现有评估未能充分衡量模型的框架敏感性问题，因此需要系统化的基准来量化这一风险。
AI.method: 构建FramingQA基准，设计三层嵌套的框架注入方式：（1）root层——框架偏置的问题措辞；（2）propositional层——在中立问题前附加框架偏置的前提；（3）global层——前提与框架偏置问题组合。评估9个开放模型（3.8B-70B）覆盖4个模型家族。
AI.result: 研究发现，模型在单个变体上的强准确率并不能保证在不同措辞问题上的鲁棒性——即使在固定事实信息不变的条件下，模型回答仍会随问题框架而显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在跨问题框架的鲁棒性方面存在系统性不足，现有的单一指标评估方式可能掩盖这种脆弱性。该基准为衡量高风险领域中模型的框架敏感性提供了标准化工具。

title: CAM: Question Answering on Entity-Centric Videos with Continuous Extraction and Adaptive Querying
summary: Memory facilitates question answering over long videos by extracting and retrieving facts to fit within the limited context windows of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). Existing solutions typically extract independent memory entries from fixed-length video clips and thus cannot capture high-level semantics that need to be summarized over extended time periods, such as character traits and relations. Moreover, they rely solely on similarity-based retrieval and may fail to retrieve the fine-grained details required for question answering. To tackle these problems, we propose CAM, featuring continuous extraction for high-level semantics and adaptive querying for fine-grained details. In particular, CAM stores the entities and relations extracted from video clips in a knowledge graph. To capture the high-level semantics of each entity or relation, CAM summarizes the local subgraph of the target entity or relation once the subgraph reaches a predefined size. To retrieve the fine-grained details required for question answering, CAM supports multiple search methods, including knowledge graph traversal, video re-watching, and audio listening. It utilizes a planner-executor-verifier pipeline to adaptively compose these search methods according to question intent. Evaluations on three benchmarks show that CAM outperforms SOTA baselines and improves their accuracy by up to 23 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/Jake-Tian/CAM.

AI.tldr: CAM通过知识图谱实现连续高层语义提取和自适应查询，解决长视频问答中MLLM上下文受限的问题，在三个基准上比现有最优方法提升最多23个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答记忆方案从固定长度视频片段中提取独立记忆条目，无法捕捉需要跨长时间段总结的高层语义（如人物性格和关系）；同时仅依赖基于相似度的检索，可能无法获取问答所需的细粒度细节。
AI.method: CAM采用知识图谱存储从视频片段中提取的实体和关系。当某个实体或关系的局部子图达到预设大小后，对其进行总结以捕捉高层语义。CAM支持多种检索方法（知识图谱遍历、视频重看、音频听取），并通过规划器-执行器-验证器流水线根据问题意图自适应组合这些检索方法。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的评估显示，CAM优于当前最优基线方法，并将基线准确率提升最多23个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CAM通过知识图谱连续提取与自适应多模态查询机制，有效解决了长视频问答中高层语义缺失和细粒度细节检索不足的问题。

title: MEMO: Multimodal Evidence Memory Organization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to store and reuse information beyond a single context window, yet there is a fundamental tension between the continuous accumulation of interaction trajectories and the limited context capacity. The key challenge in agent memory is therefore not only to retrieve relevant records, but also to select necessary evidence under a given budget and organize it in an appropriate modality. Existing memory readout methods mainly use textual or visual forms. Text preserves high fidelity, but its linear token representation makes contents with different importance compete for the limited context at nearly uniform unit cost. Visual readout renders text into document-like images, which can use two-dimensional layouts to expose structure and emphasize key information, but it may lose fine-grained details during rendering and compression. To address this issue, we propose MEMO, a multimodal evidence memory organization method for LLM agents. MEMO first uses a trained evidence extractor to select relevant memory blocks and form evidence units with source information and presentation requirements. A trained query-conditioned memory manager assigns each unit to a textual, visual, or dual-channel carrier and selects a layout that matches the evidence structure. A deterministic memory construction module then generates the textual package and visual pages. The memory manager is trained with feedback from an offline reader that measures the utility of the guided memory plan, so that retention and presentation decisions align with downstream usage. We evaluate MEMO on four benchmarks, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, LoCoMo, and ALFWorld, with multiple reader backends. The results show that MEMO presents memory more efficiently with fewer memory tokens, improves downstream task performance, and builds more effective working memory under constrained budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出MEMO，一种用于LLM智能体的多模态证据记忆组织方法，通过训练证据提取器选择相关记忆块，并由查询条件化的记忆管理器将其分配至文本、视觉或双通道载体，以高效利用有限的上下文预算。
AI.motivation: 长运行LLM智能体依赖外部记忆进行信息存储与复用，但记忆轨迹的持续累积与有限的上下文容量之间存在根本矛盾。现有文本式记忆读入保真度高但线性表示导致不同重要性的内容以近似均匀的单位成本竞争有限上下文；视觉式读入可利用二维布局突出结构但可能损失细节。
AI.method: MEMO包含三个核心组件：(1) 训练的证据提取器用于选择相关记忆块并形成带有源信息和展示需求的证据单元；(2) 查询条件化的记忆管理器将每个单元分配到文本、视觉或双通道载体，并选择与证据结构匹配的布局；(3) 确定性记忆构建模块生成文本包裹和视觉页面。记忆管理器通过离线读取器的反馈进行训练，使保留与呈现决策与下游使用对齐。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、LoCoMo和ALFWorld四个基准上使用多个读取器后端进行评估。结果表明MEMO以更少的记忆令牌更高效地呈现记忆，提升了下游任务性能，并在有限预算下构建了更有效的工作记忆。
AI.conclusion: MEMO通过多模态记忆呈现策略有效解决了大上下文记忆中的预算分配问题，验证了文本与视觉载体互补的记忆组织方式在提高记忆效率与下游性能方面的有效性。

title: A Cloud-Based Hybrid Model for Real-Time Detection of BRTA-Approved Licence Plates Using YOLO Tiny and Haar Cascade
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in 2024 27th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT), Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, 2024, pp. 2488-2493, doi: 10.1109/ICCIT64611.2024.11022598
summary: Accurate vehicle license plate detection is essential for applications such as intelligent transportation systems, toll collection, parking management, and law enforcement. In Bangladesh, this task presents distinct challenges due to the complexity of localized license plates and environmental factors like lighting, occlusion, motion blur, and obstructions such as dirt or mud. These challenges often render conventional methods ineffective. This paper introduces a novel hybrid approach, combining the YOLO Tiny deep learning model with the Haar-Cascade classifier, for enhanced detection and localization of Bengali license plates. A key innovation of our system is the integration of a dynamic retraining pipeline, which allows the model to adapt to evolving real-world conditions. This retraining mechanism significantly boosts performance in low-confidence scenarios by continuously improving the model's accuracy as new data is encountered. Additionally, a publicly accessible dataset of BRTA-compliant license plates, captured under diverse and challenging conditions, has been developed to support this approach. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach not only achieves superior detection accuracy and computational efficiency over conventional models but also ensures consistent performance in resource-constrained environments, particularly in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合YOLO Tiny深度学习模型与Haar-Cascade分类器的混合方法，用于孟加拉语车牌检测，并引入动态重训练流水线以提升模型在真实多变环境下的适应性。实验表明该方法在检测精度和计算效率上优于传统模型，并适合资源受限环境。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国的车牌检测面临本地车牌结构复杂及光照、遮挡、运动模糊、污垢等环境因素的严峻挑战，传统方法在这些场景下效果不佳，亟需一种鲁棒且高效的检测方案。
AI.method: 采用YOLO Tiny与Haar-Cascade分类器相结合的混合检测架构，并创新性地集成动态重训练流水线，使模型能够根据新遇到的数据持续自我优化，提升低置信度场景下的检测表现。同时构建了符合BRTA规范的公开车牌数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法在检测精度和计算效率方面均优于传统模型，且在资源受限环境中（尤其是孟加拉国）能够保持一致的稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: 该混合方法有效解决了孟加拉语车牌在复杂环境下的检测难题，动态重训练机制是提升模型适应性的关键创新，为资源受限环境下的智能交通应用提供了可行方案。

title: Where Should Language Sit in a Multimodal Model? Lessons from What Language Does to Human Perception and Cognition
summary: Language models compute over tokens: language is their input, their output, and increasingly their internal representation. Whether language should keep all of these positions depends on what language does to the system that uses it. The one system with a century of data on that question is the human. We review what language does to human perception, the brain, and thought, and read the same evidence against multimodal models and language models. Throughout, we treat language as a compressor that runs on a shared codebook: a word is an index, the content is in the receiver, and a community maintains the codebook. In humans the compression is measurable, learning the codebook reorganizes the senses, and thought survives the loss of language. We then measure the rule that models apply when two cues disagree, with cue-conflict experiments on six vision-language models and two robot policies. Surviving cues are weighted in the order their reliabilities prescribe, at 11 to 82\% of the ideal observer's slope, and many answers copy the text. One policy family drops a cue that adds no information beyond the others rather than down-weighting it, another keeps it at a weight that fails when the cues conflict, and a visual cue that identifies the task in every training frame is never learned, because the language pathway already fits the data. Language models are the best current models of the human language network, and they have entered the human speech community, shifting word frequencies while alignment narrows their conceptual diversity. We close with seven implications for token-based systems. Language belongs at a model's boundary and in the shared codebook, as in the brain, not as its internal representation; the price of leaving the codebook inside is auditability.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了语言对人类感知、大脑和思维的影响，将语言视为运行在共享码本上的压缩器，并通过提示冲突实验检验了多模态模型和语言模型处理冲突线索的规则，最后提出关于词元系统设计的七项启示。
AI.motivation: 需要解答语言在模型计算中应扮演什么角色的问题——是作为输入、输出还是内部表示。通过借鉴人类百年数据来理解语言对系统的影响，从而为多模态模型和语言模型的边界设计提供依据。
AI.method: 首先对人类研究证据进行综述，将语言概念化为共享码本上的压缩器；然后设计提示冲突实验，对六个视觉语言模型和两个机器人策略进行测试，测量模型在两种线索不一致时的加权规则和可靠性遵循程度。
AI.result: 模型对冲突线索的加权介于理想观察者斜率的11%至82%之间，许多回答直接复制文本；一个策略族直接丢弃无新增信息的线索而非降权，另一个则保持固定权重导致冲突失败；一个在每帧训练数据中都识别任务的视觉线索从未被学习，因为语言通路已足以拟合数据。
AI.conclusion: 语言应位于模型边界及共享码本中（如同在大脑中的位置），而非作为内部表示；将码本留在模型内部的代价是可审计性的丧失。

title: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
summary: Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retention via neuron-level gradient manipulation. Our method maintains a compact historical knowledge state to protect highly activated MLP neurons that preserve previous knowledge. When a new application arrives, it performs real-time gradient surgery conditioned on forward activation. Concretely, the protected neurons are categorized into two types: unactivated neurons holding specific knowledge, whose gradients are truncated to prevent interference; and activated neurons holding shared knowledge, whose gradients are orthogonally projected to preserve stability while enabling adaptation. After each application stage, newly identified critical neurons are merged into the historical state for future learning. Empirical evaluations on multi-app sequential benchmark demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting on prior applications while sustaining robust adaptation to new ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于激活条件的选择性知识控制方法，通过神经元级别的梯度操纵实现GUI智能体的持续学习，在保留旧应用知识的同时适应新应用。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体需要适应不断演化的应用程序，但新应用与旧应用之间存在共享知识和特定知识的复杂关系，现有持续学习方法难以在保留历史知识的同时有效学习新知识。
AI.method: 维护紧凑的历史知识状态来保护承载旧知识的高激活MLP神经元；在新应用到达时，根据前向激活进行实时梯度手术——未激活神经元（特定知识）截断梯度防止干扰，激活神经元（共享知识）正交投影保持稳定性同时允许适应；每个应用阶段后将新识别的关键神经元合并进历史状态。
AI.result: 在多应用顺序基准上的实验表明，该方法有效缓解了旧应用的灾难性遗忘，同时保持了对新应用的稳健适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是一种轻量级的选择性知识保留方案，为GUI智能体在应用流环境下的持续学习提供了有效途径。

title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR Technical Report
summary: In recent years, automatic speech recognition (ASR) has witnessed transformative advancements driven by three complementary paradigms: data scaling, model scaling, and deep integration with large language models (LLMs). However, bridging the gap between academic benchmark performance and real-world production utility remains a persistent challenge, particularly in handling diverse regional dialects, dynamic entities and hotwords, long-range contextual information, and disfluent spontaneous speech. In this report, we present Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM-based ASR system designed to address these production demands through a unified, instruction-following framework. The model is built upon the Qwen backbone, and is trained on tens of millions of hours of large-scale speech data. Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR supports transcription across 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialectal varieties spanning eight major dialect regions. Beyond multilingual and dialectal recognition, the model provides production-oriented capabilities including industry-domain entity recognition, hierarchical hotword customization, native single-pass transcription polishing, and long-audio contextual modeling. We further develop a dedicated streaming variant, Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming, for latency-sensitive applications. Extensive evaluations on Chinese, English, multilingual, and real-world industrial test sets demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive recognition performance across a broad range of evaluation conditions, with strong performance relative to leading commercial and proprietary systems including GPT-4o Transcribe and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR，一个基于Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)和大语言模型的自动语音识别(ASR)系统，旨在弥合学术基准与现实生产应用之间的差距。该系统支持30种语言和16种汉语方言变体，并提供领域实体识别、热词定制、语音文本润色和长音频上下文建模等面向生产的功能，同时配备流式计算变体以满足低延迟需求。实验表明其在多种评估条件下达到了领先或极具竞争力的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 当前ASR领域虽然通过数据扩展、模型扩展和与LLM深度集成取得了显著进展，但在现实生产应用中仍面临地域方言多样性、动态实体和热词处理、长距离上下文建模以及非流利自发言语等挑战。作者旨在构建一个能够弥合学术基准与现实生产性能差距的统一指令跟随式ASR系统。
AI.method: 该模型基于Qwen骨干网络构建MoE架构，使用数千万小时的大规模语音数据进行训练。模型采用统一指令跟随框架，支持30种语言和16种汉语方言变体（覆盖八个主要方言区）。除多语言和方言识别外，还提供行业领域实体识别、层级化热词定制、单遍转录润色和长音频上下文建模等面向生产的功能，并开发了专门的流式变体Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Streaming用于时延敏感型应用。
AI.result: 在中文、英文、多语言以及真实工业测试集上的广泛评估表明，系统达到了最先进或极具竞争力的识别性能，相较于包括GPT-4o Transcribe和Gemini 3.1 Pro在内的领先商业及专有系统表现出强劲的性能。
AI.conclusion: Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR通过MoE架构和LLM深度集成的统一框架，成功解决了ASR从学术研究到生产部署中的多项关键挑战，在方言处理、实体识别、热词定制和长音频建模等方面取得了突破性成果，验证了大语言模型与语音识别系统深度结合的可行性。

title: 3DHarnessBench: Probing Agentic 3D-to-Code Capabilities of Frontier Vision-Language Models
summary: We introduce 3DHarnessBench, a benchmark that evaluates the agentic ability of frontier vision-language models (VLMs) to recover 3D geometry as Blender Python code from a variety of inputs. Unlike previous frameworks that prompt the VLMs with a fixed input (e.g., a single rendering or a text description), 3DHarnessBench evaluates four separate harness settings that progressively enable active agentic exploration, facilitated by recent Blender MCP functionality. Our hierarchy from Single-view, Multi-view, Active Visual (arbitrary viewpoint access), and Full 3D Interaction (complete access to the target object through Blender function calls) probes the models' abilities in both visual perception and active inference, tool calling, and self-correction. We observe that the ability of all frontier models to recover 3D geometry improves significantly with richer function call access, although the improvements are strongly model-dependent, revealing highly uneven agentic 3D-to-code capabilities. We will release the benchmark, code, outputs, and agent trajectories for reproducible 3D evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍3DHarnessBench基准，用于评估前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）将3D几何恢复为Blender Python代码的智能体能力。该基准通过四种递进式交互设置（单视图、多视图、主动视觉、完整3D交互），利用Blender MCP功能逐步启用主动智能体探索，系统评估模型在视觉感知、主动推理、工具调用和自我纠错方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 以往评估视觉语言模型3D重建能力的框架通常使用固定输入（如单一渲染图或文本描述），无法充分测试模型的主动智能体能力。作者希望构建一个更全面的基准，能够评估模型在逐步增加交互自由度的情况下恢复3D几何结构的能力差异。
AI.method: 3DHarnessBench设计了四个递进式基准设置：Single-view（单视图）、Multi-view（多视图）、Active Visual（任意视点访问）和Full 3D Interaction（通过Blender函数调用完全访问目标对象）。该框架利用Blender MCP功能实现主动智能体探索，要求模型输出Blender Python代码以恢复3D几何。
AI.result: 所有前沿模型在更丰富的函数调用访问条件下，其3D几何恢复能力均显著提升，但提升幅度因模型而异，显示出各模型在智能体式3D到代码转换方面能力分布很不均匀。
AI.conclusion: 3DHarnessBench提供了一个可复现的3D评估基准，并将公开发布其基准、代码、输出及智能体轨迹，用于支持可重复的3D智能体能力评测。

title: We're Cooked! - Probing LLM Political Alignment Via Conflict-Framed Recipe Translation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for translation tasks, yet their implicit political positioning in such contexts remains understudied. We ask whether a single politically charged framing term, such as aggressor, enemy, neighbour, or coloniser is sufficient to trigger implicit political alignment in an otherwise apolitical task. We present a fully crossed factorial study in which eight models spanning Western, Chinese, and European origins are prompted to translate culturally attributed recipes into a target language left deliberately unspecified. Across 17 languages, four framing conditions, eight models, and 15,680 responses, we find that models do not simply decline or ask for clarification but resolve the ambiguity. Language resolution and reasoning behavior cluster meaningfully along model families: Western models hedge and deflect with vague justifications, Chinese models resolve conflicts silently, and Mistral Large emerges as a distinct profile combining high compliance with conflict-grounded reasoning. Sensitivity to framing terms is consistent across models: even subtle framing variation is sufficient to modulate behavior. Our findings urge caution when deploying LLMs for translation in conflict-adjacent contexts, where implicit political judgments may be made without any signal to the user.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过全因子实验（8个模型×17种语言×4种框架条件×15,680条响应），发现LLMs在翻译任务中即便面对单一政治敏感框架词（如"侵略者"、"敌人"等），也会产生隐含的政治立场对齐，且不同模型家族表现出可聚类的行为模式：西方模型回避含糊、中国模型沉默解决、Mistral Large则表现出高服从性与冲突推理结合的特征。
AI.motivation: LLMs越来越多地被用于翻译任务，但其在此类场景中的隐含政治定位尚未得到充分研究。作者希望探究在一个看似非政治的任务中，单个政治敏感框架词是否足以触发模型产生隐含的政治立场对齐。
AI.method: 采用完全交叉的因子设计实验：使用8个来自西方、中国和欧洲的LLMs，将被文化归属的菜谱提示翻译为刻意未指定的目标语言。研究涵盖17种语言、4种框架条件，共收集15,680条响应，系统分析模型如何解决语言歧义及推理行为。
AI.result: 研究发现模型不会简单拒绝或要求澄清，而是主动解决歧义。模型家族的行为模式呈显著聚类：西方模型倾向回避和含糊推脱；中国模型倾向于默默解决冲突；Mistral Large表现出独特的行为特征，兼具高服从性和基于冲突的推理。所有模型对框架词均表现出敏感性，即使是微妙的框架变化也足以改变其行为。
AI.conclusion: 在冲突相关的翻译场景中部署LLMs需要谨慎，模型可能在没有向用户发出任何信号的情况下做出隐含的政治判断。

title: Learning to Use Imagination: Progress-Conditioned Future Utilization for World Action Models
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Project page: https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/ProWAM
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) extend Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by incorporating future visual dynamics into action generation. However, existing WAMs often utilize imagined futures with limited adaptation to evolving execution progress, potentially introducing distracting or unreliable predictive cues. This limitation arises from two empirically identified forms of non-uniformity in future utility: (i) at the inter-progress level, the utility of imagined futures varies across execution stages as control demands change; and (ii) at the intra-progress level, individual future latents exhibit heterogeneous relevance within the same progress state. To address these limitations, we propose ProWAM, a Progress-Conditioned World Action Model that introduces execution progress as an explicit intermediate representation for adaptive imagination utilization. ProWAM comprises two tightly coupled components: (1) To obtain a reliable representation of execution progress, we propose the Self-Supervised Dual-Temporal Progress Encoder (SS-DTPE). SS-DTPE couples short-term action-observation interaction modeling with long-term recurrent progress aggregation to capture recent execution feedback and accumulated task history. (2) Conditioned on the progress representation from SS-DTPE, we propose the Hierarchical Progress-Conditioned Imagination Modulation (HPIM) to adapt imagination utilization to execution progress. HPIM operates at two complementary levels: an inter-progress global modulation mechanism adapts future utilization across execution stages, while an intra-progress relevance mechanism differentiates individual future latents within each progress state. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains over strong VLA and WAM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProWAM（进度条件世界动作模型），通过引入执行进度作为显式中间表示，解决现有世界动作模型（WAMs）中想象未来利用不均的问题。包含自监督双时序进度编码器（SS-DTPE）和层次化进度条件想象调制（HPIM）两个核心组件，实验表明在VLA和WAM基线上均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有WAMs将未来视觉动态融入动作生成时，对演化中的执行进度适应能力有限，可能引入干扰性或不可靠的预测线索。作者从经验上识别出未来效用的两种非均匀性：(i)跨进度层面，想象未来的效用随执行阶段控制需求的变化而变化；(ii)进度内层面，同一进度状态下不同未来潜在表示的相关性存在异质性。这些问题限制了WAMs的性能。
AI.method: ProWAM由两个紧密耦合的组件构成：(1) 自监督双时序进度编码器（SS-DTPE），耦合短期动作-观察交互建模与长期递归进度聚合，同时捕捉近期执行反馈和累积任务历史，以获得可靠的执行进度表示；(2) 层次化进度条件想象调制（HPIM），基于SS-DTPE的进度表示，在跨进度层级通过全局调制机制自适应调节未来利用，在进度内层级通过相关性机制区分单个未来潜在特征。
AI.result: 大量实验证明ProWAM相对于强VLA和WAM基线取得一致性的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模执行进度并在两个层级上自适应调制想象未来的利用，ProWAM有效地缓解了想象未来在任务执行中非均匀效用的问题，验证了进度条件化想象利用是提升WAM性能的有效途径。

title: Validating DBpedia Triple Sets for Natural Language Generation
summary: We present a study of the quality of individual DBpedia triples from the perspective of Natural Language Generation, and propose and evaluate an approach for collecting entity-specific triple sets that filters out questionable triples while minimizing the loss of correct ones. We show in an evaluation against manually annotated data that with validation rules, it is possible to reach 98% precision in triple selection, and with improvements to a few Property definitions, it is possible to improve recall by 40% without harming precision.

AI.tldr: 本文从自然语言生成的角度研究了DBpedia三元组的质量问题，提出了一种收集实体特定三元组集合的方法，通过验证规则过滤可疑三元组，在保持最小正确三元组损失的同时达到98%的精确率，并通过改进属性定义将召回率提升40%而不损害精确率。
AI.motivation: DBpedia三元组在自然语言生成任务中存在质量问题，需要一种能够过滤低质量三元组同时保留正确三元组的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种收集实体特定三元组集合的方法，采用验证规则来过滤可疑三元组，并通过改进部分Property定义来提升召回率。
AI.result: 通过验证规则可以达到98%的三元组选择精确率；通过改进属性定义，召回率提升40%且不损害精确率。
AI.conclusion: 验证规则和改进属性定义是提升DBpedia三元组在自然语言生成任务中质量的有效手段，能够在保证精确率的同时显著提高召回率。

title: Reading Decoder Trajectories: Training-Free Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability for Small-Object Detection
summary: Small-object detection remains challenging because limited pixels cause information loss and suppress the scale knowledge encoded in pretrained detectors. Existing approaches mainly improve representations through multiscale training, architecture redesign, or parameter adaptation, implicitly assuming that frozen models lack the required capability. We challenge this assumption and hypothesize that small-object knowledge already exists in frozen detectors but remains underactivated and unstable during query evolution. To test this hypothesis, we propose Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability (CQTR), a training-free framework that elicits latent responses through counterfactual scale interventions and interprets candidate reliability from decoder-internal spatial convergence, semantic persistence, and cross-scale conflicts. A small unlabeled training subset selects the appropriate correction mechanism for each model-data stream, without parameter updates or target-domain annotations. Across 27 combinations of nine frozen detectors and three datasets, CQTR consistently improves average precision (AP) and average precision for small objects (APs). Closed-loop analyses further show that scale intervention activates latent responses, trajectory evidence predicts ground-truth support, and unlabeled routing selects the more effective branch. CQTR therefore reframes small-object detection from external scale augmentation to the activation and reliability assessment of latent scale knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CQTR框架，通过反事实尺度干预和查询轨迹可靠性分析，无需训练即可激活冻结检测器中潜在的小目标知识，在27种模型-数据集组合上一致提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: 小目标检测因像素有限导致信息丢失，现有方法假设冻结模型缺乏所需能力，但作者质疑这一假设，认为小目标知识已存在于冻结检测器中，只是未被充分激活且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability (CQTR)训练-free框架，通过反事实尺度干预激发潜在响应，从解码器内部的空域收敛性、语义持续性和跨尺度冲突三个角度评估候选可靠性，并利用小规模无标注子集选择每对模型-数据流最合适的修正机制，全程无需参数更新或目标域标注。
AI.result: 在9个冻结检测器和3个数据集的27种组合上，CQTR一致提升AP和APs指标。闭环分析验证了尺度干预能激活潜在响应、轨迹证据能预测ground-truth支持度、无标注路由能选择更有效的分支。
AI.conclusion: CQTR将小目标检测从外部尺度增强重构为对潜在尺度知识的激活与可靠性评估，挑战了"冻结模型能力不足"的传统假设，为检测器利用开辟了新范式。

title: ObGynLongBench: Revealing the Evidence-to-EHR Gap in Longitudinal EHR Decision-Making
summary: The application of large language models (LLMs) to personalized medical assistants has garnered growing interest. However, existing medical benchmarks largely rely on static question answering with pre-selected evidence, leaving unclear whether LLMs can make reliable clinical decisions from real longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). To bridge this gap, we introduce ObGynLongBench, a rule-grounded long-context EHR benchmark for obstetric and gynecologic decision-making, comprising 1,500 clinical decision-point cases from 976 real pregnancy EHR histories and traceable rules. Each case is anchored to a patient, a pregnancy-timeline point, and a pre-decision information boundary, enabling Evidence-only, Visit-level EHR, and History-level EHR evaluation. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals a substantial Evidence-to-EHR Gap: models perform well when evidence is directly provided, but accuracy drops when evidence must be extracted from same-day records or full pre-decision EHR histories. Further analyses identify evidence utilization as a key bottleneck: performance decreases with longer EHR contexts and more complex evidence requirements, and earlier failures often predict later failures within the same patient history. Finally, active-search agents perform best among EHR access strategies, highlighting patient-specific evidence utilization as a central challenge for reliable personalized medical assistants. Resources are available at https://github.com/xiangjun2003/ObgynLongbench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ObGynLongBench，一个基于规则的产科和妇科长上下文EHR基准，包含1,500个来自976个真实妊娠EHR历史的临床决策案例及可追溯规则，用于评估LLM在真实纵向电子健康记录中的临床决策能力。对17个LLM的评估揭示了显著的"证据到EHR差距"：模型在直接提供证据时表现良好，但当需要从记录中提取证据时准确率大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准多基于静态问答和预选证据，无法评估LLM能否从真实纵向电子健康记录中做出可靠的临床决策，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建ObGynLongBench基准，包含1,500个临床决策点案例（来自976个真实妊娠EHR历史），每个案例锚定患者、妊娠时间线和决策前信息边界，支持三种评估模式（Evidence-only、Visit-level EHR、History-level EHR），并设计规则可追溯。
AI.result: 对17个LLM的评估显示显著的Evidence-to-EHR差距；性能随EHR上下文增长和证据需求复杂化而下降；同一患者历史中早期失败可预测后期失败；主动搜索智能体在EHR访问策略中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 患者特定的证据利用是构建可靠个性化医疗助手的关键挑战，主动搜索智能体提供了有前景的解决方向。

title: Multi-History-Step SDE Inversion for Image Editing with Superior Regional Awareness
summary: In recent years, diffusion stochastic differential equation (SDE) inversion and inversion-free methods have become prevalent for training-free image editing, as they can achieve faithful reconstruction without tuning. However, existing approaches remain inefficient, exhibit limited plasticity, and struggle to accurately preserve unedited regions. To address these issues, we propose MIEdit, a training-free editing framework based on SDE inversion. MIEdit introduces a predictor-corrector multi-history-step scheme to achieve superior editing quality with fewer steps. We further mitigate heterogeneity and conflict between the multi-conditioned noise residuals and gradient terms during sampling, improving stability and editing plasticity under large edits. MIEdit also includes Inversion-Time Automatic Semantic Angle Masking (IASM); it leverages classifier-free guidance to automatically generate semantic angle masks during inversion and applies them throughout the sampling process for regional constraints, without extra user inputs. We additionally construct EditEval++ (30 fine-grained tasks, 1,000+ image-text-mask triplets) for comprehensive evaluation; experiments show that MIEdit outperforms state-of-the-art techniques. Project page: https://whywwwzzzg.github.io/MIEdit/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIEdit，一种基于SDE反演的无训练图像编辑框架，通过预测-校正多历史步方案提升编辑质量与效率，引入自动语义角度掩码（IASM）实现区域约束，并构建了含30个细粒度任务、1000多个图像-文本-掩码三元组的EditEval++基准，实验证明其性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散SDE反演和无反演方法的无训练图像编辑虽能实现忠实重构，但仍存在效率低下、可塑性有限以及难以精确保留未编辑区域等问题。
AI.method: MIEdit包含三个核心组件：(1) 预测-校正多历史步方案，在更少步数下实现更优编辑质量；(2) 缓解多条件噪声残差与梯度项在采样过程中的异质性和冲突，提升大范围编辑下的稳定性与可塑性；(3) 反演时自动语义角度掩码（IASM），利用分类器免费引导自动生成语义角度掩码并在采样中施加区域约束，无需额外用户输入。
AI.result: 构建了EditEval++基准（30个细粒度任务、1000+图像-文本-掩码三元组），实验表明MIEdit在编辑质量、效率和区域保持等方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: MIEdit在无训练图像编辑中同时实现了高效率、高可塑性和精确的区域保留，为SDE反演类编辑方法提供了更完善的解决方案。

title: The Art of Hierarchical Competing Patterns: Gaussian Process Optimization of Hyphenation
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Findings). Code and data: https://github.com/ondrejsojka/pat-gen-opt
summary:
Hyphenation patterns remain a compact and widely deployed solution for word breaking in typesetting systems, text processors, and web rendering engines, but their generation still depends on manually tuned patgen program parameter profiles. We formulate patgen profile selection as a black-box hyperparameter optimization problem and evaluate Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization for this task. The search objective combines a precision-oriented F_{1/7}-score with an explicit trie size-accuracy trade-off using a normalized trie-size penalty.
  We evaluate the method on 17 hyphenated word-list datasets covering 14 languages and multiple scripts. Against two strong hand-tuned profiles regenerated from the same 8/10 training split and evaluated on the same 1/10 held-out test split, the GP-optimized profiles improve F_{1/7} on 16 of 17 datasets and reduce trie size on all 17. The median optimized/baseline trie ratio is 0.407. A dataset-level sign test gives p = 1.37e-4; a separate budget-matched comparison on five representative datasets shows that systematic search is competitive and usually improves over the best hand-tuned profile under the fixed comparison objective. The results show that model-based optimization can make pattern generation more reproducible and less dependent on expert trial-and-error while keeping the accuracy-compactness trade-off explicit.

AI.tldr: 该论文将hyphenation patterns（断字模式）的生成参数选择形式化为黑盒超参数优化问题，使用高斯过程贝叶斯优化来自动优化patgen程序的参数配置，在17个跨14种语言的数据集上相比手工调优的基线配置，在16个数据集上提升了F_{1/7}分数，并将trie大小中位数降低至基线的0.407倍。
AI.motivation: Hyphenation patterns虽然广泛应用，但其生成仍依赖人工手工调优patgen参数，缺乏系统性和可复现性。
AI.method: 将patgen profile选择建模为黑盒超参数优化问题，采用高斯过程贝叶斯优化进行搜索；优化目标结合了F_{1/7}精度导向分数与归一化trie大小惩罚，以显式平衡准确性与紧凑性。
AI.result: 在17个覆盖14种语言多种文字的数据集上，GP优化配置在16/17个数据集上优于手工调优基线，且在全部17个数据集上减小了trie大小，中位比率为0.407；数据集级符号检验p=1.37e-4，预算匹配比较也显示系统搜索具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的优化可以使断字模式生成更具可复现性，减少对专家试错过程的依赖，同时保持准确性与紧凑性之间的权衡是显式的。

title: GAN-Blot: A Controllable Structure-Style Synthesis Benchmark for Western Blot Forensics
summary: Western blot (WB) images are widely used as key evidence in biomedical research. Recent scientific misconduct cases reveal that WB imagery is increasingly fabricated, making WB forensics a major concern for research integrity. However, while the progress of forensic detection techniques often relies on advances in forgery-generation techniques, the development of WB forensic techniques has been hindered by the lack of standardized appearance attribute definitions, image datasets, and controllable generation frameworks for WB imagery. To address this limitation, we present a controllable WB image synthesis framework, named GAN-Blot, for generating realistic synthetic WB images. We introduce a formulation that decomposes a WB image into a structure component and a style-reference component, enabling independent control over local protein-band geometry and the global visual appearance of a synthetic WB image. GAN-Blot integrates a dual-path autoencoding design with several style-alignment loss terms to enable implicit control over structure-style synthesis without predefined semantic appearance attributes. We further contribute a synthetic WB dataset containing more than 46K images and propose four evaluation protocols for controllable WB synthesis. Extensive experiments show that GAN-Blot can generate WB images with high fidelity in both protein-band structure and visual style. Under blind inspection, the generated images can fool domain experts and are not reliably distinguished from authentic WB images by existing detectors and screening platforms. These results demonstrate their utility as challenging controlled cases for validating and developing WB forensic methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAN-Blot，一个可控的Western blot图像合成框架，用于生成逼真的合成WB图像。该框架将WB图像分解为结构组件和风格参考组件，实现独立控制蛋白质条带几何形状和全局视觉外观。作者构建了超过46K张图像的合成WB数据集，并提出四种评估协议，实验表明生成的图像具有高保真度，可骗过领域专家和现有检测器。
AI.motivation: WB图像在生物医学研究中被广泛用作关键证据，但近年来越来越多的学术不端案例显示WB图像被伪造。WB取证技术的发展受限于缺乏标准化的外观属性定义、图像数据集和可控的WB图像生成框架，因此亟需解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: GAN-Blot将WB图像分解为结构组件和风格参考组件，采用双路径自编码设计并结合多种风格对齐损失项，实现对结构-风格合成的隐式控制，无需预定义的语义外观属性。同时构建包含超过46K张图像的合成WB数据集并提出四种评估协议。
AI.result: 大量实验表明GAN-Blot能生成在蛋白质条带结构和视觉风格上都具有高保真度的WB图像。在盲检条件下，生成的图像能骗过领域专家，且现有检测器和筛查平台无法可靠地区分真实与合成图像。
AI.conclusion: GAN-Blot生成的图像可作为具有挑战性的受控案例，用于验证和开发WB取证方法，对促进研究诚信和WB图像取证技术的发展具有重要意义。

title: Syntactic Patterns and Stylistic Functions in Narrative Prose: A Rule-Based and Machine-Learning Approach
comment: Submitted as a Discussion Paper to JOHD (Journal of Open Humanities Data), 2026
summary: This paper presents a small-scale quantitative experiment that links syntactic structure to stylistic functions in narrative prose. Starting from a dependency-parsed corpus of 3,300 sentences, we derive sentence-level stylistic labels across five categories --- descriptive, introspective, causal, ideological, and neutral --- using a transparent rule-based procedure that inspects lemmas, universal part-of-speech tags, and syntactic relations. For each sentence we construct a compact representation of its syntactic profile as a sequence of linearised triples combining lemma, POS tag, and dependency relation. These patterns serve as input to standard machine-learning classifiers trained to predict sentence-level style. The best-performing model achieves a macro-F1 of 0.948 under 10-fold cross-validation. The experiment is implemented entirely in Python using open-source tools. Our goal is not to propose a fully fledged stylistic theory, but to offer a reproducible and extensible workflow for exploring how grammatical structure contributes to narrative interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个小规模定量实验，利用依存句法分析从3300个句子中提取句法结构模式，并训练机器学习分类器预测五种叙事文体标签（描述性、内省性、因果性、意识形态性和中性），最优模型在10折交叉验证下达到0.948的宏F1分数。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过可复现的计算实验，将句法结构与叙事散文中的文体功能联系起来，为探索语法结构如何贡献于叙事解读提供一种透明的、可扩展的工作流程。
AI.method: 基于依存句法分析的3300句语料库，使用透明的基于规则的流程（检查词元、通用词性标注和句法关系）为每句生成五种文体标签；将每句的句法特征表示为结合词元、词性和依存关系的线性化三元组序列，输入标准机器学习分类器进行训练。
AI.result: 最优模型在10折交叉验证下实现0.948的宏F1分数，实验完全使用Python和开源工具实现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不旨在提出完整的文体理论，而是提供一个可复现、可扩展的工作流程，用于探索语法结构在叙事解读中的作用。

title: GeoCo-SAVi: Geometry-Consistent Slot Attention for Explicitly Editable Object Representations
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures. Code is available at [https://github.com/starx237/GeoCo](https://github.com/starx237/GeoCo)
summary:
Object-centric video models represent scenes with slots, yet exposed geometry can vary in meaning with appearance. In Invariant Slot Attention (ISA), explicit position and scale can disagree with the decoded center and extent; edits can yield unexpected motion or resizing, and replacing appearance can shift geometry.
  GeoCo-SAVi promotes geometric authority and semantic alignment. Its spatially equivariant, object-wise decoder makes position and scale effective commands: changing them moves or resizes the rendered support. Factual position alignment ties position to the decoded center, and normalized attention overlap discourages duplicate allocation. Appearance transplantation aligns geometry semantics across objects, so recipient geometry governs layout while donor appearance supplies shape. A temporal initializer propagates calibrated slots across frames.
  On Obj3D, GeoCo-SAVi matches ISA reconstruction, reduces p-centroid error by over 80%, and cuts appearance-induced size variation by over 50% while producing the expected translation and scale responses. On 250 MOVi-C videos, it also improves reconstruction, instance grouping, and fixed-identity geometry control over two same-protocol references. GeoCo-SAVi transforms explicit geometry into compositional control, making both position and scale more readable and editable.

AI.tldr: GeoCo-SAVi是一种面向对象中心视频模型的新方法，通过空间等变解码器、事实位置对齐和外观移植等机制，使显式位置和尺度成为有效的几何控制指令，显著提高了几何控制的精准度和可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 现有对象中心视频模型（如ISA）中，显式位置和尺度与实际解码的几何属性可能不一致，导致编辑时产生意外的运动或尺寸变化，且替换外观会改变几何形状，缺乏可控性。
AI.method: GeoCo-SAVi包含三个关键设计：1）空间等变的对象级解码器，使位置和尺度成为有效的命令参数；2）事实位置对齐（将位置与解码中心绑定）和归一化注意力重叠约束（避免重复分配）；3）外观移植用于跨对象的几何语义对齐，配合时间初始化器在帧间传播校准后的slots。
AI.result: 在Obj3D上，GeoCo-SAVi在保持与ISA相同重建质量的同时，将质心误差降低超过80%，外观引起的尺寸变化减少超过50%，并产生预期的平移和尺度响应。在250个MOVi-C视频上，相比两种同协议基准方法，在重建、实例分组和固定身份几何控制方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: GeoCo-SAVi将显式几何从外观耦合中解放，转化为可组合的控制信号，使位置和尺度更具可读性和可编辑性，推动对象中心视频模型向更可控的场景理解与编辑方向发展。

title: How AI Models Manage Epistemic Authority: A Taxonomy and Comparative Analysis of Responses to User Disagreement
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as sources of advice and information, including in high-stakes settings, yet little is known about how they respond to user disagreement. We study how a model manages its epistemic authority, referring here to its claim to knowledge, competence, or the right to advise, once a user challenges its answer. Building on Conversation Analysis, we introduce a taxonomy of six challenge types and a four-layer framework for analysing each response: whether the original claim is maintained or changed, where authority is located, how the disagreement is socially managed, and what kind of evidential support is offered. We construct a new dataset of 2,310 controlled challenge scenarios and 32,340 corresponding responses from 14 models, and analyse them using our framework with an LLM-as-judge pipeline, providing a vocabulary which future evaluation and benchmark design can build on. We find that models show conflicting behaviour: they validate users in 85% of responses but maintain their original claim in 65%. They explicitly apologise in 33% of responses, yet 59% of those apologies accompany maintenance of the original claim. They transfer authority most often in advice tasks, doing so in 28% of responses and reaching 57% in health advice and 49% in legal advice, compared with 6% in fact and 3% in explanation tasks. Abandonment of the original claim ranges from 0.8% for GPT-5.2 to 40% for DeepSeek 7B, while complete replacement of the original claim is rare overall at 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在面对用户质疑时的认知权威管理行为，提出了包含六种质疑类型和四层分析框架的分类体系，并基于14个模型的32,340条响应构建了新数据集。研究发现模型行为存在矛盾：85%响应中认可用户，但65%保持原主张；33%道歉但其中59%伴随坚持原主张；在健康和法律建议任务中最常转移权威（57%和49%），而事实和解释任务中仅6%和3%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于高风险场景提供建议和信息，但我们对模型如何应对用户对其答案的质疑知之甚少。理解模型在被挑战时的认知权威管理行为，对于评估模型的可靠性和可信度至关重要。
AI.method: 基于会话分析理论，提出了六种质疑类型的分类体系和一个四层分析框架（主张是否维持或改变、权威定位、分歧的社会管理方式、提供的证据支持类型）。构建了2,310个受控质疑场景和32,340条来自14个模型的响应，使用LLM-as-judge流水线进行分析。
AI.result: 模型表现出冲突行为：85%响应中认可用户但65%保持原主张；33%明确道歉但其中59%的道歉伴随坚持原主张。权威转移在建议任务中最常见（28%），在健康建议中达57%、法律建议中达49%，而事实和解释任务仅6%和3%。放弃原主张的比例从GPT-5.2的0.8%到DeepSeek 7B的40%不等，完全替换原主张总体仅1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为评估和基准设计提供了新的词汇和框架基础，揭示了模型在冲突情境下的认知权威管理存在系统性的不一致行为，对未来大语言模型的可信度和可靠性评估有重要启示。

title: Physico-Geospatial Grounded Scene Interpretation for Mobile Robotics
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 table; accepted for International Conference on FutureTech 2026 (ICFT), AMMAN, JORDAN October 18-22 2026
summary: Recent advancements in deep learning allow robotic agents to interact with dynamic and unstructured environments. Of special interest is the integration of physico-geospatial world knowledge into such systems, either by using physics-aware machine learning models, knowledge graphs to model relationships or spatio-temporal and logical reasoning. In the present work, we introduce an approach to augment the output of pre-trained, unmodified VLMs used for scene interpretation by integrating semantic descriptions, OpenStreetMap building data and street information with positional, temporal and metric information obtained from our sensory systems, fusing this information using LLMs. We apply this concept to an outdoor recording within a university campus, achieving an F1-Score of 0.83 in the task of grounding buildings and 0.64 for path surface grounding on our pilot evaluation set. The results demonstrate the conceptual capability of the proposed solution to deliver physico-geospatial grounded natural language descriptions. Code and results are available at https://datahub.rz.rptu.de/hstr-csrl-public/publications/physico-geospatial-grounded-scene-interpretation

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将VLM输出的场景理解结果与开放地理数据（OpenStreetMap）及传感信息融合的方法，利用LLM实现物理-地理空间接地，在建筑与路径表面对接任务上分别取得0.83和0.64的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 将物理-地理空间世界知识整合到深度学习驱动的机器人场景理解系统中，以弥补预训练VLM缺乏空间与地理接地能力的不足。
AI.method: 在不修改预训练VLM的前提下，将其场景解释输出与语义描述、OpenStreetMap建筑及街道数据、来自传感器的位置/时间/度量信息相结合，通过LLM进行信息融合。
AI.result: 在大学校园户外录制中，建筑接地任务F1分数为0.83，路径表面接地任务F1分数为0.64。
AI.conclusion: 该方案展示了在复杂动态环境中为机器人提供物理-地理空间接地的自然语言描述的概念可行性。

title: Perspectives on Cross-Lingual Consistency in LLMs for Medical Questions
summary: Should multilingual LLMs answer medical questions consistently across input languages, or adapt responses to cultural cues? Existing multilingual medical benchmarks usually assume that medically correct answers should remain consistent across languages and treat cross-lingual variation as model error. In contrast, cultural adaptation research argues that appropriate medical answers may legitimately differ across contexts. We review the multilingual medical NLP literature through these two perspectives, we identify three gaps: limited stakeholder perspectives (e.g., of medical professionals), a lack of empirical evidence on which approach better serves users, and no benchmarks capable of distinguishing universally correct from culture-specific cases. To address the first gap, we survey 356 participants across three stakeholder groups (medical, NLP, and anthropology professionals) in three countries (Germany, Spain, and the United States). Anthropologists consistently favor adaptation, while medical and NLP respondents remain divided, with notable divergence between U.S. and European medical professionals. LLMs prompted with profession and country personas fail to reproduce this variation, overestimating cross-lingual consistency preference among NLP and medical personas. We conclude that neither consistency nor adaptation can currently be considered clearly preferable, highlighting the need for empirical evidence on which approach better serves users across cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查356名来自不同国家和专业背景的参与者，探讨多语言LLM在医疗问答中应保持跨语言一致性还是适应文化差异的问题，发现不同利益相关群体观点分歧显著，且LLM无法通过角色提示复现这种分歧，结论是目前一致性或适应性策略均无明确优劣之分。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言医疗基准通常假设正确医疗答案应跨语言一致，但文化适应研究认为医疗答案可能因文化背景而合法不同。作者指出现有文献存在三个空白：缺乏利益相关者视角、缺乏哪种方式更优的经验证据、缺乏能区分普适正确与文化特定案例的基准。
AI.method: 作者对德国、西班牙和美国三个国家的356名参与者进行问卷调查，涵盖医学、NLP和人类学三个专业群体；随后用职业和国家人物角色提示LLM，检验其能否复现人类参与者的观点分布。
AI.result: 人类学专家一致支持文化适应，而医学和NLP受访者意见分歧，且美国和欧洲医学专业人士之间存在显著差异。LLM在角色提示下未能复现这种人类观点异质性，反而高估了NLP和医学人物角色对跨语言一致性的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 一致性和文化适应性两种策略目前都无法被明确视作更优方案，未来需要更多关于哪种方法能更好地服务不同文化背景下用户的经验证据，以及能够区分普适正确与文化特定医疗案例的基准。

title: MARR: Decoupling Policy, Execution, and Calibration for All-in-One Medical Image Restoration
summary: All-in-one medical image restoration seeks to recover heterogeneous clinical images with a single model, but PET, CT, and MRI differ substantially in degradation statistics, anatomical contrast, and output-space bias. A fully shared network can entangle modality-specific residual errors, whereas separate modality-specific networks sacrifice the practical advantages of unified deployment. We therefore recast all-in-one restoration as a question of where limited adaptation should be placed: policy selection, feature execution, or output calibration. We propose MARR, a compact restoration framework that constrains multi-modality adaptation into degradation-aware policy routing, modality-private residual execution, and image-domain residual correction without requiring degradation labels or separate modality-specific models. The policy branch forms a routing prompt from input statistics, latent content, and modality identity, and uses it only as a control signal. Prompt-gated modality-private adapters then perform lightweight residual refinement at intermediate decoder stages, while zero-initialized modality-specific output heads calibrate the final image-domain residual without perturbing the initial shared prediction. On an all-in-one PET, CT, and MRI restoration benchmark, MARR outperforms thirteen methods re-trained under the same protocol, achieving PSNR values of 37.34 dB, 33.85 dB, and 32.09 dB on PET, CT, and MRI, respectively, and the best modality-average PSNR of 34.43 dB. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHB-learner/MARR.

AI.tldr: MARR是一个紧凑的全能医学图像恢复框架，通过退化感知策略路由、模态私有残差执行和图像域残差校正来解决PET、CT和MRI等不同模态图像恢复中的模态纠缠问题，无需退化标签或独立模态模型。
AI.motivation: 不同医学影像模态（PET、CT、MRI）在退化统计、解剖对比和输出空间偏差上差异显著，完全共享网络会纠缠模态特异的残差误差，而完全分离的网络则牺牲了统一部署的实际优势。
AI.method: MARR将多模态适配约束为三个组件：1)退化感知策略路由分支，基于输入统计、潜在内容和模态身份形成控制信号；2)提示门控的模态私有适配器，在解码器中间阶段执行轻量级残差精炼；3)零初始化的模态特异输出头，在不干扰初始共享预测的情况下校准最终图像域残差。
AI.result: 在PET、CT和MRI全能恢复基准上，MARR在相同协议下超越13种方法，分别达到37.34 dB、33.85 dB和32.09 dB的PSNR，模态平均PSNR为34.43 dB，达到最佳水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过将有限适配策略性地放置在策略选择、特征执行和输出校准三个层面，可以在不依赖退化标签或独立模态模型的情况下实现高效的统一多模态医学图像恢复。

title: Fine PT-PT Web: A High-Quality 41 Billion Tokens Data Collection of the European Portuguese Web
summary: Curating Web corpora for regional language variants like European Portuguese (PT-PT) is heavily bottlenecked by dialectal overlap (mainly with PT-BR) and data processing scale. This paper presents an efficient pipeline to curate a production-ready PT-PT corpus from the Portuguese Web, spanning 411 TB of raw data from Arquivo.pt. We introduce a novel post-scraping block that removes boilerplate and line duplicates prior to filtering. This early-stage intervention increases final document yield by 19.04% by rescuing valid text that standard heuristic filters prematurely discard. Integrated with rigorous language identification, weighted fuzzy deduplication, and neural quality classification, our pipeline offers a scalable framework and a clean, representative corpus optimized for LLM pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的管道，用于从葡萄牙语网络中构建面向欧洲葡萄牙语（PT-PT）的生产级语料库，处理了411 TB的原始数据。通过引入后抓取去噪模块（去除样板内容和行重复），最终文档产出提升19.04%，并集成语言识别、加权模糊去重和神经质量分类，为LLM预训练提供可扩展的语料构建框架。
AI.motivation: 构建欧洲葡萄牙语区域变体的Web语料库面临两大瓶颈：与其他方言（主要是PT-BR）的重叠以及大规模数据处理挑战，需要一种高效且能区分方言变体的语料处理方案。
AI.method: 提出一个高效管道：(1) 创新的后抓取模块，在过滤之前去除样板内容和行重复，防止有效文本被启发式过滤器过早丢弃；(2) 严格的方言语言识别；(3) 加权模糊去重；(4) 神经质量分类。数据源为Arquivo.pt的411 TB原始葡萄牙语网络数据。
AI.result: 早期介入的后抓取去噪模块使最终文档产出提高了19.04%，成功挽救了原本会被标准启发式过滤器丢弃的有效文本，最终产出了清洁、具代表性的PT-PT语料库。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的管道提供了可扩展的语料构建框架，能够生成优化用于LLM预训练的高质量、代表性PT-PT语料库，有效解决了方言重叠和大规模处理这两个核心瓶颈。

title: When Does a Laugh Begin? Structured Annotator Disagreement in Temporal Laughter Localization
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Affective & Behavior Analysis in-the-wild, ECCV 2026
summary: Annotators routinely disagree on laughter boundaries and subtle chuckles, yet temporal laughter localization typically evaluates against a single reference annotation. We show that this disagreement is structured rather than random noise. Re-annotating the SMILE-Temporal benchmark (672 videos, 1,683 events) with 3-5 annotators per video (alpha = 0.757), we find systematic patterns: disagreement is 1.73 times larger at offsets than onsets, far more common for chuckles than full laughs (77% vs. 20%), and predictable from event attributes (AUC = 0.831). Evaluating against a single annotator breaks down under this structure: system scores shift by 0.246 F1 depending on the chosen ground truth, correctly ranking systems only 69.7% of the time (vs. 80% against all annotators). We propose a disagreement-calibrated evaluation that scores predictions against the full annotator distribution using conformally calibrated tolerance bands (wider at offsets, 0.727s, than onsets, 0.5s). The per-annotator annotations and analysis code are available at https://github.com/WSCSports/SMILE-Disagreement .

AI.tldr: 本文发现笑声时间定位中标注者之间对笑声边界和细微笑声的分歧是结构化的而非随机噪音，并提出了一种基于校准容差带的、针对完整标注者分布进行评估的分歧校准方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间笑声定位任务通常只使用单一参考标注进行评估，但标注者之间经常对笑声边界和细微笑声存在分歧，这可能导致评估结果不可靠。本文想证明这种分歧是结构化的，并且会影响系统评估的公平性和稳定性。
AI.method: 对SMILE-Temporal基准进行重新标注，每个视频由3-5名标注者标注；分析分歧的结构性模式（偏移vs起点、细微笑声vs完整笑声）；提出分歧校准评估方法，使用共形校准的容差带对预测结果与完整标注者分布进行评分。
AI.result: 分歧在偏移处比起点处大1.73倍；细微笑声的分歧率（77%）远高于完整笑声（20%）；可从事件属性预测分歧（AUC=0.831）。单标注评估导致F1分数偏移0.246，系统排序正确率仅69.7%，而基于所有标注者的评估可达80%。
AI.conclusion: 单一标注评估在笑声时间定位中存在系统性缺陷，采用校准容差带的分歧感知评估方法能更公平稳定地对系统进行排序。

title: DeepTable: Structural Attention Biases and Tree Path Encoding for Hierarchical Table Understanding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in table understanding. However, they typically process table content and headers as linearized token sequences. This representation weakens the two-dimensional and hierarchical structural relationships encoded by multi-level row and column headers. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods incorporate basic row and column information but do not explicitly capture the rich structural dependencies induced by hierarchical table headers. We propose DeepTable, a structure-aware approach for table understanding with LLMs. DeepTable comprises two complementary components. Structural Attention Bias (SAB) introduces learnable biases into the attention logits to explicitly represent whether pairs of table tokens share the same row or column. Tree Path Encoding (TPE) represents each table token using the ancestor paths of its row and column headers, preserving its position within the multi-level table structure. We integrate DeepTable with TableLoRA (He et al., 2025) to inject structural information into parameter-efficient adaptation. Across three LLM backbones, DeepTable consistently improves the corresponding TableLoRA baselines on three table question answering benchmarks, achieving average gains of 7.42 points on HiTab, 3.23 points on WikiTQ, and 2.01 BLEU points on FeTaQA. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed structural biases across different LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepTable，一种用于大语言模型表格理解的结构感知方法，通过结构注意力偏置（SAB）和树路径编码（TPE）两种互补组件，显式建模多级行列表头的二维和层次结构关系，并在三个表格问答基准上一致提升了TableLoRA基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM处理表格时通常将内容线性化为token序列，削弱了表格的二维和层次结构信息；已有的参数高效微调方法只融入基本的行列信息，未能显式捕获层级表头带来的丰富结构依赖关系。
AI.method: DeepTable包含两个互补组件：1）结构注意力偏置（SAB），在注意力logits中引入可学习偏置，显式表示表格token对是否共享同一行或列；2）树路径编码（TPE），利用行列表头的祖先路径表示每个表格token，保留其在多级表格结构中的位置。该方法与TableLoRA集成，将结构信息注入参数高效适配过程。
AI.result: 在三个LLM骨干网络上，DeepTable在三个表格问答基准上一致优于对应TableLoRA基线：HiTab上平均提升7.42点，WikiTQ上平均提升3.23点，FeTaQA上平均提升2.01个BLEU点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明所提出的结构偏置在不同LLM骨干网络上的有效性，证明了显式建模层级表格结构能够显著提升LLM的表格理解能力。

title: VidaForge: Open Research Infrastructure for Video Pretraining Data Recipes
summary: Video foundation models increasingly rely on large-scale pretraining data, yet the end-to-end data pipelines behind them remain largely closed and difficult to inspect or reuse. Researchers seeking to understand how video data recipes affect model pretraining often need to build substantial infrastructure before testing even a focused hypothesis. We present VIDAFORGE, an open research infrastructure that represents a video data recipe as an executable five-stage workflow from raw videos to training datasets. A decision in this workflow can be varied to construct alternative datasets while preserving how every sample was produced. To demon strate this research workflow, we compare data recipes with different coverage and quality in early from-scratch pretraining of Wan 2.1 and V-JEPA 2.1. Across both learning objectives, the broader-coverage recipe achieves the highest downstream benchmark scores, while loss-based evaluation favors different recipes. This study demonstrates how VidaForge connects data-recipe choices to downstream model performance. We further release VIDAFORGE-3M, containing 3.14 million scene level clips totaling 6,475 hours, with fine-grained annotations and curation signals for video data-recipe research.

AI.tldr: VIDAFORGE是一个开放的研究基础设施，将视频数据配方表示为从原始视频到训练数据集的可执行五阶段工作流，并配套发布了包含314万个场景级片段（共6475小时）的VIDAFORGE-3M数据集。通过在Wan 2.1和V-JEPA 2.1上进行早期从头预训练实验，研究发现更广覆盖范围的数据配方在下游基准上表现最好，但基于损失的评估偏好不同的配方。
AI.motivation: 视频基础模型依赖大规模预训练数据，但端到端数据管道通常是封闭的，难以检查和复用。研究者为验证关于视频数据配方如何影响模型预训练的具体假设，往往需要先构建大量基础设施，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出VIDAFORGE，一种将视频数据配方建模为包含五阶段（从原始视频到训练数据集）的可执行工作流基础设施。通过在该工作流的不同决策点变化构建替代数据集，同时保留每个样本的产生方式。然后在Wan 2.1和V-JEPA 2.1上对比不同覆盖率和质量的数据配方进行早期从头预训练实验。
AI.result: 在两种学习目标下，更广覆盖率的数据配方取得了最高的下游基准分数，而基于损失的评估则倾向于不同的配方。表明VIDAFORGE能够将数据配方的选择与下游模型性能联系起来。此外发布了包含314万个场景级片段（总计6475小时）的VIDAFORGE-3M数据集，带有细粒度标注和策展信号。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了VIDAFORGE作为研究基础设施的有效性，说明数据配方的选择与下游模型表现存在可量化关联，为视频数据配方的系统研究提供了开放基础设施和大规模带标注数据集。

title: Translation Indeterminacy and the Distributional Fallacy
comment: Accepted for publication in Philosophy of Translation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly associated with the distributional hypothesis, according to which (1) semantic meaning is grounded in distributional patterns of linguistic context, and (2) knowledge of cross-linguistic distributional correspondences allows for successful translation. This paper rejects the first claim as a causal inversion: linguistic distributions reflect patterns arising from meaning-making practices rather than constituting their source. At the same time, it accepts the second claim, arguing that translation -human or machine - can succeed without requiring access to meaning or reference. Knowledge of interlingual distributional correspondence and their inferential organization may be sufficient for translation. The paper develops an ecological-enactivist perspective, according to which reference and meaning are grounded in agent-environment interaction and stabilized through action-grounded concepts, forms of world-involving cognition that current LLMs do not possess.

AI.tldr: 本文从生态-生成主义的视角审视大语言模型与分布假说的关系，拒绝"语义源于分布模式"的第一主张（视之为因果倒置），但接受第二主张——翻译（无论人类还是机器）无需理解意义或指称，仅靠跨语言分布对应及其推理组织知识即可成功。
AI.motivation: 挑战大语言模型与分布假说的主流关联认知，澄清语言分布与语义意义之间的因果关系，并从哲学认知科学角度阐明LLM在指称和意义层面上的根本局限。
AI.method: 采用生态-生成主义（ecological-enactivism）理论框架进行哲学论证，将分布假说分解为两个独立主张分别审视，并通过概念分析区分语言分布、意义指称与世界参与认知之间的关系。
AI.result: 论证指出：语言分布反映的是意义创造实践的产物而非源头（因果倒置）；翻译成功不必然需要意义访问；LLM缺乏基于行动的概念与世界参与的认知形式，不具备真正的指称和意义能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以在翻译任务上取得功能性成功，但这并不意味着它们掌握了分布假说所宣称的语义基础；意义和指称植根于行动与世界互动之中，是当前LLM所不具备的认知维度。

title: FSAN: Flow State Attention Network for Aerodynamic Prediction
summary: Accurate aerodynamic prediction is critical for designing fuel-efficient and safe transportation systems such as aircraft and automobiles, yet traditional computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations remain computationally expensive and expertise-intensive, severely limiting their use in iterative design and real-time analysis. Existing deep learning surrogates suffer from two major limitations: (i) they are evaluated on datasets with narrow flow-condition ranges, leaving their performance under complex flow conditions undemonstrated; (ii) they treat global flow conditions as a single vector injected uniformly across all surface points, ignoring that different geometric regions experience distinct local flow phenomena, which degrades prediction accuracy under complex flow conditions. To address these limitations, we propose the Flow State Attention Network (FSAN). FSAN separately encodes point cloud and flow conditions, then partitions the geometry into multiple flow states via learnable soft assignments, and uses flow features to update these state representations, which in turn influence point cloud features through state changes. This enables fine-grained, state-specific interaction between geometry and flow information. Extensive experiments on two well-recognized aerodynamic benchmarks demonstrate that FSAN achieves the highest accuracy among the methods compared in this work at a higher computational cost. On Emmi-Wing, FSAN reduces the Relative L2 (REL-L2) error by over 20\% compared to the strongest baseline (Transolver), and on DrivAerNet++, it achieves a 10\% reduction compared to the strongest baseline (AdaField). These results establish FSAN as a promising neural surrogate on public benchmarks with diverse flow conditions and geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flow State Attention Network (FSAN)，一种用于气动预测的神经代理模型。FSAN将点云与流动条件分开编码，通过可学习的软分配将几何划分为多个流动状态，并利用流动特征更新状态表征，实现几何与流动信息之间细粒度、状态特定的交互，在Emmi-Wing和DrivAerNet++两个公开基准上均取得最优精度。
AI.motivation: 传统CFD仿真计算昂贵且需要专业知识，而现有深度学习代理方法存在两大局限：一是仅在狭窄流动条件范围的数据集上评估，未展示复杂流动条件下的性能；二是将全局流动条件作为单一向量均匀注入所有表面点，忽略了不同几何区域经历不同局部流动现象，导致复杂条件下预测精度下降。
AI.method: FSAN分别编码点云和流动条件，通过可学习的软分配将几何划分为多个流动状态，使用流动特征更新这些状态表征，状态变化反过来影响点云特征，从而实现几何与流动信息间细粒度、状态特定的交互。
AI.result: 在两个公认的气动基准上进行了广泛实验。Emmi-Wing数据集上，FSAN相比最强基线Transolver将REL-L2误差降低超过20%；DrivAerNet++数据集上，相比最强基线AdaField实现10%的误差降低。但代价是更高的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: FSAN在包含多样流动条件和几何形状的公开基准上被证明是一种有前景的神经代理模型，兼具高精度和复杂条件下的鲁棒性。

title: From Echo Chambers to Epistemic Monoculture: Large Language Models Present Temporally Contingent Partisan Alignments as Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly becoming an interface between citizens and political information. They are often regarded as "a better Google." While this analogy might work for some instances, it is unintuitively problematic for democratic politics. A search engine retrieves human-authored documents, while a language model generates novel text that necessarily embeds invisible framing decisions. Because conveying knowledge involves framing, a system that generates answers cannot serve as a neutral conduit to "all human knowledge." Instead, these systems are becoming a new kind of political intermediary. Mechanistic evidence shows that partisan identity is encoded as a locatable geometric direction inside the Llama 3.1 8B model, and that alignment training masks rather than removes this structure. Building on that evidence, we present steering experiments that exploit a model's training cutoff in 2024. This cutpoint auspiciously falls just before a dramatic realignment in American politics marked by the second Trump administration and the MAHA transformation of health politics, providing us with a natural experiment. We find that the model presents temporally contingent partisan alignments as knowledge, with no mechanism for distinguishing fact from opinion. This reality moves the information environment beyond the echo chamber toward an epistemic monoculture where language models, purporting to summarize "all human knowledge" are, in actuality, simply magnifying the cultural and partisan divides inherent in their training data.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大语言模型正成为公民与政治信息之间的新型中介，由于其在生成文本时必然嵌入框架决策，无法作为"中立的谷歌"来传播政治知识。通过操纵Llama 3.1 8B模型的机制性证据，论文展示党派身份以几何方向编码于模型内部，对齐训练只是掩盖而非移除这种结构，最终将信息环境推向"认识论单一文化"。
AI.motivation: 挑战"LLM是更好的谷歌"这一流行类比，揭示语言模型作为生成式系统而非检索系统，在政治信息传播中面临根本性的框架偏见问题，无法充当中立的知识中介。
AI.method: 利用Llama 3.1 8B模型的机制性证据，通过几何方向定位展示党派身份编码；同时利用模型2024年训练截止点恰逢美国政治重大重组（第二次特朗普政府及MAHA健康政治转型）形成自然实验，进行模型操纵（steering）实验。
AI.result: 发现模型将时间依赖的党派联盟呈现为知识，且没有任何区分事实与意见的机制；对齐训练仅掩盖而无法移除编码的党派结构。
AI.conclusion: 信息环境正从"回声室"演变为"认识论单一文化"——语言模型标榜总结"全人类知识"，实际上只是放大了训练数据中固有的文化与党派分歧。

title: TransNormal-2: Geometry-Grounded Rectified Flow with Edge-Aware Decoding for Precise Normal Estimation
summary: Diffusion-based models enable monocular geometry estimation, yet their pixel-space precision is limited by a shared, under-studied error source: VAE reconstruction degradation. The 8x spatial compression in the VAE encoder-decoder degrades surface normals at object boundaries; even encoding and decoding ground-truth normals introduces 1.3--8.5° of mean angular error (MAE), with edge MAE reaching 2.8x the global MAE. We present TransNormal-2, a FLUX.2-based rectified-flow framework with single-step deterministic inference that addresses this degradation on both sides of the VAE decoder: in how latent predictions are supervised during training, and in how decoded normals are corrected at inference. First, geometry-aware pixel-space losses, including inverse rendering self-consistency, von~Mises-Fisher angular loss, and wavelet edge-aware regularization, complement latent MSE by enforcing spherical normal geometry and diffuse image-formation cues after VAE decoding. Second, a lightweight Geometric Refinement Module (GRM) applies an RGB-guided residual correction to reduce boundary-localized decoding errors without freely rewriting the coarse prediction. On general-scene benchmarks, TransNormal-2 matches or exceeds MoGe-2 on all eight reported metrics while using only 1.4% as many task-specific normal annotations. The gains are clearest for transparent objects, reducing MAE by 4.2° on ClearGrasp and 3.1° on ClearPose over the strongest prior baselines. Code will be released at https://longxiang-ai.github.io/TransNormal-2.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了TransNormal-2，一个基于FLUX.2的整流流框架，用于单目法线估计。该框架针对VAE重建退化问题，通过几何感知像素空间损失（包括逆渲染自洽性、von Mises-Fisher角损失和小波边缘感知正则化）以及轻量级几何细化模块，在无需大量任务特定标注的情况下，在通用场景基准上达到或超越MoGe-2的所有八项指标。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散模型的单目几何估计方法受限于VAE重建退化问题——8倍空间压缩导致物体边界处表面法线退化，即使对真值法线进行编解码也会引入1.3-8.5度的平均角误差，边缘误差可达全局的2.8倍。这一问题此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 在VAE解码器的两侧同时解决退化问题：(1)训练时引入几何感知的像素空间损失，包括逆渲染自洽性、von Mises-Fisher角损失和小波边缘感知正则化，用于强制球面法线几何和漫反射图像形成先验；(2)推理时使用轻量级几何细化模块(GRM)应用RGB引导的残差修正，减少边界局部的解码误差，而不随意重写粗略预测。
AI.result: 在通用场景基准上，TransNormal-2在全部八项指标上匹配或超越MoGe-2，且仅使用其1.4%的任务特定法线标注。在透明物体场景表现最为突出，ClearGrasp上MAE降低4.2度，ClearPose上降低3.1度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示并解决了VAE重建退化对单目法线估计精度的根本限制，通过在VAE解码器两侧进行针对性设计，实现了仅需极少量标注即可达到顶尖性能的效果，特别是在透明物体等困难场景中表现出显著优势。

title: LLM Forensics: Where Do Backdoors Hide? Localizing and Controlling Trigger Mechanisms with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Even though backdoors in LLMs have been a growing concern, their inner workings are still under heavy scrutiny. Trigger-based backdoors are easy to define behaviorally, a rare input that makes the model switch to a chosen response pattern, but the mechanism between triggers and their responses is less clear. We study this mechanism in a controlled, harmless language-switching setting, where fixed trigger sequences make 1B and 8B language models continue English prompts in French or German. For this, we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) across layers and transformer components, then compare triggered prompts with translation and pretraining controls to identify trigger-relevant feature directions. We show how SAE features separate triggered prompts from controls with near-perfect F1, but features that detect the trigger do not necessarily control the behavior. In intervention tests, attention and MLP features often fire reliably on triggered prompts, making them good detectors, but ablating them rarely suppresses the language switch and activating them rarely induces it. In contrast, residual-stream features can suppress triggered generation when ablated, and some selected features can induce target-language continuations without the trigger. In short, these token-trigger mechanisms decompose into distinct SAE feature directions, with separate features for trigger detection, residual-stream propagation, and later language tracking. This role-level decomposition is the part most likely to transfer to other trigger-based backdoors, even when the payload, layers, or circuit locations differ.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在无害的语言切换场景（英语提示切换为法语/德语）中训练稀疏自编码器，揭示了LLM中基于触发器的后门工作机制：触发检测、残差流传播和语言跟踪由不同的SAE特征方向分别负责，且检测器特征不等于控制器特征。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM后门问题日益受到关注，其内部工作机制仍不清晰。触发器触发特定行为的行为学定义容易，但触发器与响应之间的神经机制尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 在受控且无害的语言切换设定中，对1B和8B规模的模型跨层和Transformer组件训练稀疏自编码器（SAEs），将触发提示与翻译和预训练对照组进行比较，以识别与触发器相关的特征方向；随后通过消融和激活干预测试特征的功能角色。
AI.result: SAE特征能够以接近完美的F1区分触发的提示与对照组，但检测到触发器的特征不一定控制行为。注意力层和MLP特征常能可靠检测触发器，但消融它们很少抑制语言切换，激活它们也很少诱导该行为；相比之下，消融残差流特征可抑制触发生成，且部分选定的特征无需触发器即可诱导目标语言续写。
AI.conclusion: 令牌触发机制可分解为不同的SAE特征方向，分别负责触发检测、残差流传播和后续语言跟踪。这种角色级分解最有可能迁移到其他基于触发器的后门场景，即便有效载荷、层数或电路位置有所不同。

title: Attention-Enhanced Deep Features with Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning for Glaucoma Detection
comment: Accepted and presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Computer and Information Technology for Health (BECITHCON)
summary: Glaucoma is a progressive optic neuropathy characterized by irreversible damage to the optic nerve, making timely diagnosis critical to prevent permanent vision loss. Although deep learning has demonstrated promising performance in automated glaucoma detection, existing approaches often overlook feature refinement, suffer from class imbalance, and rely on individual classifiers that limit prediction robustness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid glaucoma detection framework that integrates attention-enhanced deep feature extraction with heterogeneous ensemble learning. Specifically, deep representations are extracted using InceptionV3 and subsequently refined by incorporating the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to enhance discriminative retinal features. To improve classification robustness, the extracted features are classified using multiple machine learning models together with Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE) strategies, while SMOTE combined with Tomek Links (SMOTE+TL) is employed to alleviate class imbalance. Furthermore, a systematic comparison of handcrafted, deep, and attention-enhanced deep feature representations is conducted. Experimental evaluation on two public retinal fundus datasets demonstrates that deep feature-based methods consistently outperform handcrafted feature-based methods, while the proposed attention-enhanced framework achieves the best overall performance. Furthermore, Grad-CAM visualizations confirm that the proposed model focuses on clinically relevant retinal regions, providing interpretable evidence on the model's prediction process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合青光眼检测框架，将注意力增强的深度特征提取（InceptionV3+CBAM）与异构集成学习结合，并采用SMOTE+Tomek Links解决类别不平衡问题。在两个公开视网膜眼底数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于手工特征和纯深度特征方法，Grad-CAM可视化验证了模型关注临床相关区域。
AI.motivation: 青光眼早期诊断至关重要，但现有深度学习方法存在三方面不足：忽视特征细化、类别不平衡问题未妥善处理、依赖单一分类器导致预测鲁棒性有限。
AI.method: 采用InceptionV3提取深度特征，引入CBAM注意力模块细化判别性视网膜特征；使用多个机器学习模型结合SLE和DLE集成策略进行分类；采用SMOTE+TL缓解类别不平衡；系统比较手工、深度及注意力增强深度特征表示。
AI.result: 在两个公开视网膜眼底数据集上，深度特征方法一致优于手工特征方法，所提注意力增强框架取得最佳整体性能；Grad-CAM可视化证实模型聚焦于临床相关的视网膜区域。
AI.conclusion: 注意力增强的深度特征结合异构集成学习能有效提升青光眼检测性能与可解释性，为临床青光眼自动诊断提供了更具鲁棒性和可信度的解决方案。

title: Replicating a Disjoint-Set Union Experiment over Various Notions of Micro Units to assess Translation Effort
summary: The paper describes a replication experiment to assess "the distribution of editing procedures across micro and macro units as an indicator of the strain of text production". We investigate various pause thresholds to isolate Micro and Macro units and conclude that process-based units might be more suitable entity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复制实验评估编辑程序在微观与宏观单元中的分布，作为文本生产压力的指标，并探讨不同暂停阈值来区分微宏观单元，最终认为基于过程的单元更为合适。
AI.motivation: 探究编辑程序在微宏观单元中的分布能否作为文本生产压力的有效指标，并通过复制实验验证其可靠性。
AI.method: 开展复制实验，通过设置不同的暂停阈值来分离微观单元和宏观单元，并对比分析基于过程的单元与传统单元划分方式。
AI.result: 研究发现不同暂停阈值会影响微宏观单元的划分，基于过程的单元可能比传统的静态单元划分更适合作为分析实体。
AI.conclusion: 基于过程的单元比微宏观静态单元更适合作文本生产研究的分析单位。

title: Counterfactual Tests for Measuring Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness in Visual Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) may often look plausible, yet it may not faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. While methods for measuring the faithfulness of CoTs for textual inputs have been increasingly introduced, using these methods for visual inputs is not straightforward. In this work, we adapt the family of counterfactual methods for measuring CoT faithfulness, namely the Counterfactual Test (CT) and Correlational Counterfactual Test (CCT), to visual inputs, and call them vCT and vCCT, respectively. Using vCT and vCCT, we benchmark eight recent open-source Vision Language Models (VLMs) on two datasets. Our analysis shows that CoTs do not reliably track visual evidence that influences model predictions: they may omit the removed object even when its removal causes a large prediction shift, yet mention it when the shift is small. We further find that Predict-then-Explain explanations align more strongly with perturbation-induced probability shifts than pre-answer CoTs, while binary vCT scores are often nearly saturated. We also include a reconstruction control, in which images pass through the same editing pipeline without object removal, and find that the main object-removal intervention induces larger shifts than reconstruction alone. We construct and release Counter-SNLI-VE and Counter-A-OKVQA, two datasets of image pairs that differ by a single object.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将反事实测试框架（CT和CCT）适配到视觉输入的方法（vCT和vCCT），用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图像推理中链式思维（CoT）的忠实性。通过两个数据集对8个开源VLM进行基准测试，发现CoT往往不能忠实反映影响模型预测的视觉证据，且Predict-then-Explain解释比CoT与概率变化更一致。
AI.motivation: 现有的CoT忠实性测量方法主要针对文本输入，将其应用于视觉输入并非易事，因此需要一种能够评估视觉语言模型推理链忠实性的方法。
AI.method: 将反事实测试（CT）和相关反事实测试（CCT）适配到视觉输入，分别命名为vCT和vCCT；在两个数据集上对8个开源VLM进行基准评估；引入重建控制以排除图像编辑管线本身的干扰；构建了Counter-SNLI-VE和Counter-A-OKVQA两个图像对数据集。
AI.result: CoT不能可靠地追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据：当移除对象导致较大预测变化时，CoT可能遗漏该对象；当变化较小时反而可能提及。Predict-then-Explain解释与扰动引起的概率变化一致性更强。二进制vCT分数往往接近饱和。主对象移除干预比单纯重建引起更大的变化。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的CoT推理链不能忠实反映其决策依据的视觉证据，需要开发更可靠的推理链方法或采用Predict-then-Explain等替代策略。

title: Bag of Tricks or Bag of Myths? Reducing Modeling Complexity with Task Knowledge in Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
comment: This work was shaped by the IEEE Big Data Cup, where our team, NIDHI, ranked 3rd overall. NIDHI (Neurosymbolic Intelligent Diagnostics for Holistic Trauma-Informed Care) is an effort from IAIRO.ai . 21 pages, 6 Tables, 4 Figures
summary: Assessing suicide risk from social media text is a small-data, high-stakes setting requiring not only severity prediction but also supporting evidence and clinically relevant risk and protective factors. Yet common NLP techniques, including model scaling, synthetic data, loss reweighting, ensembling, and threshold tuning, are often applied without testing whether their gains hold up under severe class imbalance, coupled outputs, and limited author-level data. We study 1,635 clinician-annotated posts and audit 31 pre-specified techniques from 7 methodological families through roughly 300 controlled experiments on author-disjoint partitions. We found no prior audit of this playbook in this regime. The findings guide a task-grounded system for three outputs: 4-level suicide risk, evidence spans, and 24 clinical risk and protective factors. Only 5 of 31 comparisons produced reliable gains. We reformulate factor prediction as entailment between each post and its codebook definitions, using an architecturally diverse ensemble with class-balanced training and score rescaling. Risk predictions condition a 7-model evidence tagger ensemble; evidence restricts symbolic risk rules; and a difficult risk class is routed separately. The factor predictor remains independent because risk evidence provides no additional factor signal. We also correct a mismatch between validation scores used for threshold fitting and test-time ensemble scores through deployment-consistent calibration, yielding the largest improvement to the factor system. The final system achieves 0.8203 for risk, 0.7953 for evidence, and 0.7045 macro-F1 for factors, with a 0.7781 composite, ranking third among 53 teams. We call the underlying principle task-conditioned technique selection: retain techniques only when task-specific knowledge, structure, or empirical evidence justifies them.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了31种预定义NLP技术在社交媒体自杀风险评估场景（1,635条临床标注帖子）中的适用性，发现仅5种方法能产生可靠增益。基于此构建了一个任务驱动的系统，分别使用蕴含重述框架预测24个风险/保护因子、7模型集成标注证据、符号规则处理风险等级，最终在53个队伍中排名第三（综合得分0.7781）。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体自杀风险评估是少样本、高风险场景，需要同时进行严重程度预测、证据定位和风险/保护因子识别。然而常见的NLP技术（如模型缩放、合成数据、损失重加权、集成、阈值调优）在此类场景下未经验证，可能存在无效甚至适得其反的情况，缺乏系统的技术审计。
AI.method: 在1,635条临床标注帖子上，对7个方法家族的31种预定义技术进行了约300个受控实验（按作者不相交划分），识别出5个可靠增益技术。系统包括：因子预测重构为帖子与codebook定义的蕴含任务，采用架构多样化的集成+类别平衡训练+分数缩放；风险预测使用7模型证据标注器集成，证据约束符号风险规则；困难风险类别单独路由；通过部署一致的校准修正验证分数与测试分数不匹配的问题。
AI.result: 最终系统在风险预测上取得0.8203，证据标注0.7953，因子宏F1 0.7045，综合得分0.7781，在53个参赛队伍中排名第三。因子预测与风险证据解耦证明了风险证据不提供额外因子信号；部署一致校准带来了因子系统最大的单项改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出"任务条件性技术选择"原则：只有当任务特定知识、结构或经验证据支持时才保留特定NLP技术，而非不加区分地套用通用技术。该研究填补了此类高风险少样本场景下NLP技术系统审计的空白，为类似临床预测任务提供了方法论指导。

title: RoLA: Rotary-Positioned Low-Rank Linear Attention for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
summary:
Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong video generation quality, but their dense spatiotemporal self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length and quickly becomes the dominant inference bottleneck.
