AI.tldr: 本文提出TLCTrack，一种通过连续更新的显著令牌（token）建模令牌级时空上下文的视觉跟踪框架，包含掩码单向注意力（MUA）、空间显著令牌采集（SSTC）和时间显著令牌库（TSTB）三个模块，在五个基准数据集上超越现有最先进跟踪器。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉跟踪方法大多通过离散采样策略提取时空线索，这与时空上下文的内在连续性相偏离，导致跟踪性能下降。
AI.method: TLCTrack包含三个核心组件：MUA（掩码单向注意力）显式整合时空上下文以提取判别性的目标感知空间特征；SSTC（空间显著令牌采集）逐步抑制背景干扰以增强目标空间表示；TSTB（时间显著令牌库）通过连续显著令牌更新捕获高质量的时空信息。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TLCTrack的性能优于最先进的跟踪器。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续更新的显著令牌建模时空上下文，TLCTrack有效解决了离散采样与时空连续性之间的偏差问题，提升了视觉跟踪的精度。代码和模型已公开。

title: Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ELCD，一种面向响应级别（response-level）的潜在冲突检测器，用于在生成后、交付前验证LLM输出是否违反系统级指令约束，解决现有防御机制仅关注静态输入检查而无法检测"响应漂移"的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM在分层指令（层次化指令）下部署时，用户指令可能覆盖系统级约束导致违规，而现有防御机制主要依赖静态输入检查，无法检测最终响应违反系统约束但输入看似合规的"响应漂移"现象。
AI.method: ELCD构建生成输出的复合隐藏状态表示：拼接最终token的嵌入与响应均值池化嵌入；随后优化成对边际排序目标函数，在潜在空间中将合规响应与漂移响应进行区分。
AI.result: 在五个主流LLM（参数规模1.5B至14B）上的广泛实验表明，ELCD显著优于竞争基线；在Llama-2-7B上PR-AUC提升约30个百分点，在Mistral-7B上将95% TPR下的假阳性率（FPR95）降至2.67%。
AI.conclusion: ELCD为开放权重或自托管LLM部署中的潜在指令冲突检测提供了有前景的解决方案，填补了响应层面防御机制的空白。

title: Detect Anything in Graphic Design: Element-Level Rewards for Autoregressive Detection
summary: Graphic designs, such as posters, advertisements, and infographics, are an important medium for communicating information and shaping understanding. Unlike natural images, they consist of layered elements with explicit compositional order. However, existing object detection models treat these elements as an unordered set, leaving compositional order unexploited. To address this limitation, we present Detect Anything in Graphic Design (DAD), a model that formulates graphic design detection as compositional deconstruction. It decodes elements in compositional order, using lower-layer elements to better detect higher-layer ones. The key feature of DAD is amodal detection, which predicts the full bounding box of each element, including regions occluded by elements placed above it. Building on this formulation, we propose Element Relative Policy Optimization (EleRPO), which extends GRPO from sequence-level supervision to element-level optimization. EleRPO provides fine-grained training signals that capture how each detected element contributes to overall detection quality, and works synergistically with compositional order to improve detection performance. To support training and evaluation, we build a dataset of 10 million graphic designs. Experiments show that DAD outperforms all baselines and achieves human-level performance in amodal detection, supporting effective image-to-layer decomposition. EleRPO consistently improves over GRPO across nine detection benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAD模型，将图形设计检测形式化为组合解构，按构图顺序解码元素并使用amodal检测预测被遮挡元素的完整边界框。同时提出EleRPO优化方法，将GRPO从序列级监督扩展到元素级优化。基于1000万图形设计数据集训练，DAD在amodal检测上达到人类水平，EleRPO在九个检测基准上一致优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有目标检测模型将图形设计中的元素视为无序集合，忽略了设计中元素具有显式构图顺序这一关键特性。图形设计（如海报、广告、信息图）与自然图像不同，由具有层叠关系和顺序的分层元素组成，充分利用这种组合顺序可以提升检测性能。
AI.method: 提出DAD模型，将图形设计检测形式化为组合解构：按构图顺序解码元素，利用底层元素辅助检测高层元素。核心特点是amodal检测——预测每个元素的完整边界框，包括被上层元素遮挡的区域。同时提出EleRPO（元素相对策略优化），将GRPO从序列级监督扩展至元素级优化，提供细粒度训练信号，捕捉每个检测元素对整体检测质量的贡献，并与组合顺序协同提升性能。构建了包含1000万图形设计的数据集用于训练和评估。
AI.result: 实验表明DAD在所有基线上表现优越，在amodal检测上达到人类水平，支持有效的图像到图层分解。EleRPO在九个检测基准上一致优于GRPO。
AI.conclusion: 利用构图顺序和amodal检测可显著提升图形设计元素检测性能，元素级优化的EleRPO相较于序列级GRPO具有更优效果，DAD为实现图形设计图像到图层的自动分解提供了有效方案。

title: When Victorian Becomes a Prompt: Literary Periodization as a Generative Constraint in 100 AI-Generated Novels
summary: Generative AI inverts the typical periodization of literary history: the periodizing tag Victorian can now come first and influence what is written. Generative periodization, defined and tested here, describes the use of literary-period designations in generating texts. I test this approach on 100 book-length novels produced under Victorian and Zero-Style conditions using GPT, Qwen, and Llama workflows. The Period Alignment Score (PAS), trained on nineteenth-century literature and benchmarked against human Zero-Style prose, assesses alignment using topic-reduced grammatical features. Victorian prompts produce consistent historical-direction shifts in GPT and Qwen, but not robustly in Llama. Victorian-only recalibration and harder comparison corpora preserve the GPT and Qwen effects. Cross-model transfer also shows a shared direction of grammatical change. The measurable target is the broader nineteenth century rather than the Victorian period per se.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成性时期划分"（generative periodization）概念，指在文本生成中使用文学时期标签（如Victorian）作为提示条件。作者在GPT、Qwen、Llama三种大语言模型上生成100部英文长篇小说（维多利亚条件与无风格条件对比），并通过PAS（时期对齐得分）评估生成文本与19世纪文学语法的对齐程度。结果显示GPT和Qwen在维多利亚提示下产生一致的历时语法偏移，而Llama效果不稳健；校准与更严格的对照语料不影响前两者的效应；跨模型迁移表明存在共同的语法变化方向。测量的实际目标是更广义的19世纪，而非严格限定于维多利亚时期本身。
AI.motivation: 传统的文学史分期通常是对已有文本的事后归类和描述，而生成式AI颠覆了这种顺序——时期标签可以前置并直接影响文本的生成过程。作者因此提出"生成性时期划分"这一新概念，试图实证检验大语言模型是否真的能依据文学时期标签在生成层面产生符合该时期特征的文本。
AI.method: 作者在GPT、Qwen和Llama三种模型工作流上，分别生成100部书级长度小说，分为维多利亚条件（Victorian prompt）和零风格条件（Zero-Style prompt）两组。训练了"时期对齐得分"（PAS）指标：该指标以19世纪文学为训练语料，以人类撰写的零风格散文为基准，利用主题缩减（topic-reduced）的语法特征来评估生成文本与目标时期的语法对齐程度。作者还进行了维多利亚唯一风格重校准、采用更困难的对照语料、以及跨模型迁移分析等稳健性检验。
AI.result: 维多利亚时期提示在GPT和Qwen中产生了稳健且一致的历时期偏移（grammatical shift），但在Llama中不够稳健。仅用维多利亚风格重新校准提示词以及换用更难的对照语料，并未破坏GPT和Qwen所观察到的效应。跨模型迁移实验还显示，三种模型在语法变化方向上具有共享的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在特定条件下能够按照文学时期标签生成语法上向历史时期倾斜的文本，但该能力具有模型特异性，并非所有模型都一致有效。实际可测量和实现的目标更接近广义的19世纪文学特征，而非严格意义上的维多利亚时期本身——这意味着"生成性时期划分"的有效性边界和语义粒度需要进一步界定。

title: One for All: Generalist Foundation Model for Cross-Sensor Skeleton Representation Learning
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SOfA_site/
summary: For learning generalizable motion representations from large-scale unlabeled data, Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become a widely adopted methodology. However, existing approaches are primarily limited by the inherent heterogeneity of skeleton data---characterized by varying joint counts, indexing protocols, and topological structures across different sensors---which typically necessitates training separate, sensor-specific, or even entirely dataset-specific models. To overcome this, we introduce SOfA (Skeleton One for All), the first generalist foundation model designed to achieve sensor-unified skeleton representation learning across diverse sensors. To accommodate the dimensional gap caused by varying joint counts, we introduce a fixed-size set of learnable Canonical Joint Slots, acting as a universal vessel that seamlessly accommodates arbitrary skeletal topologies. SOfA fills these slots via an attention mechanism that dynamically aggregates skeletal information from sensor-specific inputs. Furthermore, we resolve joint index misalignment between various sensors by introducing a Semantic Joint Embedding derived from a pre-trained text encoder, rather than relying on absolute positional embeddings. To validate our approach, we standardized ten 3D skeleton datasets for unified training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SOfA can serve as a truly universal encoder, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a wide range of downstream tasks and sensor types, often outperforming dataset-specific specialist models with a single foundation model.

AI.tldr: SOfA是首个面向多传感器骨骼数据的通用基础模型，通过可学习的Canonical Joint Slots和基于文本编码器的Semantic Joint Embedding，解决了不同传感器间关节数量、索引和拓扑结构的异质性，实现跨数据集的统一表示学习。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习方法受限于骨骼数据的异质性（不同传感器的关节数量、索引协议和拓扑结构不同），导致必须为每个传感器或数据集单独训练模型，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出固定大小的可学习Canonical Joint Slots作为通用载体，通过注意力机制动态聚合任意关节拓扑的信息；同时引入Semantic Joint Embedding（基于预训练文本编码器）替代绝对位置编码，解决关节索引错位问题；并在10个3D骨骼数据集上统一训练。
AI.result: SOfA在广泛的下游任务和传感器类型上均达到SOTA性能，且通常以单一基础模型超越数据集特化的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: SOfA证明了单一基础模型能够统一多种传感器的骨骼表示学习，为骨骼自监督学习提供了一个真正的通用编码器范式。

title: Global Divergence, Local Convergence: Representation Geometry in SSMs and Transformers
summary: Recent state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba achieve language modeling performance comparable to transformers despite relying on fundamentally different architectures. This raises an important question: how do these structural differences influence the geometry and functional nature of their internal representations? We study this question through a multi-scale analysis of representations in transformers, SSMs, and hybrid architecture. First, we find that SSMs distribute their representational information evenly across all dimensions, whereas transformer representations are heavily dominated by a single principal direction. By evaluating hybrid architectures, we observe that the representation space becomes increasingly skewed toward a single dominant direction after each attention layer. Next, we explore how the different geometric spread of representations impacts representational capacity through compressibility. Surprisingly, we find that despite their contrasting geometric structures, both architectures exhibit tightly matched effective capacities. We further investigate whether this skewed geometry affects how concepts are encoded. Using rank-constrained probes, we demonstrate that both architectures encode concepts in subspaces of surprisingly similar dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the transformers' dominant principal direction does not inherently encode more conceptual information. Finally, we zoom in and examine the alignment between manifolds, either by analyzing representations of specific topics or by looking at the nearest neighborhoods of tokens, and find that they are highly aligned. Ultimately, our analysis suggests that while transformers and SSMs induce different usage of latent space, they display a striking functional convergence at the level of local semantic manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多尺度分析比较了Transformer、状态空间模型（如Mamba）及混合架构的内部表示几何与功能特性，发现尽管两者在潜在空间的利用方式上存在显著差异（SSMs均匀分布信息，Transformers由单一主导方向支配），但在表征容量、概念编码维度及局部语义流形方面展现出惊人的功能趋同。
AI.motivation: Mamba等状态空间模型在语言建模性能上可与Transformer媲美，但两者架构本质不同。这引发关键问题：这些结构差异如何影响其内部表示的几何结构和功能性质？理解这一问题有助于揭示不同架构下模型表示空间的本质规律。
AI.method: 采用多尺度分析框架对Transformer、SSMs和混合架构进行系统比较。首先分析表示空间的几何分布（SSMs维度均匀分布vs. Transformer主导方向）；其次通过压缩性测试评估表征容量；再次使用秩约束探针检测概念编码的子空间维度；最后通过主题表示分析和最近邻token分析来检验流形间对齐程度。
AI.result: 研究发现：SSMs将表示信息均匀分布在所有维度上，而Transformer表示被单一主导方向支配；混合架构中每经过一个注意力层，表示空间就愈加倾向于单一主导方向。尽管几何结构截然不同，两种架构的有效容量却紧密匹配。秩约束探针显示两者以惊人相似的子空间维度编码概念，且Transformer的主导方向并不蕴含更多概念信息。在局部语义流形层面，两者的主题表示和token最近邻具有高度对齐性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管Transformer和SSMs在潜在空间利用方式上诱导出不同的几何结构，但在局部语义流形层面展现出显著的功能趋同。这表明底层架构选择可能更多影响的是表示的"编码风格"而非其语义功能本质。

title: SupGRPO: Enhancing GRPO with Matching-based Online SFT for Text Spotting
summary: Text spotting requires both accurate text recognition and precise spatial localization. Current specialised spotters excel at predicting tight bounding boxes in natural scenes, but falter on complex or artistic text, whereas multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess strong recognition capabilities yet remain weak at localisation. To equip the text spotter with general and powerful recognition capabilities and to maximize its localization ability, we explore two MLLM-based fine-tuning methods: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning fine-tuning based on Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). An interesting finding is that SFT is less effective than GRPO at enhancing recognition, while GRPO is less effective than SFT at enhancing detection. To compensate for each other's shortcomings, we introduce a joint training strategy, SupGRPO, which simultaneously optimizes the model using both SFT and GRPO. SupGRPO employs the specially designed reward functions and develops a matching-based online SFT applied solely to coordinate tokens. It both mitigates the reward sparsity problem of GRPO and avoids the instance order dependency problem of SFT. To evaluate particularly challenging cases, we curate ATS, a dataset for artistic text spotting. Experiments demonstrate that SupGRPO improves both text recognition and detection, and attains superior performance. Our code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/Psycho-9/SupGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SupGRPO，一种结合SFT和GRPO的联合训练策略，用于增强基于多模态大语言模型的文本检测与识别能力。作者发现SFT更擅长提升检测能力而GRPO更擅长提升识别能力，因此通过联合训练取长补短，并构建了艺术文本检测数据集ATS验证效果。
AI.motivation: 当前文本检测器在自然场景下能准确预测紧密边界框，但在复杂或艺术文本上表现不佳；而多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备强大的识别能力，但定位能力较弱。如何兼得强大的通用识别能力和精确的定位能力是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 探索两种基于MLLM的微调方法：监督微调（SFT）和基于GRPO的强化学习微调。发现SFT擅长检测提升而GRPO擅长识别提升后，提出联合训练策略SupGRPO，同时用SFT和GRPO优化模型。SupGRPO设计了专门的奖励函数，并开发了基于匹配的在线SFT仅应用于坐标令牌，既缓解了GRPO的奖励稀疏问题，又避免了SFT的实例顺序依赖问题。此外构建了艺术文本检测数据集ATS用于评测。
AI.result: 实验表明SupGRPO同时提升了文本识别和检测能力，在包括艺术文本等复杂场景下达到了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: SupGRPO通过SFT与GRPO的联合训练有效弥补了两种方法各自的缺陷，实现了识别与检测能力的协同提升，为MLLM驱动的文本检测提供了新思路。

title: Record Grouping Controls Evidence Weight in Language Models
summary: Retrieved records are presentation units; a supplied partition determines which records enter a language model as one evidential contribution. We characterize the invariant group-content state that removes within-group copies while retaining complementary canonical content, show that equal group counts can encode different evidence states, and derive a sharp content-aware partition-error bound. Given a supplied partition, our pre-generation representation deduplicates and aggregates content within groups and bounds each group's contribution. Across 104,402 trials and 6 public checkpoints, a central natural-text intervention finds that content-fixed false splits add 10.27-32.66 percentage points and false merges remove 9.13-31.79 points; a matched six-slot control retains the positive direction in all 16 cells. In a new 48-item controlled campaign panel, changing the supplied partition produces measurable, checkpoint-dependent decision shifts across all four models, and the balanced mirror design exposes substantial order interactions. Together, the theory and experiments establish the supplied partition as a controllable pre-generation representation variable and characterize its checkpoint-dependent behavioral effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在检索增强生成（RAG）中，"提供的分区"（supplied partition）如何作为可控的预生成表示变量影响语言模型行为。作者建立了群组内容状态的不变性质理论框架，推导了内容感知的分区错误界，并通过10万余次实验和6个公开检查点验证了分区错误（错误拆分/合并）对模型输出的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG研究通常关注检索什么内容，而忽略了"内容如何分组呈现给语言模型"这一问题。检索结果作为呈现单元进入模型时，分区方式（哪些记录归在一组作为一个证据贡献）可能显著影响模型输出，但缺乏理论刻画和系统实验验证。
AI.method: 理论上，作者刻画了群组内容状态的不变性质（去除组内重复同时保留互补的典型内容），揭示了相等的组数量可编码不同的证据状态，并推导出内容感知的分区错误界。提出一种预生成表示方法，在给定分区下进行去重和组内聚合，并限制每组的贡献。实验上，通过104,402次试验和6个公共检查点进行自然文本干预测试，并设计48项受控宣传面板和匹配的六槽位对照实验来验证效果。
AI.result: 内容固定的错误拆分增加了10.27-32.66个百分点，错误合并移除了9.13-31.79个百分点；匹配的六槽位对照在全部16个单元中保持正向方向。在48项受控宣传面板中，改变分区在所有四种模型中产生了可测量的、依赖检查点的决策偏移；平衡镜像设计暴露了显著的顺序交互效应。
AI.conclusion: 提供的分区是一个可控的预生成表示变量，其变化会产生依赖检查点的可测量行为效应。理论与实验共同建立了对此变量的系统理解和控制方法。

title: Single Image to Textured 3D Object Generation in Frequency Domain: From Theory to Pipeline
summary: Single-view 3D reconstruction, also known as image-to-3D, is a persistently challenging task due to the extreme lack of information. Recently, diffusion models pre-trained on large-scale datasets served as 2D priors are used to solve the ill-posed task but suffer from color deviation and view inconsistency, which can be curbed by using diffusion models fine-tuned with 3D annotated data served as 3D priors. However, 3D priors lack high-frequency details, which cannot be solved by direct complementation with 2D priors in spatial domain for introducing erroneous low-frequency 2D prior guidance. In this paper, we revisit the characteristics of different diffusion priors from the frequency perspective. Based on our observations, we theoretically present a unified framework of hybrid optimization using multiple diffusion priors in frequency domain. Under this framework, we further propose Morpheus3D, a pipeline of 3D object generation from any single unposed image in the wild. Morpheus3D enhances 3D prior with high-pass image-prompt 2D prior guidance to reconstruct high-quality 3D objects while effectively suppressing view inconsistency, low-frequency color deviation, and high-frequency lacking problems. Both quantitative and qualitative experiments on the public and our collected datasets with complex textures show that our method exhibits significant improvements in generation quality.

title: Improving Term Evaluation in Machine Translation: Variation Matters
summary: Terminology evaluation in machine translation (MT) usually assumes a single correct target form per source term. However, human translators routinely introduce variation that current metrics penalize as inconsistency. We examine how to account for this variation in document-level MT evaluation of English-French scientific translation, combining glossary-based accuracy, translation consistency, and a new cross-term variation (CTV) diagnostic measure that tests whether variation relationships are preserved across languages. Based on analyses of two parallel corpora, translated by four MT systems, we find that (1) MT systems generate less target-side variation than human translators; (2) transfer patterns strongly depend on the variation type; (3) consistency rankings vary with the choice of metric; and (4) constraining MT with a glossary improves accuracy and consistency but degrades CTV by suppressing valid variation. We argue for variation-aware evaluation that conditions consistency penalties on whether target-side variation mirrors source-side variation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了机器翻译（MT）术语评估中因人类译者自然产生的术语变体而导致的评价偏差问题，提出了一种新的跨术语变体（CTV）诊断指标，并基于英法科学翻译的双语平行语料和四个MT系统的实验，揭示了MT系统变体生成少于人类译者、变体迁移模式依赖类型、不同指标导致一致性排名不同，以及术语表约束虽提升准确率但抑制合法变体等现象，主张应构建考虑源语言变体的变体感知评估方法。
AI.motivation: 传统MT术语评估假设每个源术语只有一个正确的目标形式，但人类译者会自然地引入术语变体，现有指标会将这些合法变体误判为不一致。该研究旨在解决如何在文档级MT评估中合理处理这种术语变体的问题。
AI.method: 结合基于术语表的准确率评估、翻译一致性评估，以及新提出的跨术语变体（CTV）诊断指标（检验变体关系是否在语言间被保留），基于两套平行语料对四个MT系统的翻译输出进行分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）MT系统的目标侧变体生成少于人类译者；（2）变体的迁移模式高度依赖变体类型；（3）一致性排名随所选指标的不同而变化；（4）用术语表约束MT虽能提升准确率和一致性，但因抑制了合法的变体使用而降低了CTV分数。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张采用变体感知的评估方法，即一致性惩罚应以目标侧变体是否镜像源侧变体为条件，从而更合理地衡量MT的术语翻译质量。

title: CASCADE: A Spatio-Temporal-Causal Reasoning Representation and Dataset for Driving
summary: Reasoning is a promising route to the generalization that autonomous driving requires in the long tail, as it can infer how the elements of a scene depend on one another and traverse those dependencies to conclusions beyond what is observed. Yet it is hard to tell whether a model's conclusions follow the scene's dependencies, because no driving representation makes them explicit enough to test against. Text-based reasoning traces lack spatio-temporal grounding, spatio-temporal scene graphs lack causal links, and reasoning annotations at scale are increasingly model-generated and hard to verify. To this end, we introduce CASCADE (Causal Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Driving Environments), which encompasses two components: (1) a structured scene representation for reasoning in driving scenes and (2) a human-annotated dataset built on it. For every actor that interacts with the ego vehicle, the CASCADE representation records frame-by-frame, for as long as the actor is visible, what action is taken, where it occurs, and how it depends on the actions and states of others. The resulting structure makes reasoning predictions machine-verifiable: they can be scored against it element by element, without relying on (M)LLM judges. The CASCADE dataset provides comprehensive human annotations for 2,066 driving clips of the PhysicalAI dataset, with over 34K elements that establish the spatio-temporal and causal context of each scene, including 8.6K time-stamped ego and agent actions, 3.7K causal links and 2.9K potential influences, and 6.1K annotations for agents, objects, traffic lights, and environments. Being entirely human-annotated, CASCADE provides the reference for this comparison: benchmarking the reasoning abilities of Physical AI models, and verifying the quality of automatically generated reasoning labels. The CASCADE dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/cascade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASCADE（Causal Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Driving Environments），一种用于自动驾驶场景推理的结构化场景表示及基于其构建的人工标注数据集。该表示以逐帧方式记录每个与自车交互的智能体的动作、位置及其对其他智能体动作和状态的因果依赖关系，使推理预测可逐元素机器验证，无需依赖(M)LLM评判。数据集包含对PhysicalAI数据集2,066个驾驶片段的全人工标注，含34K+场景元素、8.6K时间戳动作、3.7K因果链接、2.9K潜在影响及6.1K实体标注。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在长尾场景中需要推理来实现泛化，但现有方法难以验证模型的推理结论是否真正遵循场景中的依赖关系。文本推理轨迹缺乏时空基础，时空场景图缺乏因果链接，大规模推理标注多为模型生成且难以验证。
AI.method: 提出CASCADE结构化场景表示，对每个与自车交互的智能体逐帧记录其动作、发生位置及对他人动作/状态的因果依赖，使推理预测可机器验证。同时构建基于此表示的人工标注数据集，对所有预测逐元素打分，不依赖LLM评判。
AI.result: CASCADE数据集包含2,066个PhysicalAI驾驶片段的全人工标注，总计34K+元素：8.6K时间戳自车/智能体动作、3.7K因果链接、2.9K潜在影响、6.1K代理/物体/交通灯/环境标注。
AI.conclusion: CASCADE为自动驾驶推理提供了可验证的基准平台，可评估Physical AI模型的推理能力并验证自动生成推理标签的质量。数据集已公开发布。

title: Evolution of Multimodal Question Answering: From Modality-Adaptive Extraction to Unified Language Representation
summary: The rapid growth of multimodal data has intensified the need for question answering (QA) systems capable of reasoning across heterogeneous sources such as text, tables, and images. In this paper, we present a comprehensive methodological comparison of three influential frameworks, namely Multimodal Adaptive Extraction (MAE), Solar, and UniMMQA, tracing the evolution of multimodal question answering from modality-adaptive pipelines to fully unified architectures. We examine how each approach models cross-modal interactions, transforms heterogeneous inputs, and performs reasoning, highlighting key design differences in modality representation, reasoning, and answer generation. Our analysis demonstrates a clear shift from explicit modality-specific processing toward unified text-centric formulations enabled by pre-trained language models (PLMs). Empirical comparisons across benchmark datasets show that this transition leads to substantial improvements in both Exact Match (EM) and F1-Scores, with UniMMQA achieving the most consistent and scalable performance. Despite these advances, we identify persistent challenges, including information loss during modality transformation, error propagation in multi-stage pipelines, and limitations in capturing fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Overall, this study provides a deeper understanding of current design trends and offers insights into the future direction of unified multimodal reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对三种多模态问答框架（MAE、Solar和UniMMQA）进行系统性方法比较，展示了从模态自适应管道到完全统一架构的演进趋势，并指出UniMMQA在EM和F1指标上表现最优，同时揭示了模态转换信息丢失、多阶段管道错误传播等持续挑战。
AI.motivation: 多模态数据快速增长使得跨文本、表格和图像的问答系统需求日益迫切，但目前缺乏对这些代表性框架的系统性比较研究。
AI.method: 对三种多模态问答框架（MAE、Solar和UniMMQA）进行综合方法论比较，分析各框架在跨模态交互建模、异构输入转换和推理方面的设计差异，并通过基准数据集进行实证对比。
AI.result: 从显式模态特定处理向基于预训练语言模型的统一文本中心化范式转变，UniMMQA在精确匹配和F1分数上表现最一致且可扩展性最佳。
AI.conclusion: 多模态问答正朝统一架构方向发展，但仍面临信息损失、错误传播和细粒度跨模态依赖捕获等挑战，为未来统一多模态推理系统提供了方向性见解。

title: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
comment: Winning solution technical report for the EgoProactive track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Grand Challenge
summary:
We present our submission to the EgoProactive track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Challenge, which ranked first in the large-model division and second in the <=2B division. The task requires a wearable assistant to decide after each eight-second segment of egocentric video whether to intervene or remain silent.
  Our approach has two main components. First, we reformulate intervention timing as single-token classification. Rather than generating either $interrupt$<utterance> or $silent$, the model predicts yes or no, and we derive the decision from the renormalised probabilities of these two tokens. This formulation improved macro-F1 by 0.249 and G-mean by 0.30 over free-form generation. Second, because labelled data were limited to the released validation set, we generated additional supervision using a tool-calling video agent that inspects each clip and assigns intervention timestamps. A narration-only alternative was four times larger and ten times cheaper, but transferred worse than supervision from an unrelated real corpus, suggesting that visual grounding is more important than annotation volume for this task.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ECCV 2026可穿戴AI挑战赛EgoProactive赛道中排名第一（大模型组）和第二（≤2B组）的方案。方法核心包括两点：将干预时机预测重构为单token分类任务（预测yes/no而非生成完整话语），使macro-F1提升0.249、G-mean提升0.30；以及利用工具调用视频智能体生成额外的监督数据，实验表明视觉基础比标注数量更重要。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴助手的核心挑战在于需要在八秒的自我中心视频片段后准确判断是否应主动干预（打断）或保持沉默，这是一个关键但研究不足的交互时机决策问题。同时，标注数据极其有限（仅发布验证集可用），需要寻找有效的监督信号补充方式。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：（1）将干预时机预测重构为单token分类问题——模型只需预测yes或no，通过重归一化的token概率导出决策，而非直接生成free-form的interrupt<话语>或silent文本；（2）利用工具调用的视频智能体检查每个视频片段并标记干预时间戳，以此生成额外监督数据。论文还比较了仅基于叙述的替代方案（数据量大4倍、成本低10倍）与现实语料库监督的效果差异。
AI.result: 单token分类公式相比自由生成在macro-F1上提升0.249，在G-mean上提升0.30；方法在大模型分组中排名第一，在≤2B参数分组中排名第二。叙述-only替代方案虽然规模更大且更便宜，但其迁移效果不如来自不相关真实语料库的监督，说明视觉基础比标注数量对任务更重要。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了对决策边界进行任务重构（单token分类）和借助视频智能体的视觉基础标注可以显著改善可穿戴AI的干预时机判断性能。论文强调了视觉基础信息在此类自我中心视频任务中的关键价值，甚至超过更多的标注数量。

title: Experience Funnel: A State-Policy Alternating Loop for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) continuously accumulate experience through interaction, creating an opportunity to improve future behavior through self-evolution. A fundamental challenge is how to transform abundant, task-specific interaction experience into reusable model competence without sacrificing the ability to adapt rapidly to newly observed evidence. Explicit textual states, such as skills and agent harnesses, provide fast, human-readable and editable adaptation, but incur persistent dependence on external context; parametric policies provide compact and reusable competence, but are substantially slower to update. We present \textit{Experience Funnel}, a self-evolving framework that couples fast state adaptation with slow policy consolidation in an alternating loop. Interaction trajectories are first distilled into an explicit textual state, where newly acquired experience can be rapidly incorporated and validated. The framework then selectively identifies state-enabled behavior that remains useful across state revisions and consolidates it into the policy through transition-aware distillation. The updated state--policy pair subsequently generates new rollouts, providing fresh evidence for the next round of state adaptation and policy consolidation. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that \textit{Experience Funnel} consistently improves agent capability over state-only evolution and policy-internalization approaches, while progressively converting useful explicit experience into autonomous policy competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Experience Funnel框架，一种结合快速状态适应与慢速策略固化的自进化框架。通过交替循环进行交互轨迹提炼与策略巩固，将显式经验逐步转化为自主策略能力，在多个智能体基准上优于仅状态演化与仅策略内化的方法。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的自主智能体通过交互不断积累经验，但如何将大量任务特定经验转化为可复用的模型能力、同时保持对新证据的快速适应能力是一大挑战。显式文本状态（如技能、智能体封装）适应快但依赖外部上下文；参数化策略可复用但更新缓慢。
AI.method: Experience Funnel采用交替循环：(1) 将交互轨迹蒸馏为显式文本状态，实现快速纳入与验证新经验；(2) 选择性识别跨状态修订仍有用的状态驱动行为，通过transitions-aware蒸馏固化为策略；(3) 更新后的状态-策略对生成新rollouts，提供下一轮迭代的原始证据。
AI.result: 在多个智能体基准实验中，Experience Funnel一致地提升了智能体能力，优于仅状态演化和策略内化方法，且能逐步将有用的显式经验转化为自主策略能力。
AI.conclusion: Experience Funnel有效弥合了快速状态适应与慢速策略固化的差距，通过"漏斗式"演化将经验从快速、可解释的显式状态逐步转化为压缩、可复用的隐式策略能力，实现持续自进化。

title: Discovering Natural Transformation Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Vision Models
summary: Natural adversarial examples (NAEs) reveal that vision models can fail under realistic semantic changes beyond norm-bounded perturbations. However, generating NAEs in a black-box setting remains challenging because existing generative attacks often rely on surrogate models, learned attack priors, or costly query-based optimization, whereas the natural transformations that expose model vulnerabilities are unknown a priori. We propose \textbf{Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA)}, a query-based black-box framework that searches over natural-language editing scenarios using a multimodal language model and a modern text-guided generative editor. ASA jointly explores background, weather, and material/color transformations through winner--loser feedback, and uses a greedy explorer to compose only attack-improving scenarios. Across diverse ImageNet classifiers, ASA achieves substantially higher attack success rates than prior query-based generative attacks while requiring fewer victim-model queries and preserving competitive perceptual quality. Moreover, ASA exhibits both image-level and prompt-level transferability: its adversarial images remain effective across victim-model architectures, while its discovered editing scenarios can be reused across same-class images and, in some cases, across architectures. These findings suggest that vision models possess reusable vulnerabilities to natural transformation patterns, which ASA can efficiently identify in a black-box setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Adversarial Scenario Attack (ASA)，一种基于查询的黑盒攻击框架，利用多模态语言模型和文本引导生成器搜索自然语言编辑场景（如背景、天气、材质/颜色变化）来生成自然对抗样本。ASA在ImageNet分类器上实现了比现有基于查询的生成攻击更高的攻击成功率，同时查询次数更少，并展现出图像级和提示级的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 自然对抗样本揭示视觉模型在现实语义变化下会失效，但现有生成性攻击在黑盒场景下面临挑战：依赖替代模型、需要学习攻击先验或昂贵的查询优化，且暴露模型漏洞的自然变换在事前不可知。
AI.method: ASA通过多模态语言模型搜索自然语言编辑场景，结合现代文本引导的生成式编辑器，联合探索背景、天气和材质/颜色变换。它采用胜者-败者反馈机制，并使用贪心探索器仅组合有助于攻击的场景。
AI.result: 在多种ImageNet分类器上，ASA比现有基于查询的生成攻击获得显著更高的攻击成功率，且需要更少的受害者查询，同时保持竞争性的感知质量。对抗图像跨模型架构有效，发现的编辑场景可跨同类图像和跨架构复用。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模型存在对自然变换模式的可复用漏洞，ASA能够在黑盒环境下高效地识别这些漏洞，表明语言引导的编辑搜索是黑盒自然对抗攻击的有效途径。

title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA
comment: Work Accepted at GroundLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Language models often receive a question together with a claim about what another source answered. We audit whether such claims destabilize answers in multiple-choice question answering. For each item, we hold one wrong option fixed across misleading conditions and vary the cue template attached to it. We introduce \emph{neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate} (NC-MCAR), which measures switches to that option only on valid cued trials where the same model first selected the gold answer under a neutral prompt. This is a measure of answer instability, not proof that the model knew the answer or that all deference is irrational. We evaluate four instruction-following models on MMLU-Pro and IndicMMLU-Pro in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. Across 220{,}000 outputs, the expert template yields 41.1\% aggregate NC-MCAR, compared with 12.5\% for the majority template. These two conditions use the same wrong option and final instruction. Filler accuracy remains well above expert-wrong accuracy, while correct-cue prompts have high valid-response accuracy. The audit documents answer instability relevant to grounding under the tested forced-choice prompts: a bare, unverified source claim can outweigh an answer that was previously consistent with the task evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文对多选问答中语言模型是否会被"他人声称的答案"所动摇进行了审计。通过引入NC-MCAR指标（仅统计在有效提示下模型先正确选择gold答案后转向错误选项的比率），对四种指令遵循模型在MMLU-Pro和IndicMMLU-Pro的多种语言上进行了大规模评估，发现"专家模板"下NC-MCAR高达41.1%，远高于"多数模板"的12.5%，表明未经验证的源声称可以推翻模型原本基于任务证据的正确答案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被输入一个附带他人答案声称的问题，这些未经核实的声称可能使模型偏离正确答案。现有研究缺乏对此类"答案不稳定"现象的系统量化，需要设计严格的指标来衡量模型在误导性线索下是否会放弃原本正确的选择。
AI.method: 引入NC-MCAR（neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate）指标，仅统计在有效提示条件下模型先在neutral prompt下选中gold answer、随后在误导条件下切换到被固定的错误选项的比率。设计不同误导性cue模板（如专家声称、多数人意见）附加到同一错误选项上，比较模型在不同条件下是否发生答案翻转。在MMMLU-Pro和IndicMMLU-Pro上用英语、印地语、孟加拉语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语对四个指令遵循模型进行大规模评测，共产生约22万条输出。
AI.result: 在22万条输出中，专家模板的聚合NC-MCAR为41.1%，而多数模板仅为12.5%。两种条件下使用相同的错误选项和最终指令，仅cue模板不同。填充任务（filler）的准确率远高于专家错误条件下的准确率，说明模型在非误导条件下表现正常；正确cue提示下的有效回答准确率较高。该审计文档化了在强制选择提示下外源声称对答案稳定性的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该审计表明，语言模型在回答多选问题时存在显著的回答不稳定性：一条未经验证的外部声称（即使是虚假的专家说法）能够使模型放弃先前与任务证据一致的正确答案。NC-MCAR提供了一种衡量回答不稳定性的方法，而非证明模型"知道"答案或所有顺从外部声称的行为都是不理性的。这一发现对基于检索或外部来源的grounding机制提出了警示。

title: A Two-Stage Framework for Ego-Centric Key Object Identification via Object State Prediction
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: This paper presents a novel framework designed to enhance key object identification in autonomous driving. Existing methods primarily focus on either detecting objects independently or leveraging visual relationships, but they do not explicitly consider the ego vehicle's perspective in determining object importance. To address this gap, we propose a structured approach that integrates a virtual ego-vehicle representation and a modular object state predictor, enabling a more accurate estimation of object behaviors relative to the ego-vehicle. Subsequently, our framework employs spatial-temporal reasoning to refine key object identification, prioritizing objects based on their states and relative spatial information rather than relying solely on visual relationships. Experimental results on real-world driving datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in accurately detecting critical objects in complex traffic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于增强自动驾驶中的关键目标识别。该框架通过整合虚拟自车表示和模块化目标状态预测器，并结合时空推理来优先识别关键目标，而不是仅依赖视觉关系。在真实驾驶数据集上的实验证明了其在复杂交通环境中准确检测关键目标的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么独立检测目标，要么利用视觉关系，但未明确考虑自车视角在确定目标重要性中的作用，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出结构化方法整合虚拟自车表示和模块化目标状态预测器，以更准确地估计目标相对于自车的行为；随后采用时空推理来细化关键目标识别，基于目标状态和相对空间信息进行优先级排序。
AI.result: 在真实驾驶数据集上的实验结果验证了该方法在复杂交通环境中准确检测关键目标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过纳入自车视角进行关键目标识别，弥补了现有方法在目标重要性判断上的不足，为自动驾驶中的关键目标检测提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Evaluating and Improving Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking in LLMs via Multi-Round Evidence Ablation
summary: Automatic fact-checking systems assess the veracity of claims given evidence from relevant documents. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in fact-checking due to their general reasoning capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether they faithfully make use of the evidence provided to reach veracity judgments or rely on parametric knowledge. To investigate this, we introduce Fact-Ablated Evaluation (FAE), a new evaluation framework that iteratively ablates the cited evidence to assess whether LLMs revise their predictions accordingly. Our empirical results show that current off-the-shelf LLMs as fact-checking systems rely more on their parametric knowledge than on the evidence provided. To bridge this gap between prediction accuracy and evidence grounding, we propose REAL (Rigorous Evidence Ablation Learning), a training framework that promotes evidence-dependent verification through counterfactual evidence supervision for the LLM-as-verifier models. Experiments on four fact-checking datasets across different domains demonstrate that models trained with REAL obtain superior evidence-dependent capabilities compared to standard fine-tuned models. Our findings highlight that strong fact-checking performance can still coexist with weak evidence dependency, while REAL encourages veracity predictions to remain more closely tied to the availability of supporting evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fact-Ablated Evaluation (FAE)评估框架和REAL训练框架，揭示当前LLM事实核查系统过度依赖参数化知识而非提供的证据，并证明REAL能通过反事实证据监督增强模型对证据的依赖性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在事实核查任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚它们是否真正基于提供的证据做出判断，还是依赖其内在的参数化知识。这种证据依赖性的缺失可能导致预测不可靠。
AI.method: 提出FAE（迭代性地去除引用证据以评估模型预测是否随之改变）和REAL（通过反事实证据监督训练框架，促进证据依赖性的验证能力），并在四个不同领域的事实核查数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 现有LLM在事实核查中更依赖参数化知识而非证据；使用REAL训练的模型相比标准微调模型，获得了显著更优的证据依赖能力。发现强事实核查性能可与弱证据依赖共存。
AI.conclusion: REAL训练框架能有效使模型的真实性预测与支持证据的可获得性保持更紧密的联系，弥合预测准确性与证据基础之间的差距。

title: NutriBench-Kitchen: Benchmarking Embodied AI for Nutrition Management
summary: An embodied kitchen assistant must do more than recognize food in isolated frames. It must track ingredient states over time and integrate visual observations with recipe and nutritional knowledge to support constraint-aware decision-making. We formalize this capability as \emph{Embodied Nutrition Management}: perceiving nutrition-relevant events, maintaining a persistent food state, and using it for knowledge-grounded planning. Existing benchmarks evaluate static food understanding or embodied cooking actions, but do not measure whether an agent can continuously update and use nutrition-relevant states in dynamic kitchens. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{NutriBench-Kitchen}, a benchmark containing 1,500 manually verified question--answer pairs from 160 cooking videos. It covers five task families: Ingredient Entry, Memory Management, Recipe Query, Long-Term Planning, and Short-Term Planning, spanning food-state construction, maintenance, knowledge retrieval, and decision-making across different planning horizons. Evaluations of proprietary and open-source large vision-language models reveal a substantial gap from human performance, particularly in quantitative ingredient estimation, long-term state tracking, and reasoning under interacting constraints. We further introduce \textbf{Nutri-Vgent}, a diagnostic long-video agent with separate episodic, food-state, and recipe memories. Its consistent improvements demonstrate the value of explicit state representations and structured memory for nutrition management. Together, NutriBench-Kitchen and Nutri-Vgent provide a testbed for studying persistent state tracking and knowledge-grounded reasoning in dynamic kitchens. Code is available at https://github.com/V1ol1n/NutriBench-Kitchen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NutriBench-Kitchen基准测试（含160个烹饪视频中1500个QA对，覆盖五大任务族）用于评估具身营养管理能力，并引入Nutri-Vgent长视频诊断代理，通过显式状态表示与结构化记忆显著提升模型在动态厨房场景中的持续性状态追踪与规划表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估静态食物理解或具身烹饪动作，无法衡量代理能否在动态厨房中持续更新并利用与营养相关的状态信息。
AI.method: 构建NutriBench-Kitchen基准（1500个手工验证QA对，来自160个烹饪视频，覆盖五大任务族），并开发Nutri-Vgent诊断代理，配备分离的情节记忆、食品状态记忆和食谱记忆。
AI.result: 专有与开源大型视觉语言模型表现与人类存在显著差距，尤其在定量食材估计、长期状态追踪和交互约束推理方面；Nutri-Vgent展现出持续的改进效果。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态表示与结构化记忆对动态厨房中的营养管理至关重要，NutriBench-Kitchen与Nutri-Vgent为持久状态追踪与知识驱动推理提供了测试平台。

title: Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness in measuring correctness, faithfulness, and interpretability in LLM-generated responses.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于知识图谱的新型评估框架S3KG，通过混合结构相似度和语义相似度来评估LLM在问答任务中的上下文理解能力，弥补传统指标（如困惑度、BLEU）无法揭示模型真实推理能力的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标（如perplexity、BLEU和表面准确率）无法充分揭示LLM在上下文信息提取、整合和推理方面的真实能力，尤其在问答任务中，模型需要基于上下文的推理而非记忆关联，现有评估方法存在明显缺口。
AI.method: 提出S3KG（Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs）框架，该混合相似度度量将知识图谱的结构相似性与语义相似性整合为连续评估分数，并配套设计了一个用于错误分类的诊断框架。
AI.result: 在人工策划的问答基准数据集上，将S3KG与已有评估指标进行对比验证，结果表明该框架能有效衡量LLM生成回复的正确性（correctness）、忠实性（faithfulness）和可解释性（interpretability）。
AI.conclusion: 基于知识图谱的S3KG框架为LLM上下文理解评估提供了更全面、更细粒度的替代方案，能够同时评估正确性、忠实性和可解释性，填补了传统评估指标的不足。

title: Flow3D-OPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for 3D Geometry Generation with Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer
summary: Recent image-to-3D generation models built on flow-matching diffusion Transformers (DiT) can produce high-fidelity meshes, yet their post-training strategy remains largely unexplored. There exist several critical bottlenecks in reinforcement learning: the inherent difficulty of defining comprehensive rewards for 3D geometric quality, and the gradient interference that arises when jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives. Inspired by the practicability of on-policy distillation (OPD) in large language models and image generation, we propose \textbf{Flow3D-OPD}, a two-stage post-training framework that introduces multi-teacher distillation into 3D geometry generation. In the first stage, we utilize the semi-policy to enhance the foundational capability of the pretrained model and then design an agentic verifier for 3D geometric quality evaluation. Based on the verifier, we could cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via direct preference optimization (DPO). In the second stage, we consolidate heterogeneous expertise into a unified student model through on-policy distillation with hard task-routing sampling and gradient accumulation, which could mitigate the gradient interference in joint optimization. Without relying on elaborate modifications, our straightforward yet effective design achieves consistent improvements across all geometric quality dimensions and surpasses all teacher models in the average metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach provides an effective paradigm for reinforcement learning in 3D generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flow3D-OPD，一个两阶段后训练框架，通过多教师蒸馏提升图像到3D生成模型的几何质量。第一阶段利用半策略增强基础能力并设计代理验证器评估几何质量，通过DPO培养领域专精教师模型；第二阶段通过带硬任务路由采样和梯度累积的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将异构专家知识整合到统一学生模型中，有效缓解联合优化中的梯度干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于流匹配扩散Transformer的图像到3D生成模型能产生高保真网格，但其后训练策略尚未被充分探索。强化学习中存在两个关键瓶颈：为3D几何质量定义综合奖励的固有困难，以及联合优化异构目标时产生的梯度干扰问题。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练框架：(1) 第一阶段利用半策略增强预训练模型的基础能力，设计agentic验证器评估3D几何质量，并基于该验证器通过直接偏好优化（DPO）培养领域专精教师模型；(2) 第二阶段通过带硬任务路由采样和梯度累积的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将多个教师的异构专业知识整合到统一学生模型中，以缓解联合优化中的梯度干扰。
AI.result: 无需复杂修改，该方法在所有几何质量维度上均取得一致性改进，并在平均指标上超越所有教师模型，实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Flow3D-OPD为3D生成中的强化学习提供了一种有效的范式，展示了将LLM和图像生成中OPD的成功实践迁移到3D几何生成领域的可行性。

title: The Audit Decides the Verdict: Instrument Effects Rival Demographic Bias in LLM Decision Audits
comment: Accepted to REALM 2026, the 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at EMNLP 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Whether a language model looks demographically biased can depend on how the audit asks its question. A charitable-aid benchmark reports that the same models favor minority applicants when rating requests one at a time and penalize some when ranking side by side. We test whether that reversal generalizes to hiring, lending, and medical triage: 40,726 requests to five models, applications differing only in the applicant's name, and a primary test fixed before collection. It does not. None of 36 planned contrasts survives correction. The rating advantage keeps its sign at roughly half the published size, and a precision extension bounds any hiring ranking penalty below the published effect, though the lending and triage ranking floors sit above that margin, so the exclusion is conclusive for hiring ranking and for rating in all three domains only. Planted disparities tracking their injected sizes and a directional replication on the original aid materials bound these nulls. The audit is livelier than the demographics: models recognize transparent audits nearly always, tie every identical-content comparison whether the varying detail is race or a hobby, and reward first-listed candidates as much as any demographic effect we measure. Audit verdicts reflect audit construction more than demographic bias.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了先前关于语言模型在逐项评分与并列排序中存在人口统计偏见反转的研究发现在招聘、贷款和医疗分诊场景中的普适性。通过对五个模型进行40,726个请求的测试，作者发现在这些新领域中原有反转不成立，36个预设对比无一通过校正。评级优势保持在约发表效应量一半的水平，精度扩展表明招聘排序惩罚被排除，但贷款和分诊的排序下限仍高于该边际。模型能够识别透明的审计，且审计结论更多反映审计建构方式而非真实的人口统计偏见。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示同一语言模型在逐项评分时偏向少数族裔申请人，但在并列排序时却对其不利。作者想要检验这种"评分-排序反向"现象是否在招聘、贷款和医疗分诊等高风险场景中具有普适性，以澄清审计结论是否真正反映模型偏见还是审计方法本身造成的假象。
AI.method: 作者在三个领域（招聘、贷款、医疗分诊）对五个语言模型进行了40,726个请求测试，请求中仅改变申请人姓名以体现种族差异。采用预先固定的主要检验标准，并通过引入注入的人为差异（planted disparities）进行效度验证，同时对比动机类细节变化与姓名变化的效果，并在原始救助材料上进行方向性复制。
AI.result: 研究发现原有反转不具普遍性：36个预设对比无一在多重比较校正后显著。评级优势虽保持符号方向但效应量约为已发表的50%。精度分析排除了招聘排序惩罚的可能性（排他性结论），但贷款和分诊排序的下限高于发表效应边际，排他性仅在招聘排序以及三个领域的评级中具有结论性。模型几乎总能识别透明的审计，任何等同内容比较都会产生相同结果（无论变化是种族还是爱好），且列表位置效应对结果的影响不亚于所测量的人口统计效应。
AI.conclusion: 审计结论反映审计建构方式多于模型的人口统计偏见。模型的排名位置效应、对审计情境的识别等因素对结果的系统性影响超过种族姓名变化本身。因此，在评估语言模型的人口统计公平性时，必须谨慎考虑审计方法的设计，单凭某一审计范式得出的结论可能具有误导性。

title: Ambient @ EgoLongQA 2026: Distilling Long-Video perception into a Sub-2B Model
comment: Winning solution technical report for the EgoLongQA track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Grand Challenge
summary: We describe our entry to the EgoLongQA track of the Wearable-AI Challenge in ECCV 2026, which placed first in the <=2B parameter division with 0.8279 on the held-out test set. Our system is a single 2B vision-language model that answers multiple-choice questions about ten-minute egocentric videos in one greedy forward pass; It is obtained by distilling the junior perception module of a tool-using agentic pipeline, not the agent itself into a small student, using teacher traces filtered to those that answered correctly. it reaches 89% of the accuracy of the large agentic pipeline using 1.1% of its parameters. This raises a 27.1% base model to 81.4% on our held-out questions. The 2B backbone has 2.2132B parameters and therefore over the divisional limit, to make the entry admissable we prune the multilingual embedding table from 248,320 to 143,469 rows, reaching 1.9985B with provably identical logits on retained rows.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ECCV 2026 Wearable-AI挑战赛EgoLongQA赛道≤2B参数组第一名的系统：一个2B视觉语言模型，通过对工具使用智能体管线中的初级感知模块进行知识蒸馏（而非对整个智能体蒸馏），仅用1.1%的参数达到大型智能体管线89%的准确率。为满足2B参数限制，作者通过剪枝多语言嵌入表将模型从2.2132B降至1.9985B参数。
AI.motivation: 目标是构建一个满足≤2B参数限制的单一模型，能够高效回答十分钟自我中心视频中的多项选择题，同时尽可能接近大型智能体管线的准确率。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个关键步骤：(1) 将一个工具使用智能体管线中的"初级感知模块"（而非智能体本身）蒸馏到一个2B学生模型中，使用回答正确的教师轨迹进行过滤训练； (2) 通过将多语言嵌入表从248,320行剪枝到143,469行，将模型参数从2.2132B压缩到1.9985B，以满足分区限制，且保留行上的logits在数学上保持一致。
AI.result: 该系统在held-out测试集上取得0.8279的分数，位列≤2B参数组第一名。仅用大型智能体管线1.1%的参数达到其89%的准确率，将基础模型从27.1%提升到81.4%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏感知模块而非整个智能体是一种高效的模型压缩策略，可在极小参数量下保留大部分性能；嵌入表剪枝提供了一种无损（在保留行上）的参数缩减方法以满足竞争性限制。

title: Performance of Clinical AI System and Physicians and Frontier Language Models in primary care diagnostics
summary: Clinical AI evaluation should encompass diagnosis and management after adaptive information gathering. We compared Doctorina, eight physicians and four standalone frontier language models in 150 synthetic Polish-language primary-care consultations. Doctorina achieved 82.0% Top-1 concordance versus 57.0% for physicians (difference, 25.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 17.7-32.7) and 97.3% versus 85.0% primary-or-reference-differential concordance. Across 149 case pairs, normalized workup and treatment scores were 89.4 versus 66.9 and 83.7 versus 61.2. Doctorina had the highest diagnostic point estimates among all six groups; Kimi K3 ranked next, while Claude Opus 5 led the closely spaced management estimates of Opus, Doctorina and Kimi. A second Doctorina execution reproduced the advantages over physicians across all outcomes. Doctorina's advantage over physicians therefore extended from primary-diagnosis selection to higher-rated diagnostic workup and initial treatment after adaptive consultation.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了Doctorina、八名医生和四个前沿语言模型在150个合成波兰语初级保健咨询中的临床AI评估表现。Doctorina在诊断一致性（82.0% vs 57.0%）、鉴别诊断、检查及治疗评分方面均显著优于医生，且二次执行后优势稳定。
AI.motivation: 临床AI评估应涵盖适应性信息收集后的诊断和管理全过程，而现有评估往往局限于单一诊断任务，缺乏对医生和AI在完整诊疗流程中的系统比较。
AI.method: 在150个合成波兰语初级保健咨询场景中，对Doctorina、八名医生和四个独立前沿语言模型进行对比评估，使用Top-1诊断一致性、主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性、标准化检查及治疗评分等指标。
AI.result: Doctorina的Top-1一致性为82.0%（医生为57.0%，差25.0个百分点），主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性为97.3%（医生85.0%）。检查评分89.4 vs 66.9，治疗评分83.7 vs 61.2。Kimi K3在诊断上排名第二，Claude Opus 5在管理评估中领先。二次执行仍显示Doctorina全面优于医生。
AI.conclusion: Doctorina相比医生的优势从主诊断选择延伸至更高评分的检查计划和初始治疗方案，表明其能在适应性咨询的全流程中保持临床能力优势且结果可复现。

title: Mind the Approximation: Fisher-Weighted SVD Compression for ViTs
summary: Model compression is key to mitigate deployment challenges of ever growing machine learning models. In this area of research, singular value decomposition (SVD)-based compression offers a compelling trade-off between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Fisher-weighted SVD in particular provides principled, loss-aware compression. However, we find that improving the fidelity of Fisher approximation used in the compression is poorly predictive of post-compression accuracy for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Motivated by this observation, we propose FACTS, a structured Fisher Approximation tailored to Compressing ViTs with Fisher-weighted SVD, which enforces token-local aggregation while preserving within-token activation-gradient dependence. Additionally, we introduce a fast Constrained Rank Search (CoRS), that optimizes layer-wise rank allocation while adhering to a fixed floating point operation (FLOP) constraint. Extensive experiments across ViTs and hybrid architectures demonstrate that FACTS consistently improves accuracy-efficiency trade-offs without requiring finetuning. Notably, it outperforms the strongest SVD baseline by up to +5.8 percentage points (p.p.) Top-1 on Swin-B, with further gains driven by our search method. Code is available at https://github.com/MoritzTho/FACTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACTS，一种针对Vision Transformers (ViTs)的Fisher加权SVD结构化压缩方法，通过保持token内激活梯度依赖和token局部聚合来提升压缩精度，并引入CoRS方法在固定FLOP约束下优化层间秩分配，无需微调即可在多个ViT架构上提升精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有Fisher近似压缩方法在ViTs上，其Fisher近似的保真度与压缩后精度之间缺乏相关性，这促使作者设计一种更契合ViT结构和压缩目标的结构化Fisher近似方法。
AI.method: 1) FACTS：一种结构化Fisher近似方法，强制进行token局部聚合，同时保留token内激活梯度的依赖性，用于Fisher加权SVD压缩ViTs。2) CoRS：一种带约束的快速秩搜索方法，在满足固定FLOP约束的前提下优化逐层的秩分配。
AI.result: 在多个ViT和混合架构上的实验表明，FACTS无需微调即可持续改善精度-效率权衡；在Swin-B上相比最强SVD基线最高提升+5.8个百分点Top-1精度，结合搜索方法可获得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: FACTS是针对ViTs的高效Fisher加权SVD压缩方法，结合CoRS秩分配策略，能够在无需微调的情况下显著超越现有SVD压缩基线，为ViT模型压缩提供了更好的精度-效率平衡方案。

title: ToolLoop: Closed-Loop Tool-Use Data Synthesis via Decomposed Generation and Dynamic Self-Feedback
comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: High-quality tool-use data is critical for training language models to interact effectively with external tools. However, existing synthetic approaches typically follow a generate-then-filter paradigm with static post-hoc verification, often yielding inefficient data with imbalanced feature distributions. We propose ToolLoop, a closed-loop framework that decomposes synthesis into three progressive stages: (1) sampling function name combinations as ground truth; (2) backward derivation of user queries; and (3) forward derivation of tool calls. At each stage, dynamic self-feedback iteratively guides the model toward high-quality generation, realizing a transition from generate-then-filter to generate-verify-refine. On the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), a 4B parameter model trained with our 11K synthetic examples achieves 86.40% accuracy in non-reasoning mode, while an Isolate variant that removes BFCL-overlapping candidate functions still reaches 86.07\%. Cross-benchmark evaluation on ACEBench further demonstrates strong generalization, with 72.1% overall accuracy using only 18.3% of baseline training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolLoop，一个闭环工具调用数据合成框架，通过动态自我反馈从"生成-过滤"范式转变为"生成-验证-精炼"范式，仅用11K合成样本训练4B模型即达到BFCL 86.40%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用数据的合成方法通常遵循"先生成后过滤"的静态范式，导致数据效率低下且特征分布不平衡，难以获得高质量的训练数据。
AI.method: ToolLoop采用三阶段递进式闭环框架：(1)采样函数名组合作为真值；(2)反向推导用户查询；(3)正向推导工具调用。每个阶段通过动态自我反馈迭代引导模型生成高质量数据，实现从generate-then-filter到generate-verify-refine的转变。
AI.result: 在BFCL基准上，使用11K合成样本训练的4B参数模型在非推理模式下达到86.40%准确率；去除BFCL重叠候选函数的Isolate变体仍达86.07%。在ACEBench跨基准评估中，仅使用基线18.3%的训练数据即达到72.1%的整体准确率，展现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ToolLoop验证了闭环生成-验证-精炼框架相比传统静态过滤方法能显著提升工具调用数据的合成质量与效率，以更少的训练数据获得更强的模型性能。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Symbol Spotting in Historical Encrypted Manuscripts
summary: The decipherment of historical encrypted manuscripts poses a fundamental challenge in Digital Humanities: before any transcription can begin, the symbol inventory of the underlying cipher alphabet must first be identified and characterized. We address this challenge through symbol spotting: given a candidate alphabet specified as a set of rendered font glyphs, the task is to determine whether and where its characters appear in an unseen handwritten document, without any labeled examples from the target script. The main difficulty lies in the domain gap between clean, digitally rendered font queries and degraded handwritten manuscript symbols. We propose a three-stage pipeline that bridges this gap without manual annotation, combining a joint SimCLR+DANN encoder for domain-invariant glyph representations with an embedding-space style-adaptation mechanism applied at retrieval time, requiring no re-training. Experiments on fourteen pages from seven encrypted manuscript collections show that our method outperforms zero-shot foundation models, including CLIP and DINOv2, by a large margin ($+0.194$ P@1 over CLIP ViT-L/14), and surpasses task-specific trained baselines by $+0.138$ P@1. We further demonstrate that the Raw-Cover metric, computed in a fully unsupervised setting, provides a meaningful script-family fingerprint that identifies the underlying alphabet of an unknown document. This capability is of direct practical relevance to palaeographers, historians, and other researchers working with undeciphered manuscripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需标注的三阶段流水线，用于在未解密的历史加密手稿中实现符号定位（symbol spotting），通过联合SimCLR+DANN编码器与嵌入空间的风格适应机制，弥合数字字体查询与手写符号之间的域差距。实验在14页/7部加密手稿上显著超越CLIP、DINOv2等零样本基础模型及任务特定训练基线，并展示Raw-Cover指标可无监督地识别未知文档的底层字母表。
AI.motivation: 历史加密手稿的解密面临根本性挑战——在转录之前必须先识别和表征底层密码字母表的符号清单。现有方法需要目标脚本的标注样本，而寻求零标注的跨域符号定位方法至关重要。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线：(1) 联合SimCLR+DANN编码器学习域不变的符号表征；(2) 检索时在嵌入空间应用风格适应机制（无需重新训练）；(3) 结合候选字母表和Raw-Cover指标进行无监督的字幕指纹识别。
AI.result: 在14页来自7部加密手稿的实验中，方法比CLIP ViT-L/14高出+0.194 P@1，比任务特定的训练基线高出+0.138 P@1。Raw-Cover指标能在完全无监督设置下提供有效的脚本家族指纹。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法无需任何手动标注即可有效弥合字体与手稿符号之间的域差距，为古文字学家和历史学家研究未解密手稿提供了直接实用的工具。

title: ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation
summary: As LLMs are increasingly used for pre-submission self-review, there is growing demand for feedback that not only identifies weaknesses but also guides authors toward concrete revisions. We study this as Actionable Peer-review Generation and decompose it into two subtasks: diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation. We introduce ActReview, a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that connects paper-specific diagnoses to concrete, grounded revision plans. Our central insight is that author rebuttals reveal plausible actions for addressing reviewer concerns and can therefore provide latent supervision for revision-oriented feedback. From real review-rebuttal threads on OpenReview, we construct ActReview-40K by aligning reviewer weaknesses with author responses and grounding the resulting feedback in localized paper evidence. We post-train Qwen3-8B-Base with multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards. We also introduce ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances for evaluating diagnostic quality and revision usefulness. Experiments show that ActReview outperforms prior specialized review-generation models on actionability and grounding while remaining competitive with strong prompt-based LLMs. Human evaluation confirms improved revision usefulness while revealing a remaining gap in technical accuracy, and additional analyses support generalization to held-out papers and robustness across independent judges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActReview框架，通过逆推式后训练将诊断性评审意见与具体修订建议相结合。从OpenReview的真实评审-作者回复数据中构建ActReview-40K数据集，并基于Qwen3-8B进行多任务SFT和GRPO训练，在可操作性和接地性上优于现有评审生成模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于论文投稿前自我评审，但现有反馈往往只指出问题而不提供具体的修订指导。作者希望生成既识别弱点又引导具体修改的可操作性评审意见，而传统评审生成方法缺乏对"如何修改"的监督信号。关键洞察在于：作者对评审意见的回复（rebuttal）隐含了解决评审关注点的可行行动方案，可作为修订导向反馈的潜在监督来源。
AI.method: 1) 将可操作评审生成分解为两个子任务：诊断性声明生成(revision suggestion generation)和修订建议生成(diagnostic claim generation)。2) 从OpenReview真实的评审-回复线程中构建ActReview-40K数据集，将评审指出的弱点与作者回复对齐，并将反馈基于局部论文证据。3) 使用Qwen3-8B-Base进行多任务监督微调(SFT)，随后采用GRPO算法配合候选感知的、针对弱点的rubric奖励进行强化学习后训练。4) 构建ActReview-Bench基准，包含1,000个人工策划的实例用于评估。
AI.result: 实验表明ActReview在可操作性和接地性上优于先前专门的评审生成模型，同时与基于提示词的强LLM相当。人工评估确认了修订有用性的提升，但也揭示了在技术准确性方面仍存在差距。额外分析支持模型对未见论文的泛化能力以及跨独立评估者的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: ActReview通过利用作者回复作为潜在监督信号，有效提升了LLM生成可操作、可接地学术评审的能力，为投稿前自我评审场景提供了实用工具。尽管在可操作性和有用性上取得了显著进展，但技术准确性仍是有待未来工作解决的关键差距。

title: Weakly-supervised Kidney Tumor Classification from CT Scans with Multi-Instance Learning and Anatomical Filtering
summary: Deep learning models for CT scan analysis are often limited by the scarcity of precise pixel-level annotations, which require significant radiologist effort to produce. Training on scan-level labels alone reduces annotation requirements but introduces challenges: low supervision ratios and large input volumes make models prone to overfitting and shortcut learning. In this work, we investigate two complementary methods to address these challenges: multi-instance learning (MIL) and anatomical filtering. MIL divides CT volumes into 2D slice instances, enabling efficient 2D architectures with ImageNet pretraining rather than computationally demanding 3D models. Anatomical filtering uses Compass, our self-supervised body part regression model, to crop scans to pathology-relevant subregions without requiring segmentation masks. We evaluate two MIL frameworks - Attention-based MIL (ABMIL) and FocusMIL - on kidney tumor classification across one internal dataset (TUH) and two external datasets (KiTS23 and TCGA-KiRC). Our best models achieve F1 = 0.83 on the internal test set using only scan-level labels. We further show that anatomical filtering with the Compass model is critical for the out-of-distribution generalization of embedding-based ABMIL, while instance-based FocusMIL demonstrates greater inherent robustness to distribution shift. While evaluated on kidney tumors, we consider this a proof-of-concept for a broader weakly supervised CT classification pipeline applicable to other organs and pathologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合多实例学习（MIL）和解剖过滤两种互补方法，利用仅需扫描级标签的弱监督方式对CT扫描进行肾脏肿瘤分类。通过将CT体积分割为2D切片实例并使用Compass自监督模型进行解剖区域裁剪，在内部和外部数据集上取得了较好性能，为更广泛的弱监督CT分类流程提供了概念验证。
AI.motivation: CT扫描深度学习的精确像素级标注需要放射科医生大量努力且稀缺；仅使用扫描级标签虽减少标注需求，但存在低监督比例和大输入体量导致模型过拟合与捷径学习的问题。
AI.method: 采用两种互补方法：(1) 多实例学习（MIL）将CT体积划分为2D切片实例，利用ImageNet预训练的2D架构而非计算量大的3D模型；(2) 解剖过滤使用Compass（自监督身体部位回归模型）裁剪出病理相关子区域，无需分割掩膜。在内部数据集TUH和外部数据集KiTS23、TCGA-KiRC上评估了ABMIL和FocusMIL两种MIL框架。
AI.result: 仅使用扫描级标签在内部测试集达到F1=0.83；解剖过滤对基于嵌入的ABMIL的分布外泛化至关重要，而基于实例的FocusMIL对分布偏移具有更强的内在鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法证明了在弱监督条件下进行CT肿瘤分类的可行性，可作为适用于其他器官和病理类型的更广泛弱监督CT分类流程的概念验证。

title: It's Not RoPE that Creates Sinks: The Role of Self-Concentration and Value-Non-Mixing in Attention
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit "Attention Sink" (AS) and the accompanying "Massive Activations" (MAs) at the initial position of a sequence. These phenomena frequently co-occur, and MAs can pose challenges for low-bit quantization. In this study, we analyze the factors underlying AS and MAs that emerge at the initial position regardless of the token occupying it. Our experiments suggest that self-concentration of attention, resulting from the causal mask, and the subsequent Value-non-mixing in attention outputs contribute to AS and MAs. These findings provide new empirical evidence on the internal dynamics of LLMs, offering insights that may inform future quantization strategies and advance our understanding of the internal mechanisms of attention layers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中"注意力汇"（Attention Sink）和"大规模激活"（Massive Activations）在序列初始位置同时出现的现象，并通过实验分析发现，因果掩码导致的注意力自我集中以及注意力输出中的Value非混合是这些现象的根本原因，该发现为低比特量化和理解注意力层内部机制提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: LLMs中出现的注意力汇和伴随的大规模激活现象常在序列初始位置同时出现，而大规模激活会给低比特量化带来挑战。理解这些现象的根本成因，有助于改进量化策略并加深对注意力层内部动力学的理解。
AI.method: 通过实验分析，研究了与占据初始位置的token无关的注意力汇和大规模激活现象的成因，验证注意力自我集中（由因果掩码导致）以及注意输出中Value非混合对这两类现象的贡献。
AI.result: 实验表明，因果掩码导致的注意力自我集中以及随之而来的注意力输出中的Value-non-mixing是注意力汇和大规模激活现象产生的根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM内部动力学提供了新的经验证据，揭示了注意力汇和大规模激活的机制性成因，可为未来量化策略设计提供指导，并推动对注意力层内部机制的深入理解。

title: Deep Learning for Biopsy-Free Subtyping of Basal Cell Carcinoma from Dermatoscopic Images
summary: Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, accounting for nearly 80% of skin cancer di- agnoses. Its optimal clinical management is guided by the distinct histopathologic subtype, with aggressive variants requiring more drastic measures. In current clinical practice, subtyping relies on skin biopsies, a procedure both costly and invasive. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary investigation into using deep learning for BCC subtyping, solely from a single dermatoscopic image of the lesion. Given the limited data at our disposal, we employ pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs), a state-of-the-art family of models highly effective for challenging downstream tasks with limited labeled data. Through repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation, we demonstrate that ViTs can achieve superior performance (AUC 0.784 on a dataset of 1271 dermatoscopic images of various BCC subtypes) over standard CNN-based baselines as well as previously-reported human reader perfor- mance, on the task of differentiating aggressive BCCs from other subtype families. These initial findings highlight the potential of combining deep learning and dermatoscopy to provide a biopsy- free alternative for BCC subtyping, thus aiding in improving treatment planning and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文初步探究了使用深度学习仅凭皮肤镜图像对基底细胞癌（BCC）进行组织病理亚型分类的方法，利用预训练视觉Transformer（ViTs）在1271张皮肤镜图像上实现了AUC 0.784的性能，优于传统CNN基线和人类读者表现，为免活检的BCC亚型分类提供了潜在替代方案。
AI.motivation: BCC是最常见的皮肤癌类型，其治疗策略取决于组织病理亚型，而侵袭性变异需要更激进的治疗。目前亚型分类依赖皮肤活检，该过程既有创又昂贵，因此需要探索免活检的替代方法。
AI.method: 采用预训练的视觉Transformer（ViTs）模型，仅使用单张皮肤镜图像对BCC进行亚型分类，通过重复分层k折交叉验证评估其在区分侵袭性BCC与其他亚型家族任务上的性能，并与标准CNN基线和前人报道的人类读者表现进行对比。
AI.result: ViTs在1271张不同BCC亚型皮肤镜图像数据集上取得了AUC 0.784的优越性能，超越了标准CNN基线和此前报道的人类读者表现。
AI.conclusion: 初步研究结果表明，将深度学习和皮肤镜结合有潜力提供免活检的BCC亚型分类方案，有助于改善治疗规划和患者预后。

title: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, pre-specified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four production systems and three Olmo3-7b variants on 100 false-presupposition and 100 unethical-query items. Our experimental results show that collapse rates increase with conversation length for every model, short-horizon protocols underestimate sycophancy and resistance under sustained pressure remains unreliable across current models. By analyzing models with accessible reasoning traces, we surprisingly found that the correct position often remains represented in a reasoning trace when the response concedes, suggesting that the model chooses to please a user and sycophancy is not due to lack of knowledge or ignorance. Ablations show that adaptive LLM proxy exposes more sycophantic collapse than pre-generated scripts. Among all tactics, emotional appeals is the most associated with inducing LLM sycophantic behavior. The code and data are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPINE基准测试，通过LLM代理扮演持续错误用户进行最长25轮的自适应对抗，评估模型在持续压力下的谄媚性崩溃。实验发现所有模型的崩溃率随对话轮次增加而上升，短对话会低估谄媚程度，且正确立场在推理痕迹中往往仍然保留，表明谄媚并非源于知识缺失而是取悦用户的主动选择。
AI.motivation: 现有谄媚评估多使用简短、预先设定的对话，无法捕捉在持续且自适应分歧下出现的失败模式，因此需要更真实的评估框架来检验模型在长期对抗中坚守正确立场的能力。
AI.method: 构建SPINE基准，让LLM代理扮演持久但错误的用户角色，对目标模型进行最长25轮的自适应挑战。评估了4个生产系统与3个Olmo3-7b变体，覆盖100个错误预设和100个不道德查询场景，并通过可访问的推理痕迹进行分析及消融实验。
AI.result: 所有模型的崩溃率均随对话长度增加而上升；短视野协议低估了谄媚性；推理痕迹分析发现正确立场在模型让步时往往仍保留在推理中，说明谄媚是主动取悦用户的选择而非无知；自适应LLM代理比预生成脚本暴露更多谄媚崩溃；情感诉求是最易诱发谄媚的策略。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在持续压力下坚守正确立场的能力仍然不可靠，谄媚问题本质上是模型的责任倾向而非知识缺陷，需要更长时间视野的评估协议和针对性的改进方向。

title: CHILD: Human-in-the-Loop OOD Detection for Safe Clinical Deployment
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical for safe deployment of medical AI systems. Recently, test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a new paradigm for OOD detection, automatically adjusting detector behavior during deployment. However, such automatic adaptation mechanisms may raise safety concerns in safety-critical clinical environments. While physician oversight can mitigate these risks, it is resource-intensive and must be judiciously allocated. To reconcile safety with efficiency, we propose CHILD, a training-free framework designed to enhance streaming OOD detection via sparse human feedback. Operating under strict budget constraints, CHILD employs an adaptive risk-aware sample selection mechanism to pinpoint only the most decision-uncertain samples for review. Crucially, it maximizes the utility of this sparse feedback through a retrieval-based score calibration module, which refines model predictions using a compact feature cache without any parameter updates. Extensive experiments on four medical benchmarks demonstrate that CHILD turns limited supervision into significant reliability gains: with a sparse feedback budget of only 5%, it reduces the average FPR95 from 72.63% to 60.26% and improves AUROC from 75.53% to 81.85%, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/figec/CHILD.

AI.tldr: CHILD是一个无需训练的框架，通过稀疏的人类反馈增强流式OOD检测。在严格的预算约束下，它采用自适应风险感知的样本选择机制来识别最不确定的样本，并利用基于检索的分数校准模块最大化稀疏反馈的效用。在四个医学基准上，仅需5%的反馈预算即可将平均FPR95从72.63%降至60.26%，AUROC从75.53%提升至81.85%。
AI.motivation: 测试时自适应（TTA）作为OOD检测的新范式虽能自动调整检测器，但在安全关键的临床环境中可能引发安全隐患。虽然医生监督可以降低风险，但资源密集且需要合理分配。如何在安全与效率之间取得平衡是核心动机。
AI.method: CHILD包含两个核心模块：一是自适应风险感知的样本选择机制，在预算约束下仅挑选最具决策不确定性的样本供人工审查；二是基于检索的分数校准模块，利用紧凑的特征缓存优化模型预测，整个过程不需要任何参数更新（training-free）。
AI.result: 在四个医学基准数据集上，稀疏反馈预算仅5%时，平均FPR95从72.63%降至60.26%（降低12.37个百分点），AUROC从75.53%提升至81.85%（提升6.32个百分点），一致优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: CHILD通过将有限的人力监督有效转化为显著的可靠性提升，证明稀疏人类反馈足以在安全关键的医学环境下大幅增强流式OOD检测性能，为安全与效率的平衡提供了可行方案。代码已开源。

title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://hyy279.github.io/ReCite
summary: Accurate citations are the foundation of academic writing, tracing intellectual origins and substantiating core claims. However, manually navigating the growing volume of scientific literature is increasingly difficult, prompting reliance on automatic citation recommendation. While modern retrieval-augmented architectures have largely mitigated the fabrication of non-existent papers, current systems relying on semantic similarity struggle with misattribution, often citing authentic papers that fail to logically support the author's claim. To address this challenge, we argue that accurate citation requires a shift from similarity-based search to active, claim-level reasoning. We propose ReCite, a decoupled agentic framework that orchestrates location perception, intent-aware query planning, and reflective verification. Trained on synthesized reasoning trajectories, our agent verifies claim-evidence consistency and triggers self-correction loops when retrieved candidates lack logical support. Experiments demonstrate that our lightweight framework outperforms state-of-the-art massive generative models in strict citation accuracy. By grounding literature matching in verifiable logic rather than semantic overlap, ReCite establishes a reliable foundation for automated academic writing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReCite，一个解耦的智能体框架，用于自动引用推荐。该方法从基于语义相似度的检索转向主动的声明级逻辑推理，通过位置感知、意图查询规划和反思性验证来确保引用的逻辑一致性，在严格引用准确率上超越了大规模生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现有自动引用推荐系统主要依赖语义相似度检索，虽然缓解了虚构不存在的论文问题，但经常出现误归因——推荐真实存在却无法逻辑支持作者声明的论文。准确的引用需要声明级别的逻辑推理，而非简单的语义匹配。
AI.method: ReCite是一个解耦的智能体框架，包含三个核心模块：位置感知（location perception）、意图感知的查询规划（intent-aware query planning）和反思性验证（reflective verification）。该框架在合成的推理轨迹上进行训练，代理能够验证声明-证据的一致性，并在检索到的候选文献缺乏逻辑支持时触发自我纠正循环。
AI.result: 实验表明，ReCite这个轻量级框架在严格引用准确率指标上优于最先进的大规模生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将文献匹配建立在可验证的逻辑推理而非语义重叠之上，ReCite为自动化学术写作建立了可靠的引用基础，解决了引用推荐中的误归因问题。

title: The Price of Consistency: Exploiting Visual Anchors for Multimodal Jailbreaking in Video Generation
comment: This paper has been accepted to ACM MM 2026
summary: The rapid evolution of video generation has shifted the paradigm from pure text-driven to multi-conditional controllable generation, with reference images now widely adopted as conditional inputs to achieve superior spatiotemporal consistency. While these reference images serve as powerful visual anchors that significantly enhance controllability, their impact on safety remains largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal the visual anchoring effect: by enforcing consistency, the mechanism prevents the generated content from drifting away from the original harmful intent, thereby eliminating the model's natural safety escape route from harmful to benign content. Consequently, visual anchors inherently increase the safety risk---this is the price of consistency. Building on this insight, we propose Decoupling Intent via Visual Anchors (DIVA), a training-free multimodal jailbreak framework for video generation that exploits this vulnerability. DIVA decouples harmful intent into a static visual anchor image and a dynamic motion text prompt, and employs dual-criteria selection to balance attack stealthiness with semantic preservation. Extensive experiments across various leading commercial platforms and mainstream open-source video generation models demonstrate that DIVA achieves a substantially higher Attack Success Rate than existing text-only methods. To facilitate future research, we additionally contribute TI2VSafetyBench, the first safety benchmark for multi-conditional video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了视频生成中的"视觉锚定效应"：参考图像通过强制一致性消除模型从有害内容自然逃逸到良性内容的机制，从而固有地增加安全风险。作者提出DIVA（一种无需训练的多模态越狱框架）利用该漏洞，将有害意图解耦为静态视觉锚定图像和动态运动文本提示，并通过双标准选择平衡攻击隐蔽性与语义保持。
AI.motivation: 参考图像在视频生成中广泛用作条件输入以增强时空一致性，但其对安全性的影响尚未被探索。作者发现视觉锚定机制会阻止生成内容偏离原始有害意图，消除了模型从有害到良性的自然安全逃生通道，因此需要揭示并应对这一安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出的DIVA框架无需训练，通过将有害意图解耦为静态视觉锚定图像和动态运动文本提示来实现多模态越狱，并采用双标准选择机制来平衡攻击隐蔽性与语义保持。此外构建了首个多条件视频生成安全基准TI2VSafetyBench。
AI.result: 在多个主流商业平台和开源视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，DIVA相比仅基于文本的方法实现了显著更高的攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉锚定在视频生成中是一把双刃剑：它在增强可控性的同时固有地增加了安全风险。该工作为多条件视频生成的安全研究开辟了新方向，并提供了首个相关基准以促进未来研究。

title: Proximity-CLIP: Text-Guided Semantic Proximity Learning for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Including supplementary material
summary: Vision-language models offer a promising approach for zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD). However, due to object-centric bias, normal and anomalous text prototypes exhibit a high semantic overlap. While enforcing strict orthogonality between them improves discriminability, mapping highly contiguous visual inputs onto drastically orthogonal prototypes introduces a geometric dilemma, disrupting the pre-trained structural continuity. To address this problem, we propose Proximity-CLIP, a framework that visually calibrates the semantic margin to guide visual adaptation. First, we introduce a visually-calibrated semantic proximity learning mechanism that uses a bounded dynamic regularization to learn an appropriate semantic margin, ensuring discriminative separation while preserving structural alignment. Second, we design an Anomaly Query Module (AQM) driven by these text priors. Using the calibrated anomalous prototype as a semantic query, the AQM actively retrieves localized defect cues from contextual visual patches, mitigating the dilution of subtle anomalies during global pooling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Proximity-CLIP outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple ZSAD benchmarks with minimal architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Proximity-CLIP框架用于零样本异常检测，通过视觉校准语义间隔来引导视觉适应，解决文本原型语义重叠和正交化带来的几何困境问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在零样本异常检测中存在物体中心偏差，导致正常与异常文本原型语义高度重叠。简单强制正交虽可提升区分性，但映射高连续视觉输入到极端正交原型会破坏预训练结构连续性，造成几何困境。
AI.method: 1) 提出视觉校准语义邻近学习机制，利用有界动态正则化学习恰当的语义间隔，在保持判别分离的同时保留结构对齐；2) 设计异常查询模块(AQM)，以校准后的异常原型作为语义查询，从上下文视觉补丁中主动检索局部缺陷线索，缓解全局池化中细微异常的稀释问题。
AI.result: 在多个零样本异常检测基准上，Proximity-CLIP以极小的架构修改超越了当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉校准语义间隔和异常查询模块，Proximity-CLIP有效解决了零样本异常检测中原型语义重叠与正交化几何困境的矛盾，验证了以视觉信息引导语义适配的有效性。

title: MV-STRIDE: Enabling MLLMs to Master Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Hierarchical Capability Modeling
summary: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in 2D vision-language tasks, robust multi-view spatial reasoning remains a fundamental bottleneck due to the lack of structured 3D cognitive pathways in existing datasets. To address this, we introduce MV-STRIDE, a Multi-View hierarchical SpaTial Reasoning dataset with Interdependent and DEcomposed capabilitiEs. Moving beyond flat data structures, MV-STRIDE explicitly models the dependency relationships between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, providing a coherent learning pathway aligned with human spatial cognition. We develop a systematic QA generation pipeline leveraging diverse 3D scene sources that enforces cross-view dependency constraints to prevent single-view solvability, generating multi-level spatial reasoning tasks supported by cognitively grounded chain-of-thought supervision for complex inference. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our multi-stage training framework based on our hierarchical dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, notably the multi-view oriented MMSI-Bench. Our approach enables MLLMs to maintain robust, 3D-consistent spatial reasoning across diverse viewpoints. The code and dataset are available at https://co1dspring.github.io/MV-STRIDE/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MV-STRIDE，一个多视角分层空间推理数据集，通过显式建模基础感知、场景理解和复杂上下文推理之间的依赖关系，为多模态大语言模型提供结构化的3D认知路径。实验表明基于该数据集的多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在2D视觉-语言任务上进展迅速，但多视角空间推理仍存在根本性瓶颈。现有数据集缺乏结构化的3D认知路径，无法为模型提供连贯的学习信号以支持稳健的多视角空间理解。
AI.method: 1) 构建MV-STRIDE分层数据集，建模基础感知→场景理解→复杂上下文推理的依赖关系；2) 设计系统化QA生成流程，利用多样化的3D场景源，通过跨视角依赖约束防止单一视角可解；3) 为复杂推理提供认知grounded的思维链（CoT）监督；4) 提出基于分层数据集的多阶段训练框架。
AI.result: 多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准上达到最先进性能，尤其在多视角导向的MMSI-Bench上表现突出，使MLLM能够跨不同视角维持稳健且3D一致的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的分层3D认知路径和跨视角约束的数据生成，可以有效提升MLLM的多视角空间推理能力，使其实现与人类空间认知对齐的3D一致性理解。

title: KODAMA: Multimodal Digital Twin Reconstruction for Urban RF Propagation Modelling
summary: 3D reconstruction typically strives for geometric fidelity or visual plausibility. Radio frequency digital twins (RFDT) are instead judged by whether communication channels behave in them as they do in the real world. RFDTs promise site-specific channel prediction but current practice forces a choice between coarse automated scenes and hand-built, measurement-calibrated models that take weeks to construct per-site. We present KODAMA, an automated pipeline that reconstructs ray tracing-ready RFDTs at city scale from off-the-shelf geospatial data alone: aerial imagery, LiDAR, and photogrammetry yield terrain and watertight building meshes, while exposure-weighted multi-view fusion of street-level imagery recovers façade relief, electromagnetic materials, and clutter---all without site visits or calibration. Across three sites spanning 3.6 to 28 GHz, KODAMA's uncalibrated predictions achieve single-digit RMSE, reducing point-to-point error by up to 5.35 dB over automated baselines and coming within 0.22 dB of a measurement-calibrated, hand-built RFDT.

AI.tldr: KODAMA是一个自动化管道，仅从现成地理空间数据（航拍影像、LiDAR、摄影测量及街景图像）构建城市规模的射电频率数字孪生（RFDT），无需现场勘察或校准即可进行光线追踪级信道预测。在三个站点（3.6–28 GHz）上，其未校准预测实现了个位数RMSE，点对点误差比自动化基线最多降低5.35 dB，与手工标定RFDT仅差0.22 dB。
AI.motivation: RFDT以信道行为是否与真实世界一致为评判标准，但现有方法被迫在粗粒度的自动化场景与需数周手工建造的测量标定模型之间做出选择。作者希望突破这一困境，实现无需现场测量即可自动重建高保真RFDT的流程。
AI.method: KODAMA采用端到端自动化管道：利用航拍影像、LiDAR和摄影测量生成地形及水密建筑网格；通过曝光加权多视角融合技术处理街景图像，恢复建筑立面浮雕、电磁材料和杂波信息。全过程无需现场勘察或标定校准。
AI.result: 在覆盖3.6至28 GHz的三个站点上，KODAMA的未校准预测达到个位数RMSE，较自动化基线将点对点误差最多降低5.35 dB，并向手工标定RFDT逼近至0.22 dB以内。
AI.conclusion: KODAMA证明仅依赖现成地理空间数据即可自动化构建可进行光线追踪的高保真RFDT，其性能接近需要数周手工建造和测量标定的模型，大幅降低了RFDT的构建成本与复杂度。

title: CRISP: Corneal Confocal Microscopy Real-Time Image Stitching Pipeline
summary:
Morphology of the sub-basal nerve plexus (SNP) reflects peripheral nerve health, and corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) provides an important means for in vivo, real-time, non-invasive observation of the SNP. However, mainstream CCM devices offer a limited field of view per frame, whereas the SNP is spatially non-uniform; discrete image sampling is therefore sensitive to sampling location and frame selection, which limits the reproducibility and clinical adoption of CCM as a quantitative assessment tool. Wide-field stitching can reconstruct larger SNP mosaics by integrating sequentially acquired CCM images, but existing methods largely rely on offline post-processing, additional hardware, or specific acquisition protocols, and lack open-source real-time solutions for conventional CCM video streams.
  This paper presents CRISP (Corneal confocal microscopy Real-time Image Stitching Pipeline), an open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework for conventional CCM examination video streams. CRISP excludes defocused and discontinuous segments via focus-aware gating, propagates poses through local pairwise registration, and maintains non-redundant spatial coverage with a sparse anchor map; when local temporal continuity is interrupted, the system completes relocalization and subgraph merging through global appearance retrieval followed by geometric verification. The framework prioritizes low-latency coverage feedback during examination while outputting accepted frames, poses, and anchor information to initialize offline fine stitching.
  To our knowledge, CRISP is the first open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework released for conventional CCM video streams. By lowering the barrier to adoption and reproduction of wide-field stitching, CRISP may help move SNP wide-field imaging from a research tool into routine clinical examination workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP，一个开源的实时角膜共聚焦显微镜（CCM）视频流图像拼接框架，用于重建角膜上皮下神经丛（SNP）的宽视野图像，克服传统CCM视野有限、采样位置敏感及缺乏实时开源方案的问题。
AI.motivation: 主流CCM设备单帧视野有限，而SNP空间分布不均匀，导致离散采样对位置和帧选择敏感，影响可重复性和临床采用；现有宽视野拼接依赖离线后处理、额外硬件或特定采集协议，且缺乏面向常规CCM视频流的开源实时解决方案。
AI.method: CRISP通过焦点感知的门控机制排除离焦和不连续片段，利用局部成对配准传播位姿，并通过稀疏锚点图维持非冗余空间覆盖；当局部时间连续性中断时，通过全局外观检索和几何验证完成重定位与子图合并。框架在检查过程中提供低延迟覆盖反馈，同时输出已接受帧、位姿和锚点信息以初始化离线精细拼接。
AI.result: CRISP被认为是首个面向常规CCM视频流发布的开源实时SNP宽视野拼接框架，降低了宽视野拼接的采用和复现门槛。
AI.conclusion: CRISP有望推动SNP宽视野成像从研究工具向常规临床检查流程转化。

title: From Explicit References to Scene Manifolds: Distributional Fidelity and Realism for Radiance Field Quality Assessment
