AI.method: GS-IQA将IQA重构为"哪里(Where)-什么(What)-如何(How)"的渐进式诊断：1) 两阶段强化学习范式中，浏览阶段(glance stage)使用感知门控奖励来定位和识别退化，仅在两者都正确时才激活严重性反馈；2) 细查阶段(scrutiny stage)引入在线奖励条件退化生成，合成针对模型感知弱点的难样本以提升严重性判别能力。
AI.result: 构建了包含约2.5万个样本的Diag-Bench区域级IQA基准，覆盖12种失真类型和5个序数严重性级别。GS-IQA在失真定位、识别和严重性估计上一致超越最先进方法，其诊断表征可有效迁移到外部基准的传统全局质量预测任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将质量评估分解为有依赖关系的渐进式诊断步骤并配合强化学习训练，GS-IQA实现了更透明、更细粒度的图像质量分析，且诊断能力可泛化至全局质量预测。

title: Supervised Cross-Modal Feature Alignment for Zero-Wearable Freezing of Gait Detection in Parkinsonism
summary: Objective assessment of Freezing of Gait (FoG) in Parkinson's disease (PD) relies predominantly on wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). While IMUs provide optimal kinematic precision, mandatory sensor attachment restricts continuous clinical deployment. Conversely, unobtrusive vision-based alternatives suffer substantial classification errors during turning-in-place tasks, where geometric self-occlusion degrades deterministic skeletal coordinates and obscures the high-frequency precursors required for FoG detection. To resolve these physical observation limits, we propose a supervised cross-modal subspace distillation framework. During optimisation, pre-trained kinematic data from IMU sensors and contextual clinical metadata act as oracles to guide a deployable visual architecture. By incorporating joint velocity and acceleration derivatives, utilising a confidence-based gating mechanism, the visual model mitigates some of the tracking errors during occlusion events. Empirical evaluations confirm this latent alignment transfers the predictive fidelity of hardware sensors directly into the visual representation, yielding $85.5\%$ accuracy, and $82.4\%$ balanced accuracy. All the while maintaining a vision only model at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种监督跨模态子空间蒸馏框架，利用IMU传感器数据和临床元数据作为"教师"，引导仅基于视觉的模型进行帕金森病冻结步态(FoG)检测。通过引入关节速度和加速度导数以及基于置信度的门控机制，缓解了转弯动作中自遮挡导致的骨骼跟踪误差，最终在纯视觉推理条件下达到85.5%准确率和82.4%平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病冻结步态(FoG)的客观评估依赖于穿戴式IMU传感器，其虽具有精确的运动学测量能力，但要求患者持续佩戴传感器，限制了临床长期部署。而视觉方案虽然非侵入式，但在原地转身任务中因几何自遮挡导致骨骼关键点退化，丢失了FoG检测所需的高频前兆特征，分类误差显著。作者旨在解决这一物理观测限制。
AI.method: 提出监督跨模态子空间蒸馏框架：在训练阶段，预训练的IMU运动学数据和临床元数据作为"或acles"引导可部署的视觉架构进行学习。视觉模型通过纳入关节速度和加速度导数（高阶运动特征），并利用基于置信度的门控机制来减轻遮挡事件中的跟踪误差，实现跨模态潜空间对齐。
AI.result: 实验验证了潜空间对齐能将硬件传感器的预测保真度直接迁移至视觉表征，在纯视觉推理条件下取得85.5%的准确率和82.4%的平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将IMU传感器的预测能力蒸馏进视觉模型，在推理阶段无需任何穿戴传感器，仅依靠视觉即可实现可比的FoG检测性能，兼顾了临床部署的无侵入性与检测精度。

title: Do Input-Level Defenses Transfer to Observation-Level Attacks on VideoLLMs?
comment: Preprint. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing. 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications such as content moderation and video analytics. To process long videos efficiently, VideoLLMs rely on frame sampling, token compression, and modality fusion, which together form an observation pipeline that reduces the raw video to a compact internal representation. Recent observation-level attacks exploit this pipeline to prevent the model from perceiving harmful content, yet no defense has been explicitly designed for this threat. We introduce DefTEval, a controlled evaluation framework that systematically assesses whether input-level adversarial defenses, which operate on the pixel content of already-sampled frames, can mitigate observation-level attacks. Across five VideoLLMs, eleven representative defenses, and five attack types, we find that input-level defenses offer limited and inconsistent protection, with harmful detection rates frequently near zero. Critically, defenses fail even against attacks that embed harmful signals in every sampled frame, indicating that the bottleneck extends beyond sampling omission to the suppression of signals that do enter the model. Token compression discards localized features, and modality fusion systematically down-weights weakened visual signals. Furthermore, defense effectiveness is dominated by model architecture rather than by the defense method itself, and detection rates vary drastically across content categories, exposing structural weaknesses in temporal reasoning. These findings demonstrate that securing VideoLLMs requires system-level robustness mechanisms spanning sampling-aware coverage guarantees, token-level preservation of safety-relevant features, and modality-balanced fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DefTEval框架，系统评估输入级对抗防御能否缓解针对视频大语言模型(VideoLLMs)的观测级攻击。实验发现输入级防御的保护效果有限且不稳定，无法有效应对嵌入在音频帧中的有害信号对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: VideoLLMs在内容审核等安全关键应用中被广泛部署，但观测级攻击可阻止模型感知有害内容，然而尚无专门针对此类威胁设计的防御机制，缺乏系统性评估框架来验证现有输入级防御的有效性。
AI.method: 构建DefTEval受控评估框架，在五个VideoLLM上测试十一种代表性输入级防御和五种攻击类型，分析防御效果与模型架构、内容类别之间的关系，探测失效的根本原因。
AI.result: 输入级防御提供有限且不一致的保护，有害检测率常接近零；防御在攻击嵌入每个采样帧时依然失效。令牌压缩和模态融合进一步丢弃或弱化局部特征。防御效果主要受模型架构影响而非防御方法本身，各内容类别间检测率差异大。
AI.conclusion: 保障VideoLLM安全需要系统级鲁棒性机制，包括采样感知的覆盖保证、令牌级安全特征保真以及模态均衡融合，单一输入级防御不足以应对观测级攻击。

title: EdMCGS: Event-Driven Markov Chain Gaussian Splatting for Extreme-Low-Frame-Rate Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present EdMCGS (Event-driven Markov chain Gaussian Splatting), an end-to-end method for reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from extreme-low-frame-rate RGB together with an event stream, which can then be rendered at any intermediate timestamp. Methods relying solely on RGB images generate numerous artifacts due to the lack of evidence from between consecutive frames. To supply this missing evidence, we model the scene motion as an event-driven Markov chain, in which the sparse RGB frames anchor the state at their own timestamps while the events recorded within an interval drive the transition across it. Since the transition reads the events of the current interval, it remains active at inference and produces the in-between motion of the 3D Gaussians directly from the events rather than by interpolation, which sets our method apart from prior work that uses events only as training-time supervision. The state is carried by a compact set of control points, each driven by the events sampled in the neighborhood of its own image projection, and a temporal local isometry term keeps the propagated motion locally rigid. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scenes show that EdMCGS outperforms both RGB-based and event-based baselines, while rendering in real time with far fewer Gaussians than the strongest event-based baseline. We release our source code and a new dataset at https://github.com/joseclipse/EdMCGS.

AI.tldr: EdMCGS提出了一种从极低帧率RGB图像和事件流端到端重建动态3D场景的方法，通过将场景运动建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫链，事件在推理阶段直接驱动3D高斯间的中间运动，而非仅作为训练监督，实现了任意中间时间戳的高质量渲染。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖RGB图像重建动态场景时，由于帧间缺乏证据，会产生大量伪影。需要补充帧间的运动证据来提升重建质量。
AI.method: 将场景运动建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫链：稀疏的RGB帧作为锚点定义状态，时间间隔内记录的事件驱动状态转移。转移过程在推理时读取当前间隔的事件，直接生成3D高斯的中间运动而非插值。状态由紧凑的控制点集携带，每个控制点由其图像投影邻域内采样的事件驱动，并通过时间局部等距项保持传播运动的局部刚性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实场景上的实验表明，EdMCGS优于基于RGB和基于事件的基线方法，且能以远少于最强事件基线的3D高斯数量实现实时渲染。代码和新数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了事件流可在推理阶段直接驱动动态场景重建的中间运动，超越了仅将事件作为训练监督的现有方法，为极低帧率动态场景重建提供了新的范式。

title: VeriScene: Reconstructing Crime Scenes from Legal Evidence via World-Model Agent
summary: World models take multimodal inputs like text, photos, and diagrams to generate dynamic scenes in accordance with the laws of physics, thus opening a compelling application: fusing multimodal legal evidence to re-create a crime scene and re-enact how an offence could have been committed. However, feeding the raw, unorganized evidence into a world model fails in forensic use: it silently drops evidence, glosses over contradictory testimony, and produces motion that violates the evidentiary record. This paper presents VeriScene, an agent that orchestrates the world model: it reconstructs crime scenes from forensic photographs and witness statements of varying reliability, keeping every claim traceable to evidence and every motion physically plausible. VeriScene iteratively fuses the evidence into a cited narrative under an auditing loop, verifies the hypothesized dynamics via probe rollouts in the world model with corrective constraint injection, and renders the offence as a re-enactment video from a fused keyframe. On a benchmark of 25 crime scenarios across 7 physically-driven case types (139 forensic-style photographs and 65 statements with planted unreliability), VeriScene attains 0.9014 evidence coverage and 0.7217 factual consistency (0-1 scale) on the 20 test scenes, outperforming an end-to-end multimodal-LLM baseline by 20.35% in factual consistency and 34.88% in temporal coherence, while generalizing across four LLM orchestration backends at USD 1.82 per scene.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriScene，一个用于法医犯罪现场重建的智能体，通过编排世界模型融合多模态证据（照片、证人陈述），在审计循环中保持每个主张可追溯，并通过校正约束注入验证动态假设，生成犯罪现场重演视频，在25个场景基准上取得显著优于端到端基线的事实一致性和时间连贯性。
AI.motivation: 将世界模型应用于法医取证（融合多模态法律证据重建犯罪现场）具有吸引力，但直接将原始杂乱证据输入世界模型会导致证据丢失、矛盾证词被忽略以及运动违反证据记录等问题，现有方法无法满足法医使用的严格性要求。
AI.method: VeriScene是一个智能体，采用迭代方式将证据融合为带引用的叙述，在审计循环下运行；通过世界模型中的探针回放验证假设动态并进行校正约束注入；最后从融合关键帧渲染犯罪重演视频。该方法能处理不同可靠性的证人陈述，保持每个主张可追溯至证据且运动物理可行。
AI.result: 在25个犯罪场景（7种物理驱动案件类型，139张法医风格照片和65份带有植入不可靠性的陈述）的基准上，VeriScene在20个测试场景上达到0.9014的证据覆盖率和0.7217的事实一致性（0-1尺度），相比端到端多模态LLM基线在事实一致性上提升20.35%，时间连贯性上提升34.88%，且能在四个LLM编排后端上泛化，每场景成本1.82美元。
AI.conclusion: VeriScene通过智能体编排世界模型的方式，有效解决了法医证据重建中证据可追溯性和物理合理性两大核心问题，验证了该方法在不同LLM后端上的泛化能力及成本效益，为法医取证场景中的世界模型应用提供了可行的技术路径。

title: CoVeR: Coverage-Based Token Pruning for Multi-View 3D Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Representing a 3D scene as multi-view images allows 2D VLMs to reason in 3D by reusing priors from pre-training, sidestepping the scarcity of annotated 3D data. However, it produces thousands of redundant visual tokens whose cost grows with every view. Existing visual token pruners fall into two families, each limited in the 3D multi-view setting. Learned importance methods rank tokens by attention or encoder features; because redundancy here is fundamentally spatial, they keep near-duplicate tokens from a few prominent regions and leave most of the scene unrepresented. Voxelization methods improve spatial coverage but cannot enforce an exact token budget and saturate as multi-view observations overlap in 3D, capping retention well below the target. We show that spatial coverage is associated with 3D reasoning performance and introduce CoVeR, a deterministic, training-free selector that uses only token coordinates, with no learned signals. CoVeR selects tokens that collectively cover every region of the scene, and solves the limitations of both families: it enforces an exact per-scene budget, breaks the voxelization saturation plateau, and avoids the near-duplicate selections of learned importance. Extensive experiments show CoVeR outperforms prior SOTAs on all three 3D reasoning benchmarks and generalizes as a plug-and-play module tested across four VLMs. Notably, with only $\approx$8% of visual tokens, it preserves 93.5% of full-token performance, surpassing SOTA by 3.9 percentage points on average across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CoVeR是一种确定性、无需训练的多视角3D场景视觉token选择器，仅基于token坐标实现空间覆盖最大化，在精确控制token预算的同时突破现有方法（学习式重要性排序和体素化）的限制，以约8%的token保留了93.5%的完整性能，在三个3D推理基准上均优于现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 将3D场景表示为多视角图像可让2D VLM复用预训练先验进行3D推理，但会产生大量冗余视觉token。现有两类token剪枝方法在3D多视角场景下各有缺陷：学习式重要性方法因冗余本质上是空间性的，会保留来自少数显著区域的近似重复token，导致大部分场景未被表示；体素化方法虽改善了空间覆盖，但无法强制精确token预算，且多视角观察在3D中重叠时出现饱和，保留率远低于目标。
AI.method: CoVeR是一种确定性、无需训练的选择器，仅使用token坐标而不依赖任何学习信号。它选择能在空间上共同覆盖场景每个区域的token集合，同时实现三个目标：强制每场景精确预算、打破体素化饱和瓶颈、避免学习式重要性的近似重复选择问题。空间覆盖率被证明与3D推理性能相关。
AI.result: 在三个3D推理基准上均超越现有SOTA，作为即插即用模块可适用于四种VLM。仅使用约8%的视觉token即可保留93.5%的全token性能，平均超越SOTA 3.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 空间覆盖与3D推理性能正相关，CoVeR通过纯几何坐标驱动的确定性token选择，同时解决了学习式方法的空间偏置和体素化方法的预算/饱和限制，为多视角3D推理提供了高效、通用的视觉token剪枝方案。

title: Segment Any Motion with Radar: Robust Multimodal Moving-Object Segmentation and Tracking
summary: Moving-object perception must decide which image regions correspond to real motion and keep every instance identified over time. Methods that read motion from appearance, optical flow, or estimated trajectories lose that evidence under poor illumination, adverse weather, reflections, and occlusion. Radar is a natural remedy because it measures radial velocity directly instead of inferring it from photometric correspondence. However, existing benchmarks do not jointly provide radar measurements, dense moving-instance masks, and temporally consistent identities for surveillance. We therefore introduce RGBTR-Motion, a synchronized and calibrated fixed-camera benchmark that pairs RGB, thermal, and radar streams with dense instance masks and temporally consistent identities across diverse surveillance scenes. We also develop SAM-Radar, an RGB, thermal, and radar-based segmentation and tracking framework built on SAM 3. SAM-Radar's radar-aware detector fuses calibrated RGBT features with radar returns that are grounded at their projected image locations, and motion supervision, implemented as foreground classification of those projected returns, teaches the detector to reject clutter without any text prompt. The tracker associates accepted radar returns with individual trajectories and uses them as physical evidence that a visually degraded target remains present. This allows it to bridge short periods of low visibility or occlusion and reconnect a reappearing target to its existing identity instead of starting a new track. SAM-Radar attains 0.7027 IoU and 0.8090 F1-50, and raises MOTA, HOTA, and IDF1 by 0.2977, 0.1603, and 0.2857 over the strongest competing values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RGBTR-Motion基准数据集（同步校准的RGB、热成像和雷达流，含密集实例掩码和跨帧一致身份标注），并开发SAM-Radar框架——基于SAM 3的雷达感知分割与跟踪系统，通过雷达回波直接测量径向速度以应对光照不足、恶劣天气、遮挡等视觉退化场景，在跟踪指标上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 运动目标感知需要区分真实运动区域并保持实例身份一致性，但基于外观、光流或轨迹估计的方法在弱光、恶劣天气、反射和遮挡下会丢失证据。雷达可直接测量径向速度，但现有基准缺乏同时提供雷达数据、密集运动实例掩码和时间一致身份标注的数据集，制约了相关研究。
AI.method: (1) 构建RGBTR-Motion：同步校准的固定相机基准，配对各RGB、热成像和雷达流与密集实例掩码及时间一致身份；(2) 提出SAM-Radar框架：雷达感知检测器将校准的RGBT特征与投影到图像位置的雷达回波融合，通过运动监督（投影回波的前景分类）实现无文本提示的杂波抑制；(3) 跟踪器将接受的雷达回波关联至各轨迹，以物理证据桥接视觉退化时段，使重现目标恢复既有身份而非新建轨迹。
AI.result: SAM-Radar在分割上达到0.7027 IoU和0.8090 F1-50，在跟踪指标MOTA、HOTA和IDF1上分别比最强竞争方法提升0.2977、0.1603和0.2857。
AI.conclusion: 雷达作为直接运动证据能有效弥补视觉模态在弱光和遮挡等退化条件下的不足，RGB-热-雷达多模态融合结合运动监督可显著提升监控场景下的运动目标分割与跟踪性能。

title: ReMoMask-2: Latent Retrieval-Augmented Masked Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion (T2M) generation maps natural language to human joint movements, aiding gaming, VR, and robotics. Retrieval-Augmented Text-to-Motion (RAG-T2M) improves generation on complex descriptions by conditioning on retrieved motion-text pairs. However, existing RAG-T2M models face two challenges: coarse-grained retrieval and fusion mechanisms overlook the hierarchical, spatial-temporal topology of human motion, and a representation gap exists because retrieved evidence resides in a semantic space separate from the generator's latents. To address the first, we present ReMoMask, a structure-aware RAG framework coupling Hierarchical Bidirectional Momentum (HBM) contrastive learning to align global and part-level features with text; Semantic Spatial-Temporal Attention (SSTA) for topology-aware fusion; and Topology Structured Masking (TSM) to force robust part-level grounding via adaptive masking. To address the second, we introduce ReMoMask-2, which rebuilds the retrieval database directly within the generator's pre-quantization latent space and aligns text queries via a distilled lightweight projector, allowing the generator to directly consume the retrieved motion's semantic content. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D, KIT-ML, and SnapMoGen demonstrate our retriever achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, while ReMoMask-2 attains the lowest FID on KIT-ML and SnapMoGen; notably, its single mask-transformer stage surpasses ReMoMask's full two-stage pipeline and delivers the fastest inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMoMask和ReMoMask-2两个结构感知的检索增强文本到运动生成框架，分别解决检索融合中忽略人体运动层次化时空拓扑结构的问题，以及检索证据与生成器潜在空间之间的表示间隙问题。ReMoMask结合HBM对比学习、SSTA融合和TSM掩码机制，ReMoMask-2则直接在生成器预量化潜在空间中重建检索数据库并用轻量投影器对齐文本查询。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG-T2M模型面临两个挑战：1) 粗粒度检索和融合机制忽略了人体运动的层次化时空拓扑结构；2) 检索到的证据位于与生成器潜在空间分离的语义空间中，存在表示间隙。
AI.method: ReMoMask包含三个组件：Hierarchical Bidirectional Momentum (HBM)对比学习对齐全局和局部特征与文本；Semantic Spatial-Temporal Attention (SSTA)实现拓扑感知融合；Topology Structured Masking (TSM)通过自适应掩码强制鲁棒的局部接地。ReMoMask-2在生成器的预量化潜在空间中重建检索数据库，并通过蒸馏的轻量投影器对齐文本查询。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D、KIT-ML和SnapMoGen上，检索器达到最先进准确率；ReMoMask-2在KIT-ML和SnapMoGen上取得最低FID，其单阶段mask-transformer超越了ReMoMask完整两阶段pipeline，并具有最快推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构感知检索与融合设计以及消除表示间隙的潜在空间检索数据库重建，可以显著提升检索增强文本到运动生成的性能，同时简化pipeline并提升效率。

title: To Adapt or Not to Adapt? Selective Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a prominent strategy for adapting vision-language models to distribution shifts during inference. We conduct a per-sample analysis of model predictions before and after adaptation, and observe two failure modes in existing TTA methods that echo previous work. Adaptations are frequently negligible, yielding no change in the model's predictions, and more severely, they can be detrimental by flipping previously correct predictions to incorrect ones. This naturally raises a question: Can we identify and skip such negligible or harmful adaptations? In this work, we introduce a new problem of selective adaptation, which aims to determine whether a given test sample should undergo adaptation or be skipped. To this end, we propose Cross-Augmentation Similarity (CAS), a simple baseline that performs adaptation only when predictions across augmented views exhibit low similarity. Notably, CAS not only preserves but in some cases improves overall accuracy, even when skipping nearly 85% of the adaptation process. We hope other researchers will explore this new direction and surpass the performance of our baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/selective-adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出选择性适应（Selective Adaptation）问题，通过跨增强相似性（CAS）基线方法判断哪些测试样本需要适应、哪些应跳过，在跳过近85%适应过程的情况下仍能保持甚至提升模型准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时适应（TTA）方法在适应视觉-语言模型时存在两个失败模式：适应经常是无效的（不改变预测），甚至可能是有害的（将原本正确的预测翻转错误）。因此需要识别并跳过这些无效或有害的适应过程。
AI.method: 提出选择性适应问题，并引入跨增强相似性（Cross-Augmentation Similarity, CAS）作为简单基线：仅当测试样本在多个增强视图下的预测相似度较低时才进行适应，相似度高则跳过。
AI.result: CAS在跳过近85%适应过程的情况下，不仅能保持整体准确率，在某些情况下还能提升准确率，超越了现有TTA方法的完整适应效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性适应跳过无效或有害的适应步骤，可以更高效且稳健地实现测试时适应，为TTA领域开辟了新的研究方向。

title: GALoc: Gravity Aligned Wireframes for Depth-Free Monocular Floorplan Localization
summary: Floorplans are compact, appearance-invariant maps ideal for indoor localization, yet existing methods rely on depth networks that are brittle in cluttered scenes. We propose GALoc, a geometry-first framework that replaces depth prediction with gravity-aligned wireframes that satisfy verticality and coplanarity by construction. Given monocular RGB, camera intrinsics, relative poses, and IMU orientation, GALoc constructs a linear constraint matrix encoding verticality and coplanarity, and finds the camera gauge minimizing its smallest singular value via global search. The rectified wireframes are projected into bird's-eye-view layouts through a closed-form, FOV-consistent transformation and matched against the floorplan via metric-free SE(2) search. We evaluate end-to-end on Structured3D, with calibrated noise on Gibson, and on real-world author-collected sequences. When sufficient wall geometry is visible, GALoc matches or outperforms depth-based baselines -- achieving 88% sequential localization success at 0.1m over 100-step sequences on Gibson vs the baseline's 68% -- while abstaining in structure-blind scenes.

AI.tldr: GALoc提出了一种几何优先的室内定位框架，用重力对齐的线框替代深度预测，通过构造满足垂直性和共面性约束的线性矩阵来估计相机位姿，并将线框投影到鸟瞰图与平面图匹配，在多种数据集上优于基于深度的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于深度网络的室内平面图定位方法在杂乱场景中表现脆弱，深度预测鲁棒性不足，需要一种不依赖深度但具有外观不变性的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用单目RGB、相机内参、相对位姿和IMU方向，构建编码垂直性和共面性约束的线性矩阵，通过全局搜索最小化最小奇异值来确定相机gauge；通过闭合形式且FOV一致的变换将校正后的线框投影为鸟瞰图，再通过无度量的SE(2)搜索与平面图匹配。
AI.result: 在Structured3D、带有校准噪声的Gibson以及自采真实序列上进行评估，在可观测到足够墙体几何时匹配或超越基于深度的方法——在Gibson上100步序列的0.1m顺序定位成功率88%，优于基线的68%，同时在结构盲场景中主动弃权。
AI.conclusion: GALoc证明了纯几何先验结合线框表示可以在室内定位中实现优于深度方法的精度和鲁棒性，同时具备在无足够结构信息时安全弃权的能力。

title: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset as the companion resource of exemplary trajectories constructed by an automatic pipeline. It consists of 7.7k episodes for searching objects of diverse categories and attributes, spanning three difficulty levels. To address the AGOS task, we propose AGOS-Agent, a training-free and tool-augmented approach. The agentic method relieves VLMs from complex and dynamic coordination via a deliberate search-handoff-verify cooperation protocol, only demanding VLMs for scene understanding and decision-making. Extensive experiments on nine VLMs show that AGOS-Agent improves overall success rate for eight of the nine evaluated backbones while reducing decision steps for all nine. On the hard split, the SR and SPL of Gemini-3.6-Flash increase from 8.6% to 55.7% and from 7.6% to 44.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGOS-Bench，这是首个专门用于评测视觉语言模型（VLMs）在无人机与地面机器人协同下完成空中发现到地面验证的空中-地面物体搜索（AGOS）任务的基准，并配套提供包含7.7k个episode的AGOS-Dataset。作者还提出AGOS-Agent这一免训练、工具增强的智能体方法，通过搜索-交接-验证的协作协议，在九个VLMs上实验表明其能提升大多数模型的成功率并减少决策步骤。
AI.motivation: AGOS（空中-地面物体搜索）是城市环境中具有挑战性的具身任务，要求无人机和地面车从多视角视觉参考中协同搜索并验证指定目标车辆。这是一个此前未被充分探索的问题，亟需专门的基准来评测通用VLMs在无人机-地面车协作场景下的空中发现与地面验证能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了AGOS-Bench基准和AGOS-Dataset数据集（由自动管线生成，含7.7k个episode、覆盖多种类别和属性、分三个难度等级），并提出AGOS-Agent——一种免训练且工具增强的智能体方法，通过搜索-交接-验证的协作协议来减轻VLMs在复杂动态协调上的负担，仅需VLMs负责场景理解和决策。
AI.result: 在九个VLMs上的实验表明，AGOS-Agent在九个评测骨干模型中的八个上提升了总体成功率，并减少了全部九个模型的决策步骤。在困难分片（hard split）上，Gemini-3.6-Flash的成功率从8.6%提升至55.7%，SPL从7.6%提升至44.0%。
AI.conclusion: AGOS-Bench为研究无人机-地面机器人协同下的物体搜索任务提供了首个标准化评测平台，AGOS-Agent展示了免训练工具增强方法在提升VLMs完成复杂具身协作任务上的巨大潜力，为该领域后续研究奠定了重要基础。

title: CAR-MIL: Counterfactual Attention Regularization for Multiple Instance Learning
summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised learning, particularly in digital pathology, where fine-grained annotations are costly. Most MIL methods aggregate instance features via attention mechanisms. However, attention weights do not always faithfully reflect instance importance and may focus on spuriously correlated regions. In this work, we propose CAR-MIL, a framework that explicitly guides attention learning through a counterfactual attention regularization objective inspired by counterfactual explanations. Built on a standard attention-based MIL architecture, our approach introduces a lightweight counterfactual attention branch trained to produce an alternative prediction while remaining close to the factual attention distribution. This encourages prediction changes to arise from minimal, structured redistributions of attention, leading to more informative evidence allocation. The resulting factual and counterfactual attention maps capture complementary evidence: the former highlights regions supporting the prediction, while the latter reveals regions whose reweighting would challenge it. We evaluate our method on synthetic MIL benchmarks with instance-level ground truth enabling controlled analysis of attention behavior and on five digital pathology datasets across four tasks. CAR-MIL maintains competitive classification performance, with the largest gains observed on more challenging tasks, while improving attention reliability, demonstrating the benefits of integrating counterfactual explainability reasoning into attention learning. Code is available at: https://github.com/ImaneCR/CAR-MIL/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAR-MIL框架，通过反事实注意力正则化目标引导注意力学习，使注意力分布发生最小化、结构化的重新分配来改变预测，从而提升注意力可靠性。在合成基准和五个数字病理数据集上，CAR-MIL在保持竞争性分类性能的同时显著提升注意力可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在多实例学习（MIL）中，注意力机制被广泛用于聚合实例特征，但注意力权重并不总是真实反映实例的重要性，可能聚焦于虚假相关区域，导致模型可解释性和可靠性不足。
AI.method: 基于标准注意力MIL架构，引入一个轻量级反事实注意力分支，该分支生成与原预测不同的替代预测，同时保持与事实注意力分布接近。通过反事实注意力正则化目标，鼓励预测变化源自对注意力进行最小化、结构化的重新分配，从而获得更具信息量的证据分配。事实注意力和反事实注意力图形成互补证据。
AI.result: 在合成MIL基准和五个数字病理数据集（涵盖四个任务）上验证，CAR-MIL在更具挑战性的任务上获得最大性能提升，保持了竞争性的分类性能，同时显著改善了注意力可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将反事实可解释性推理整合进注意力学习能够带来性能与可解释性的双重收益，展示了反事实思维在弱监督学习中的价值。

title: AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation requires drones to follow natural-language instructions and navigate through complex urban environments. Accurate navigation relies on both local and global spatial information, which support immediate action grounding and long-horizon path planning, respectively. However, existing zero-shot methods typically operate at a single spatial scale, relying either on local representations constructed online from current observations or on global memories built offline from historical experience. To address this limitation, we propose AirAnchor, a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors and integrates both into a shared navigation framework, enabling comprehensive spatial grounding for decision-making. AirAnchor consists of three core components: (1) Query-Driven Spatial Anchor Grounding, which identifies decision-relevant anchors from visual observations and organizes them into local spatial representations; (2) Persistent Object Spatial Memory, which incrementally maintains an object knowledge base as persistent global spatial memory and retrieves landmark-related spatial priors; and (3) a Spatially-Informed Navigation Agent, which explicitly integrates both local and global spatial information into an agentic framework for decision-making. Extensive experiments on AerialVLN demonstrate that AirAnchor substantially outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AirAnchor，一种结合局部与全局空间信息的零样本航拍视觉语言导航新范式，通过空间锚点将两类信息统一到共享导航框架中，在AerialVLN数据集上显著优于现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本航拍视觉语言导航方法通常只工作在单一空间尺度上，要么仅依赖在线构建的局部表征，要么仅依赖离线构建的全局记忆，缺乏对局部与全局空间信息的综合运用，限制了导航决策的准确性。
AI.method: AirAnchor包含三个核心组件：(1)查询驱动的空间锚点定位——从视觉观测中识别决策相关的锚点并组织为局部空间表征；(2)持久化物体空间记忆——增量维护物体知识库作为持久全局空间记忆并检索地标相关空间先验；(3)空间感知导航代理——将局部与全局空间信息显式整合到智能体框架中进行决策。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN数据集上的大量实验表明，AirAnchor大幅优于现有零样本基线方法，验证了该范式的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: AirAnchor证明了通过空间锚点桥接局部与全局空间信息可以显著提升零样本航拍视觉语言导航的性能，为复杂城市环境中的无人机自主导航提供了一种综合性的空间理解范式。

title: GSComplete: Gaussian Splat Completion with 2D Diffusion Priors
summary: Gaussian splats provide a fast, high-fidelity representation for 3D objects but are often constructed from incomplete input data in practice, leaving missing regions. Existing completion methods either do not preserve the original splats or require scarcely available 3D training data. We propose GSComplete, which combines 3D generation based on Score Distillation Sampling with a novel preservation loss that encourages the original splats to be preserved where they should be visible. This effectively completes the Gaussian splat object using only 2D diffusion priors while fully preserving existing splats and generating new splats only in missing regions, without occluding the input. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a new dataset of partial Gaussian splat objects and show that GSComplete achieves significantly more accurate preservation of the input than existing methods with comparable plausibility of the completed result. Our code and dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: GSComplete是一种新的高斯飞溅物体补全方法，结合基于得分蒸馏采样的3D生成与新型保真损失，仅利用2D扩散先验即可在缺失区域生成新飞溅，同时完整保留原有飞溅不被遮挡。实验表明该方法在输入保真度上显著优于现有方法，且补全结果的合理性相当。
AI.motivation: 高斯飞溅在实际中常由不完整输入数据构建，存在缺失区域。现有的补全方法要么无法保留原始飞溅，要么需要稀缺的3D训练数据。因此需要一种既保留原始飞溅又不需要3D训练数据的补全方法。
AI.method: 结合基于得分蒸馏采样的3D生成与新型保真损失函数。该保真损失鼓励原始飞溅在应可见的位置被保留，利用2D扩散先验生成缺失区域的飞溅，同时避免遮挡原始输入。并构建了部分高斯飞溅物体的新数据集用于评估。
AI.result: 在新引入的部分高斯飞溅数据集上，GSComplete在输入保真度上显著优于现有方法，同时补全结果具有可比的合理性。
AI.conclusion: GSComplete证明了利用2D扩散先验即可有效完成高斯飞溅物体的补全任务，在不使用3D训练数据的前提下实现高保真的输入保留与合理的缺失区域补全。

title: SignRefine: Adapting Foundational Video Models for Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language video generation demands precise hand and facial articulation, yet modern video diffusion models, trained predominantly on spoken-language video, produce artifacts that render signing unintelligible. We propose SignRefine, a sign language video generation model that produces comprehensible signing from 2D keypoint conditioning alone, generalizing across appearances and visual conditions. Our approach builds on a pretrained video diffusion transformer and introduces local adapters with spatial grounding to selectively refine hand and face regions, steering the strong base model's prior toward accurate articulation. To enable this work and support broader sign language research, we present NVSign, a large-scale dataset of video content natively produced in sign language, offering diverse signer appearances, environments, and natural conversational settings. Trained on this data, our model shows up to 30% improvement in hand pose precision metrics over the strongest baseline and is preferred by sign language users for visual quality and comprehensibility in more than 80% of comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SignRefine，一种手语视频生成模型，通过局部适配器与空间接地机制精细化手部和面部区域，仅依赖2D关键点条件即可生成可理解的手语视频；同时发布NVSign大规模原生手语视频数据集用于训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 手语视频生成对手部和面部关节的精细动作要求极高，但现有视频扩散模型主要在口语视频上训练，生成结果存在伪影，导致手语难以被理解。
AI.method: 基于预训练的视频扩散Transformer，引入带有空间接地机制的局部适配器，选择性精炼手部和面部区域，利用基础模型的先验知识引导准确的关节动作表达。
AI.result: 在NVSign数据集上训练后，手部姿态精度指标相比最强基线提升最高30%，超过80%的对比中手语使用者更偏好该模型的视觉质量与可理解性。
AI.conclusion: SignRefine仅凭2D关键点条件即可生成跨外观和视觉条件泛化的可理解手语视频，NVSign数据集为更广泛的手语研究提供了有力支撑。

title: Temporal State Transport in Video Generation: Diagnosing and Correcting Spectral Imbalance
summary: Reliable video generation requires more than high-quality frames to form a coherent story: a model must maintain a persistent state, transporting visual attributes such as identity, scene layout, motion, and fine details across time. Existing training-free methods mainly strengthen cross-frame attention or analyze local attention entropy, but these views do not reveal whether temporal interactions stay in a healthy transport regime. In this work, we study video generation through the perspective of Temporal State Transport. We introduce Spectral Tension, a signed diagnostic that compares local attention diffuseness with global spectral diversity, and use it to identify two opposite temporal failures: fragmented transport and over-mixing hotspots. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Spectral Transport Homeostasis, a training-free regulator that softly corrects pathological temporal states while largely preserving balanced ones. Experiments on pretrained video generation models show that the original model often occupies imbalanced temporal regimes, whereas our method selectively applies larger corrections to the worst temporal hotspots and improves temporal consistency and visual quality without finetuning. Code: https://github.com/lytang63/temporal-state-transport

AI.tldr: 本文从"时态状态传输"视角研究视频生成，提出了一种名为Spectral Tension的有符号诊断指标（对比局部注意力扩散度与全局光谱多样性），并基于此设计了无需训练的调节器Spectral Transport Homeostasis，用于修正视频生成中出现的两种时间失败模式（碎片化传输与过度混合热点），实验表明该方法能提升时序一致性和视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有无需训练的视频生成方法主要聚焦于增强跨帧注意力或分析局部注意力熵，但这些方法无法揭示时序交互是否处于健康的传输状态。现有方法缺乏对时序状态是否处于合理"传输机制"的判别能力，因此需要一种新的诊断视角来识别并纠正时序传输中的病理状态。
AI.method: 1) 提出Spectral Tension指标，作为一种有符号诊断工具，对比局部注意力扩散度与全局光谱多样性；2) 基于该指标识别两种对立的时序失败模式：碎片化传输（fragmented transport）和过度混合热点（over-mixing hotspots）；3) 提出Spectral Transport Homeostasis，一种无需训练的调节器，以软方式纠正病理时序状态，同时尽量保留原本均衡的状态。
AI.result: 在预训练视频生成模型上的实验表明，原始模型通常处于不均衡的时序机制中，而该方法能够对最差的时序热点施加更大的修正，在不进行微调的情况下提升时序一致性和视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入时序状态传输的视角和Spectral Tension诊断指标，有效识别并纠正了视频生成中的时序病理状态，验证了无需微调的调节方法能够改善视频生成的时序一致性与视觉质量。

title: Layer Selection in VLMs for Zero-Shot OOD Detection via Multi-Resolution Entropy Estimation
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial for safe deployment of medical AI systems, where domain shifts arise across institutions, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. VLMs enable zero-shot OOD detection by embedding images into a language-aligned latent space, where cross-modal similarity serves as a non-parametric confidence signal for identifying in-distribution samples. Yet existing methods rely almost exclusively on final-layer embeddings, implicitly assuming that the deepest representations are universally optimal. We first show that this assumption does not hold in medical imaging: intermediate layers provide complementary OOD signals, and the optimal representational depth depends on the respective image modality. While prior work selects layer combinations via entropy minimization of normalized histograms, we demonstrate that single-resolution entropy estimation is highly sensitive to binning choices, leading to performance variations of up to 19.3% AUROC. To address this instability, we propose a multi-resolution entropy estimation strategy that aggregates histogram statistics across multiple discretization scales, enabling robust and stable intermediate-layer selection. Across two medical OOD benchmarks, namely MIDOG and OASIS, covering distinct imaging modalities, diverse shift types, and different VLM backbones, our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, offering a lightweight and stable solution for zero-shot OOD detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多分辨率熵估计的中间层选择策略，用于提升视觉-语言模型在医学图像零样本分布外检测中的性能，解决现有方法仅依赖最终层嵌入且单分辨率熵估计对分箱选择敏感的问题。
AI.motivation: 在医学图像分布外检测中，视觉-语言模型方法的现有工作几乎只使用最终层嵌入，隐含假设最深层的表征是最优的。然而作者证明该假设在医学影像中不成立：中间层能提供互补的分布外信号，且最优表征深度取决于图像模态。此外，已有的层选择方法使用单分辨率熵估计，对分箱选择高度敏感，导致AUROC性能波动高达19.3%。
AI.method: 作者提出一种多分辨率熵估计策略，通过在不同离散化尺度上聚合直方图统计，实现稳健且稳定的中间层选择。该方法在多个分辨率下计算熵并聚合统计量，以克服单分辨率熵估计对分箱选择的敏感性，从而选择最优特征层组合用于零样本分布外检测。
AI.result: 在MIDOG和OASIS两个医学分布外检测基准上，覆盖不同成像模态、多种偏移类型和不同的视觉-语言模型骨干网络，所提方法在性能上一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为医学图像的零样本分布外检测提供了轻量且稳定的解决方案，表明中间层特征选择需要多分辨率尺度的稳健评估，而非仅限于最终层嵌入或对分箱敏感的单分辨率熵指标。

title: STSG-VQA: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Question Answering from Surgical Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs
summary: Despite recent advances in surgical vision-language models (VLMs), temporal reasoning remains limited because existing supervision is largely frame-centric. Frame-level scene graphs (SGs) have proven effective in providing structured representations of surgical environments but do not explicitly model the dynamics of surgical workflows. To explicitly model how surgical states evolve across time, we introduce a multi-level structured temporal supervision methodology that augments frame-level surgical SGs with object-level continuity, event-level interaction continuity, and procedure-level connectivity. We then execute temporal queries over the resulting spatio-temporal scene graphs (STSGs) to generate evidence-grounded question-answer pairs, which together form the STSG-VQA benchmark. Each question is linked to the temporal interval and STSG evidence used to derive its reference answer, enabling traceable verification. The benchmark contains 18,458 question-answer pairs across seven temporal categories. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-4B and Hulu-Med-4B with STSG-derived supervision improves question-level micro accuracy by 24.39 and 19.56 percentage points over their zero-shot baselines and by 16.50 and 14.25 points over static scene-graph supervision, respectively. These gains span all temporal categories, indicating that STSG-derived supervision helps surgical VLMs reason over temporally grounded interactions rather than isolated frames. The code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STSG-VQA基准，通过多层级结构化的时间监督方法（对象级连续性、事件级交互连续性和手术流程级连通性）将手术场景图扩展为时空场景图（STSGs），并据此生成18,458个带证据追踪的问答对（覆盖7个时间类别）。实验表明，使用STSG监督微调Qwen3-VL-4B和Hulu-Med-4B后，其准确率比零样本基线分别提升24.39和19.56个百分点，比静态场景图监督提升16.50和14.25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视觉语言模型的时间推理能力受限，因为现有监督大多是帧级别的。帧级场景图虽能提供手术环境的结构化表示，但无法显式建模手术工作流的动态演变过程。
AI.method: 提出多层级结构化时间监督方法：在帧级手术场景图中补充对象级连续性、事件级交互连续性和流程级连通性，形成时空场景图（STSG）。随后在STSG上执行时间查询以生成有证据支撑的问答对，构建STSG-VQA基准（18,458个问答对，7个时间类别），每个问题关联时间区间及用于推导答案的STSG证据。
AI.result: 在STSG-VQA上，微调Qwen3-VL-4B和Hulu-Med-4B后，问题级微准确率较零样本基线分别提升24.39和19.56个百分点；较静态场景图监督分别提升16.50和14.25个百分点；所有时间类别均获得性能增益。
AI.conclusion: STSG衍生的监督信号能帮助手术视觉语言模型对时间上有依据的交互进行推理，而非局限于孤立的帧，有效提升了跨所有时间类别的时间推理能力。

title: Effects of model architecture and learning strategies on deep learning-based recognition of activated sludge microscopic images and comparison with quantitative image analysis
summary: Microscopic image analysis has long been recognized as a promising approach for monitoring activated sludge. In recent years, deep learning-based image analysis has been increasingly adopted in this field because of its high performance. However, previous studies on microscopic image analysis of activated sludge have rarely explored transformer-based models or self-supervised foundation models and have instead relied on CNNs and supervised ImageNet pretraining. In addition, previous studies often downsampled image sizes, but the effects of downsampling have not been sufficiently investigated, and the relationship between downsampling strategies and image analysis performance remains unclear. Furthermore, no study has quantitatively compared deep learning performance with quantitative image analysis (QIA), which was widely used before the emergence of deep learning. In this study, to examine how model architecture and learning strategies affect performance in microscopic image analysis of activated sludge and to quantitatively determine whether deep learning outperforms QIA, we prepared three types of activated sludge samples, classified their microscopic images, and evaluated classification accuracy. Our results showed that transformer-based architectures and alternative pretraining methods were effective in terms of classification accuracy. Our downsampling analysis showed that using overly small images reduced accuracy, but increasing image size beyond a certain point did not improve it further. In addition, the analysis indicated that, to achieve high classification accuracy, maintaining the field of view was a more effective downsampling strategy than maintaining resolution. Finally, our comparison between deep learning and QIA showed that deep learning outperformed QIA in terms of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了模型架构（Transformer vs CNN）、预训练策略（自监督 vs ImageNet监督）、图像下采样策略对活性污泥显微图像分类性能的影响，并定量比较了深度学习方法与传统定量图像分析（QIA）的精度差异。
AI.motivation: 以往活性污泥显微图像分析研究多依赖CNN和监督式ImageNet预训练，很少探索Transformer或自监督基础模型；下采样策略对性能的影响尚未被充分研究，且缺乏深度学习与QIA的定量对比。
AI.method: 制备三种类型的活性污泥样本并采集显微图像，对不同模型架构（CNN vs Transformer）、预训练策略（ImageNet监督 vs 自监督）及多种下采样策略进行系统比较，评估分类准确率，并与QIA进行对比。
AI.result: Transformer架构和替代预训练方法在分类准确率上表现更优；过小的图像会降低准确率，但图像超过一定大小后继续增大无进一步提升；保持视野比保持分辨率更有利于提高分类精度；深度学习在精度上优于传统QIA。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果为活性污泥显微图像分析中的深度学习模型选型和图像预处理策略提供了实证指导，确认了深度学习相比QIA的优势。

title: GOLF: Global Observation with Local Focus for Calibration-Aware Stereo Interaction Field Estimation
comment: First-Place Solution for the HANDS@ECCV 2026 SHOW3D Challenge
summary: We present GOLF, the first-place solution to the SHOW3D Interaction Field Estimation Challenge at HANDS@ECCV 2026. Given synchronized egocentric stereo views, the task is to predict a 3D vector from each of 21 hand joints to the closest point on the manipulated object. GOLF combines dense global context, locally sampled hand/object evidence, and common-frame Plücker-ray geometry. We adapt DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 with LoRA and trainable LayerNorm parameters, then jointly decode both interaction fields. Our primary model achieves an official score of 27.61 and a mean ADE of 27.96 mm on the hidden test set. An equal-weight ensemble with a complementary directly fine-tuned variant improves these results to an official score of 27.47 and a mean ADE of 27.82 mm, securing first place.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GOLF，即SHOW3D交互场估计挑战赛（HANDS@ECCV 2026）的第一名解决方案。该方法利用同步的第一人称立体视图，预测21个手部关节点到被操作物体最近点的3D向量。GOLF结合了全局上下文信息、局部采样的手/物体证据以及共同坐标系下的Plücker射线几何，并采用LoRA微调的DINOv3 ViT-H+/16骨干网络联合解码交互场。主模型在隐藏测试集上取得官方分数27.61和平均ADE 27.96mm，通过等权重集成进一步优化至官方分数27.47和平均ADE 27.82mm，最终夺得第一名。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决第一人称立体视角下的人手-物体交互场估计问题，即预测每个手部关节到被操作物体表面的3D方向向量，该任务对理解手物交互动态具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出GOLF框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 密集全局上下文提取，基于DINOv3 ViT-H+/16并引入LoRA和可训练LayerNorm参数进行高效微调；(2) 对每个手部关节点进行局部采样以获取精细的手/物体证据；(3) 在共同坐标系下利用Plücker射线几何约束立体视图的几何一致性。最终联合解码两个交互场。
AI.result: 主模型在隐藏测试集上达到官方分数27.61和平均ADE 27.96mm；采用等权重集成（与直接微调的互补变体组合）后，官方分数提升至27.47，平均ADE降至27.82mm，最终获得挑战赛第一名。
AI.conclusion: 全局上下文、局部证据与几何约束的有机结合（GOLF）在手物交互场估计任务上取得了领先性能，验证了该方法在处理第一人称立体手物交互建模中的有效性与优越性。

title: SynthRCT: Scalable Conditional Deformation Synthesis for Synthetic Repeat CT Generation
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the MIART Workshop, MICCAI 2026. This preprint corresponds to the initial submission prior to peer review
summary: In proton therapy, plans are typically optimized on a single planning CT, making robustness evaluation essential under anatomical changes. However, current scenarios often rely on simplified perturbations that poorly capture complex, patient-specific variability. We propose SynthRCT, a scalable conditional generative framework for 3D anatomical deformation synthesis. Based on a conditional variational autoencoder, SynthRCT learns a latent deformation space and decodes sampled latent codes into local stationary velocity fields conditioned on an input anatomy. Local fields are assembled into coherent full-volume transformations, enabling memory-scalable generation for large field-of-view CT data. We validate the approach on respiratory 4DCT data with multiple breathing-phase anatomies per subject. SynthRCT enables patient-specific sampling of plausible anatomical transformations beyond predefined robustness scenarios. Code available at: https://github.com/TomasGuija/SynthRCT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynthRCT，一种基于条件变分自编码器的可扩展条件生成框架，用于3D解剖变形合成。该框架学习潜在变形空间，并将采样到的潜在编码解码为局部平稳速度场，最终组装成全卷变换，实现大视野CT数据的记忆可扩展生成，以支持质子治疗中的鲁棒性评估。
AI.motivation: 质子治疗中计划通常在单一规划CT上优化，因此在不同解剖变化下进行鲁棒性评估至关重要。然而现有评估场景常依赖简化的扰动，无法充分捕捉复杂且患者特异的变异性。
AI.method: 基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习潜在变形空间；将采样的潜在编码解码为局部平稳速度场（SVF），并以输入解剖为条件；将局部场组装为完整的全卷变换，实现大视野CT数据上的记忆可扩展生成。
AI.result: 在包含每个受试者多个呼吸相位解剖的呼吸4DCT数据上验证了该方法；SynthRCT能够实现超出预定义鲁棒性场景的患者特异性、合理的解剖变换采样。
AI.conclusion: SynthRCT提供了一种可扩展且患者特异性的解剖变形生成方法，有望改进质子治疗鲁棒性评估中场景的多样性和真实性。代码已在GitHub上开源。

title: From Where to How: Continuous 4D Interaction Forecasting from Egocentric Video
summary: Egocentric 4D interaction forecasting aims to anticipate both where future interactions will occur in 3D and how the human body will move to realize them, providing an important capability for assistive robotics and human-computer interaction. Existing methods struggle to translate semantic understanding into precise continuous 3D localization and to balance motion diversity with structural consistency in pose forecasting. More fundamentally, these tasks are often modeled separately, leaving the continuous geometric and temporal correspondence between interaction locations and body motion insufficiently captured. To address these challenges, we introduce Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset for continuous 4D interaction forecasting, comprising approximately 233K samples across three domains. Each sample pairs a sequence of future 3D interaction locations with corresponding full-body poses, aligned in time and expressed in a shared coordinate system. We also provide evaluation metrics in continuous space. Building on this formulation, we propose HIGFlow, a Hand Interaction Guided Residual Flow framework that models forecasting as a cascaded where-to-how process. HIGFlow first forecasts continuous future interaction locations by combining semantic grounding with short-horizon visual dynamics, and then uses the predicted location sequence to condition a deterministic motion anchor and residual Flow Matching for diverse yet structurally consistent full-body motion forecasting. Extensive experiments across all three domains demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines on both location and pose forecasting, while ablations validate the contributions of the proposed components. The project page is available at https://corrineqiu.github.io/from-where-to-how/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Coherent4D大规模自我中心4D交互预测数据集和HIGFlow级联框架，将"未来交互位置在哪里"与"人体如何运动实现交互"这两个任务统一在共享坐标系中进行连续建模，在三个域的实验中优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的4D交互预测方法存在三个核心问题：难以将语义理解转化为精确的连续3D定位；在姿态预测中难以平衡运动多样性与结构一致性；更根本的是，交互位置与身体运动通常被分开建模，缺乏对两者间连续几何和时间对应关系的捕捉。
AI.method: 构建Coherent4D数据集（约23.3万样本，三个域，每样本包含时间对齐、共享坐标系中的未来3D交互位置序列与全身姿态对），并提出HIGFlow框架：采用"where-to-how"级联结构，先结合语义接地与短期视觉动态预测连续交互位置，再以预测位置序列为条件，通过确定性运动锚点加残差流匹配生成多样且结构一致的全身体运动。
AI.result: 在三个域上的大量实验表明，该方法在位置预测和姿态预测两方面均一致优于代表性基线，消融实验验证了各提出组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将"where"和"how"统一到连续共享坐标系中的级联建模方式是有效的，Coherent4D数据集可为该方向提供可靠的评测基础，HIGFlow则为4D交互预测提供了一种可行的新范式。

title: Charts Are Beyond Pixels: Probing for Layer-Wise Chart Understanding and Editing
summary: Charts are structured visual compositions whose elements have distinct functional roles, semantic correspondences, and visibility relations. This structural view motivates evaluating whether models can understand and manipulate charts at the layer level. Existing chart benchmarks, however, primarily assess the correctness or fidelity of final outputs and do not directly evaluate these layer-wise behaviors. We present LayerWiseBench, a benchmark organized around three core concepts, layer attribution, layer binding, and visibility ordering, that structure its chart-understanding and chart-editing evaluations. Generated from executable chart programs, LayerWiseBench pairs each rendered chart with spatially aligned per-layer RGBA assets and construction-derived labels for functional roles, semantic bindings, and visibility relations. From this layer-wise representation, we derive controlled understanding questions, editing targets, reference images, and evaluation regions. It contains 2,800 source charts across 14 chart paradigms, from which we derive 7,329 layer-wise understanding questions and 53,791 instruction-guided editing variants. Among the evaluated VLMs, Qwen3.5-27B, which achieves the highest QA macro-average, obtains 93.04% accuracy on layer attribution and 97.46% on layer binding, but only 61.46% on visibility ordering. Across the four evaluated image editors, overall mIoU ranges from 1.49% to 4.93%, and visibility-constrained edits have the lowest mIoU for every editor, ranging from 0.37% to 2.00%. Taken together, these results identify tasks involving front-to-back relations between overlapping components as a recurring challenge across understanding and editing, motivating more explicit modeling of component identity and visibility relations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LayerWiseBench，一个从图层层面评估多模态大模型图表理解与编辑能力的基准，包含14种图表范式、2,800幅源图表、7,329个理解问题和53,791个编辑变体。实验发现VLM在可见性排序任务上显著弱于图层属性归因和绑定，图像编辑器在所有任务上表现极低（mIoU最高仅4.93%），表明前后层叠关系是跨理解与编辑的持续挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有图表基准主要评估最终输出的正确性或保真度，未能直接反映模型在图层层面的行为（如功能角色、语义对应和可见性关系），缺乏对图表结构化图层级能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 基于可执行图表程序生成每个渲染图与空间对齐的逐层RGBA资产和构造派生标签，围绕图层归因、图层绑定和可见性排序三个核心概念组织理解与编辑评估，衍生出受控理解问题、编辑目标、参考图像和评估区域。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-27B在QA中表现最佳（图层归因93.04%、图层绑定97.46%），但可见性排序仅61.46%；四类图像编辑器的整体mIoU在1.49%-4.93%之间，且可见性约束编辑在所有编辑器中mIoU最低（0.37%-2.00%）。
AI.conclusion: 重叠组件的前后层叠关系对于当前VLM和图像编辑器而言是跨理解和编辑的普遍难点，需要更显式地建模组件身份与可见性关系。

title: TriCCOT: Tri-part Convolutional Conformal Transformer for Onboard Space Object Detection
summary:
Onboard object detection in Earth observation is constrained by limited computational resources and the absence of fully corrected imagery. While convolutional detectors are hardware-efficient, they often struggle to extract robust representations from raw and noisy data. Conversely, transformer-based models provide stronger global reasoning capabilities but remain difficult to deploy on FPGA accelerators due to quadratic attention complexity and non-compatible operations.
  We introduce TriCCOT, a tri-part architecture for robust and deployable onboard object detection. TriCCOT combines a convolutional region proposal network, a conformal prediction stage, and Aper-GATES, our hardware-friendly attention-based classifier. The region proposal network generates candidate bounding boxes, which are subsequently enlarged via conformal prediction, providing a distribution-free probabilistic coverage guarantee. The resulting crops are processed by Aper-GATES, which reformulates self-attention through convolutional projections, global channel statistics, and hardware-friendly gating operations, avoiding standard transformer operations that are poorly suited to CNN-oriented accelerators.
  Experiments on the DIOR and VDVRaw datasets demonstrate competitive detection performance and improved robustness to spatial blur and signal-dependent noise when compared to FPGA-compatible architectures. Finally, we report full deployment on a Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA without modifying the underlying DPU architecture, enabling unified CNN-Transformer inference for spaceborne embedded applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriCCOT，一种面向航天星载端上目标检测的三部分架构，结合卷积区域提议网络、保形预测阶段和硬件友好的注意力分类器Aper-GATES，在不修改底层DPU架构的情况下实现FPGA上的统一CNN-Transformer推理，兼顾检测性能与硬件可部署性。
AI.motivation: 星载对地观测目标检测受限于有限计算资源和缺乏完全校正的图像。卷积检测器硬件高效但对原始噪声数据鲁棒性不足，而Transformer模型虽具有强大全局推理能力但因二次复杂度注意力与非兼容操作难以在FPGA上部署。
AI.method: TriCCOT采用三部分架构：1) 卷积区域提议网络生成候选边界框；2) 保形预测阶段扩大边界框并提供无分布的概率覆盖保证；3) Aper-GATES注意力分类器通过卷积投影、全局通道统计和硬件友好的门控操作重新构建自注意力，避免不适配CNN加速器标准Transformer操作。
AI.result: 在DIOR和VDVRaw数据集上，TriCCOT相比FPGA兼容架构展现出具有竞争力的检测性能和更好的对空间模糊及信号相关噪声的鲁棒性；并在Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA上完成全面部署，无需修改底层DPU架构。
AI.conclusion: TriCCOT证明了在航天嵌入式应用中，通过精心设计硬件兼容的注意力机制，可以在受限资源下实现统一的CNN-Transformer推理，同时兼顾检测精度、对原始数据的鲁棒性以及FPGA上的可部署性，为星载目标检测提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: CoordFormer: Give Me Any Coordinates and I Will Give You Labels
summary: Semantic segmentation on very-high-resolution images remains challenging due to the high computational cost and the difficulty of capturing fine-grained details. We propose CoordFormer, a novel coordinate-based architecture for semantic segmentation that predicts labels at arbitrary spatial locations through a Coordinate Decoder equipped with a Localized Cross-Attention mechanism. The decoder combines coordinate embeddings with high-resolution local patch features and interacts with global tokens extracted from a downsampled image processed by a ViT foundation encoder, enabling rich semantic context while preserving pixel-level precision. This design enables flexible inference at arbitrary resolutions while keeping memory low on very-high-resolution inputs, and supports an efficient semantic-edge-focused strategy that concentrates computation along boundaries, maintaining fine-grained accuracy while reducing latency and computational cost. CoordFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on MaSS13K and outperforms comparably sized and higher-parameter methods on DIS5K and KPIs, demonstrating its effectiveness for high-quality, very-high-resolution semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: CoordFormer是一种基于坐标的新型语义分割架构，通过局部交叉注意力坐标解码器在任意空间位置预测标签，结合ViT全局特征与局部补丁特征，实现对超高分辨率图像的高效精细分割，在MaSS13K、DIS5K和KPIs数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率图像的语义分割面临高计算成本和难以捕捉细粒度细节两大挑战，现有方法难以在保持像素级精度的同时兼顾内存与计算效率。
AI.method: 提出CoordFormer架构，包含：(1) 配备局部交叉注意力的坐标解码器，将坐标嵌入与高分辨率局部补丁特征结合；(2) 利用ViT基础编码器从下采样图像提取全局token以提供语义上下文；(3) 支持任意分辨率灵活推理，并采用语义边缘聚焦策略将计算集中在边界区域以减少延迟和计算成本。
AI.result: 在MaSS13K数据集上达到最先进性能，并在DIS5K和KPIs数据集上优于同等规模及更高参数量的方法，验证了该架构在超高分辨率语义分割中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CoordFormer通过坐标式的灵活推理及边缘聚焦策略，成功在超高分辨率语义分割中实现了细粒度精度与计算效率的平衡，为处理极高分辨率图像提供了有效的解决方案。

title: CausalChapter: Improving Long-Video Chaptering with Interventional Dependency Modeling
summary: Long-form instructional videos require automatic chaptering to support browsing, navigation, and knowledge access. Recent long-context language models can perform chaptering from textualized video inputs, but they remain costly and brittle for content-dense lecture videos with long transcripts, smooth topic transitions, and detailed chapter outputs. A scalable segment-then-caption paradigm reduces this cost, but introduces two new challenges: boundary error propagation and fragmented cross-chapter context. We propose \textbf{CausalChapter}, an intervention-inspired framework for long-video chaptering that estimates prediction-level influence through lightweight masking and removal interventions. For boundary localization, our Local Dependency Shift module detects drops in predictive dependency between adjacent temporal windows; for chapter description generation, our Cross-Segment Support Selection module reranks historical contexts according to their support for the current prediction. Experiments on long-video chaptering benchmarks show that CausalChapter improves boundary localization, chapter description quality, and cross-chapter coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalChapter框架，通过轻量级掩码和移除干预来估计预测级因果影响，解决长视频章节划分中边界错误传播和跨章节上下文碎片化两大挑战。
AI.motivation: 长格式教学视频需要自动章节划分以支持浏览和知识访问。虽然长上下文语言模型可以从文本化视频输入进行章节划分，但对于内容密集、转写较长、主题平滑过渡的讲座视频，这种方法成本高且不稳定。分段-再描述（segment-then-caption）范式虽然降低了成本，但引入了边界错误传播和跨章节上下文碎片化两个新问题。
AI.method: 提出CausalChapter框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Local Dependency Shift模块用于边界定位，通过检测相邻时间窗口间预测依赖性的下降来发现边界；(2) Cross-Segment Support Selection模块用于章节描述生成，根据对当前预测的支持度对历史上下文进行重排序。
AI.result: 在长视频章节划分基准上的实验表明，CausalChapter在边界定位、章节描述质量和跨章节连贯性方面均取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: CausalChapter通过基于干预的因果关系估计方法，有效解决了分段式章节划分中的边界错误传播和跨章节上下文碎片化问题，为长视频自动章节化提供了可行的改进方案。

title: Enhancing Table Structure Recognition via Bounding Box Guidance
summary: Table Structure Recognition (TSR) aims to extract the bounding boxes of cells and table structure (e.g., HTML) from table images. Although current approaches have made significant progress, the latest image-to-sequence methods overlook the explicit utilization of the bounding box information when predicting HTML sequences, leading to error predictions in complex scenes. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework BGTR (Bounding Box-Guided Table Recognizer). To more effectively utilize bounding box information, we first predict the bounding boxes of cells and then use this information to guide the generation of HTML sequences. While utilizing bounding box information can enhance the accuracy of HTML sequences, for natural scene tables, the data volume is too small to allow for sufficient training of bbox-guided HTML generation. In response, we adopt a progressive training method for natural scene tables and introduce SNSTab, a synthetically generated natural scene table dataset. Our experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate SOTA performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BGTR框架，先预测单元格边界框，再以此指导HTML序列生成，用于表格结构识别（TSR），并在五个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像到序列方法在预测HTML序列时未充分利用边界框信息，导致在复杂场景下产生错误预测。
AI.method: 提出BGTR框架：先预测单元格边界框，再利用边界框信息引导HTML序列生成；针对自然场景表格数据量不足的问题，采用渐进式训练方法，并引入合成自然场景表格数据集SNSTab。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验取得了SOTA（最先进）性能。
AI.conclusion: 边界框引导的HTML生成策略能有效提升表格结构识别的准确性，尤其在复杂场景下表现突出。

title: CVT-GS: Learning to Simplify 3D Gaussian Splatting with Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful representation for real-time novel view synthesis, rendering high-fidelity scenes often relies on a massive number of Gaussian primitives, incurring substantial storage and computational overhead. Existing simplification techniques are largely intrusive, requiring training-time pruning, architectural modifications, or computationally expensive per-scene fine-tuning. These drawbacks limit their deployment on off-the-shelf pretrained models. In this paper, we propose CVT-GS, a novel optimization-free post-hoc simplification framework that directly compresses trained 3DGS scenes without sacrificing visual fidelity. Our approach first constructs spatially coherent cells over Gaussian centers via a geometry-aware Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation (CVT). Subsequently, a lightweight neural cell merger predicts the geometry and appearance of a single, highly representative Gaussian primitive for each cell under differentiable rendering supervision. By formulating simplification as a rendering-aware many-to-one merging process rather than naive primitive pruning, CVT-GS outputs a standard 3DGS scene that is seamlessly compatible with existing renderers. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method. Notably, when achieving a 100-fold reduction in Gaussian points, our method operates 12 times faster than state-of-the-art methods while improving the PSNR by 1.3 dB.

AI.tldr: CVT-GS是一种免优化的后处理3DGS简化框架，通过几何感知的质心Voronoi划分和轻量级神经单元合并器，将大量高斯原语压缩为少数代表性原语，在100倍压缩下比SOTA方法快12倍且PSNR提升1.3dB。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS简化方法大多是侵入式的，需要在训练时剪枝、修改架构或进行昂贵的逐场景微调，难以直接应用于现成的预训练模型，限制了其部署实用性。
AI.method: 首先对高斯中心进行几何感知的质心Voronoi划分，形成空间相干单元；随后使用轻量级神经单元合并器，在可微渲染监督下为每个单元预测一个高代表性的高斯原语的几何与外观，将简化建模为渲染感知的多对一合并过程而非简单的原语剪枝。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上验证了方法的优越性，在100倍高斯点缩减时比现有最优方法快12倍，同时PSNR提升1.3dB，且输出的标准3DGS场景与现有渲染器无缝兼容。
AI.conclusion: CVT-GS通过后处理式的多对一合并策略，实现了高效、免训练、与现成渲染器兼容的3DGS场景压缩，为预训练3DGS模型的直接部署提供了可行方案。

title: Kairos: A Dataset for Fine-Grained Video-Language Modeling over Space, Time, and Dynamics
summary: Many emerging video language modeling tasks require systems to move beyond clip-level abstraction and model visual content as it unfolds over extended time horizons. However, most existing video datasets rely on coarse or sparsely aligned supervision, which compresses temporal variation and limits the ability of models to learn reusable representations of continuous visual dynamics. We introduce Kairos, a video dataset for video-language modeling with time-resolved annotations. Kairos consists of long-duration videos, ranging from ten minutes to half an hour, annotated with fine-grained temporal alignment. The annotations capture ongoing actions, entity appearances and attributes, interactions, and evolving contextual cues along the video timeline. This time-resolved structure supports fine-grained evaluation, long-range modeling and reasoning, instruction data construction, representation learning, and video generation. Kairos provides a general-purpose foundation for modeling visual experiences over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Kairos，一个具有时间分辨率注释的视频语言建模数据集，包含10分钟到半小时的长视频，以细粒度时间对齐的方式标注了持续动作、实体外观与属性、交互以及不断演变的情境线索，支持视频生成、长程建模、表征学习等多种任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频数据集大多依赖粗略或稀疏对齐的监督，压缩了时间变化，限制了模型学习可复用的连续视觉动态表征的能力；而许多新兴的视频语言建模任务需要超越片段级抽象，对长时间跨度内展开的视觉内容进行建模。
AI.method: 构建Kairos数据集：包含从十分钟到半小时的长视频，并以细粒度的时间对齐进行注释。注释覆盖沿视频时间线的持续动作、实体出现与属性、交互以及演变的情境线索等维度，形成时间分辨率的注释结构。
AI.result: 该时间分辨率结构支持细粒度评估、长程建模与推理、指令数据构建、表征学习以及视频生成等多种下游任务。
AI.conclusion: Kairos为随时间建模视觉体验提供了一个通用基础，填补了现有视频数据集在时间维度精细度上的空白。

title: Compensating for Scarce Historical Images in Cross-Domain Cultural Heritage Retrieval Using Synthetic Aging
summary: Cultural heritage collections often contain contemporary and historical visual records of the same physical object. Linking these records is difficult because corresponding images may differ in viewpoint, acquisition conditions, color reproduction, framing, resolution, and degradation, while genuine historical images are frequently scarce. This study investigates whether synthetically aged contemporary images can replace or complement missing historical training data in bidirectional instance-level retrieval. Synthetic old-domain images are generated using degradation-oriented transformations. An EfficientNetV2-M model is evaluated on identity-disjoint training, validation, and test sets across three dataset partitions and three training seeds. Mixed real-synthetic training is compared with real-only baselines using proportionally scaled and fixed 300-batch-per-epoch schedules. Complete replacement of genuine historical images reduced bidirectional mean R@1 from 86.56% to 81.27%, showing that synthetic aging does not reproduce the full genuine old-domain variability. Increasing the number of independently generated synthetic variants provided no consistent improvement. Under controlled scarcity, however, synthetic completion improved mean R@1 by 3.69 percentage points at 25% genuine historical coverage and by 2.92 points at 50%, relative to the proportionally scaled real-only baselines. At 75%, the gain decreased to 2.00 points, while performance remained comparable to the complete-real-data reference. Fixed-schedule real-only controls did not reproduce these improvements. The results indicate that genuine and synthetic observations are complementary. Synthetic completion primarily benefits retrieval by extending cross-domain identity coverage rather than by increasing training exposure, with its contribution gradually decreasing as genuine historical coverage increases.
