title: AXS-Net: Interpretable Deep Unfolding for Hyperspectral Image Denoising via Spectral Basis Unmixing and Structured Noise Refinement
comment: 15 pages. Accepted to The 14th International Conference on Image and Graphics (ICIG2026), July 31, 2026
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are often degraded by mixed noise, including band-dependent Gaussian perturbations and structured artifacts such as stripes, dead-lines, and impulse noise. Most deep denoisers regress the clean image directly, entangling signal and structured noise. We instead model HSI denoising as $\Y=\A\X+\Snoise+\Nnoise$, where $\A\X$ is a low-rank spectral-subspace (unmixing) reconstruction, $\Snoise$ is structured sparse noise and $\Nnoise$ is residual Gaussian noise. The resulting regularized optimization problem is unrolled into AXS-Net, a $K$-stage alternating proximal-point framework. Each stage combines an analytic spectral-basis gradient step, an SSX-Block proximal operator for abundance coefficients, and an SBlock proximal operator for the structured residual with column-consistent and sparse priors. This optimization correspondence exposes interpretable endmembers, abundance maps, and structured-noise estimates. Across ICVL, CAVE, and Harvard datasets and five noise configurations, the proposed AXS-Net achieves strong in-domain accuracy and competitive zero-shot transfer, with consistent gains across all five noise regimes on ICVL and Harvard. The recovered structured-noise closely follows the synthetic reference, and the recovered spectral basis is smooth and band-ordered rather than an arbitrary set of latent channels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AXS-Net，一种基于交替近端展开网络的HSI去噪方法。该方法将降质建模为低秩光谱子空间重建加结构化稀疏噪声和残差高斯噪声的优化问题，并展开为K阶段交替近端网络，同时估计清洁图像、端元、丰度图和结构化噪声。在ICVL、CAVE和Harvard数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有深度去噪器直接回归干净图像，将信号与结构化噪声（条带、死线、脉冲噪声等）纠缠在一起，缺乏对HSI中混合噪声的物理解释和可解释性建模能力。
AI.method: 将HSI去噪形式化为Y=AX+S+N的优化问题，其中AX为低秩光谱子空间（解混）重建，S为结构化稀疏噪声，N为残差高斯噪声。将该正则化优化问题展开为K阶段交替近端框架AXS-Net，每阶段包含解析光谱基梯度步、SSX-Block丰度系数近端算子、SBlock结构化残差近端算子（含列一致性和稀疏先验）。
AI.result: 在ICVL、CAVE和Harvard数据集及五种噪声配置下，AXS-Net取得强域内精度和具有竞争力的零样本迁移性能，在ICVL和Harvard上五种噪声设置均取得一致提升。恢复的结构化噪声与合成参考高度吻合，恢复的光谱基平滑且按波段有序排列。
AI.conclusion: 通过将优化展开为网络，AXS-Net不仅获得去噪性能的提升，还提供了可解释的端元、丰度图和结构化噪声估计，展现出较好的通用性与可解释性，验证了物理模型驱动的深度学习方案的潜力。

title: Interpretable Hyperspectral Unmixing Framework with Fixed Endmember Prior and Structured Residual Refinement
comment: 16 pages.Accepted to 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (PRICAI 2026)
summary: Hyperspectral unmixing decomposes mixed pixels into material endmembers and their abundances from contiguous spectral observations. In modular sensing pipelines, endmembers are often first identified and then treated as fixed during abundance estimation. When this fixed endmember prior is inaccurate, spatially structured mismatch arising from illumination changes, sensor artifacts, or material boundaries may be incorrectly captured by the abundance variables, leading to unstable decompositions. This study presents an interpretable stage-wise hyperspectral unmixing framework (I-HyperSU) under fixed endmember priors, which is explicitly decomposed into a fixed endmember matrix $\mathbf{A}$, an abundance block $\mathbf{X}$, and a structural residual refinement block $\mathbf{S}$. The X-block estimates abundances using FISTA with nonnegativity and sparsity enhancement, and a soft penalty that approximately enforces sum-to-one constraints. The S-block jointly applies low-rank SVD structural regularization and a lightweight deep image prior (DIP) to refine structured residuals. This staged design makes the interaction between abundance and residual components transparent and interpretable. Experiments on Samson, Urban, and Jasper Ridge datasets demonstrate that, under fixed and imperfect endmember priors, soft abundance relaxation consistently outperforms hard simplex projection. Under the default N-FINDR endmember prior, the proposed framework reduces the joint reconstruction error by 61.7\%--69.5\% compared with a fixed-$\mathbf{A}$ UCLS baseline, while keeping the abundance RMSE nearly unchanged, indicating that the residual refinement branch accounts for structured model mismatch without degrading the abundance estimates. For example, on Urban, the reconstruction SAM decreases from $5.99^\circ$ for the X-only model to $1.92^\circ$ for the full model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在固定端元先验下的可解释分阶段高光谱解混框架（I-HyperSU），将解混显式分解为固定端元矩阵、丰度块和结构残差精化块三个部分。通过软惩罚放松和约束条件、低秩SVD结构正则化与轻量级深度图像先验（DIP）精化结构化残差，实验表明该方法在不完美端元先验下显著降低联合重建误差（61.7%-69.5%），且不影响丰度估计精度。
AI.motivation: 在模块化高光谱传感流程中，端元通常先被识别然后固定用于丰度估计。当固定端元先验不准确时，由光照变化、传感器伪影或物质边界引起的空间结构化失配会被错误地归因于丰度变量，导致分解不稳定。现有方法缺乏对这种固定端元不匹配问题的可解释性处理。
AI.method: 将解混显式分解为三个模块：固定端元矩阵A、丰度块X（使用FISTA并施加非负性、稀疏性增强及近似和为一的软惩罚约束），以及结构残差精化块S（联合应用低秩SVD结构正则化与轻量级深度图像先验DIP来精化结构化残差）。这种分阶段设计使丰度与残差之间的交互透明可解释。
AI.result: 在Samson、Urban和Jasper Ridge数据集上，软丰度弛豫在固定且不完美端元先验下始终优于硬单纯形投影。在默认N-FINDR端元先验下，联合重建误差比固定端元UCLS基线降低61.7%-69.5%，同时丰度RMSE几乎不变。Urban数据集上重建SAM从X-only模型的5.99°降至完整模型的1.92°。
AI.conclusion: 残差精化分支能够有效捕捉结构化模型失配而不影响丰度估计质量，证明了在固定端元先验条件下引入结构残差建模的重要性，且该框架具有可解释性和实用性。

title: Hi-FLoop: Hierarchical State-Feedback Loops for Multi-Timescale World Modeling
summary: Multi-agent traffic simulation seeks diverse, coordinated, and physically realistic futures from maps and observed history. Long-horizon closed-loop generation must reconcile multiple decision time scales while its context evolves with generated states. Existing methods often unfold long futures from the initial scene and resolve intent, interaction, and motion monolithically, weakening cross-scale consistency and adaptation. We present HI-FLOOP, a branch-consistent multi-timescale state-feedback framework. Eight scene-level Worlds represent joint hypotheses, and all agents share the selected World identity throughout an 8-second rollout. Within the branch, an 8-second Goal anchors intent, a 2-second Preview coordinates interactions, and 1-second Control produces physical motion. Every 0.5-second commit feeds back only its executed prefix as new facts, while unexecuted hypotheses never enter factual memory. Joint Preview Interaction (JPI) induces a sparse directed future graph from Preview and uses conflict probabilities and signed arrival-time differences to gate interaction refinement. For generated-state recovery, a prefix-frozen A-to-B cascade lets frozen Model A generate 0-1 seconds, then transfers typed physical state, admissible context, and the branch index, but no latent state, to an independent Model B for re-encoding and 1-2-second recovery. On the full H-D public-validation split of 955 scenarios, one complete S1 run yields an Overall score of 0.689987 with the official evaluator. Under agent-centric oracle evaluation, HI-FLOOP achieves oracle-minADE@8 of 1.196636 m over the 8-second horizon and 0.526 m over the 6-second horizon.

AI.tldr: HI-FLOOP是一个分支一致的多时间尺度状态反馈框架，用于多智能体长时程交通仿真。它采用8秒Goal、2秒Preview、1秒Control的三层时间尺度结构，通过0.5秒的前缀反馈机制和联合预览交互（JPI）机制，在官方评估器上取得0.689987的Overall分数。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程交通仿真方法多从初始场景单次展开，将意图、交互和运动集成处理，导致跨时间尺度一致性和环境自适应能力不足。
AI.method: 提出HI-FLOOP框架：(1) 八个场景级World作为联合假设分支；(2) 分支内采用8秒Goal-2秒Preview-1秒Control的三层时间尺度；(3) 每0.5秒仅反馈已执行前缀，未执行假设不入事实记忆；(4) JPI机制构建稀疏有向未来图并用冲突概率和到达时间差门控交互精化；(5) 前缀冻结的A-to-B级联用于生成状态恢复。
AI.result: 在955个场景的完整H-D公共验证集上，一次S1运行获得Overall分数0.689987。智能体中心化oracle评估下，oracle-minADE@8在8秒和6秒时域分别达到1.196636米和0.526米。
AI.conclusion: 通过多时间尺度分解和分支一致的状态反馈，HI-FLOOP实现了长时程多智能体仿真的跨尺度协调与生成状态自适应恢复。

title: Evaluation Principles for MRI-MRA Registration in Trigeminal Neuralgia: An ROI-Centered Neurovascular Benchmark
summary: Preoperative evaluation of trigeminal neuralgia (TN) often requires joint interpretation of structural MRI, which depicts the trigeminal nerve and surrounding cisternal anatomy, and time-of-flight MRA, which highlights vascular structures. Although MRI-MRA fusion is clinically attractive for visualizing neurovascular compression, this task is poorly captured by conventional whole-brain registration evaluation because the clinically relevant target is a small trigeminal ROI, vessel annotations are partial and clinically focused, local TOF-MRA contrast is variable, and field-of-view mismatch can limit deformable alignment. We formulate TN MRI-MRA fusion as an ROI-centered neurovascular registration-evaluation problem and construct a benchmark from 149 patients with clinician-annotated bilateral trigeminal ROIs. Six representative registration pipelines were evaluated using local image-based metrics, segmentation-derived vessel-localization metrics, prediction-volume analysis, and contrast- and FOV-stratified comparisons. Conventional evaluation summaries were often misleading: local image similarity, vessel-background separability, and downstream vessel localization did not co-rank methods; one-sided vessel distances were strongly affected by predicted vessel extent under partial annotations; and local MRA contrast determined when vessel-separability metrics were informative. Deformable refinement provided only a small, FOV-dependent benefit over affine alignment, while reader review showed that locally favorable vessel distances could coexist with globally implausible registrations. These findings indicate that TN MRI-MRA registration should be evaluated as a local, vessel-aware, contrast-sensitive, and FOV-aware visualization task rather than as generic multimodal brain registration. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/TN-Reg-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个以ROI为中心的三叉神经痛MRI-MRA融合配准评估基准，基于149例患者数据，发现传统全脑配准评估指标容易产生误导，提出应将该任务视为局部的、血管感知的、对比度与视野敏感的评估问题。
AI.motivation: 三叉神经痛术前评估需要MRI与MRA融合以可视化神经血管压迫，但传统全脑配准评估方法不适用于这一以小范围三叉神经ROI为中心的临床任务，现有评估常产生误导性结论。
AI.method: 从149例患者中构建具有医生标注的双侧三叉神经ROI基准数据集，评估六种代表性配准流程，采用局部图像指标、分割衍生的血管定位指标、预测体积分析以及按对比度和视野分层比较等多种评估手段。
AI.result: 传统评估汇总常具误导性：局部图像相似度、血管背景可分性和下游血管定位等方法排序不一致；单侧血管距离受预测血管范围影响；局部MRA对比度决定血管可分性指标的有效性；可形变精化仅提供微小且依赖视野的优势；读者评审显示局部优选的血管距离可能与全局不合理配准共存。
AI.conclusion: 三叉神经痛MRI-MRA配准应被评估为局部的、血管感知的、对比度敏感的和视野感知的可视化任务，而非通用的多模态脑配准问题，代码已公开。

title: ArmPoser: Real-Time, Calibration-Free Arm Pose Estimation from Smartwatch IMU
summary: Arm pose estimation enables applications in fitness, extended reality input, rehabilitation, and life logging. Prior smartwatch-based approaches rely on calibration poses and preprocessing pipelines that transform raw IMU measurements into standardized training formats. These steps hinder deployment in everyday settings and introduce errors due to imperfect calibration and sensor drift. We present ArmPoser, a calibration-free arm pose estimation system using a single smartwatch IMU. Our central contribution is training models directly in the reference frame native to consumer smartwatches, aligning learning with how IMU data is produced by deployed devices. By operating on device-native axes, ArmPoser removes the need for coordinate transformations, explicit alignment, and bone-offset calibration used in prior work. We further augment training with physically grounded variations in watch placement and arm morphology to account for user-specific variability. ArmPoser also includes a wear-configuration module that infers anterior or posterior forearm placement and crown orientation. We evaluate pose estimation on public benchmarks and on a 10-participant, 30-activity study using watchOS and Android smartwatches, where ArmPoser matches or exceeds calibrated baselines without any user calibration.

AI.tldr: ArmPoser是一个免校准的智能手表单IMU手臂姿态估计系统，直接在消费级智能手表的原生参考坐标系中训练模型，消除了坐标变换、显式对齐和骨骼偏移校准的需求，并通过物理增强的放置位置和手臂形态变化以及佩戴配置模块来适应个体差异，在公开基准和真实用户研究中达到或超过校准基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于智能手表的手臂姿态估计方法依赖校准姿态和预处理流程将原始IMU测量转换为标准化训练格式，这些步骤阻碍了日常场景下的部署，并因不完美的校准和传感器漂移引入误差。
AI.method: ArmPoser直接在消费级智能手表的设备原生参考坐标系中训练模型，消除了坐标变换、显式对齐和骨骼偏移校准；通过物理驱动的腕表放置位置和手臂形态变化增强训练数据以适应用户差异；包含佩戴配置模块推断前臂前后放置位置和表冠方向。
AI.result: 在公开基准测试以及包含10名参与者、30个活动的watchOS和Android智能手表研究中，ArmPoser在无需任何用户校准的情况下达到或超过了校准基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: 在设备原生坐标系下直接训练模型是可行且有效的，能够在不牺牲精度的前提下实现真正的免校准手臂姿态估计，推动了智能手表姿态估计在日常场景中的实用化部署。

title: Beyond Gait: Person Identification from Millimeter-Wave Point Clouds Across Activities of Daily Living
summary: Person identification from millimeter-wave (mmWave) point clouds has mainly relied on gait. Indoor walking, however, is often brief and interrupted, while other activities of daily living (ADLs) may provide complementary identity information. We investigate identification across seven ADLs using mm-ADL, a new point-cloud dataset collected from 11 subjects under a controlled protocol. This extension introduces heterogeneous states and transitions whose spatial and temporal characteristics vary with activity. We therefore study whether activity can provide useful context for learning identity representations. We propose an activity-conditioned framework in which a human activity recognition router dispatches each clip to an activity-specific identity expert. The framework is implemented as a supervised mixture of experts, using a dual-stream static-dynamic PointNet (DS-SDPNet) to combine time-aggregated spatial structure with frame-to-frame information. We evaluate closed-set identification (ID) and subject-disjoint re-identification (ReID). With learned hard routing, ID accuracy increases from 62.1% to 68.0%. In a two-occupant ReID setting, hard routing increases mAP from 57.2% to 75.4% and Rank-1 accuracy from 59.1% to 82.1%. Under a matched gallery partition, activity-specific experts also outperform a shared embedding, showing that the gain extends beyond restricting the gallery. These results support the feasibility of using ADLs beyond gait for identification and the value of activity conditioning under controlled indoor conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用毫米波点云进行人的身份识别，超越传统步态识别，扩展到7种日常生活活动（ADLs）。提出了活动条件化框架（监督混合专家模型），通过活动识别路由器将每个片段路由到特定活动的身份专家模型。在11名受试者的mm-ADL数据集上，闭集识别的准确率从62.1%提升至68.0%，双人重识别场景中mAP从57.2%提升至75.4%，Rank-1准确率从59.1%提升至82.1%。结果表明利用步态以外的ADLs进行身份识别是可行的，活动条件化在受控室内条件下具有价值。
AI.motivation: 传统基于毫米波点云的身份识别主要依靠步态，但室内行走通常短暂且常被打断；而其他日常生活活动（ADLs）可能提供互补的身份信息。作者希望探索ADLs是否可用于身份识别，以及活动上下文是否能提供有用信息来学习身份表征。
AI.method: 提出活动条件化框架：由一个活动识别路由器（HAR）将每个点云片段分发到对应的活动特定身份专家模型。采用监督混合专家（MoE）架构，使用双流静态-动态PointNet（DS-SDPNet）同时提取时间聚合的空间结构和帧间动态信息。该框架支持闭集识别（ID）和受试者分离的重识别（ReID）评估。
AI.result: 封闭集识别准确率从62.1%提高到68.0%（硬路由）；双人重识别场景中，硬路由使mAP从57.2%提高到75.4%，Rank-1准确率从59.1%提高到82.1%。匹配的图库划分条件下，活动特定专家优于共享嵌入模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明利用步态之外的日常生活活动进行身份识别是可行的，活动条件化框架在受控室内条件下能显著提升身份识别性能，其增益不仅限于限制图库规模，还源于活动特定特征的充分利用。

title: Leveraging Visual and Geometric Priors for Metric-scale and Complete Vehicle Gaussian Reconstruction from Limited Views
summary: High-fidelity vehicle assets are essential for controllable traffic scene generation, particularly for synthesizing rare and safety-critical long-tail scenarios. However, reconstructing a reusable vehicle representation from in-the-wild onboard images remains challenging for two reasons. First, image-to-3D generation methods generally produce models without reliable metric scale. Second, onboard cameras usually observe only one side of a target vehicle, making conventional multi-view reconstruction incomplete on unobserved regions. To solve these problems, we propose a feed-forward vehicle asset reconstruction method, which leverages two complementary priors to reconstruct 3D Gaussian representations for vehicles using sparse one-sided observations. To achieve metric-scale reconstruction, a visual foundation model is first utilized to serve as a visual prior for Gaussian initialization. The Gaussian attributes are then estimated by a learnable encoder-decoder module. A symmetry-aware cloning strategy is presented to complete the unobserved side directly in Gaussian space, which exploits the bilateral structure of vehicles as a geometric prior. Experiments on the public dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both vehicle asset completeness and geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种前馈式车辆资产重建方法，利用视觉基础模型和车辆对称性两种互补先验，从稀疏的单侧车载图像中重建具有公制尺度的3D高斯车辆表示，在公开数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高质量的车辆资产对于可控交通场景生成至关重要，尤其是合成罕见和安全关键的长尾场景。然而，从车载野外图像重建可复用的车辆表示面临两个挑战：一是图像到3D生成方法通常缺乏可靠的公制尺度；二是车载相机通常只能观察到车辆的一侧，传统的多视角重建无法完整重建未观察区域。
AI.method: 提出一种前馈式车辆资产重建方法：1) 利用视觉基础模型提供视觉先验进行高斯初始化；2) 通过可学习的编码器-解码器模块估计高斯属性；3) 提出对称感知克隆策略，利用车辆的双边对称结构作为几何先验，直接在高斯空间中补全未观察的一侧。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在车辆资产完整性和几何精度方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合视觉先验和对称性几何先验，该前馈式方法能够从稀疏单侧观测中有效重建具有公制尺度的完整3D车辆高斯表示，为长尾交通场景生成提供了高质量的车辆资产支持。

title: FIRE3D: Feed-forward Interactive 3D Scene Reconstruction Within A Minute
summary: We present FIRE3D, a unified framework that takes a single RGB image or casual RGB video and transforms it into simulation-ready 3D scene assets for games and interactive applications in under a minute. At the core of FIRE3D is a feed-forward, end-to-end network that predicts a compositional scene representation from posed RGB-D observations estimated from the RGB capture, including the 6-DoF pose, bounding box, mesh, and texture for every object. By modeling the scene as a collection of discrete entities, FIRE3D produces amodally complete and simulation-ready environments where objects are physically decoupled and ready for interaction. Our framework requires no test-time optimization, runs orders of magnitude faster than prior interaction-ready methods, and provides object-level completeness beyond existing feed-forward 3D approaches. We demonstrate competitive or state-of-the-art results across pose accuracy, geometry completeness, and texture quality across various datasets while being orders of magnitudes faster. Project page: https://xiahongchi.github.io/Fire3D/

AI.tldr: FIRE3D是一个统一框架，可从单张RGB图像或随意RGB视频中，在一分钟内生成可用于游戏和交互应用的仿真就绪3D场景资产。其核心是一个前馈端到端网络，能从RGB捕获估计的带位姿RGB-D观测中预测组合式场景表征，为每个物体预测6自由度位姿、包围盒、网格和纹理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么前馈3D方法无法提供物体级完整性，要么交互就绪方法需要测试时优化且速度极慢，难以满足游戏和交互应用对快速、仿真就绪3D场景资产的需求。
AI.method: 采用前馈端到端网络，将场景建模为离散实体的集合，从单张RGB图像或RGB视频估计的带位姿RGB-D观测中预测每个物体的6-DoF位姿、包围盒、网格和纹理，无需测试时优化。
AI.result: 框架运行速度比先前交互就绪方法快数个数量级，在姿态精度、几何完整性和纹理质量等多个数据集上取得有竞争力或最先进的成果。
AI.conclusion: FIRE3D通过建模离散实体实现完整、仿真就绪且物理解耦的场景环境，在速度上比现有方法快数个数量级，同时保持高质量结果，为交互应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: DSE-VTG: Dual-Side Enhancement for Training-Free Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Text-guided Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) aims to localize the relevant segments in an untrimmed video based on text queries, yet collecting dense temporal annotations and training task-specific models remain costly and brittle under distribution shift. Recent training-free VTG approaches mitigate this issue by directly matching pretrained vision-language representations, but they still face two fundamental information bottlenecks: frame-wise visual encoding overlooks temporal dynamics, while fixed query embeddings cannot resolve query ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose DSE-VTG, a \underline{D}ual-\underline{S}ide \underline{E}nhancement framework that addresses both without any task-specific training. On the visual side, Multi-scale Similarity Fusion (MSF) combines frame- and clip-level similarities into a unified, temporally aware similarity profile. On the textual side, Query-level Test-Time Adaptation (Q-TTA) optimizes a lightweight additive offset to adapt the query embedding to the video at test time, without finetuning the backbone or calling external large language models. Extensive experiments on three standard and two OOD benchmarks show that DSE-VTG achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. On Charades-STA, it improves mIoU over the strongest prior training-free method by 5.61 points. Under distribution shift, DSE-VTG reaches 50.86 mIoU on Charades-CG Novel-Word, surpassing the strongest supervised baseline by 2.76 mIoU. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSE-VTG，一个无需任务特定训练的视频时序定位框架，通过视觉侧的多尺度相似度融合（MSF）和文本侧的查询级测试时适应（Q-TTA）来同时解决视频时序动态信息和查询歧义两个瓶颈，在多个标准及分布漂移基准上达到训练无关方法的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练无关VTG方法虽避免了密集标注和任务特定模型训练的成本，但仍面临两个信息瓶颈：帧级视觉编码忽略了视频中的时序动态信息，而固定的查询嵌入无法解决文本查询的歧义问题。
AI.method: 提出双侧面增强框架DSE-VTG：(1) 视觉侧采用多尺度相似度融合（MSF），将帧级与片段级相似度合并为统一且具有时序感知的相似度分布；(2) 文本侧采用查询级测试时适应（Q-TTA），优化轻量级加法偏移量以在测试时使查询嵌入适应视频内容，无需微调骨干网络或调用外部大语言模型。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准和两个OOD基准上达到训练无关方法的最优性能。在Charades-STA上较最强训练无关方法mIoU提升5.61点；在分布漂移场景下，Charades-CG Novel-Word上达到50.86 mIoU，超过最强监督基线2.76 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: DSE-VTG通过同时解决视觉和文本两侧的信息瓶颈，证明无须任务特定训练即可实现与监督方法相当甚至更优的性能，尤其在分布漂移场景下展现出更强的鲁棒性。

title: SeGDeP: Semantic- and Geometric-Aware Decoupled Prompts for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation converts an implicit linguistic conclusion into a precise mask, requiring both semantic identification and spatial grounding. Existing MLLM-segmenter interfaces either use a special trigger or compress both signals into one context, although they receive different supervision and fail differently. This coupling obscures whether a failure arises from target interpretation or from localization. We present SeGDeP, an explicit what-where interface. A semantic prompt branch and an independent geometric projection path transform resolved MLLM states into semantic features and a DETR-predicted box, which jointly condition a SAM 3 mask decoder. Training first aligns this executable interface, then uses group reward-decoupled policy optimization (GDPO) to balance format, box-IoU, and mask-IoU feedback. SeGDeP-4B reaches 82.7 average cIoU over eight RefCOCO-family splits and 66.0/59.6 gIoU on ReasonSeg val/test while adapting only 0.38% of Qwen3-VL parameters through LoRA. Controlled stage-wise ablations, gradient diagnostics, and prompt interventions further show that the two paths develop complementary semantic and geometric specialization rather than duplicating the same evidence.

AI.tldr: SeGDeP提出了一种显式的"what-where"接口用于推理分割任务，通过独立的语义提示分支和几何投影路径分别处理目标识别与空间定位，并由SAM 3掩码解码器联合生成分割结果，在RefCOCO和ReasonSeg基准上取得了优异的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM分割模型将语义识别与空间定位两种信号耦合在同一个上下文中，但二者接受不同的监督且失败模式不同，这导致难以区分分割失败源于目标理解问题还是定位问题。作者希望通过解耦这两个过程来明确错误的来源。
AI.method: 提出显式的what-where接口：语义提示分支将MLLM状态转为语义特征，独立的几何投影路径通过DETR预测边界框，两者联合输入SAM 3掩码解码器。训练采用两阶段策略，先对齐可执行接口，再用组奖励解耦策略优化（GDPO）平衡格式、Box-IoU和Mask-IoU反馈。
AI.result: SeGDeP-4B在8个RefCOCO系列子集上达到82.7平均cIoU，在ReasonSeg验证/测试集上分别达到66.0/59.6 gIoU，仅通过LoRA适配了Qwen3-VL 0.38%的参数。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验、梯度诊断和提示干预表明，语义与几何两条路径发展出互补的专业化分工而非重复同一证据，证明了这种解耦设计的有效性。

title: Medical AI Encodes a "Feeling of Error": Verifying Cancer Segmentation via Internal Concepts
summary: Cancer segmentation models can fail silently, generating plausible but incorrect masks that risk missed findings or unnecessary biopsies. A critical question arises: Do AI models "know" when they are wrong, and if so, can we use the signal to predict their own failures? Humans do have a "Feeling of Error" (FOE): a spontaneous sense of unease that flags a potential error during thinking. We investigate whether cancer segmentation models exhibit an analogous internal signal. Unlike output-level cues (e.g., prediction confidence or uncertainty), which offer no insight into why a failure occurs and suffer from a sensitivity-quality tradeoff where high detection sensitivity could degrade overall segmentation quality. We instead propose to capture the model's FOE from its inner workings. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, specifically Sparse Autoencoders, we decompose internal neural activations into a dictionary of human-interpretable concepts and show that failure cases exhibit a distinct latent signature: fewer active concepts with lower activation magnitudes compared to successful segmentation. By training a classifier on these concept activations, we achieve accurate failure detection along with explanations for the model's mistakes. Experiments on prostate, pancreatic, and brain cancer segmentation demonstrate that our approach outperforms output-based methods in failure detection while preserving segmentation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从癌症分割模型的内部神经激活中提取潜在概念信号，类比人类的"错误感"（FOE），实现高准确率的失败检测，同时不牺牲分割质量。
AI.motivation: 癌症分割模型可能静默失败，生成看似合理但不正确的分割掩码，造成漏诊或不必要活检的风险。现有基于输出层面的置信度/不确定性方法不仅无法解释失败原因，还面临灵敏度与分割质量之间的权衡问题。因此，需要从模型内部机制出发，捕捉其"知道自己错误"的信号。
AI.method: 利用可解释性机制工具——稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders），将模型内部神经激活分解为人类可解释的概念字典。观察到失败案例呈现独特的潜在特征：激活的概念更少、激活幅度更低。基于这些概念激活训练一个分类器用于失败检测。
AI.result: 在前列腺癌、胰腺癌和脑癌分割实验中，所提出的方法在失败检测准确率上优于基于输出的方法，同时保持了分割质量。该方法不仅能检测失败，还能提供模型犯错原因的解释。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部确实存在类似人类"错误感"的信号，通过机制可解释性方法捕获该信号可实现更优的失败检测，并兼顾可解释性与分割质量的保持，为安全可靠的医学AI系统提供了新方向。

title: FRAME: Factored Retrieval via Attribute Readouts for Object-Centric Scene Memory
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Woosang Jeon and Sanghyeok Choi contributed equally
summary: Language-guided robots need persistent scene memories to follow instructions, revisit objects, and resolve references to objects encountered over time. While much of language-guided scene-memory retrieval has emphasized spatial or relational references, many everyday object references specify objects by multiple persistent attributes, such as category, material, size, or surface appearance. We formalize this problem as attribute-compositional retrieval, where a fixed object-centric scene memory is queried with natural language to retrieve the object satisfying the requested attributes. To investigate this capability directly, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol with fixed scene memories and attribute-defined targets, separating retrieval from perception and annotation ambiguities. We then propose FRAME, which turns language into query-relevant attribute weights, uses learned readouts to estimate per-attribute evidence from object embeddings, and ranks objects by aggregating this evidence according to the query. Across held-out scenes and object assets, FRAME outperforms representative scene-memory retrieval baselines while reducing post-decomposition object scoring to lightweight matrix-vector computation. These results position attribute-compositional retrieval as a complementary scene-memory capability for language-guided robots, showing that persistent object attributes can be exposed as composable evidence for accurate and efficient multi-attribute retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出属性组合检索问题，即通过自然语言查询由多个持久属性（类别、材质、大小、外观）指定的物体。作者提出了FRAME方法，将语言转化为属性权重，利用学习到的读出从物体嵌入中估计各属性的证据，并聚合证据排序物体，在固定场景记忆上超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的机器人需要持久的场景记忆来理解和执行指令，但现有场景记忆检索大多侧重空间或关系性引用，忽略了日常物体引用常由多个持久属性（如类别、材质、大小、外观）指定的需求，缺乏对此类属性组合检索能力的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出FRAME框架：1）将自然语言查询转化为与查询相关的属性权重；2）使用学习到的读出机制从物体嵌入中估计每个属性的证据分数；3）根据查询权重聚合各属性证据对物体进行排序。同时设计了固定场景记忆和属性定义目标的受控评估协议，将检索与感知和标注歧义分离。
AI.result: 在未见过的场景和物体资产上，FRAME在属性组合检索任务中优于代表性场景记忆检索基线，并将分解后的物体评分简化为轻量级矩阵-向量计算，兼顾了准确性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 属性组合检索可作为语言引导机器人场景记忆的重要补充能力，持久物体属性可被转化为可组合的证据，实现准确且高效的多属性检索。

title: CoSA: Correlation-Guided Change A ttention with Learnable Residual Gating for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Pixel-level annotation of fixed traffic-camera imagery is expensive, while crosswalk models trained from street-level imagery face a substantial viewpoint and appearance shift when applied to elevated CCTV. We investigate a data-efficient target-domain pipeline using 241 manually annotated CCTV images and 5,926 unlabeled CCTV frames. A source-domain experiment trains a 31.0M-parameter custom U-Net on 3,300 first-person-view (FPV) images and obtains 93.05% IoU on its 330-image FPV test split. This result is a source baseline, not transferred performance: the released CCTV notebook instantiates a 42.0M-parameter DeepLabV3-ResNet50 from torchvision weights, and no compatible mapping from the U-Net checkpoint is implemented. Training on 201 manual CCTV images and selecting on 40 held-out manual masks yields 88.91% IoU. The model then predicts all unlabeled frames; image-level certainty and a largest-component area prior rank the candidates, and the top 1,000 attain mean certainty 0.976 and mean combined score 0.988. A repository audit shows that the reported second-stage 98.52% IoU was measured on a 150-image split containing only teacher-generated pseudo-masks. Because of a directory-layout mismatch, the executed combined-data loader found zero manual samples and split 1,000 pseudo-labeled samples into 850 training and 150 evaluation samples. We therefore report 98.52% as internal pseudo-label agreement rather than human-ground-truth accuracy. The defensible target-domain result is 88.91% IoU on the 40 manual validation images. Batch-one FP32 inference at 512 x 512 requires 12.98 ms, corresponding to 77.03 FPS, on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 48 GB GPU. These findings support the practicality of confidence-and-geometry filtering while also showing why pseudo-label evaluation must remain isolated from the labels used for self-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究交通摄像头图像中的人行横道分割任务，利用241张人工标注CCTV图像和5,926张未标注帧构建数据高效的跨视角迁移流程。源域实验（FPV训练的U-Net）达到93.05% IoU，但目标域实际可辩护结果为在40张人工验证图上获得的88.91% IoU。报告的第二阶段98.52% IoU仅是对教师生成伪标签的内部一致性度量，而非人工标注精度。
AI.motivation: 固定交通摄像头图像的人工像素级标注成本高昂，而基于街景图像训练的人行横道模型在应用于高空CCTV视角时存在显著的视角和外观域偏移，需要探索数据高效的跨域迁移方案。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：(1) 源域实验：在3,300张第一人称视角图像上训练31.0M参数的自定义U-Net，获得源域基线；(2) 目标域训练：在201张人工标注CCTV图像上训练42.0M参数的DeepLabV3-ResNet50（torchvision权重），在40张保留人工掩码上验证；(3) 伪标签自训练：模型预测所有未标注帧，通过图像级确定性和最大连通分量面积先验排序候选，选择前1,000张用于后续训练。
AI.result: 源域U-Net在330张FPV测试集上达到93.05% IoU；目标域模型在40张人工CCTV验证图上达到88.91% IoU；排名前1,000的伪标记候选平均确定性为0.976，平均综合得分为0.988。仓库审计发现98.52%的IoU是仅含教师生成伪掩码的150张分割上的内部一致性度量，而非真实人工标注精度。512×512分辨率下FP32推理耗时12.98ms（77.03 FPS），基于NVIDIA RTX A6000。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持置信度与几何过滤策略的实用性，并强调了伪标签评估必须与自训练所用标签保持隔离的关键方法论教训。可信的目标域结果应为88.91% IoU。

title: EgoSIS: From Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions to Motion-Canonical Spatial Evidence for UAV Reasoning
summary: UAV video question answering requires separating camera motion from changes in the scene, but RGB-only multimodal models receive no explicit, stable reference for that separation. We present EgoSIS, a pose-free adapter that converts RGB-derived bidirectional flow into motion-canonical visual evidence in three stages. Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions (FVET) fits a robust image-plane transition and exposes motion, residual-support, and reliability factors. Reliability-Gated Ego-Transition Memory (ReTEM) uses reliability-weighted updates for a bounded history and re-anchors it at cuts or sustained uncertainty. Ego-Aligned Spatial Evidence (EASE) warps supported visual features into each segment's local anchor and injects four spatial evidence tokens per visual slice through zero-initialized residuals, without changing Qwen's visual-token count. On SIS-Bench, EgoSIS-8B obtains 89.9\% perception, 82.5\% perception-plus-memory, and 76.2\% overall accuracy, with the largest gains concentrated in self-awareness perception and memory. The adapter thus provides an interpretable interface between optical flow and spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoSIS，一种免姿态适配器，通过三阶段将RGB衍生的双向光流转换为运动规范的视觉证据，用于无人机视频问答，在不改变Qwen视觉token数量的情况下显著提升感知与记忆准确率。
AI.motivation: 无人机视频问答需要将相机运动与场景变化分离，但仅基于RGB的多模态模型缺乏明确的、稳定的参考来实现这种分离，导致模型难以区分自我运动与场景中的真实变化。
AI.method: EgoSIS包含三个阶段：(1) FVET拟合鲁棒的图像平面转换并提取运动、残差支持和可靠性因子；(2) ReTEM使用可靠性加权更新维护有界历史，并在切变或持续不确定时重新锚定；(3) EASE将支持视觉特征扭曲到各段局部锚点，通过零初始化残差注入四个空间证据token，不改变Qwen视觉token数量。
AI.result: 在SIS-Bench上，EgoSIS-8B达到89.9%的感知准确率、82.5%的感知+记忆准确率和76.2%的整体准确率，最大的提升集中在自我意识感知和记忆任务上。
AI.conclusion: 该适配器在光流与空间推理之间提供了可解释的接口，证明免姿态的运动证据注入能有效提升无人机场景下视频问答的感知与记忆能力。

title: Prior-free relative 6D pose estimation of multiple object instances
summary: Object 6D pose estimation formulations have progressively reduced reliance on object-specific priors, evolving from explicit 3D models to multi-view object captures to single reference images. We take this progression to its extreme by introducing prior-free relative 6D pose estimation, which lifts the assumption of knowing which object is to be posed within the scene. This novel setting aims to estimate the relative poses of multiple instances of an unknown object within the same image, without requiring CAD models, templates, or reference images. We solve this by formulating a novel method (PROSE) that finds coarse correspondences between object instances using multimodal foundation features, thus requiring no training. We refine these correspondences by imposing cycle consistency across tuples of instances, and leverage the resulting globally consistent correspondences to estimate the relative 6D pose between any pair of instances. To enable systematic evaluation, we design a novel benchmark (PRENCH) built from three multi-instance BOP datasets and enriched with task-specific metadata. PROSE consistently outperforms baselines obtained by adapting state-of-the-art single-image methods to the proposed setting, while requiring neither task-specific supervision nor additional learned components. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/PROSE/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了无先验的相对6D姿态估计方法PROSE，无需CAD模型、模板或参考图像即可在单张图像中估计未知物体的多实例间相对位姿，并设计了新基准PRENCH进行评估。
AI.motivation: 物体6D姿态估计对物体特定先验的依赖逐渐减弱（从3D模型到多视图捕获再到单参考图像），本文旨在彻底消除这一依赖，即无需知道场景中要估计姿态的具体物体，实现完全无先验的相对姿态估计。
AI.method: 提出PROSE方法：利用多模态基础特征在物体实例间寻找粗对应关系（无需训练）；通过跨实例元组的循环一致性约束来细化对应关系；利用全局一致的对应关系估计任意实例对之间的相对6D姿态。同时设计新基准PRENCH，基于三个多实例BOP数据集构建并加入任务特定元数据。
AI.result: PROSE在基准上一致优于通过改编最先进单图像方法得到的基线，且无需任务特定监督或额外学习的组件。
AI.conclusion: PROSE成功将6D姿态估计推向完全无先验的极端设置，证明了基于基础特征的免训练方法在该新任务上的可行性与优越性，为该方向提供了系统的评估基准。

title: Concentrate After Imagination: Text-Conditioned Evidence Grounding for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) retrieves untrimmed videos when queries describe only short moments. Although recent methods improve local representations, uncertainty modeling, and global context, final ranking often still trusts the strongest local response; a coincidentally similar fragment can therefore produce an unsupported peak. We identify this failure as the query-agnostic concentration bottleneck and propose TRACE, a score-level evidence verification operator for PRVR. Given a query and global video registers, TRACE activates query-relevant registers, routes their support to frame-level evidence, and smoothly marginalizes alternative query-to-register-to-frame paths before localized temporal selection. Unlike representation-level feature fusion, TRACE uses this evidence only as a query-conditioned residual calibration of the original local score. On ActivityNet Captions, Charades-STA, and TVR, TRACE achieves the best SumR on all three benchmarks and improves the DreamPRVR backbone by 1.2, 1.1, and 1.5 points, respectively. Ablation, routing-corruption, hard-negative, and cross-backbone transfer analyses support the interpretation that the gains arise from query-conditioned evidence verification rather than a generic score offset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE，一种解决部分相关视频检索（PRVR）中"查询无关注意力瓶颈"问题的分数级证据验证算子。TRACE通过激活查询相关的全局视频寄存器，将其支持路由到帧级证据，并在局部时间选择前对备选路径进行平滑边际化，仅作为查询条件残差校准原始局部分数。在ActivityNet Captions、Charades-STA和TVR三个基准上取得最佳SumR。
AI.motivation: PRVR旨在检索仅描述短暂时刻的查询对应的未剪辑视频。虽然现有方法改进了局部表示、不确定性建模和全局上下文，但最终排序往往仍信任最强的局部响应，导致偶然相似的片段产生无依据的峰值。作者将此失败识别为"查询无关的注意力瓶颈"，即模型无法根据查询来验证局部证据的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出TRACE，一个分数级证据验证算子。具体流程为：(1) 给定查询和全局视频寄存器，激活查询相关的寄存器；(2) 将这些寄存器的支持路由到帧级证据；(3) 在局部时间选择前对替代的查询-寄存器-帧路径进行平滑边际化；(4) 仅将得到的证据用作查询条件残差，校准原始局部分数，而非进行表征级特征融合。
AI.result: 在ActivityNet Captions、Charades-STA和TVR上，TRACE均取得最佳SumR；相较于DreamPRVR基线，分别提升1.2、1.1和1.5个百分点。消融实验、路由破坏实验、难负样本分析及跨骨干迁移分析均支持增益来源于查询条件证据验证而非通用分数偏移的解释。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过分数级证据验证有效解决了PRVR中偶然相似片段导致错误排序的问题，其增益来源被实验证实是查询条件的证据验证机制，具有良好的泛化性和可解释性。

title: DXPR: Depth-Based Vision-LiDAR Cross-Modal Place Recognition Using Vision Foundation Models
summary: We present DXPR, a depth-based cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) framework that uses vision foundation models (VFMs) to match monocular camera queries against a LiDAR map without modality-specific encoders. This enables robots and autonomous vehicles to robustly localize using only cameras within pre-built LiDAR maps, even under severe seasonal, weather, and illumination changes. The key idea is to convert both camera images and LiDAR scans into a unified depth image representation so that a single VFM backbone with an aggregation head can learn modality-invariant global descriptors. To make pairwise metric learning faithful to scene geometry, we introduce a geometry-aware overlap miner: after cross-modal scale alignment of camera and LiDAR depth, we forward-warp measurements between views to compute a pixel-level overlap score. This score relabels ambiguous pairs and adaptively modulates the positive margin in a multi-similarity loss to avoid overfitting on weakly overlapping views. Extensive experiments on KITTI odometry and Boreas demonstrate strong performance and robustness across seasons, weather, and day/night. On KITTI, DXPR achieves near-perfect Recall@1 on most sequences and outperforms prior CMPR baselines. On Boreas, DXPR achieves intra-sequence performance on par with a strong single-modal baseline (DINOv2-SALAD), while showing clear improvements in the more challenging inter-sequence setting. Compared with RangeBEV, our method consistently performs better in both intra- and inter-sequence evaluations, demonstrating robustness under diverse seasonal and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: 提出DXPR，一种基于深度的跨模态位置识别框架，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）将单目相机查询与LiDAR地图进行匹配，通过统一的深度图像表示实现模态不变全局描述符，无需特定模态编码器。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要在恶劣季节、天气和光照变化下仅使用相机在预构建的LiDAR地图中进行鲁棒定位，但现有跨模态位置识别方法依赖特定模态编码器，难以应对环境变化。
AI.method: 将相机图像和LiDAR扫描统一转换为深度图像表示，使用单一VFM骨干网络加聚合头学习模态不变的全局描述符；提出几何感知重叠挖掘器，通过跨模态尺度对齐和正向投影计算像素级重叠分数，用于重新标注模糊配对并自适应调制多相似度损失的正边缘。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上达到接近完美的Recall@1并超越先前CMPR基线；在Boreas数据集上，序内性能与强单模态基线（DINOv2-SALAD）相当，序间设置中表现明显改进；与RangeBEV相比在序内和序间评估中均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: DXPR通过统一的深度图像表示和VFM骨干网络，有效实现了仅依赖相机的跨模态位置识别，在季节、天气和昼夜变化下展现出鲁棒性，验证了无需模态特定编码器的CMPR可行性。

title: A Joint 2D-3D Statistical Shape Model for Orthopedic Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to MICCAI Workshop on Shape in Medical Imaging (ShapeMI)
summary: Three-dimensional femoral reconstruction from radiographs supports surgical planning, implant sizing, and post-operative follow-up, but remains ill-posed as X-ray projections discard depth information. Existing methods often incorporate a 3D statistical shape model (SSM) as a shape prior to guide reconstructions toward anatomically plausible shapes, relying on iterative 3D-to-2D projection matching. Yet, these approaches are computationally expensive and constrain their SSM to a single dimensionality, leaving the statistical relationship between 2D observations and 3D geometry largely unexploited and unexplored. We instead propose a joint 2D-3D SSM that explicitly captures the co-variation between 2D and 3D segmentations in a shared latent space. During training, 2D and 3D segmentations are registered to a common 3D template and its corresponding 2D projections, and the resulting stationary velocity fields are jointly decomposed using principal component analysis (PCA). This joint modeling allows the 2D-to-3D mapping to be learned directly from data rather than computing correspondences at inference time. For unseen subjects, the 3D shape is recovered directly by lifting the 2D latent coordinates to the 3D PCA subspace, thereby eliminating the need for iterative 3D-to-2D projection. Experiments on NMDID demonstrate that the proposed joint 2D-3D SSM outperforms a widely-used 3D-only SSM baseline while achieving inference approximately 4 times faster, at under 3 seconds per subject. The code is available at: https://github.com/florence-dellaniello-picard/joint2d3d-ssm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合2D-3D统计形状模型（SSM），通过共享潜空间显式捕捉2D与3D分割之间的协变关系，实现从X光片直接三维股骨重建，无需迭代3D-2D投影匹配，推理速度约4倍于传统方法，平均不到3秒/人。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D统计形状模型的二维X光片三维重建方法存在两个问题：一是依赖迭代式3D-2D投影匹配，计算成本高；二是在单一维度上约束SSM，未充分利用2D观测与3D几何之间的统计关系。
AI.method: 提出联合2D-3D SSM：将2D和3D分割图分别配准到公共3D模板及其对应2D投影上，利用PCA对所得平稳速度场进行联合分解，获得共享潜空间。推理时通过将2D潜坐标映射到3D PCA子空间直接恢复3D形状，消除推理阶段的对应计算和迭代投影匹配。
AI.result: 在NMDID数据集上的实验表明，所提出的联合2D-3D SSM优于广泛使用的3D-only SSM基线，且推理速度约为基线的4倍，每个受试者推理时间不到3秒。
AI.conclusion: 联合2D-3D SSM有效利用2D与3D的协变信息，在提升重建精度的同时大幅加速推理，为X光片驱动的三维重建提供了一种更高效且更准确的替代方案。

title: Spheriverse: 3D Scene Understanding from Spherical Observations in the Wild
comment: The established benchmark and source code will be available at https://feit-feiteng.github.io/Spheriverse
summary: Spherical observations provide global visual context for 3D scene understanding. However, visual information is encoded in an angular domain, whereas the physical world is represented in Cartesian coordinates. This cross-space representation gap complicates geometric correspondence and semantic evidence aggregation. To delve into this challenge, we introduce Spheriverse, comprising $64,400$ temporally aligned spherical image-LiDAR pairs organized into 644 sequences. The dataset spans diverse scenes, illumination, and weather conditions, with fine-grained semantic classes. We further establish benchmarks for semantic occupancy prediction, semantic mapping, and 3D object detection, evaluating 30+ methods through overall and scene-wise comparisons. For dense prediction, we propose SphereOcc, an occupancy framework that couples spherical geometry modeling with semantic evidence retrieval. Cartesian-Spherical Representation Remodeling (CSRR) incorporates spherical range-azimuth geometry into Cartesian voxel features through region-wise modulation. Spherical Evidence Re-querying (SER) then conditions queries on voxel content and range-height-azimuth geometry to adaptively retrieve relevant semantic evidence from source spherical image features. SphereOcc achieves 13.91% mIoU and 24.65% GeoIoU, outperforming the respective best-performing methods, TPVFormer and SurroundOcc, by 1.70 and 2.10 percentage points. It also ranks first in both metrics across all five scenes, with consistent advantages across the evaluated spatial partitions and reduced fields of view. The established benchmark and source code will be available at https://feit-feiteng.github.io/Spheriverse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spheriverse数据集（含64,400对球面图像-LiDAR数据，覆盖多场景），并引入SphereOcc占用预测框架来处理球面图像与笛卡尔坐标间的跨空间表征差距问题。
AI.motivation: 球面图像提供3D场景理解的全局视觉上下文，但视觉信息处于角度域而物理世界为笛卡尔坐标，这种跨空间表征差距阻碍了几何对应和语义证据聚合。
AI.method: 提出SphereOcc框架：(1) CSRR（笛卡尔-球面表征重塑），将球面距离-方位角几何通过区域调制融入笛卡尔体素特征；(2) SER（球面证据重查询），基于体素内容和距离-高度-方位角几何自适应地从球面图像特征检索语义证据。
AI.result: SphereOcc在语义占用预测上达到13.91% mIoU和24.65% GeoIoU，分别超过最优方法TPVFormer和SurroundOcc 1.70和2.10个百分点；在全部五种场景中均排名第一，并在不同空间分区和视场缩减条件下保持优势。
AI.conclusion: SphereOcc有效解决了球面-笛卡尔跨空间表征问题，同时Spheriverse数据集和基准为球面图像驱动的3D场景理解提供了全面评估平台。

title: PIC: Revisiting INR for Image Coding with Fast Encoding and Sub-Millisecond Decoding
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis and image/video coding in recent years.Compared to conventional end-to-end image codecs, INR-based compressors demonstrate significant advantages in decoding complexity. However, their practical application has been hindered by the inferior encoding speed and underutilized decoding efficiency.In this work, we propose a feedforward INR image coding architecture, Practical INR Image Codec (PIC), that computes all the necessary information for INR network in a single forward pass, achieving an encoding speed of 20 FPS. Additionally, we implement a highly optimized decoder that reaches 2000 FPS decoding speed, significantly surpassing JPEG's performance at comparable rate-distortion (RD) performance. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first learning-based image codec that simultaneously outperforms or is comparable with JPEG in both RD performance and decoding speed while maintaining practical encoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIC（Practical INR Image Codec），一种前馈式隐式神经表示图像编码架构，通过单次前向传播计算INR网络所需的全部信息，实现20 FPS的编码速度和2000 FPS的解码速度，在率失真性能与JPEG相当或更优的同时，解码速度显著超越JPEG，据作者称是首个在这三方面同时达到实用性能的基于学习的图像编解码器。
AI.motivation: INR（隐式神经表示）在图像编码中相比传统端到端编码器具有显著的解码复杂度优势，但其实际应用受到编码速度慢和解码效率未充分利用的阻碍。
AI.method: 提出PIC前馈式INR图像编码架构：所有INR网络所需信息在单次前向传播中计算完成，实现20 FPS编码速度；同时实现高度优化的解码器，达到2000 FPS解码速度。
AI.result: 编码速度达到20 FPS，解码速度达到2000 FPS；在相当的率失真性能下，解码速度显著超越JPEG。
AI.conclusion: PIC是首个在率失真性能和解码速度方面同时超越或媲美JPEG，同时保持实用编码速度的基于学习的图像编解码器。

title: Task-driven Processing with Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception
summary: State-of-the-art vision models process images in their entirety, lacking the ability to selectively zoom in on relevant regions. This limitation is particularly acute in scenarios where processing must be conditioned on a specific task - such as instance detection, which requires localizing a specific object in a high-resolution, cluttered scene. In such settings, critical details are easily lost as images are often resized to match the model dimensions and computational constraints. We introduce Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception (CF-GAP), a task-driven front-end that enhances high-resolution processing of existing instance detectors. CF-GAP selectively directs a sequence of limited view glimpses across the scene, utilizing task information to iteratively refine focus on the most relevant regions. These localized regions are then processed at high resolution by a downstream instance detector. By avoiding full-image processing and eliminating irrelevant confounding information, CF-GAP improves Average Precision (AP) by up to 20% across various state-of-the-art instance detectors on the HR-InsDet and Robotools benchmarks, while further enabling lightweight detectors to outperform their larger counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CF-GAP（Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception），一种任务驱动的图像处理前端模块，通过选择性引导一系列有限的view glimpses（局部视图）迭代聚焦场景中最相关的区域，以高分辨率处理这些局部区域，从而提升现有实例检测器在杂乱高分辨率场景中的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的最先进视觉模型对整幅图像进行处理，缺乏对相关区域选择性放大（zoom in）的能力。在需要针对特定任务进行条件化处理的场景中（如高分辨率杂乱场景下的实例检测），图像常被压缩以适配模型尺寸和计算约束，导致关键细节丢失，检测性能受限。
AI.method: CF-GAP作为一个任务驱动的前端模块：它通过粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的策略，选择性地引导一系列有限数量的局部视图（glimpses）跨场景进行感知，利用任务信息迭代地精化聚焦于最相关的区域；随后将这些局部区域以高分辨率交给下游实例检测器处理。
AI.result: 在HR-InsDet和Robotools基准测试上，CF-GAP使多种最先进的实例检测器的平均精度（AP）提升高达20%；同时能使轻量级检测器超越其更大型的对应版本。
AI.conclusion: 通过避免全图处理并消除无关的混淆信息，CF-GAP能有效提升现有实例检测器在高分辨率杂乱场景下的性能，并展示出使小型模型获得更强能力的潜力。

title: "World Knowledge" in the Weights: Reading Concept Circuits of Vision Transformers
summary: Vision transformers (ViTs) have achieved remarkable generalization across visual domains, yet little is known about how they internally represent the structure of the world. To address this gap, we use Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) to read concept circuits from ViTs: directed graphs whose nodes correspond to sparse, interpretable concepts and edges capture concept interactions across layers. Our method yields two complementary views of model behavior. The global concept circuit is input-invariant and can be recovered directly from learned cross-layer weights, exposing the reusable "world knowledge" encoded in the model. The instance concept circuit is input-dependent and identifies the concepts and pathways actually used for a specific prediction, enabling faithful example-level explanations. We demonstrate the utility of concept circuits in three ways: (1) Automatic spurious correlation discovery: leveraging the statistics of our global concept circuits to identify shortcut dependencies within the model. (2) Spurious correlation removal: intervening on the instance concept circuit to steer the model towards correct predictions. Empirical results show that our method outperforms existing counterparts by 11.0% on the Waterbird dataset. (3) Model comparison: contrasting the global concept circuits of different foundation models (e.g., CLIP vs. DINO) to reveal how supervision paradigms shape representational structure. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/VisionCLT

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用跨层转码器（CLTs）从视觉Transformer（ViTs）中读取概念回路，分别提取输入不变和输入相关的两种回路视图，用于发现并移除虚假相关性以及比较不同基础模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉Transformer在多个视觉领域表现出色，但其内部如何表征世界结构仍缺乏理解。作者希望弥合这一认知鸿沟，揭示ViT内部的概念组织与交互方式。
AI.method: 利用Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs)从ViT中提取概念回路。全局概念回路是输入不变的，直接从跨层权重中恢复，编码可复用的世界知识；实例概念回路是输入依赖的，识别特定预测实际使用的概念与路径，用于示例级解释。
AI.result: 在Waterbird数据集上，该方法在虚假相关性移除任务中比现有方法高出11.0%的准确率。方法还实现了自动虚假相关性发现和模型结构比较（如CLIP vs DINO）。
AI.conclusion: 概念回路为理解ViT内部表征提供了双视角框架：既能揭示模型的全局可复用知识结构，也能提供实例级可解释性。该方法在虚假相关性发现/移除和模型比较方面均展现有效性，并开源了代码。

title: GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting
summary: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. An effect confirmed by a second, independent correction on a different class, indicating that language-space embeddings track physical content more faithfully. This fidelity extends to genuinely out-of-vocabulary (OOV) objects on ScanNet++ proving that language-space embeddings separate presence from absence objects far more sharply than CLIP-based embeddings do. GoDeep also localize these OOV objects within the scene, all without any 2D-3D annotation. Because every representation remains discrete text, predictions are also explainable at the point level. Finally, exploiting both a heuristic weighting, that favors precise over merely frequent observations and GoDeep's explainability property, we propose an aggregation strategy, as a proof of concept, that favors finer elements localization.

AI.tldr: 提出GoDeep方法，将视觉-语言模型仅用作翻译器，生成结构化实体级场景描述，并在纯语言嵌入空间中完成3D语义分割，无需3D训练语料或专用3D编码器。
AI.motivation: 现有的开放词汇3D语义分割方法通常将CLIP特征提升到3D，但CLIP嵌入在组合任务上表现类似词袋模型，且无标注变体仍需要大规模3D训练语料和专用3D编码器，缺乏跨领域的泛化性。
AI.method: 使用视觉-语言模型作为翻译器，将每张带姿态的图像转换为结构化、实体级的文本描述。这些描述被grounded、投影并直接在纯语言嵌入空间中聚合，无需3D训练语料库或3D编码器。同时提出利用启发式加权和可解释性的聚合策略，偏向精确而非频繁的观察。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++上与强无标注基线相竞争；在文化遗产基准上，通过单一系统性词汇修正即可逆转排名；语言空间嵌入对OOV物体能更尖锐地区分存在与不存在；能定位OOV物体且无需任何2D-3D标注，预测在点级别可解释。
AI.conclusion: GoDeep证明纯语言嵌入空间比CLIP嵌入更忠实地反映物理内容，在无训练语料、无专用编码器且无需标注的条件下实现具有可解释性的开放词汇3D语义分割。

title: Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have shown great potential in real-time video generation. Recent methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into causal AR students through Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but the generated videos often suffer from over-saturation and over-smoothing issues, resulting in limited visual quality and realism. The key contributing factor is the mode-seeking behavior of the reverse KL objective in DMD, which can cause the student distribution to collapse onto only a few modes of the teacher distribution. To address this, we propose Mask Forcing, a Dual-Noise Masking Rollout strategy that perturbs the AR student self-rollout to mitigate mode collapse induced by reverse-KL mode seeking. The core idea is to inject cleaner signals into noisy rollout inputs via random masks along spatial and temporal axes during the self-rollout process of AR diffusion distillation. Such perturbations encourage the student rollouts to explore more regions of the teacher distribution, allowing DMD to provide learning signals beyond the modes already covered by the student. Moreover, the cleaner tokens act as denoising guidance for other noisier tokens, improving the intermediate rollout predictions and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method improves multiple AR video diffusion distillation methods with higher visual quality efficiently, without incorporating real video data or additional post-training stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mask Forcing策略，通过在自回归视频扩散模型蒸馏过程中对自回归自展开施加双噪声掩膜扰动，缓解逆向KL散度导致的模式坍缩问题，从而提升生成视频的视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在实时视频生成中表现优异，但通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）从双向模型蒸馏为因果自回归学生模型时，生成的视频常出现过饱和和过平滑问题。根本原因是DMD中逆向KL目标具有模式寻求（mode-seeking）行为，导致学生分布坍缩到教师分布的少数模式上。
AI.method: 提出Mask Forcing，一种双噪声掩膜展开（Dual-Noise Masking Rollout）策略。在自回归扩散蒸馏的自展开过程中，沿空间和时间轴随机施加掩膜，将更干净（cleaner）的信号注入到带噪声的展开输入中。这种扰动促使学生展开探索教师分布的更广区域，使DMD能提供超出学生已覆盖模式的更多学习信号；同时干净token作为其他噪声token的去噪引导，改善中间展开预测并减少误差累积。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法能够在无需真实视频数据或额外后训练阶段的情况下，以更高的视觉质量和计算效率改进多种自回归视频扩散蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: Mask Forcing有效解决了AR视频扩散蒸馏中由逆向KL模式寻求引起的模式坍缩问题，为提升生成视频的真实感和视觉质量提供了一种无需额外数据的通用改进方案。

title: Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs
summary: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision encoders and VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文以典型颜色（canonical color）为受控测试案例，研究视觉编码器在灰度图像中是否仍能线性解码出物体的概念性颜色信息，并探讨这一现象与物体身份识别及VLM后训练的关系。
AI.motivation: 视觉编码器为视觉-语言模型构建图像表征，但其中除了直接可见信息外包含多少概念性信息仍不清楚。典型颜色是理想的受控测试案例，可用于追踪视觉编码器中物体层面的概念性语义信息。
AI.method: 构建具有典型颜色的物体数据集，在彩色和灰度图像上对视觉编码器进行探测（probing），测试颜色和物体身份的可解码性；同时扩展到完整VLM，检验后训练对颜色可解码性的影响。
AI.result: 典型颜色可以从灰度图像中解码出来，且与预测的物体身份相关联，表明存在概念性联系；VLM后训练对视觉编码器中颜色可解码性有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 典型颜色是追踪视觉编码器和VLM中物体层面概念性语义信息的有效受控视角，揭示了表征中概念性信息的存在及其受训练影响的性质。

title: Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction
summary: We introduce Point4D, a feed-forward model for 4D reconstruction of long-range video sequences. Point4D is able to reliably infer dense per-point 3D trajectories across multi-hundred-frame videos, unlike existing 4D methods that are limited to short input windows of at most a few dozen frames. A key innovation that enables this is our flexible 3D query-based motion decoder that decouples trajectory prediction from image-plane visibility. The predicted 3D endpoints are then directly re-queried in the next chunk without re-projection or matching. Furthermore, we show that extracting and reusing a visual descriptor from an arbitrary frame where the point is visible leads to better performance than relying solely on the source patch. Overall, Point4D achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-video tracking benchmarks spanning over 200 frames and largely outperforms previous feed-forward 4D method. Project page: https://point-4d.github.io

AI.tldr: Point4D是一个用于长视频序列4D重建的前馈模型，能够在数百帧视频中可靠推断稠密逐点3D轨迹，打破了现有4D方法仅支持数十帧短输入的限制。其关键创新在于灵活的3D查询运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像平面可见性解耦，并直接重新查询3D端点，无需重投影或匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有4D重建方法受限于短输入窗口（最多数十帧），无法处理多百帧长视频中的稠密3D轨迹预测，需要一种能够应对长距离视频序列的4D重建方法。
AI.method: 提出了基于3D查询的运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像平面可见性解耦；预测的3D端点在下个块中直接重新查询而无需重投影或匹配；从任意可见帧中提取并重用视觉描述符，而非仅依赖源图块。
AI.result: Point4D在跨越200帧以上的多种长视频跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，大幅优于此前的前馈4D方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过3D查询解码器和跨帧视觉描述符复用的设计，Point4D成功将4D重建扩展至长视频场景，为长时序列稠密3D运动理解提供了有效方案。

title: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators
summary: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

AI.tldr: SyncWorld是一个动作条件的世界模型，通过利用视觉校准序列（配对帧和动作）来指定上下文中的动作-视觉映射，实现无需额外训练的跨环境零样本模拟器，可用于测试时策略改进。
AI.motivation: 机器人的动作在像素空间中并非通用语言：环境变化、相机视角、机器人位置或形态的改变都会导致相同数值动作产生不同的视觉表现，使得混合训练时出现冲突监督，部署时泛化脆弱。
AI.method: SyncWorld利用视觉校准序列（成对的帧和动作，展示所有可控自由度）在上下文中指定特定设置的动作-视觉映射。训练时使用视觉校准上下文，教导模型通过视觉证据解释动作，并在没有显式校准时利用交互历史。
AI.result: SyncWorld能够在未见过的环境中准确模拟动作结果，其模拟回滚能力使得无需训练的测试时策略改进成为可能。
AI.conclusion: SyncWorld通过上下文视觉校准机制解决了跨环境动作语义不一致的问题，实现了零样本世界模型模拟，拓展了世界模型在机器人策略学习中的应用。
